title: Real Estate Manager
description:
**Company Description**
  
  
Astittva Marketing is a real estate advisory firm that connects buyers and investors with premium residential and commercial properties across Kolkata. The company focuses on trusted guidance, offering verified projects and transparent information to support confident decision-making. Astittva Marketing provides end-to-end real estate assistance, from property discovery and evaluation to transaction support. The team is committed to delivering professional, client-centric services that simplify the property search and investment process. Applicants can expect to join a growing organization that values integrity, local market expertise, and long-term relationships.
  
  
**Role Description**
The Real Estate Manager will oversee a portfolio of residential and commercial properties in Kolkata, ensuring effective property management and strong client relationships. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kolkata, involving frequent visits to project locations, developer offices, and client meetings. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing property listings, coordinating site visits, advising clients on property options, and supporting negotiations on leases and sales. The Real Estate Manager will handle documentation related to leases, agreements, and compliance requirements, while maintaining accurate records and reports. The role also involves monitoring market trends, building partnerships with developers, and contributing to marketing initiatives that enhance the visibility of Astittva Marketing’s property offerings.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess experience in Real Estate and Commercial Real Estate, with strong knowledge of the Kolkata property market.
* Candidates should possess skills in Property Management to oversee residential and commercial assets efficiently.
* Candidates should possess expertise in Lease Administration and Leases, including documentation, tracking, and compliance.
* Candidates should possess strong client service, negotiation, and communication skills to manage buyers, investors, and developers.
* Relevant experience in real estate brokerage, property consulting, or asset management is beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site, travel within Kolkata for meetings and site visits, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Real Estate, or a related field is preferred.
* Proficiency in basic office software and familiarity with real estate CRM or listing tools is an advantage.

title: SAP BDC-DSP-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting - Manager:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Join our SAP BI & Analytics practice as an SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) Manager and lead the delivery of enterprise-scale data transformation initiatives. You will be responsible for driving solution strategy, managing teams, engaging with senior business stakeholders, and delivering innovative analytics and data platform solutions leveraging SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP BW/4HANA, and SAP S/4HANA. This role offers the opportunity to shape clients' data modernization journeys and help them realize business value through data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of SAP Business Data Cloud and analytics transformation programs.
* Define data architecture, solution roadmaps, and implementation strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Manage client relationships and serve as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders.
* Lead workshops to gather business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP data and analytics solutions.
* Oversee the design and implementation of data models, semantic layers, reporting, and planning solutions.
* Drive integration of SAP and non-SAP data sources into the enterprise analytics landscape.
* Ensure adherence to data governance, security, compliance, and quality standards.
* Manage project planning, resource allocation, budgets, risks, and delivery milestones.
* Mentor and develop consultants, senior consultants, and team leads.
* Support business development activities, proposal creation, solution estimations, and pre-sales engagements.
* Identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement within client environments.
* Collaborate with global teams to deliver complex transformation programs.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong experience with minimum 3 end to end implementations in SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP BW/4HANA, and SAP HANA.
* Deep understanding of enterprise data warehousing, data modelling, data integration, and analytics architectures.
* Experience designing and implementing cloud-based analytics and reporting solutions.
* Proven leadership experience managing cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong stakeholder and executive management skills.
* Experience leading large-scale SAP transformation programs.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Knowledge of data governance, master data management, and data quality frameworks.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery oversight.

**<< Ideally, you’ll also>>**

* SAP certifications in Business Data Cloud, Datasphere, BW/4HANA, SAC, or SAP HANA.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with SAP Data Intelligence, SAP Integration Suite, and modern data integration technologies.
* Knowledge of AI/ML-enabled analytics and data products.
* Experience delivering Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, or Manufacturing analytics solutions.
* Exposure to enterprise data platform modernization and migration programs.

**<< What we look for>>**
We are looking for motivated professionals who are passionate about data, analytics, and digital transformation. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical expertise, a continuous learning mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams to deliver business value through innovative SAP data and analytics solutions. They should be proactive, adaptable, and committed to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Supervisor, Commercial Operations
description:
Company Overview:
  
  
Flowserve is a global manufacturer of pumps, valves, seals, and aftermarket services, delivering comprehensive flow control solutions that support essential industries such as energy, clean water, and pharmaceuticals. If you're looking for a culture built on ingenuity, innovation, and excellence, Flowserve offers the opportunity to put your experience in motion. Whether you're an individual contributor or a people leader, you'll find meaningful opportunities for professional growth, competitive rewards, and a workplace grounded in our core values: People, Safety, Integrity, Ownership and Ingenuity. At Flowserve, we're inspired by what we can achieve together—creating extraordinary flow control solutions that strengthen today's world while building tomorrow.
  
  
**Role Summary:**
The role of the Supervisor is to be a player / coach. This includes driving the responsiveness of their assigned Commercial Operations team to enable us to increase bookings overall. While maintaining responsibility for some quoting activity, this position will be responsible for building a highly responsive and customer driven group. The group will be focused on providing our Flowserve sales organization, customers, distributors, and 3rd party representative channel partners with the most technically sound and competitive quotation solutions for all pertinent inquiries in addition to transferring complete and correct order files for execution to our operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities & Requirements:**

* For pre-defined accounts, the Supervisor will be responsible for the review of RFQs and the issuance of quotes for the products that this person supports.
* Drive timely responsiveness to all viable quotation opportunities. This includes tracking the response time of the Commercial Operations team based on agreed upon standards.
* Manage the review of all valve and actuation orders for completeness and correctness and assist in resolving any issues to ensure proper order entry.
* Proper order entry to include clean Order Transfer files that are provided to Order Management in the agreed upon time frame.
* Coordinate and approve commercial terms of purchase orders and/or contracts including SAP generation and approval along with the resolution of any respective terms and conditions issues, based on Flowserve guidelines.
* Implement and oversee a continual training program to insure.
* Team members are properly applying their technical expertise and commercial knowledge during quotation preparation.
* Are updated on our techniques for utilizing any of the respective configurators / sizing and selection tools required for proposal generation.
* Are learning to apply our best practices in sizing, selecting and quoting the best suited Flowserve FPD products.
* Ensure applicable industry standards are applied correctly.
* Any schools conducted at the operation are well coordinated, informative and beneficial to all attendees (Flowserve direct or 3rd party sales personnel).
* Team Members are being developed to continuously enhance and improve performance.
* Work closely and develop strong business relationships with the key members of our operations, sales and engineering management teams to help drive the success of our FPD organization.
* Continually analyze and track the results of our pricing and quotation practices including the generation of win / loss quotation hit rates to enhance our effectiveness.
* Track, monitor, and review the performance of your individual direct reports through our performance management review process including assigning measurable goals and focused accountabilities. Monitor the progress for each team member throughout the year per our HR guidelines and processes.
* Work closely with our outside sales organization to enhance our communication, project pursuit, collaboration, and overall selling efforts.
* Comply with Flowserve goals, objectives and policies and manage your respective team members to adhere to the same standards.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Preferred Experience / Skills:**

* Successful inside / outside sales experience.
* Knowledge and experience serving the variety of process control markets associated with the assigned products and / or region.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and organizational skills.
* Detailed oriented.
* Proven track records of completing assignments as requested and in a timely manner.
* Basic knowledge of commercial issues including payment terms, shipping terms, and contract review.
* Computer skills including Microsoft Office, Internet along with the ability and willingness to learn how to use other or new business software packages as required by the role.
* BE or B.Tech Degree in relevant field and 5-7 years relevant experience.

title: Students Relations Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Medcity International Academy (MIA) is a premier professional training and coaching institution headquartered in Kannur, Kerala, India, with multiple centers across Kerala and Karnataka. Recognized as a leading provider of English language proficiency and professional assessment test training, MIA focuses on international exam success and global employability. The Academy offers specialized programs for language tests such as IELTS, OET, TOEFL, PTE, Duolingo English Test, and CELPIP, as well as nursing and healthcare assessments including NCLEX-RN, Prometric, CBT (UK), DHA, HAAD, MOH, BLS, and ACLS. With experienced, globally certified trainers, evidence-based teaching methods, digital tools, and an app-based learning ecosystem, MIA supports both online and classroom learners. Its mission is to expand global opportunities for students and professionals across healthcare, IT, engineering, hospitality, aviation, tourism, and communications through impactful education and strategic training.

**Role Description**
The Student Relations Manager is a full-time, on-site role based at the Kochi center. This role is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end student experience, from inquiry and admissions support to ongoing engagement and post-course follow-up. The Student Relations Manager will respond to inquiries, conduct counseling sessions, guide students in selecting suitable courses and exams, and coordinate with academic and administrative teams to ensure smooth onboarding and scheduling. The role involves maintaining accurate student records, handling feedback and grievance resolution, organizing orientation and student outreach activities, and supporting placement and career guidance initiatives. The Student Relations Manager will also collaborate with marketing and operations teams to improve student communication, promote programs, and contribute to continuous improvement in service quality.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong student counseling, academic advising, and relationship management skills.
* Candidates should possess skills in communication, interpersonal interaction, and presentation, with fluency in English; knowledge of regional languages is an advantage.
* Candidates should possess organizational, time management, and multitasking skills to manage admissions, scheduling, and student records efficiently.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in MS Office, CRM or student management systems, and basic data reporting and documentation skills.
* Candidates should possess problem-solving, conflict resolution, and customer service skills to address student concerns and maintain high satisfaction levels.
* Relevant experience in student services, education management, training institutes, or customer-facing roles in the education sector is preferred.
* A bachelor’s degree in education, business, psychology, communications, or a related field is required; a master’s degree is an added advantage.
* Ability to work collaboratively with trainers and administrative staff, with a proactive, ethical, and student-centric approach.

title: Security Managed Services Engineer (L2)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Security Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, your role will be to ensure that our clients' security infrastructures and systems remain operational. With a proactive approach, you'll monitor, identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, restoring service efficiently. Your primary objective will be to handle client requests or tickets with technical expertise, ensuring they are resolved within the agreed service level agreement (SLA).
  
  
You'll actively manage work queues, perform operational tasks, and update tickets with resolution actions. By identifying issues and errors early on, you'll log incidents promptly and provide second-level support, communicating effectively with other teams and clients to extend support when needed. Your role includes executing changes responsibly, flagging risks and mitigation plans, and ensuring all changes have proper approvals.
  
  
Collaborative efforts are at the heart of this role. You'll work closely with automation teams to optimize efforts and automate routine tasks, ensuring seamless handovers during shift changes. Your analytical skills will be key in auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and contributing to trend analysis reports to identify automation opportunities.
  
  
As a go-to for initial client escalations, you'll assist L1 Security Engineers with triage and troubleshooting, and support project work when required. Your contributions to the change management process will ensure thorough documentation, effective planning and execution of maintenance activities, and compliance with standard procedures.
  
  
**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Experience with managed services handling security infrastructure and working knowledge of ticketing tools, preferably ServiceNow.
* Proficiency in active listening, with techniques like paraphrasing and probing for further information.
* Excellent planning skills, able to anticipate and adjust to changing circumstances.
* Strong ability to communicate and engage across different cultures and social groups.
* Adaptability to changing conditions and flexibility in approach.
* Client-focused mindset, always putting their needs and positive experience first.
* A positive outlook and the ability to work well under pressure.
* Willingness to put in longer hours when necessary.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing, or relevant work experience.

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. title: Solution Engineer
description:
**Your role**
**What You'll Be Doing**
Solution Engineer
  
  
What We Need
  
  
Corpay is seeking a Solutions Engineer for our Cross-Border division, within the Corporate Payments line of business department, located in Chennai, India.
**Reports to:**
Payment Solutions Manager (Chennai)
  
  
**About Corpay Cross-Border**
Corpay Cross-Border helps businesses move money globally, manage currency risk, and streamline international payments. Our technology supports customers operating across markets, currencies, and regulatory environments, where reliability, security, and scale matter every day.
  
  
As part of Corpay, Inc. (NYSE: CPAY), a global corporate payments company, we combine the pace of a product-led technology team with the reach and stability of a global financial services business. To learn more, visit Payments.corpay.com/cross-border.
  
  
How We Work
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:
  
  

* Assigned workspace in our Chennai office
* Company-issued equipment
* Formal, hands-on training

Role Overview
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay Cross-Border, you will support the technical onboarding and implementation of clients integrating with Corpay's digital payment and FX solutions.
  
  
The role will primarily support clients and internal stakeholders across North America, with working hours aligned to the US Eastern Time (ET) timezone, while also providing technical support to client implementations and initiatives across other global regions as required.
  
  
You will work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and other Payment Solutions teams to support clients across integration modalities including REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other digital payment capabilities. The role requires strong technical aptitude, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
In addition to client implementations, Solutions Engineering is regularly relied upon to support special projects, new product initiatives and ad-hoc business requirements. The successful candidate should therefore be comfortable working across a variety of technical challenges and adapting to evolving business priorities.
  
  
The position will be primarily remote; however, the successful candidate will initially attend the Chennai office for induction and training and will be expected to attend occasionally thereafter for team meetings, training and other business requirements.
  
  
Role Responsibilities
  
  
**The Responsibilities Of The Role Will Include**
Client Implementation & Solutioning
  
  

* Support end-to-end technical implementation activities from onboarding through testing, certification and Production go-live.
* Support clients integrating through Corpay's REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other supported integration modalities.
* Participate in technical discovery and solutioning discussions to understand client requirements and determine appropriate implementation approaches.
* Support clients with test environment setup, configuration and integration readiness activities.
* Provide clear and timely responses to client and internal technical implementation questions.
* Support certification testing, Production readiness and post-go-live warranty activities to ensure successful client adoption.
* Take ownership of assigned implementation activities while escalating complex technical or delivery risks appropriately.
* Maintain accurate and timely implementation documentation and project updates.

Technical Analysis & Troubleshooting
  
  

* Investigate integration, configuration and implementation issues using appropriate diagnostic tools and available system information.
* Analyse API requests and responses, file structures, payment workflows, logs and other technical data to identify potential causes and solutions.
* Work collaboratively with Technical Sales, Product, Engineering, Client Engagement, Support and other teams to resolve technical blockers.
* Clearly document technical findings, troubleshooting steps and recommended solutions.
* Contribute to testing and validation of new or enhanced product capabilities where Solutions Engineering support is required.

Global Team & Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and the Solutions Engineering Lead to support successful client delivery across North America and, where required, other global regions.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across different geographies and time zones.
* Share lessons learned, technical knowledge and implementation best practices with the wider Solutions Engineering team.
* Contribute to team documentation, implementation standards and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Maintain effective communication with North American stakeholders while remaining connected to the wider Chennai and global Payment Solutions organisation.

Special Projects, Automation & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Support special and ad-hoc business initiatives requiring technical analysis, implementation support, testing, reporting or other Solutions Engineering expertise.
* Support Product and other stakeholders with the testing, analysis and rollout of new technical capabilities where appropriate.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation and business processes through automation and improved tooling.
* Develop, maintain or enhance automated workflows using tools such as Microsoft Power Automate where appropriate.
* Work with stakeholders to understand automation requirements and translate them into practical and supportable solutions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency, scalability and delivery quality.
* Contribute to the continued standardisation and improvement of Solutions Engineering processes, documentation and implementation approaches.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Sales, implementation consulting, technical support, or a comparable client-facing technical role, ideally within payments, fintech or financial services.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of client-facing technical issues and implementations, and exercise sound judgement when determining when escalation is required.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs, file-based integrations, SFTP and/or ERP solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience using tools such as Postman, SQL, Kibana, SEQ, Jira, Confluence or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Experience within payments, fintech, banking or financial services would be advantageous.
* Experience supporting North American clients or working across US time zones would be beneficial.
* Exposure to workflow automation tools such as Microsoft Power Automate or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining ownership of assigned deliverables.
* Ability to adapt to ad-hoc projects, new technical requirements and changing business priorities.
* Strong organisational skills with attention to delivery timelines, quality and stakeholder communication.

Benefits & Perks
  
  

* Leaves: Earned, sick, casual, national holidays, maternity, paternity, bereavement, and adoption/surrogacy leave.
* Medical & Insurance: Group medical coverage for self and dependents; personal accident insurance.
* Wellness & Health: Wellness allowance and annual health check-ups for self and family.
* Tech & Meals: Broadband reimbursement and meal card support.
* Commute & Retirement: Commuting allowance, provident fund, gratuity, voluntary provident fund, and pension.
* Culture & Engagement: Support for philanthropic initiatives, fun contests, and an inclusive work environment.

* Willing and able to adapt to changes in a work environment, procedures, priorities, and job duties.

* Sitting: frequent and prolonged periods of sitting at a desk while working on a computer.
* Communication: frequent and prolonged periods of speaking, listening, reading, and writing.
* Fine motor skills: frequent use of hands for typing and operating a computer mouse.
* Movement: occasional walking and climbing of stairs; limited bending, kneeling, lifting, and carrying of office-related items.

title: Microsoft 365 Administrator
description:
**Designation:**
Microsoft 365 Administrator

**Experience:**
2–3 Years

**Department:**
IT Support & Operations

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and customer-focused Microsoft 365 Administrator with 2–3 years of experience in administration, technical support, and troubleshooting of Microsoft 365 services. The candidate will be responsible for managing Microsoft 365 applications, resolving technical issues, supporting users, and ensuring the availability, security, and smooth functioning of the Microsoft 365 environment.

The ideal candidate should have strong troubleshooting skills, a good understanding of Microsoft 365 administration, and the ability to resolve incidents within agreed service-level agreements (SLAs).

Key Responsibilities

* Administer and support Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* Troubleshoot and resolve user issues related to email, mailbox access, Teams meetings, file sharing, permissions, and Microsoft 365 applications.
* Manage user accounts, licenses, distribution lists, shared mailboxes, and access permissions.
* Perform routine administrative tasks using the Microsoft 365 Admin Center and relevant service portals.
* Support password resets, account access issues, and multi-factor authentication (MFA) troubleshooting.
* Monitor and resolve service incidents, ensuring timely ticket updates and resolution within agreed SLAs.
* Assist with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) administration, including user management and access troubleshooting.
* Follow security best practices for user access, authentication, permissions, and data protection.
* Perform basic root cause analysis for recurring issues and document troubleshooting steps.
* Maintain technical documentation and knowledge base articles to support efficient issue resolution.
* Collaborate with internal IT teams to resolve escalated technical issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve support processes, service quality, and user satisfaction.

Required Skills

* 2–3 years of experience in Microsoft 365 administration or IT support.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft 365 Admin Center and its core services.
* Hands-on experience with Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* Understanding of user account management, license assignment, and access permissions.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), MFA, and identity management.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with incident management, ticketing systems, and SLA-based support.
* Understanding of IT security practices and access control.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with technical support teams.

Preferred Skills

* Basic knowledge of PowerShell for Microsoft 365 administration.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Purview fundamentals.
* Understanding of Microsoft 365 security, compliance, and identity management.
* Experience with IT service management tools such as ServiceNow or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 service health monitoring and incident management.

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Relevant technical certifications are an added advantage.

Certifications (Optional)

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert.
* Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals.
* Microsoft 365 Certified: Fundamentals.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely resolution of incidents within agreed SLAs.
* First-contact resolution rate and reduced ticket reopens.
* Accuracy of troubleshooting and technical documentation.
* User satisfaction and service quality.
* Compliance with security policies and operational procedures.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be proactive, technically proficient, and customer-focused, with hands-on experience supporting Microsoft 365 environments. The candidate should be capable of troubleshooting common technical issues, managing administrative tasks, following security standards, and contributing to continuous service improvement.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Description**
We're Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you've come to the right place.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Support Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of transforming how customers experience and adopt Salesforce technology, rolling up your sleeves to make it happen. This isn't just about troubleshooting issues or answering questions; it's about deeply understanding our customers' most complex challenges and crafting innovative solutions that accelerate adoption and drive measurable business value throughout our Salesforce platform.
  
  
The Support Engineer, will welcome our newest customers post-sale before they begin the implementation process. You'll continue to serve customers throughout their journey as a technical champion who not only resolves sophisticated platform challenges but also proactively guides them to better leverage Salesforce products, features, and best practices. Success in this role means accelerating customer adoption, strengthening their technical health and helping customers demonstrate tangible business impact through your reactive and proactive technical efforts.
  
  
This role requires someone who can think like both an engineer and a consultant – diagnosing root causes while simultaneously identifying opportunities to elevate how customers use our technology. If you're energized by solving hard problems, building customer relationships, and seeing the direct impact of your technical work on customer success, this role is for you.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Welcome & Onboard New Customers for Success: Serve as the technical welcoming committee for customers post-sale. Conduct initial technical discovery sessions and create personalized onboarding plans that set customers up for immediate wins. You'll be their first technical partner, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation and building the foundation for long-term success.
* Accelerate Product Adoption & Feature Utilization: Proactively engage with customers to drive faster time-to-value by identifying adoption gaps, demonstrating high-impact features, and creating tailored success path plans. Leverage your deep technical engagement to identify underutilized features, expansion opportunities, and strategic use cases that maximize their investment and achieve production outcomes quickly. Own measurable technical outcomes including acceleration of time-to-production, increased adoption of priority features, improved integration reliability, and demonstrated operational efficiency gains".
* Deliver Mission-Critical Support with Speed & Precision: Respond with urgency when customers face time-sensitive, business-impacting issues across the Salesforce platform, including complex data integrations, API challenges, and familiarity with AI/Agentforce implementations.   :

  :

We are hiring a

The Customer Engineering team sits at the intersection of Product Engineering and our Success and Support organization, acting as the deepest technical escalation layer for our most critical customer issues. As a Customer Centric Engineer on this team, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of complex technical escalations — from root cause analysis through code-level fixes — while also driving long-term improvements to how Workato is built, debugged, and supported at scale.
  
  
This role requires both the depth of a engineer and the communication range to work fluidly across engineering, support, and customer-facing teams. * Build trusted relationships across Success, Product Engineering, and Infrastructure as a recognized technical expert.
* Champion supportability and debuggability initiatives within Product Engineering, ensuring new features are built with observability and diagnosability in mind.
* Identify and drive AI-powered process improvements across the escalation lifecycle — from triage and classification to documentation generation and knowledge base maintenance.

* 3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including time in a customer-facing or escalation engineering role.
* Strong proficiency in Ruby (our core language);
* Good understanding of network protocols and distributed systems.
* Experience working in SaaS environments and with cloud infrastructure technologies.
* Familiarity with both relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL data stores.

**Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics**

* Passionate about solving hard technical problems and recommending meaningful improvements to products and processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — equally comfortable writing a sharp bug report, a knowledge base article, or presenting a root cause analysis to senior leadership.
* Curious, detail-oriented, and personally invested in doing the work right — you find loose ends and pull on them.

title: Senior Managed Services Consultant
description:

At ITRS, we make society's critical technology work. Our mission is to deliver automated and holistic IT observability solutions that safeguard critical applications and enable innovation. We are the only monitoring and observability platform designed for the most demanding and regulated industries — trusted by 90% of Tier 1 capital markets firms.

With headquarters in London and teams across the US, Europe, and Asia, ITRS combines the agility of a high-impact tech business with the stability of a private equity-backed global partner.

Our clients choose Managed Services to ensure Geneos is kept up to date, operational and correctly configured. We also work with our clients to ensure their monitoring is taken to a higher advancement level, to allow them to get the most value out of the product.

Reporting to our Service Delivery Manager, our Managed Service team monitors all ITRS components in our client environment to ensure they are up and operational. We respond to client queries on how to use the product, requests to make changes and configuration requests where the client requires. Also, we perform project work which includes upgrading and enhancing the client's Geneos environment. * **Monitor**

  to permanently fix reccuring incidents.

  and ensure best available workaround for Incidents are documented and communicated.

  by updating the knowledge base to provide accurate troubleshooting for the Managed Services team.
* **Provide ideas and suggestions**
  improve products, services, or processes.

**Performance is measured through regular quarterly appraisals with your line manager to include a review of the following:**

* Quality of client communication by providing concise information to the client.

* Quality of work to the client by meeting our defined standards including quality checks.
* Client satisfaction and feedback of your work.
* Positive contribution to the Managed Service workload by meeting the targets set by your line manager.
* Meet your ticket response and resolution time SLA.
* Meet Geneos uptime SLA by monitoring and resolving incidents.
* Expectation to perform according to our behaviour and values

**Requirements**

* Minimum of 6 years' experience in a client-facing role, preferably within a financial institution, vendor environment, or IT Operations
* Strong experience working in project-driven and time-sensitive environments, with the ability to manage client expectations and resolve issues effectively
* Proven track record of initiative and driving continuous improvement
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and user-friendly manner
* Experience or strong interest in Business Analysis and Project Management practices
* Solid experience with Unix/Linux and Windows operating systems (e.g., Linux, Solaris, Windows Server)
* Working knowledge of databases (e.g., Oracle) and SQL
* Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Bash, Shell, Perl, Python, PowerShell, XML)
* Experience with IT Service Management tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy)
* Familiarity with deployment and automation tools (e.g., Chef, Ansible, Jenkins)
* Experience in setup, configuration, and maintenance of IT monitoring tools

**Benefits**

* Health insurance with Care
* Provident Fund
* Group personal accident policy
* Generous leave entitlements

title: Assistant Manager - Enterprise IT
description:
**Position Overview**
We require an experienced L2 Windows Domain & Backup Engineer to manage and maintain enterprise Windows environments along with backup and recovery infrastructure. The role includes Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and core Windows services, along with enterprise backup administration, monitoring, and recovery operations. The engineer will also perform assessments, reporting, compliance activities, and enable automation using scripting/AI tools.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Windows Infrastructure Management
  
  

* Administer Active Directory (Users, Groups, GPOs, OU structure)
* Maintain DNS, DHCP, and RADIUS (NPS) services
* Manage Windows Server environments (2016/2019/2022) including installation, configuration, and upgrades
* Ensure high availability and performance optimization of Windows infrastructure

Backup Administration
  
  

* Manage and monitor enterprise backup solutions (e.g., NetBackup, BackupExec, Veeam, Commvault, or similar)
* Perform backup scheduling, configuration, and policy management for servers, databases, and applications
* Ensure successful completion of daily backups and troubleshoot failed backup jobs
* Perform data restoration (file-level, VM-level, and application-level) as per business requirements
* Conduct regular backup validation and restoration drills to ensure recoverability
* Manage backup storage, retention policies, and archival processes
* Optimize backup performance and storage utilization
* Coordinate with application and infrastructure teams during backup and restore activities
* Ensure DR readiness by supporting disaster recovery drills and failover testing
* Maintain backup reports, logs, and documentation

Security & Vulnerability Management
  
  

* Perform Windows patch management (monthly/critical updates)
* Identify and remediate vulnerabilities using tools like Qualys/Nessus
* Ensure SLA-based closure of vulnerabilities
* Implement server hardening best practices
* Ensure backup data security, encryption, and access controls
* Ensure compliance with ISO 27001 and internal policies
* Prepare documentation for audits (including backup and recovery evidence)
* Track audit findings and remediation
* Maintain security and backup baselines

Incident & Change Management
  
  

* Handle L2/L3 incidents related to Windows infrastructure and backup systems
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for failures (including backup failures)
* Support change management processes for infra and backup changes

**Required Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**
Strong experience in Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, RADIUS/NPS; Windows Server (2016/2019/2022/2025); patch management tools (WSUS/SCCM/Intune/Bigfix)
  
  
**Backup Tools:**
Experience in enterprise backup tools (NetBackup, Veeam, Commvault, etc.)
  
  
**Security:**
Knowledge of ISO 27001 and security frameworks; experience with vulnerability tools (Qualys, Nessus)
  
  
**Scripting:**
PowerShell scripting for automation
  
  
**Certifications (Preferred):**
Microsoft certifications (MCSA, Azure Admin); certifications in backup technologies (Veeam/Commvault/NetBackup)
  
  
**Environment:**

title: IT & Security Operations Lead
description:
**Who We Are**

ParamAIQ is an applied-AI company building NyaayOS, the reasoning layer for Indian law. We turn the primary sources of Indian law, from the BNS, BNSS and BSA to decades of Supreme Court and High Court precedent, into something any advocate can stand on. Work that took days takes minutes.

India has more than 55 million pending cases, and the outcome for a litigant can turn on who they can afford. We're building the foundation that gives an independent lawyer the same analytical leverage as a partner at a leading firm, and we build it with practising lawyers, not just for them.

**Why This Role Matters**

Today we run on Microsoft 365 and Slack with no central identity platform, no device management baseline, no formal service desk, and no security framework. There is no Active Directory. This is not a role that inherits a mature estate and governs it.

This is a build role first and a governance role second. In your first year you'll design and stand up the identity, endpoint, network and security foundations for the whole group, and then run them well. You'll have one engineer working to you from day one, real budget, and a direct line to the CTO. You'll also be hands-on: at our size, the person who designs conditional access is the same person who occasionally re-images a laptop.

**What You'll Own**

* Identity & access: Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory as the group's authoritative identity source. SSO, MFA, conditional access, RBAC, privileged access, joiner-mover-leaver, and periodic access reviews.
* Microsoft 365: Tenant administration and governance, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, licensing optimisation, multi-entity and multi-domain design, and security baselines.
* Slack: End-to-end administration (Teams chat is deliberately disabled). SSO and SCIM from Entra ID, retention and eDiscovery, DLP, app approval, and guest governance.
* Endpoint management: A mixed Windows and macOS fleet of roughly 100 devices. Intune, Apple Business Manager with zero-touch enrolment, FileVault escrow, and a macOS patching approach of your recommendation.
* Security operations: SPF, DKIM and DMARC across all domains, endpoint protection, vulnerability posture, phishing simulation and awareness training, shadow-IT discovery, secrets hygiene, and an incident response runbook you've actually rehearsed.
* Compliance & audit: IT controls evidence for SOC 2, IT's obligations under India's DPDP Act including breach notification readiness, the asset register, e-waste rules, and access control and CCTV administration.
* Infrastructure & network: Firewall, VPN, Wi-Fi and ISPs, the new Mumbai office comms room and cabling handover, and the physical environment for on-premises GPU infrastructure (power, cooling, access, encryption at rest).
* Backup, DR & continuity: Backup standards, defined recovery objectives, restores tested on a schedule, and documented continuity procedures.
* Service management: Select and run our first ticketing system, publish SLAs, direct the Network & Helpdesk Engineer's work, and own major incident escalation.
* Vendors & budget: Microsoft partners, ISPs, hardware and SaaS vendors. Contracts, renewals, endpoint procurement, vendor security reviews, and input into the annual IT budget.

**What Success Looks Like in Year One**

We'll judge this role on outcomes, not activity. By the end of your first twelve months we expect:

* Identity is authoritative: Entra ID and Active Directory deployed, everyone provisioned from a single source, and SSO live for our top applications including Slack
* MFA and conditional access at 100%: No exceptions without a documented, time-bound approval
* Every device managed: 100% of Windows and macOS endpoints enrolled, encrypted, patch-compliant and in a single inventory
* Joiner-mover-leaver is a process, not a favour: Documented, measured against an SLA, with offboarding that reliably revokes access on the day it should
* A service desk exists: Ticketing live, SLAs published, and a baseline satisfaction measure
* Recovery is proven, not assumed: At least one full documented restore test for each critical system
* Audit-ready: SOC 2 IT evidence produced on a defined schedule, and DPDP obligations mapped to owners
* The estate is documented: Asset register, network documentation, and runbooks your engineer can work from without you

**Scope Boundary**

* You own corporate IT: identity, endpoints, the corporate network, SaaS, and the physical technology environment, including power, cooling, access control and encryption for our on-premises GPU hardware.
* Engineering owns production cloud infrastructure, the build and deployment pipeline, and the product environment. You're consulted on those and own identity and access into them, but you're not the approver for production change.
* Where the boundary is genuinely unclear, raise it rather than either annexing or ignoring it.

**What You Bring**

* You've personally built a Microsoft identity platform from nothing, with Entra ID and Active Directory designed, deployed and cut over, not just administered one someone else built
* Deep, hands-on Microsoft 365 tenant administration: Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, licensing, security baselines and conditional access
* Real endpoint management across Windows and macOS, including Intune and Apple Business Manager, and opinions about managing Macs properly
* You've carried SOC 2, ISO 27001 or an equivalent framework as the person who produced the IT evidence, not a bystander to the audit
* Comfortable being hands-on and hands-off in the same day: architecture in the morning, a stuck user in the afternoon, without resenting either
* You can lead one engineer well: allocate work, review it honestly, and grow them
* Patience with non-technical users in a trading business and a biotech who don't think in tickets

**Bonus Points**

* Slack administration at organisation scale: SCIM, retention, DLP, eDiscovery, app governance
* Multi-entity or multi-company tenant design, including data segregation and per-entity licensing and cost allocation
* Familiarity with India's DPDP Act as it applies to IT operations
* Commissioning a new office: comms room, structured cabling, access control and CCTV integration
* Exposure to on-premises GPU or high-density compute environments
* Working fluency in Hindi or Marathi alongside English

**What You Get**

* A true build opportunity: design the group's identity, endpoint, network and security foundations from scratch
* One engineer working to you from day one, and real budget
* A direct line to the CTO
* Group-wide scope across trading, biotech and legal tech, including the infrastructure behind India's agentic legal AI

title: Network Operations Center (NOC) Analyst
description:
**About AppDirect**


Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture - one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.
  
  

**About You**


The Network Operations Center (NOC) Analyst is an active participant in network incident management for managed WAN interfaces and managed security sites with circuits varying in size from T1’s to DS3, which employ technologies such as AVPN, ADI, MPLS, Multilink T1s, Ethernet, Cellular and Broadband. The role relies heavily on knowledge and understanding of monitoring and ticketing platforms to effectively troubleshoot and resolve issues.

The NOC Analyst interacts regularly with and is an advocate for all customers with whom he/she is working and who have subscribed to AppDirect’s Managed Network Services. This position requires a strong customer focus and an ability to deal with different customer requirements and priorities.

The successful candidate for this position will effectively utilize prior education and demonstrated work experience to make an immediate, independent contribution to the Network Operations Center team.

The NOC is an integral part of AppDirect’s 24x7x365 operational environment. This position may require occasional shift rotation to cover holidays, weekends, and other normal scheduling requirements as needed to support the business. Flexibility to work any shift as needed is required.

**What you’ll do and how you’ll have an impact**

* Own, triage, and resolve customer network (WAN/LAN) related trouble tickets to successful completion
* Detection, tracking, and restoration of customer’s network connectivity via their data circuits and/or equipment
* Remotely troubleshoot and configure WAN equipment, including routers, firewalls, switches, and load balancers from various vendors
* Engage, escalate, and work with carriers and other 3rd parties when needed as part of service restoral
* Participate in incident command bridges, hypercare, and major incidents when required
* Understand and use network monitoring tools such as Zenoss or Logic Monitor to assist in troubleshooting or analyzing network issues and performance
* Converse with technical and non-technical contacts depending on the situation.
* Perform effective ticket management including but not limited to queue management, timely ticket documentation, proper hand-off to other analysts, teams, 3rd parties, etc., communications to customers, ticket resolution
* Adhere to established Service Level Objectives and/or Service Level Agreements
* Work both autonomously and also as part of a team, assisting, when necessary, on identifying and diagnosing issues

**What we’re looking for**

*Required*

* Minimum of two (2) years of WAN/LAN implementation and support/troubleshooting experience
* Well-versed in TCP/IP protocols and able to troubleshoot issues remotely
* Strong understanding of the OSI Model, SD-WAN, Transport, and TCP/IP
* Demonstrable experience with routing and troubleshooting routing issues with BGP, IGRP, RIP, and OSPF
* Must be knowledgeable in NAT, access lists, policy-based mapping, traffic shaping, and priority queuing
* Must have supported data networks and telecommunications functions in mid-size enterprises, including VPN, ADI, MPLS, Ethernet, Cellular, Broadband, Wireless (WWAN), Multilink T1s
* Must have experience in command line configuration using two or more of the following product lines: Cisco, SonicWall, Juniper, ADTRAN, Meraki, Fortinet, or other relevant technologies
* Knowledgeable with DNS, DHCP, VRRP, HSRP, VLANs, and Inter-VLAN routing.
* Knowledge of network monitoring and traffic capturing tools
* Must be conceptually familiar with security-related terms, and technologies, encryption, authentication, IPsec, VPN tunnels including GRE, and controlling traffic
* VoIP knowledge and experience is a plus
* Ability to interact, communicate, and collaborate with internal/external customers, service providers, and field technicians
* Strong verbal communication and documentation skills
* Strong process improvement and customer-focused skills

*Preferred*

* Large enterprise LAN/WAN environment or telecommunications company experience preferred
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline
* Experience working in a Managed Services organization a plus
* Experience with ServiceNow and monitoring tools such as Logic Monitor or Zenoss
* Possess or be working towards ITIL v3 or v4 Foundations Certification
* Relevant technical certifications a plus, i.e., CCNA, Network+, etc.
* Conceptual knowledge of Security Operations or experience is a plus

*At AppDirect, we believe that innovation thrives in an environment that houses diversity of excellence, experience and thought. We respect each AppDirector as their own fingerprint; unique with no one alike. We foster an environment of inclusion without regard to race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or gender identity enabling AppDirectors to embrace their uniqueness to do their best work. As such, we strongly encourage applications from Indigenous peoples, racialized people, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities, and/or people with intersectional identities.*

*https://www.appdirect.com/about/privacy-notice*

AI tools do not make hiring decisions or solely automated decisions about your candidacy – all decisions are made by our people. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that your information may be processed in this way. You may request access or deletion at any time by contacting privacy@appdirect.com.*

title: MA/MI Content Management & System Specialist
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
**THE POSITION:**
The management of Medical Affairs and Medical Information (MA/MI) content, systems, and data is critical to ensuring medical information resources remain accurate, compliant, accessible, and appropriately governed. Effective execution of these activities requires strong oversight of content classification, user administration, system support, reporting, and document governance processes.
  
  
As part of the MA/MI Operations team, the MA/MI Content Management & System Specialist is responsible for supporting Medical Information systems and content management operations for dedicated clients. The role oversees user management activities, access controls, content classification, metadata governance, system support, reporting, and procedural document management. The specialist works closely with internal stakeholders and support teams to ensure seamless system operations, maintain data quality and consistency, support audits and system releases, and ensure compliance with internal policies, quality standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
  
  
**User Management Support**

* Coordinate and support user onboarding and offboarding activities within Medical Information (MI) systems.
* Initiate and track training assignment requests for system users.
* Support updates and maintenance of training content.
* Perform user access management activities for MI systems and maintain the user management master file
* Monitor and resolve complaint and incident tickets raised by MI system users.
* Monitor Medical Information support mailboxes and Teams channels, responding to and resolving user requests and issues in a timely manner.
* Update data reports, Power BI dashboards, and maintain SharePoint lists for non-Med Source users
* Provide support to the team responsible for managing the Talent Share tool and associated training and learning activities.
* Liaise with internal support teams for interconnected systems and applications
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) script development and functionality testing during MI system releases
* Provide support during audits.
* Support the governance, oversight, and management of classification processes for MI enquiries and MI documents.
* Support the oversight, planning, review, approval, and maintenance of procedural documents

**Classification Support**

* Perform metadata classification for Medical Information enquiry cases.
* Perform metadata classification for Medical Information response documents.
* Conduct periodic normalization, harmonization, and maintenance of classifications in alignment with approved lists and established classification standards.

**Medical Affairs and Medical Information Project Management Support**

* Support MA/MI leadership in developing and managing project plans for key initiatives
* Assist in the development and maintenance of project plans and related documentation
* Support the medical content development team in uploading materials into clients’ review and approval platforms, including supporting annotating, anchoring references, etc.
* Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
* All other duties as assigned.

Consistent with applicable disability, employment, and human rights laws in the jurisdictions in which EVERSANA operates, EVERSANA is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, unless providing such an accommodation would impose an undue hardship or disproportionate burden on EVERSANA. If reasonable accommodation is needed to perform the essential functions of your position, please contact Human Resources.
  
  
**Expectations Of The Job**

* Travel: In general, this position does not travel.
* Hours: Able to work full-time and be flexible with work scheduling as required by clients and management.
* Metrics: Maintain and contribute toward process improvement which positively impacts metrics associated with activities of the MLR Review process; metrics are subject to change annually or more often as deemed necessary.
* Customer Services: Maintain and improve customer services associated with the activity of the MLR review.
* Time Management: Complete MLR coordination responsibilities in a timely manner.

*The above list reflects the general details necessary to describe the expectations of the position and shall not be construed as the only expectations that may be assigned for the position.*
*An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the expectations listed above.*
**Minimum Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
  
  

* Education: Graduates in any Life Sciences / Biomedical field.
* Must demonstrate excellent ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing.
* Experience and/or Training:

+ A minimum of 2 years of experience in a healthcare agency, pharmaceutical company contact center, or an equivalent environment, with exposure to quality control processes
+ Experience with use of Veeva Vault PromoMats / MedComms / CRM
+ Experience in MLR Coordination
+ Project management
+ Time management
+ Meeting management

* Excellent customer service skills.
* Technology/Equipment: Computer proficiency in Outlook and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and other Windows applications).

**Qualifications**
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Education: Graduates/Postgraduates in Pharmacy or Medicine preferred.
* Experience and/or Training

+ Working knowledge of or familiarity with global healthcare compliance statutes and laws.
+ Ability to perform assignments with a high degree of independence requiring extensive experience, skill, and knowledge
+ Excellent computer skills including competency in presentation, word processing and spreadsheet software, utilizing MS Office Suite.
+ Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, set priorities and meet deadlines
+ Ability to manage cross-functional projects
+ Familiar with laws and regulations regarding US drug / device advertising and promotion, including industry best practices

* Knowledge of medical terminology (preferred but not required).
* Must be quality-oriented and demonstrate consistent attention to detail.
* Must have the ability to follow established processes and procedures and the flexibility to adopt new practices and priorities as required.
* Positive Attitude and Energy – Exhibits an upbeat attitude, a genuine interest in others and a sense of humor. Energizes others and heightens morale through her/his attitude.
* Communication Skills – Possesses the ability to develop and articulate ideas and information that generate understanding and create a climate that motivates and encourages others to participate.
* Innovator – Transforms creative ideas into original solutions that positively impact the company’s performance.
* Highly Principled – Proves to be a professional of unquestionable integrity, credibility, and character who demonstrates high moral and ethical behavior.

**Additional Information**
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
  
  
From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Position Purpose/Objective (in broad terms describe what the job does and the expected end results)
  
  
Global IT is on a strategic journey to modernize Microsoft 365 collaboration capabilities, delivering secure, scalable and user-friendly SharePoint Online services across all global sites.
  
  
The Technical Consultant – SharePoint Online sits within the IT – Core Business Solutions team and serves as the primary technical authority for SharePoint Online, modern SharePoint architecture and the SharePoint Framework (SPFx). This role is responsible for designing, developing, migrating and optimizing SharePoint Online solutions, including the modernization and migration of classic SharePoint sites to the SharePoint Online modern experience.
  
  
Reporting to the ITDP/Solution Architect, this role combines deep Microsoft 365 engineering expertise with automation and integration skills across Power Automate, PowerShell and Azure cloud services. The consultant leads technical delivery, guides best-practice adoption, supports governance and compliance, and ensures the platform remains secure, maintainable and future-ready in alignment with digital transformation roadmap.
  
  
MAJOR ACCOUNTABILITIES (list KEY activities, expected results and the ways results are measured)
  
  

* Take ownership of the functional and technical solutions in the designated Microsoft 365 / SharePoint domain.
* Review and manage changes and daily operations delivered by external partners, ensuring quality, maintainability and adherence to standards.
* Translate business requirements into clear SharePoint Online functional and technical designs, including information architecture, security model, automation and integration patterns.

Technical Ownership & Governance
  
  

* Act as the primary technical SME for SharePoint Online, modern sites, communication sites, team sites, hub sites, lists, libraries, content types and metadata models.
* Define and maintain SharePoint Online governance covering site lifecycle, ownership, permissions, external sharing, naming standards, information protection, retention and operational support handover.
* Establish best-practice design principles for SharePoint Online solutions, covering usability, accessibility, searchability, performance, security, maintainability and supportability.
* Provide technical guidance to business stakeholders, IT Business Partners, Solution Architects, AMS teams and external delivery partners.

Design, Build, Migration & Automation
  
  

* Design, develop and support modern SharePoint Framework (SPFx) solutions using the latest supported SPFx patterns, including web parts, extensions and reusable components aligned to development standards.
* Lead the migration and modernization of classic SharePoint sites to SharePoint Online, including assessment, remediation, migration planning, modern site design, validation and post-migration stabilization.
* Develop and maintain Power Automate cloud flows for approvals, notifications, document lifecycle automation and business process orchestration, replacing legacy workflows where applicable.
* Use PowerShell and PnP PowerShell for SharePoint Online administration, provisioning, permissions reporting, bulk updates, migration support and operational automation.
* Design and implement integrations with Microsoft platform services including Azure cloud services, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, Teams and other enterprise applications where required.
* Define reusable templates, provisioning patterns, runbooks and technical standards for secure and scalable SharePoint Online delivery.
* Participate in solution reviews, change reviews, testing, deployment and hypercare for SharePoint Online enhancements and migration releases.
* Respond to security, compliance and audit observations by remediating configuration gaps and providing evidence for implemented controls.

Delivery & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Engage with business stakeholders to refine requirements and convert them into practical Microsoft 365 / SharePoint Online solutions.
* Coordinate with AMS vendors and third-party partners to ensure operational continuity, release coordination, incident/problem resolution and knowledge transfer.
* Support escalations and complex issue resolution related to SharePoint Online, Power Automate, PowerShell automation, Azure integrations and migration defects.

Team & Capability
  
  

* Ensure proper documentation, configuration records, solution design documents and runbooks are maintained for the SharePoint Online platform.
* Promote best practices, knowledge sharing, reuse of standard components and continuous improvement across Microsoft 365 collaboration services.

* 4+ years of Salesforce Service specialist experience
* Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

* Ability to translate business requirements into actionable tasks
* Strong coordination and communication skills
* Proactive and structured way of working
* Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail
* Ability to work effectively in a multi-vendor, complex environment
* Documentation of implemented features

* Fluent spoken and written English language
* Good communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Collaborate closely with developers, admins, and business stakeholders to align implementation with project goals.
* Knowledge of GDPR regulations
* Familiarity with Western business practices and work culture
