title: INP066: Sr. Specialist, Supply Chain Operations
description:
We are looking for an experienced Supervisor – Supply Chain Operations (Pharma Vertical in 3PL logistics ) with 10–15 years of experience in supply chain and logistics operations in India, with strong expertise in 3PL, contract logistics and customer-centric supply chain operations.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing complex supply chain operations for Pharma and/or MedTech customers, with a strong understanding of the specific quality, compliance, service and operational requirements associated with these industries.
  
  
The role will be responsible for managing end-to-end supply chain operations, driving operational excellence, improving productivity and service levels, ensuring compliance, managing customer relationships, and delivering sustainable cost and profitability improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* End-to-End Supply Chain Operations
* Lead and manage day-to-day 3PL / contract logistics operations across assigned customer accounts or locations.
* Ensure smooth and efficient execution of warehousing, inventory, order fulfillment, distribution and transportation activities.
* Translate customer requirements and contractual commitments into effective operational plans.
* Ensure achievement of agreed SLAs, KPIs, service levels and operational targets.
* Monitor operational performance and take timely corrective actions for gaps and deviations.
* Manage operational capacity in line with business volumes, seasonality and customer growth.
* Ensure business continuity and effective contingency planning.
* Pharma & MedTech Supply Chain Operations
* Manage supply chain operations for Pharma and MedTech customers, ensuring adherence to customer-specific requirements and applicable quality standards.
* Develop a strong understanding of Pharma/MedTech supply chain requirements related to product handling, storage, inventory management, order fulfillment, distribution and traceability.
* Ensure compliance with relevant customer quality systems, SOPs and regulatory requirements.
* Work closely with Quality, Compliance and customer teams to manage deviations, CAPAs, audits and operational quality issues.
* Ensure appropriate handling and control of sensitive, high-value or regulated products as applicable.
* Maintain strong focus on product integrity, inventory accuracy, order accuracy and traceability.
* Customer & Stakeholder Management
* Act as a key operational point of contact for assigned customers and stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Pharma and MedTech customers.
* Conduct regular operational performance reviews and business reviews with customers.
* Understand customer priorities and proactively address service and operational concerns.
* Manage escalations effectively and ensure timely closure of customer issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience and strengthen long-term partnerships.
* Work closely with Sales, Solution Design, Finance, Procurement, IT, Quality and other internal teams.
* Operational Excellence & Productivity
* Drive continuous improvement across warehouse, transportation and supply chain processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, resource utilization, process efficiency and service quality.
* Establish and monitor productivity standards for key operational activities.
* Optimize manpower, equipment, warehouse capacity and other operational resources.
* Lead Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma or other continuous improvement initiatives.
* Identify process bottlenecks and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive automation, digitization and technology adoption wherever commercially and operationally viable.
* Inventory & Order Management
* Ensure high levels of inventory accuracy and order fulfillment accuracy.
* Monitor inventory movements, cycle counts, stock reconciliation and inventory controls.
* Ensure timely and accurate order processing, picking, packing and dispatch.
* Monitor inventory variances, damages, losses, expiry and other inventory-related risks.
* Establish effective controls to minimize errors, rework and operational losses.
* Ensure proper documentation and system transactions across the supply chain process.
* Performance Management & Analytics
* Define, monitor and improve operational KPIs across customer accounts.
* Track metrics such as:

+ On-Time In-Full (OTIF)
+ Order Fulfillment Accuracy
+ Inventory Accuracy
+ Warehouse Productivity
+ Picking/Packing Accuracy
+ Dispatch Accuracy
+ Order Cycle Time
+ Dock-to-Stock Time
+ Cost per Order / Unit
+ Space Utilization
+ Manpower Productivity
+ Customer SLA Compliance

* Cost & Profitability Management
* Manage operating costs for assigned supply chain operations.
* Identify opportunities for cost reduction, productivity improvement and margin enhancement.
* Monitor manpower, warehouse, transportation, equipment and other operating costs.
* Ensure operations perform in line with agreed financial and commercial objectives.
* Partner with Finance to monitor budget, actual costs, accruals and profitability.
* Develop and execute action plans to improve account profitability.
* Identify and implement value-creation opportunities for customers and the business.
* 3PL & Contract Logistics Management
* Manage and operate complex third-party logistics and contract logistics environments.
* Ensure adherence to contractual obligations, SLAs, SOPs and commercial commitments.
* Review operational performance against contract requirements.
* Identify contractual gaps, scope changes and opportunities for operational/commercial improvement.
* Support contract renewals, business expansions, transition projects and new customer implementations.
* Ensure effective governance mechanisms are established with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Quality, Compliance & Risk Management
* Ensure compliance with company policies, customer SOPs and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support internal, customer and regulatory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.
* Establish effective operational controls to minimize risks related to inventory, quality, safety and service.
* Promote a strong culture of quality, compliance and operational discipline.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, training and SOP adherence across operations.
* Team Leadership & People Development
* Lead, develop and mentor operations teams across assigned locations/accounts.
* Establish clear performance objectives and productivity expectations.
* Build a culture of accountability, customer focus and continuous improvement.
* Identify capability gaps and develop training and development plans.
* Manage workforce planning and resource requirements in line with business volumes.
* Develop high-performing teams and succession pipelines.
* Transformation & New Business Implementation
* Support new customer onboarding, transition and implementation projects.
* Work with Solution Design and Business Development teams to translate proposed solutions into operational reality.
* Validate operational assumptions, capacity requirements, manpower plans and productivity targets.
* Lead operational readiness activities for new sites, customers, products and services.
* Ensure successful stabilization and handover of new operations to the BAU team.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* MBA in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Engineering, Business Administration or related discipline.
* 10–15 years of relevant experience in supply chain, logistics or operations in India.
* Strong experience in 3PL / third-party contract logistics.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end supply chain or logistics operations.
* Relevant experience working with Pharma and/or MedTech customers within supply chain/logistics operations is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of warehousing, inventory management, order fulfillment, transportation and distribution.
* Experience managing customer accounts and senior customer stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of operational KPIs, SLAs and contract logistics commercial models.
* Experience in productivity improvement, cost optimization and operational excellence.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with WMS, TMS, ERP/SAP or other supply chain technology platforms is preferred.

**Preferred Industry Experience**
Candidates from organizations providing
**3PL / contract logistics services to Pharma, Healthcare, Medical Devices or Life Sciences customers**
would be strongly preferred.
  
  
**Experience With The Following Would Be An Advantage**

* Pharma distribution and logistics
* Medical device logistics
* Healthcare supply chains
* Temperature-controlled / controlled-condition logistics
* High-value product handling
* Batch / lot / serial number traceability
* Expiry management
* FEFO / FIFO inventory management
* Regulatory and customer audits
* Reverse logistics
* Product recall / quarantine processes
* Customer-specific quality and compliance requirements

The Company
  
  
FedEx Logistics provides e-Commerce, freight forwarding, as well as import and export services that allow companies to reach markets throughout the world. They help customers of all sizes solve the intricacies of shipping goods globally by providing comprehensive international ocean and air freight forwarding, surface transportation and distribution, customs brokerage, trade and customs advisory services, and advanced e-commerce and trade facilitation solutions.
  
  
The Philosophy
  
  
People–Service–Profit (P-S-P). We take care of our People so that they can deliver impeccable Service to our customers who will give us the Profit necessary for FedEx to be successful. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages employees to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for our employees' well-being and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
The Culture
  
  
We honor innovation, integrity and diversity. We have many formal policies, procedures and programs to bring out the best in our staff, individually and in teams.
  
  
The Mission
  
  
We strive to be the Best Company to work for with the Best Service and the Best Brand in our industry.
  
  
We're glad you stopped by and hope your job search experience with FedEx Logistics, Inc. will be rewarding. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Open Secret - Senior Manager Supply Chain
description:
**About Us:**

Open Secret is a fast-growing, innovation-driven food & beverage brand making snacks for new India. We are on a mission to transform the way India snacks by creating a range of "unjunked" food options that are delicious, healthier, and guilt-free. We blend food science, great taste, and transparency to create better-for-you products families love.

Our Founder and CEO, Ahana Gautam, is a graduate from IIT Bombay and Harvard Business School, and has a strong FMCG background - Procter & Gamble and General Mills.

We are backed by a stellar group of investors - including Matrix, Sixth Sense, Ananta Capital, Vijay Shekhar Sharma, and other prominent leaders.

Join us in the Unjunked Revolution.

**Location:**
Bhandup - Mumbai (in office)

**Experience Level:**
6-7 years

**About the Role:**

As a Manager (Supply Chain) at Open Secret, you will be at the heart of our logistics and distribution strategy. We currently fulfil all orders from our Mumbai warehouse, and this role will own two critical mandates: (1) build and scale a multi-city warehouse and last mile network across India, and (2) improve the current supply chain performance. You will be the link between demand signals, inventory planning, and on-ground logistics execution.

You will report to the Head of Operations and also work closely with founder and senior leadership from day one, owning metrics that directly drive revenue on India's top e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms - Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, FK, Amazon, etc.

This is not just another desk job! If you enjoy getting your hands dirty with data, vendors, and real operational challenges - this will be fun.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Own end-to-end PO lifecycle: Supply planning, PO creation, GRN tracking, and fill-rate analysis across channels.

- Drive warehouse network expansion: Analyse city-level sales and inventory data to identify and stand up new fulfilment nodes beyond Mumbai.

- Build and manage a last-mile vendor ecosystem: Onboard 3PL partners, define delivery SLAs, and track TAT performance rigorously.

- Monitor On-Shelf Availability (OSA) daily across all SKUs and cities; diagnose availability drops and trigger replenishment actions proactively.

- Build inventory health dashboards tracking Days of Inventory (DOI), frontend/backend stock levels, Daily Run Rate (DRR) trends, and expiry risk.

- Collaborate with sales and demand planning teams to align PO scheduling with platform promotional calendars.

- Root-cause fulfilment gaps: Analyse deficit quantities, diagnose PO state failures, and drive on-time delivery improvements with vendors.

- Set up SOPs for new warehouse nodes covering inbound, storage, and dispatch protocols.

- Take ownership of evolving supply chain priorities, demonstrating agility and adaptability in addressing new or ambiguous challenges with speed and impact.

**Key Metrics You Will Own:**

- OSA (On-Shelf Availability): Weighted % of SKUs in-stock across dark stores; directly drives offtake and platform ranking.

- PO Fill Rate: Units delivered (GRN) vs. units ordered; reflects fulfilment accuracy and reliability.

- Lead Time: Days from PO creation to GRN; impacts replenishment cadence and stock-out risk.

- DOI (Days of Inventory): Determines reorder frequency and working capital.

- Fulfilment Gap: Delta between ordered and received quantity, by city and SKU.

- Inventory Value: Working capital tied up in front-end and back-end inventory across the warehouse network.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor's in engineering or related field from a tier-1 institution - IIT or BITS.

- 6 - 7 years of total work experience.

- Prior stints at companies such as Delhivery, Ecom Express, Dunzo, Shadowfax, Loadshare, Porter, or similar q-commerce / last-mile / logistics-tech startups.

- High proficiency in MS Office/Google Suite (especially Excel).

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare concise documents.

- Fast learner, detail-oriented, and excited to work in a high-growth, dynamic startup.

- Positive attitude, strong sense of ownership, and willingness to go beyond the job description as needed.

**What's in It for You?:**

- Greenfield mandate - you design and build the supply chain network from scratch, not maintain someone else's legacy system.

- Direct exposure to q-commerce operations at scale across India's top platforms.

- Exposure to business strategy and decision-making at top leadership level.

- Chance to work across diverse functions and fast-track your learning.

- Direct mentorship from founders and senior leaders.

- Accelerated growth opportunities in a growing F&B startup.

title: Crewing Officer
description:
**About the Company**

Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Limited (KMEW) is a fast-growing, dynamic player in the marine industry. Managing human resources at KMEW requires a distinct approach that balances corporate HR metrics with the logistical complexities of dredging operations, ship repairs, port ancillary crafts, and multi-country maritime staffing.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**General Manager – Crewing & Marine Personnel**

**Industry:**
Marine Dredging |
**Vessel Type:**
Trailing Suction Hopper Dredger (TSHD)

**Department:**
Marine Operations / Crewing |
**Reporting To:**
COO / Head – Marine Operations

**Experience:**
7-10 years in the marine industry, with relevant senior-level crewing management experience.

**1. Job Purpose**

To lead and manage the complete crewing and marine personnel function for the company's TSHD fleet, ensuring timely deployment of qualified personnel, statutory compliance, effective crew rotation, operational readiness, crew welfare, and cost optimization across all projects.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

* **Fleet Crew Management:**
  Plan and manage crew requirements, deployment, rotation, relief, and emergency replacements for all TSHDs and associated vessels.
* **Recruitment & Selection:**
  Lead recruitment of Masters, Chief Officers, Chief Engineers, marine officers, dredge operators, engine-room personnel, and ratings with relevant dredging experience.
* **TSHD Competency:**
  Ensure appropriate crew competency in trailing and suction dredging, draghead handling, hopper operations, dredge pumps, discharge systems, and vessel machinery.
* **Statutory Compliance:**
  Monitor crew certifications, CoCs/CoPs, STCW, medical fitness, CDCs, passports, visas, minimum safe manning, and other applicable statutory and client requirements.
* **Crew Rotation & Welfare:**
  Manage joining/sign-off schedules, leave planning, crew grievances, performance evaluations, retention, and succession planning.
* **Budget & Cost Control:**
  Prepare crewing budgets, monitor salaries, overtime, travel, recruitment, training, and other personnel costs.
* **Training & Performance:**
  Establish crew appraisal systems, competency assessments, training programmes, and development plans for senior onboard personnel.
* **Safety & Compliance:**
  Coordinate with QHSE and vessel management on crew-related audits, safety training, incidents, and corrective actions.
* **Coordination & Reporting:**
  Work closely with Marine Operations, Technical, HR, Finance, and Project teams to ensure uninterrupted vessel operations and submit periodic manpower, compliance, and cost reports to management.

**3. Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate degree or diploma in Nautical Science, Marine Engineering, Maritime Studies, or a related discipline preferred.
* 7-10 years of relevant marine industry experience, including substantial experience in senior crewing or marine personnel management.
* Proven experience managing crew for dredgers, preferably TSHDs, and handling multiple vessels or project locations.
* Sound knowledge of applicable DG Shipping requirements, STCW, MLC 2006, ISM Code, and international maritime regulations.
* Strong expertise in manpower planning, recruitment, crew documentation, budgeting, and team leadership.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely crew deployment and vessel readiness.
* Full compliance with applicable crew certification and manning requirements.
* Effective crew rotation and reduced operational disruptions.
* Recruitment efficiency and retention of experienced personnel.
* Adherence to approved crewing budgets.
* Timely completion of training, appraisals, and audit corrective actions.

**5. Desired Candidate Profile**

A strong marine crewing professional with proven leadership, commercial awareness, sound technical understanding of TSHD operations, excellent coordination and negotiation skills, and the ability to independently lead the complete crewing function for a multi-vessel dredging fleet.

**6. C.T.C**

18-24Lac./Annum (Relative to experience & Capability)

**Work Location:**
Head Office- Mumbai, with travel to project sites and vessels as required.

title: Food Beverage Controller
description:
**Designation**
**-**
Senior Manager - F&B Controls

**Location -**
Worli, Mumbai

**A. Food & Beverage Cost Control**

• Monitor food and beverage costs against approved budgets and established cost benchmarks.

• Track actual food cost, beverage cost, consumption, wastage, and cost variances.

• Analyse recipe costing, portion control, yield, and menu profitability in coordination with the culinary team.

• Identify cost leakages and recommend corrective measures to improve gross margins.

• Monitor food cost percentages across outlets, banquet events, and catering operations.

**B. Inventory & Stores Management**

• Oversee inventory planning, stock movement, consumption, and reconciliation.

• Ensure regular physical stock counts and reconciliation with system records.

• Monitor expiry, spoilage, breakage, wastage, and stock discrepancies.

• Establish controls for stock transfers, material requisitions, returns, and inter-location movements. • Ensure appropriate stock levels and adherence to FIFO/FEFO practices.

**C. Procurement & Vendor Control**

• Review purchase prices, vendor rates, and procurement practices to identify cost-saving opportunities.

• Monitor purchase price variances and compliance with approved vendor and procurement policies.

• Coordinate with procurement, stores, culinary, and operations teams to control material costs.

• Review receiving procedures, quality checks, and quantity discrepancies. D. Banqueting & Catering Costing

• Prepare and review food and beverage cost sheets for banquets, weddings, corporate events, and large scale catering assignments.

• Validate event-wise consumption against planned menus, guest counts, and production quantities.

• Analyse actual versus estimated event costs and identify deviations.

• Monitor contribution margins and profitability by event, venue, and business vertical.

• Establish post-event cost reconciliation and variance reporting processes.

**E. Budgeting, MIS & Financial Analysis**

• Prepare monthly F&B cost reports, inventory reports, and variance analysis.

• Track food cost percentage, beverage cost percentage, gross margins, wastage, and inventory holding levels.

• Develop dashboards highlighting cost trends, exceptions, and corrective actions.

• Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and cost-saving initiatives.

• Provide actionable insights to senior management on profitability and operational efficiency.

**F. Audit, Compliance & Process Improvement**

• Conduct periodic operational audits across kitchens, stores, outlets, and banquet locations.

• Ensure adherence to inventory, procurement, billing, consumption, and stock reconciliation SOPs. • Identify control gaps, irregularities, and potential pilferage.

• Implement standardised F&B control processes across all operating locations.

• Coordinate with internal audit and finance teams to ensure accurate reporting and compliance.

**Experience:-**

* 8–12 years of relevant experience in F&B cost control, hospitality finance, inventory control, or food and beverage operations.
* Prior experience in hotels, premium restaurants, large-scale catering, banqueting, central kitchens, or multi-outlet F&B businesses.
* Experience in handling multi-location operations and high-volume food production will be preferred.

title: Assistant Vice President - Collateral Management
description:
**Job Title:**
Assistant Vice President
  
  
**Department**
: ISPL Collateral Management CIB – OTC & REPO Margining
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
The Collateral Management Group compares the Net Present Value of the portfolio of trades between BNP Paribas and its counterparties on a daily (or as specified) basis and ensure that this exposure is sufficiently collateralized.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The process requires comparison of exposures with the value of the assets pledged, in accordance with the parameters specified in the legal agreement. Changes in exposure will generate changes in collateral balance. The collateral teams will call for or post additional collateral. This daily margin call process ensures that the Bank is covered in terms of excessive credit risk exposure. As a part of regulatory requirements of EMIR, collateral management is also required to perform portfolio reconciliation as a risk mitigation technique for dispute resolution and to be in line with regulatory requirements of EMIR. Process requires working with clients, Middle Office, P&L and risk team along with key stakeholders across the bank to report / resolve issues.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Performing daily margin call process front to back for specified clients.
* Margin Call issuance and chasing clients for unanswered margin calls for OTC and REPO business lines
* Investigating disputed calls and liaising with client, MO and legal on various aspects of disputed margin calls.
* Chasing clients on failed/missed payments.
* Investigating with settlements team on all bonds that have not settled in the market.
* Working on Substitution requests sent by clients/traders.
* Booking interest for all monthly clients.
* Investigating Interest discrepancies.
* Review control report to ensure effective break, fails and exception management
* Perform trade level reconciliation between BNPP and client portfolio as per EMIR Regulations.
* Investigating and resolving unmatched, entity mismatch and ageing trade breaks that contribute to disputes.
* Investigating and resolving trades breaking due to MTM discrepancy.
* Creating Dispute Notes and working with Margin Call team on trades breaking due to MTM discrepancy.
* Performing high level analysis on Booking / cash flows / FX / discounting / validation of Bid-offer prior to reaching out to Front Office / Valuations teams for further analysis.
* Ownership of Collateral Dispute which requires working with Risk / Front Office to review CSA level / trade level disputes and providing a clear status to allow next steps for resolution to be determined.
* Presenting findings to the management during meetings.
* Creating and maintaining KPIs and perform quality checks.
* Drive end-to-end process ownership by proactively identifying operational gaps and designing robust controls to mitigate risk. Act as the primary escalation point to resolve complex, aging breaks and high-level disputes, ensuring seamless operational continuity
* Act as an escalation point of contact for the team and manage day to day work allocation to ensure that the BAU is completed for the day.
* Perform control activities on aging breaks, disputes and intervene wherever required to resolve the breaks or course correct the investigation.
* Responsible for the continuous maintenance and optimization of process SOPs to ensure operational consistency. Lead the audit readiness process for IG and other regulatory reviews, ensuring timely and accurate provision of required documentation and evidence to auditors.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Training and mentoring the team members on the collateral mgmt process and instilling overall best practices for the team members
* Point of escalation for client queries, disputes, trade breaks and fails resolution.
* Work closely with other managers in Collateral Operations to perform effective capacity management.
* Working on developing and implements new controls / processes based on Business/ Risk / Industry evolution to better support the risk management needs of BNPP.
* Designing and testing new functionalities. Working on enhancements/automations that leads to efficiency gains in the process.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong Communication skills required for an effective liaison with counterparties and internal stakeholders to the reconciliation process. (Middle offices, marketers, traders, credit, compliance and legal)
* Knowledge of derivative products (Credit, Interest Rate, FX , Equities)
* Strong knowledge of Trade Life Cycle.
* Experience in Portfolio Reconciliation Operations, Collateral Management Operations or another Middle Office Operation functions within Investment Banking is favorable.
* Working experience on Trioptima, Acadia and POWER BI favorable
* Excel skills required.
* Experience of ISDA /GMRA documentation

**Specific Qualifications: (If required)**

* Minimum 8 years of experience along with Bachelor's Degree - in management, finance, related field or equivalent experience.

**Skills Referential (Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)**

* Skill 1 – Strong knowledge of Trade Life Cycle
* Skill 2 – Knowledge of derivative products (Credit, Interest Rate, FX , Equities).
* Skill 3 - Experience in Portfolio Reconciliation Operations, Collateral Management Operations or another Middle Office Operation functions within Investment Banking is favorable.

**Technical Skills**

* Skill 1 – MS office
* Skill 2 – Application understanding.

Skill 3 – Email Management
  
  
**Behavioral Skills**

* Skill 1 - Attention to detail / rigor
* Skill 2 - Organizational skills
* Skill 3 - Personal Impact / Ability to influence
* Skill 4 - Critical thinking

**Education Level:**
Bachelor Degree or equivalent
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**Shift**
: APAC/ EMEA/ NY
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. title: Senior Manager
description:
TITLE
  
  
Senior Manager, People Manager
  
  
**Who We Are**
Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences.
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you’ll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Position Overview**
Duck Creek’s products are designed for cloud-native true SaaS architecture and have a complex architecture that spans multiple layers of code and functionality. All products are deployed on the Azure cloud platform and use several Azure cloud services. We complete end-to-end automated testing and automate the end-to-end build to production deployment CI/CD processes. We are building a future-forward Duck Creek platform that will serve as the foundation for all the products and will provide multiple services that other products will use. The platform will include infrastructure, data, and various other services that will be required by all the products. You will work on one or more of Duck Creek’s products.
**As a Senior People Manager, Engineering**
, you will be responsible for managing and ensuring the performance and results of multiple agile teams across the Engineering organization. Your key responsibilities will include:
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Team Leadership and Management:

+ Manage and be accountable for the performance and results of multiple agile teams.
+ Lead and supervise teams, assuming people management responsibilities including the management of direct reports and subordinate team members.
+ Set performance objectives and conduct annual performance reviews.
+ Develop staff members through coaching and fostering a positive work environment.
+ Mentor and grow team leaders, ensuring they have the support and guidance needed to succeed.
+ Build and lead a culture of accountability to meet business objectives and goals.

* Strategic Planning and Execution:

+ Manage planning, staffing, budgeting, and expense priorities.
+ Recommend and implement changes to methods and processes.
+ Drive teams to adhere to existing processes and define new/improved processes.
+ Establish operational objectives and plans, delegating assignments to staff members.
+ Provide end-to-end governance and manage stakeholder relationships across the business group.
+ Perform risk and dependency management across the engineering organization.
+ Oversee resource planning activities and drive process improvement across the suite.

* Technical Leadership:

+ Lead and manage the technical activities of multiple complex software development projects.
+ Ensure the team delivers software within the accepted quality standards by facilitating a working “definition of done” (DoD) for Agile stories within each team.
+ Motivate teams to solve problems and deliver high-quality results.
+ Play an active lead role within the skill organization.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
  
  
**What You’ve Done**

* Education and Work Experience:

+ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Sciences, or a related field.
+ Total Work Experience: 15+ years (related to software development), 12 years minimum.
+ OR Master’s degree with 12+ years of experience.
+ Leadership Experience: 5 years minimum
+ Product Development Experience: 6+ years.
+ Minimum 1 year of experience in AI native development.

* Knowledge and Skills Required (AI and Development Skills):

+ Machine Learning fundamentals (supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement learning)
+ Deep Learning basics
+ Generative AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning concepts)
+ NLP, Computer Vision basics
+ Model lifecycle (training, validation, deployment)
+ MLOps concepts
+ API-based AI integration
+ Cloud AI services (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI)
+ Proficient in scalable, resilient, modern, cloud-native development with .NET (primarily), Python, or Typescript.
+ Proficient in Object-oriented design, .NET (preferred).
+ Proficient in CI/CD technologies to deliver software to customers with full automation.
+ Experience building monitoring, alerting, and observability for maintaining high customer SLAs for SaaS delivered products.
+ Excels in the ability to lead, teach, and guide modern software-development practices across Product Development, operating independently with guidance.

**Skills & Capabilities**

* Strong engineering background with the ability to multi-task and work on several projects simultaneously.
* Deep knowledge of Agile Scrum.
* Strong leadership skills with a focus on mentorship and team development.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to drive third-party relationships when required.
* Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Human relation skills or combined skills in understanding, developing, and/or motivating people.

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
* Benefits & Rewards – Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations.
  
  
This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Duck Creek is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements—without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead.

title: Head – Retail (Express Business)
description:
**Head – Retail (Express Business)**

**Location:**
Mumbai, India

**Experience:**
18–25 years

**About the Company**

Our organization is India’s largest integrated logistics services provider and a global leader in less-than-container-load consolidation, headquartered in Mumbai. With more than three decades of logistics experience, we operate across 180 countries, provide door-to-door delivery in more than 50 markets, and maintain extensive express distribution coverage across India. Growth has been shaped by organic expansion, strategic mergers and acquisitions, and entry into multiple logistics verticals. Our integrated portfolio spans international supply chain, express distribution, CFS-ICD, contract logistics, air freight, and logistics parks. By creating synergies across group businesses, we deliver customized supply-chain solutions. We aim to stay ahead through dynamic leadership, innovation, courageous decision-making, change management, and agile execution in India and globally.

**About the Role**

The Head – Retail will own the pan-India channel and retail ecosystem for the Express Business, converting network scale into profitable, sustainable growth. This leader will shape national strategy, expand franchise and partner coverage in underpenetrated markets, and own the Channel and Retail P&L across zones. The role will lead a network of more than 6,000 partners and approximately 4,000 employees through zonal leadership, while improving partner capability, retention, productivity, and returns. Success requires transforming retail experience through consistent outlets, technology-enabled visibility, customer-service improvements, activations, loyalty initiatives, and stronger governance. The leader will mentor zonal business heads and future leaders, establish audit and financial controls, and align Operations, Product, Finance, Marketing, HR, and L&D. Reporting to the National Head – Sales and Marketing, the role manages four to five direct reports and requires extensive travel across India.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and execute the national channel and retail strategy, aligning network expansion, partner economics, customer experience, and P&L outcomes with Express Business growth priorities.
* Expand into underpenetrated markets through scalable franchise and partner models, using market data, investment discipline, and clear return thresholds to build sustainable coverage.
* Own Channel and Retail P&L performance across zones, shifting the operating model from volume-led expansion toward value-based partner engagement, productivity, contribution, and profitability.
* Govern a network of more than 6,000 partners and approximately 4,000 employees through zonal leadership, strengthening capability, retention, grievance resolution, and long-term partner relationships.
* Establish data-backed channel-health metrics, CRM and retail analytics reviews, and performance cadences that improve partner productivity, outlet economics, visibility, and return on investment.
* Transform the retail experience through footprint expansion, brand consistency, technology-enabled service visibility, retail activation, loyalty programs, and coordinated customer engagement with Marketing.
* Build leadership depth by mentoring zonal business heads and next-line leaders, while partnering with HR and L&D on training for channel sales teams and franchise owners.
* Strengthen governance through franchise audits, financial controls, operational discipline, and cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Product, Finance, and industry stakeholders.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Deep expertise in logistics, express distribution, retail operations, franchise networks, and channel-partner ecosystems, with the judgment to balance scale, service quality, and profitable growth.
* Proven P&L ownership, financial acumen, negotiation, stakeholder management, and national-level commercial leadership across complex, distributed operating environments.
* Working familiarity with CRM, ERP, retail analytics, logistics software, inventory-management systems, and data-analysis tools used to improve visibility, decisions, execution, and governance.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience leading large-scale channel or franchise networks in logistics, express delivery, e-commerce, FMCG, or other distributed consumer-facing businesses will be advantageous.
* A postgraduate degree such as an MBA, exposure to national retail transformation, or experience with technology-enabled outlet models will strengthen candidacy.
* Demonstrated success in building partner capability, improving franchise profitability, and expanding coverage across underpenetrated geographies will be valued.

**What You'll Bring**

* You will bring 18–25 years of experience in channel leadership, franchise-network development, retail operations, logistics, express delivery, e-commerce, FMCG, or a closely related distributed business. At least five years should reflect national leadership responsibility, with ownership of large networks, multi-zone performance, and commercially material P&L outcomes.
* You will combine strategic thinking with execution discipline, translating market opportunities into scalable partner programs, stronger outlet economics, improved customer experience, and sustainable profitability. Your leadership will be grounded in analytical decision-making, problem-solving, negotiation, communication, and relationship management across partners, employees, and senior stakeholders.
* You will demonstrate customer focus, adaptability, resilience, integrity, and governance in a fast-moving environment. A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Logistics, or a related discipline is expected; an MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* You must be comfortable using data, CRM, ERP, retail analytics, logistics, inventory, and performance-management systems to create visibility and accountability. Extensive travel across India is essential for direct network engagement.

**Why Join Us**

* Shape the national retail and channel agenda for a large, integrated logistics platform, with direct ownership of partner ecosystem growth, customer experience transformation, and profitable Express Business outcomes.
* Influence a distributed ecosystem spanning more than 6,000 partners and approximately 4,000 employees, while building the next generation of zonal and channel leadership.
* Work across international supply chain, express distribution, contract logistics, air freight, and logistics-park businesses to create synergies and deliver integrated customer solutions.
* Lead a high-impact transformation agenda centered on technology, governance, partner economics, operational efficiency, and sustainable national expansion.

**What We Offer**

* A senior national leadership mandate with ownership of Channel and Retail P&L, strategic expansion, partner governance, customer experience, and profitability across India.
* The opportunity to work with a broad logistics portfolio, cross-functional leadership teams, and a large partner and retail ecosystem undergoing technology-enabled transformation.
* A performance-oriented environment that values innovation, courageous decisions, agile execution, collaboration, integrity, and disciplined governance.

title: Technical Service Manager (TSM) - Maritime, Mumbai
description:

As a partner to industry, we offer services in testing, certification, training, and technical advisory through the energy value chain. That means we’re continually investing heavily into R&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.
  
  
**About The Role**
Be the primary liaison for assigned Key Accounts on technical and operational matters which cannot be solved neither by DATE, nor by the Operational Centres or the surveyor network. Help the assigned Key Accounts maintain smooth technical operations and continuous vessel trade by providing personal attention, outstanding competence and added value in identifying, solving and advising the customer on those technical and operational issues in alignment with DNV’s purpose, business objectives and principles.
  
  
The result is that you maintain and develop a trustful win-win relationship and contribute to high customer satisfaction and loyalty which build an important foundation for DNV to maintain a high quality fleet, successfully retain existing business and secure new business.
  
  
Team up with the relevant Key Account Manager (KAM) and work collaboratively with the Account Team and all relevant departments within DNV to ensure that excellent technical customer service levels are delivered.
  
  
Be an important part of the Key Account Planning and Implementation process to help the KAM prepare and execute a high-impact Key Account Plan, Account Strategy and Actions that adds value to the customer and to DNV. Provide input to the KAM on the Key Account`s technical needs and expectations, relevant technology and regulatory developments, suitable strategies and actions related to the Key Account`s technical issues and technical operations. Help implement the assigned actions according to plan.
  
  
Develop and strengthen the customer relationship, operating at the Key Account`s technical department and technical management levels, to achieve preferred supplier status based on lasting personal relationships and the added value delivered.
  
  
Solve and advise on operational requests, customer technical concerns and technical complaints related to survey and audit performance in close collaboration with relevant technical experts and the KAM to ensure continuous vessel trade. Hand over customer requests to DATE or Operations Centres in case the requests fall into the service scope of those units.
  
  
Systematically identify any major technical and technical operation challenges and technical concerns related to the DNV interaction with the Key Account and cascade to the KAM and to relevant departments within DNV. Follow-up with the findings and ensure that related improvement activities are executed under utilization of the relevant DNV organization.
  
  
Bring in foresight and help spot and resolve potential technical problems before they occur.

title: Manager - Sourcing
description:
**About Us**
**Who we are:**
Samsonite is the worldwide leader in superior travel bags, luggage, and accessories combining notable style with the latest design technology and the utmost attention to quality and durability. For more than 100 years, Samsonite has leveraged its rich heritage to create unparalleled products that fulfill the travel lifestyle needs of conscious movers everywhere. With a portfolio of brands including Samsonite, Tumi, American Tourister, High Sierra, Gregory, Hartmann, and Lipault Paris, our products are sold in over 100 countries in North America, Asia, Europe and Latin America through our company-operated retail store, websites and a variety of retail partners.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Product Development & Commercialization: Manage product development from concept and design brief through sampling, prototyping, validation, pilot production and commercialization, ensuring approved samples, completed milestones and timely product launches.
* Vendor Development & Supplier Management: Identify, evaluate, onboard and develop domestic and international suppliers based on their technical capabilities, capacity, quality, commercial competitiveness and ability to meet business requirements.
* Costing, Negotiation & Value Engineering: Prepare and finalize product and raw material costing, negotiate pricing and commercial terms, identify alternate sourcing opportunities and drive cost optimization through material changes and value engineering.
* BOM & Pricing Management: Prepare, finalize, and maintain accurate Bills of Material (BOMs), pricing records and cost documentation for finished goods, raw materials and components, ensuring data accuracy and availability for business decisions.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate with Design, Marketing, Quality, Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain teams to finalize requirements, secure approvals, resolve development issues and ensure timely product launches.
* Supplier Quality, Performance & Compliance: Monitor supplier adherence to quality standards and company requirements, support audits and compliance reviews, resolve development and consumer quality issues, and drive corrective actions and periodic supplier performance evaluations.
* Market Intelligence & Continuous Improvement: Monitor supplier and material trends, identify alternate sources, develop supplier capacity, improve sourcing processes and support strategic sourcing initiatives and special projects.
* Project, MIS & Documentation Management: Maintain product development trackers, sourcing databases, supplier agreements, NDAs, costing records, MIS reports and supporting documentation to ensure effective project monitoring, reporting and record control.

Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Industrial Engineering, Production Engineering, Polymer Engineering, Textile Engineering, or equivalent.
  
  
MBA/PGDM in Operations, Supply Chain, or Materials Management will be an added advantage.
  
  
**Experience Required**
12–15 years of experience in Product Development, Vendor Development, Sourcing, or Manufacturing within the luggage, backpacks, bags, footwear, consumer goods, plastics, or related manufacturing industries.
  
  
Experience in managing end-to-end New Product Development (NPD), vendor management, costing, BOM preparation, and cross-functional project execution.
  
  
Exposure to ERP systems (preferably LN ERP) is desirable.
  
  
**About The Team**
**Why you'll love working here:**

* Our employees matter. As a people-focused business, we work hard to provide meaningful rewards and development opportunities for our employees, recognizing performance, and creating a supportive working environment for them, wherever they are based.
* Vibrant culture. We are committed to a diverse and rich culture, welcoming people from all walks of life. Our long-standing commitment to culture and inclusion empowers us to bring our authentic selves and unique differences to work every day.
* Socially responsible. We want to minimize our products' impact on the environment and help create positive journeys worldwide. We do this by creating the best products using the most sustainable and innovative materials, methods, and models.

**What We Value**
At Samsonite, we do more than create the bags that move with our consumer, we inspire and celebrate the moments that move them. We believe we have a responsibility to the world in how we operate, the products we sell, the communities where we live and work, and how we treat the people we employ. We're as diverse as travel itself, and like travel, your journey with Samsonite presents the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and explore your passions. This is why we offer various paths for professionals and celebrate the knowledge and skills they bring to our team. We are committed to a respectful workplace that allows our team members to bring their best selves to the workplace daily.
  
  
Samsonite is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting and maintaining a work environment in which all applicants, associates, customers, and other individuals are treated with dignity and respect free from unlawful harassment, discrimination, or retaliation.

title: Head of Operations
description: The RoleWe're hiring a Head of Operations to run Adzzat day to day. Today our COO does it himself. Your job is to take it off his plate and run it better. Adzzat is the delivery layer behind AI data companies. They bring the project. We bring vetted engineers, finance experts and annotators from across India, and we run everything else: vetting, onboarding, quality, project management and payouts. Our promise to clients is simple: you get the output, we handle the ops. We're growing fast, and you're the person who keeps that promise as we do.What a week looks likeNo two weeks are the same. A typical one, compressed:Monday: A client sends a new project: 200 expert tasks in 10 days, in a skill we've never staffed. By Wednesday you've scoped it, tested the first 20 people and shipped a pilot batch.Tuesday: A batch comes back with too many rejections. By evening you know why. By morning the guidelines are fixed and the team is retrained. Wednesday: A prospect wants samples by Friday to decide on a pilot. They get them Thursday. Thursday: Your best reviewer is out mid-deadline. Nothing slips, because you never let one person become the bottleneck. Friday: Payout day. Hundreds of tasks across projects and pay tiers. Everyone is paid on time and the numbers match the invoice. In between: client calls, contributor escalations, and at least one problem nobody has seen before.You're measured on: On-time delivery First-pass acceptance (work the client accepts without rework) Days from kickoff to first accepted batch Payouts on time and accurate Retention of top contributors Founder hours spent in ops (target: close to zero)

title: Utm Supervisor

description:

Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Providing superior customer service and ensuring operational efficiency in all Teller and clearing functions like withdrawals, deposits, transfers, customer queries on transactions
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities: Key activities and decision making areas**
**Impact on the Business**

* Increasing PIB registrations and migrating teller queues to the ATMs.
* Ensure that a Cross sell attempt is made for every customer interaction at the teller counter
* Process cash payments and accept cash deposits after carrying out all necessary operational checks as per guidelines.
* All operational requirements like bundling, labeling, sorting of notes is done and no soiled notes are handed over back to the customer.
* Ensure that his/her cash position is as per the laid down cash control procedures, and cash till is balanced end of day every day.
* Minimize cash differences and ensure that they are informed immediately to the Teller Supervisor.
* Maintain control over all deliverables like cheque books, Cards, pins, welcome packs, IWPs. Ensure that all collect items are handed over to the customers as per the laid down operational guidelines and after carrying out all necessary checks as mandated from time to time.
* Ensure satisfactory implementation of all audit recommendations with the assistance of the Teller Supervisor. To identify process gaps with a view to ensure compliance of the procedures.
* Ensure that ATMs are replenished and all ATM related facilities are available to the customer as required by the internal policy of the bank.

**Typical Targets And Measures**

* Transaction migration to ADCs
* Cross Sell of bank products
* Teller Operations
* Error Rates

**Customers/Stakeholders**

* Ensure effective service of customers by providing prompt and qualitative service
* Through effective service delivery, which would include prompt reply to customer queries and complaints, identifying and implementing initiatives to reduce customer waiting time, monitoring customer service scores on an ongoing basis and driving improvements in these scores
* Ensure that customer complaints are handled within defined TATs, and all staff is sensitised to proactively manage customer service issues
* Dockable complaints should be kept within acceptable benchmarks
* VOC on the Teller Parameters

**Leadership & Teamwork**

* Teamwork
* By effective communication and by regular discussions and feedback

* Teller functions

( applicable for CSMs in smaller branches)
  
  

* Audit and operational responsibility. Maintain HSBC internal control standards.
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ INM FCC office/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the AML and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of AML policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional FCC AML Office/ AML Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the AML and Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated by the AML Education Lead FCC;
* Requesting additional AML training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD & EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM RBWM is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP.
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by INM RBWM example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM RBWM customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers

* Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non-adherence to the policy laid down in the LoBP
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification

* Reduction in customer waiting periods, and accurate transaction processing.

Constant pressure of customer queries

Service proposition is a key differentiator in any retail business, and the jobholder needs to ensure a positive customer experience on a consistent basis in basic retail banking operations
  
  
**Management of Risk**
Adheres to processes and controls to identify and mitigate risks and ensures timely escalation of control issues and reputation risks.

title: Governance & Financial Control, Vice President, Business Unit Management

* Oversee invoice, accrual, allocation, vendor, and operational controls, including billing recovery, SLA compliance, utilization, payment aging, and exception remediation
* Lead major vendor reviews and process improvements, embedding stronger SLAs, automation, and governance into business-as-usual operations
* Define and govern MIS requirements, KPIs, thresholds, dashboards, and reporting standards to provide leadership and OpCos with visibility into control health, savings, and exceptions
* Partner with Technology, Finance, Sourcing, Service Owners, and process-optimization teams to translate control requirements into reporting and automation solutions while protecting data integrity
* Provide independent challenge and governance reporting, driving issue resolution, continuous improvement, centralized exception management, and knowledge transfer across the CS governance function

**What You'll Bring To The Role**

title: Head of Operations
description:
**The Role**

We're hiring a Head of Operations to run Adzzat day to day. Today our COO does it himself. Your job is to take it off his plate and run it better. Adzzat is the delivery layer behind AI data companies. They bring the project. We bring vetted engineers, finance experts and annotators from across India, and we run everything else: vetting, onboarding, quality, project management and payouts. Our promise to clients is simple: you get the output, we handle the ops. We're growing fast, and you're the person who keeps that promise as we do.

**What a week looks like**

No two weeks are the same. A typical one, compressed:

**Monday:** A client sends a new project: 200 expert tasks in 10 days, in a skill we've never staffed. By Wednesday you've scoped it, tested the first 20 people and shipped a pilot batch.

**Tuesday:** A batch comes back with too many rejections. By evening you know why. By morning the guidelines are fixed and the team is retrained.

**Wednesday:** A prospect wants samples by Friday to decide on a pilot. They get them Thursday.

**Thursday:** Your best reviewer is out mid-deadline. Nothing slips, because you never let one person become the bottleneck.

**Friday:** Payout day. Hundreds of tasks across projects and pay tiers. Everyone is paid on time and the numbers match the invoice.

In between: client calls, contributor escalations, and at least one problem nobody has seen before.

**You're measured on:**

* On-time delivery
* First-pass acceptance (work the client accepts without rework)
* Days from kickoff to first accepted batch
* Payouts on time and accurate
* Retention of top contributors
* Founder hours spent in ops (target: close to zero)

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Department Manager
description:
**WHO WE ARE**
**​**

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
**​**
  
As a Department Manager, you’ll be the leader supporting and encouraging your whole team. By fostering an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration and an entrepreneurial spirit, you’ll create an environment where everyone can thrive. Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to both your own success and the success of the company.

You will:

* Lead your team to deliver an outstanding customer experience by ensuring excellent operational and visual standards, while actively promoting and selling our products.
* Take responsibility for your store and department’s strengths, analyse sales performance, identify commercial opportunities, set goals, and create plans to optimize results, profits, and stock levels.
* Manage team planning, scheduling, and ensure seamless opening and closing routines.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop your team while fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture that promotes growth and innovation.
* Stay updated on fashion trends, customer preferences, and competitors to maintain a competitive edge.
* Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions.

​

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.

​

​

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**
**​**

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

· We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability.

· We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years.

· We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work

· You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits.

· We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness for self and family.

· You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M group.

· We offer 5 days of working in a week to have great work life balance.

Click here for complete role description.

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

​

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

​

​

* 3+ Years of experience in retail management and operations.

description:
**About Agoda**

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

**About Agoda**

 

 

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodation, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting edge technology that connects travelers with more than 2.5 million accommodations globally. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 4,000+ talents coming from 90+ different nationalities foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enabling our customers to experience the world.  

 

**Get to Know our Team:**

 

 

The Customer Experience Group of Agoda effectively serves our customers and partners to ensure satisfying results. This great task is accomplished with the support of our Global Service Vertical team. We serve as the backbone for Customer Experience Group’s global operations. Our team is comprised of project managers, process owners, analysts, and talent management. Together we work nonstop to improve the quality and efficiency of our customer and partner support processes. Working with the Global Service Vertical team is a great opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders and develop initiatives with our sister companies and external partners all over the world. We are a very data-driven environment, eager to move fast and learn through experimentation. A clear focus on supporting our customers and partners is bolstered by a strong, entrepreneurial culture that enriches us and Agoda’s business performance.

 

 

 

**The Opportunity:**

 

The Senior Associate WFM Manager is a people leader in role, responsible for leading a WFM team, enabling them to be successful and delivering against the prescribed KPIs.

 

The Manager enables their team and team members by providing coaching and feedback, building strong professional relationships, maintaining a regular flow of communication, and providing direction, support, and development.

 

The Manager also contributes to the overall WFM performance and culture, collaborating with peers and broader colleagues to ensure WFM delivers to the company and CEG objectives.

 

The Senior Associate WFM Manager is expected to be an SME in Workforce Management, having a good knowledge of WFM concepts, to support the team with challenges and capability and to adequately represent WFM, to senior stakeholders.

 

 

 

**ACTIVITIES PERFORMED ON THE JOB:**

 

* ****Coaching and giving feedback:****

* Coaching and providing feedback within WFM (usually one-on-one) constructively and creatively, to enable colleagues to perform at their best.

* Review performance of individuals and team using performance reports/dashboards, observations, buddying, and reviewing system audit reports.

* Manage all underperformance, using the Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) process where appropriate.

* ****People leadership:****

* Build healthy and professional relationships with team members.

* Establish and nurture a culture of performance excellence, open feedback, collaboration, recognition, and quality delivery of outcomes.

* Organize team building activities that will engage people in teamwork and create a positive work environment.

* Ensure the team is well supported to perform their day-to-day activities, including:

* ensuring appropriate real-time support is available, taking and managing escalated issues.

* Providing approvals as part of the business process (e.g. absorption).

* Ensure team schedule is maintained to a high standard to provide stakeholder support and manage team requests and unplanned absence, in line with process.

* Provide clarity on performance vs targets, and any other team or group objectives.

* Use reward and recognition as part of motivating the team.

* Conduct team meetings: sharing important information, updates, performance progress, and broader company updates.

* Ensure your team is connected to the company's WFM objectives and strategy.

* Be an example to the team through behavior, living up to the Agoda values and behavior standards expected of people leaders.

* Collaborate with other departments, working together to enable overall success (e.g. WFM teams, CEG Operations Teams, CEG Teach Team).

* ****Reporting & data analysis:****

* Work with data from various sources to analyze and observe performance of CEG SLAs and gain insights as a basis for feedback and change suggestions.

* Prepare and present team performance data, challenges, issues, ideas, and opportunities.

* ****Collaboration:****

* Collaborate with local WFM team:

* On team performance: providing updates about the team, traffic, projects, concerns, challenges, and opportunities.

* Participate actively in leadership meetings: share what works well for you, provide feedback and input on decisions or updates, and be open and constructive about what is not working well and how the group can improve.

* Stay up to date with products, news, goals, decisions, projects.

* Collaborate with other teams:

* CEG Operations Leadership and Management.

* CEG GSV.

* ****Personal Management:****

* Remain up to date with important company/team/department updates, requirements.

* Act in the best interests of the organization: ensuring that we operate with absolute integrity and compliance with all legal obligations or compliance requirements.

* Be an active and constructive Agoda team member: Always being respectful to others and seeking to be better together.

* Aim to understand, then meet and exceed the expectations agreed with your manager.

 

**EXPECTATIONS - BEHAVIORS AND VALUES**

 

**Behavior**

 

**Definition**

 

***Continuous improvement***

 

Regularly identify improvement opportunities, quantify them, and follow through to measurable/demonstratable outcomes. Embraces both successes and failures to learn and maximize the benefits.
 
  

Embraces and drives change, is open and supportive of improvement opportunities identified by others.

 

***Deliver better together***

 

Collaborates and engages with colleagues and broader Agoda teams to share ideas and learn and work together toward shared ambitions.
 
  

Is respectful to colleagues, open to different perspectives /viewpoints, and positively contributes to discussions.

 

***Enable others` success***

 

Is committed to building and nurturing a culture of frequent feedback, coaching and career development. 
 
  

Provides clarity on accountability, goals, and progress.
 
  

Regularly takes the opportunity to connect and align teams and team members to the Agoda/CEG strategy, making these relevant and digestible.

 

 

**COMPETENCIES REQUIRED**

 

**Analytical Ability & Problem Solving**

 

Can visualise, articulate, conceptualise, or solve both complex and uncomplicated problems using the data available.

 

**Decision making ability**

 

Set a course of action purposely chosen from different alternatives to achieve company objectives.

 

**Effective communication**

(Verbal and written)

 

Delivers, receives, and interprets ideas and information, presents information appropriately to a diverse range of audiences, and influences partner decisions Excel/Power Point Skills

 

**Flexibility and Agility**

 

Can adjust behavior to new information and changing circumstances. Be open to new ways of doing things and always experiment with new methods. Works effectively in a dynamic environment.

 

**KPI management**

 

Create and execute a KPI plan designed to help achieve and evaluate success in reaching the company's goals.

 

**Listening and influencing**

 

Practice attentive and active listening. Can influence strategies that persuade key stakeholders to take action that will promote shared interests and business goals.

 

**Process Improvement**

 

Organise, evaluate, plan, and implement improvements in our internal and external processes and practices. Actively work on creating better processes once changes take place.

 

**Reporting**

 

 Be able to confidently give a written account of business metrics, projects, and team performance based on data, observations, or investigations.

 

**Result driven**

 

Driving high standards to accomplish challenging goals. Works hard to achieve them.

 

**Time / workload management & prioritization**

 

Creating a work environment where tasks and responsibilities are accomplished successfully within the time available.

 

**Coaching**

 

Support and develop team members to achieve a specific personal and professional goal by guiding and training.

 

**Develop and Manage team**

 

Govern and coordinate the team to perform in their job. Learn the skills, potential, and ambitions of the team members and define long term success.

 

**Operational Planning & Coordination**

 

Create and execute a detailed plan with the aim to provide a clear vision on how the team, department will contribute to the achievement of the company’s strategic goals

 

**People training**

 

Identify training needs, create, and develop training to help team members with specific knowledge or skills to improve performance in their current roles.

 

**Presentation**

 

Clearly conveys information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message.

 

**Team level KPI management**

 

Create and execute a team KPI plan designed to help achieve and evaluate success in reaching the company goals.

 

 

 

**Qualifications, Experience and Trainings required:**

 

**Qualifications**

 

High level written & verbal language/communication skills. Intermediate or above computer literacy (MS Excel particularly), high level problem solving / analytical reasoning skills. High level stakeholder management skills.

6+ years of

WFM experience

Experience in coaching and developing, in a technical environment.

 

Experience in delivering high-level business objectives or initiatives.

OJT, WFM onboarding, RT Onboarding
