description:
**About Agoda**

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**

 

The WFM Manager is a people leader role, responsible for the leadership of a team of WFM Capacity Planners, enabling them to be successful and delivering against the prescribed KPIs.

 

The Manager enables their team and team members by providing coaching and feedback, building strong professional relationships, maintaining a regular flow of communication, and providing encouragement, support, and development.

 

The Manager also contributes to the overall WFM performance and culture, collaborating with peers and broader colleagues to ensure WFM delivers to the company and CEG objectives.

 

The WFM Manager is expected to have a good knowledge of WFM concepts, to support the team with challenges and capability and to adequately represent WFM, to senior stakeholders.

 

 

**ACTIVITIES PERFORMED ON THE JOB**

 

* ****People leadership****

* Foster a positive team culture through open feedback, collaboration, recognition, and clear communication of performance expectations and CEG/ WFM objectives

* Oversee team performance against targets, supporting specialists in overcoming obstacles, and providing guidance to facilitate problem-solving and effective decision-making.

* Upholding Agoda Value and CEG Leadership behaviors with high standard of professionalism

 

 

* ****WFM Reporting & data analysis****

* Capacity Modelling: Participate in the design and implementation of capacity modelling activities and projects, focusing on enhancing the accuracy of volume forecasting and other valuable metric

* Data management: Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Analytics, Ops, HR) on design, and manage tracking for WFM key metrics

* Data analysis/ approach: Recommend actions for maintaining SLAs, identifying process gaps through deep dives and implementing improvements,

* Reporting and presentation: Preparing and presenting team performance data, challenges, and opportunities.

 

 

* ****Collaboration****

* Collaborate with local WFM teams

* Provide regular updates on team performance, traffic trends, ongoing projects, challenges, and opportunities.

* Actively participate in leadership meetings by sharing best practices, offering constructive feedback, and contributing to group improvements.

* Stay informed about company products, updates, goals, decisions, and projects to align team efforts effectively.

* Collaborate with other teams/Stakeholder:

* Work closely with stakeholders to understand the gaps and work towards the solution

* Partner with GSV and Operations teams on various initiatives and projects

* Management:

* Stay updated on key company, team, and departmental updates to ensure alignment with organizational priorities.

* Collaborate to deliver on CEG, divisional, and project objectives while maintaining a focus on integrity and compliance.

 

 

* **Coaching and giving feedback**

* Provide constructive and creative one-on-one coaching and feedback to WFM team members to help them achieve their best performance.

* Regularly review performance with Capacity Planners and the team through performance reports, dashboards, observations, buddying sessions, and system audit reviews.

* Address underperformance effectively by utilizing the Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) process when necessary

 

 

**COMPETENCIES REQUIRED**

 

**Analytical Ability & Problem Solving**

 

Can visualize, articulate, conceptualize, or solve complex problems using the data available.

 

**Decision making ability**

 

Set a course of action purposely chosen from different alternatives to achieve company objectives.

 

**Effective communication**

(Verbal and written)

 

Delivers, receives, and interprets ideas and information, presents information appropriately to a diverse range of audiences, and influences partner decisions Excel/Power Point Skills

 

**Flexibility and Agility**

 

Can adjust behavior to new information and changing circumstances. Be open to new ways of doing things and always experiment with new methods. Works effectively in a dynamic environment.

 

**KPI management**

 

Execute a KPI plan designed to help achieve and evaluate the success in reaching the company goals.

 

**Listening and influencing**

 

Practice attentive and active listening. Can influence strategies that persuade key stakeholders to take action that will promote shared interests and business goals.

 

**Process Improvement**

 

Organize, evaluate, plan, and implement improvements in our internal and external processes and practices. Actively work on creating better processes once changes take place.

 

**Reporting**

 

 Be able to confidently give a written account of business metrics, projects and team performance based on data, observations, or investigations.

 

**Result driven**

 

Driving high standards to accomplish challenging goals. Works hard to achieve them.

 

**Time / workload management & prioritization**

 

Creating a work environment where tasks and responsibilities are accomplished successfully within the time available.

 

**Coaching**

 

Support and develop team members to achieve a specific personal and professional goal by guiding and training.

 

**Develop and Manage team**

 

Govern and coordinate the team to perform in their job. Learn the skills, potential and ambitions of the team members and define long term success.

 

**Operational Planning & Coordination**

 

Create and execute a detailed plan with the aim to provide a clear vision on how the team, department will contribute to the achievement of the company’s strategic goals

 

**People training**

 

Identify training needs, create, and develop trainings to help team member’s specific knowledge or skill to improve performance in their current roles.

 

**Presentation**

 

Clearly conveys information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message.

 

**Team level KPI management**

 

Create and execute a team KPI plan designed to help achieve and evaluate the success in reaching the company goals.

 

 

 

**NICE TO HAVE:**

 

* Experience being a functional lead.

* Experience in setting functional level OKRs.

* Experience in presenting to Director-level stakeholders.

* Project Management qualifications (e.g. Prince or SixSigma).

* Experience in SQL, Python, metabase, etc

title: Manufacturing Engineering Supervisor / Deputy Manager for Manufacturing Engineering
description:
**Summary**
Responsible for managing a production shift in order to meet production schedules, quality, and cost objectives.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.**
**Leadership And Management Responsibilities**
Recruitment and Retention:
  
  
q Communicate criteria to recruiters for manufacturing position candidates.
  
  
q Monitor team member turnover; identify key factors that can be improved; make improvements.
  
  
Employee and Team Development:
  
  
q Identify individual and team strengths and development needs on an ongoing basis by streamlining processes and systems.
  
  
q Validate training curriculum in area of responsibility.
  
  
q Coach and mentor manufacturing staff to deliver excellence to every internal and external customer.
  
  
Performance Management:
  
  
q Express pride in staff and encourage them to feel good about their accomplishments.
  
  
q Responsible for managing labor discipline and policy issues with employees.
  
  
q Perform team member evaluations professionally and on time.

q Coordinate activities of large teams and keep them focused in times of crisis.
  
  
q Ensure recognition and rewards are managed fairly and consistently in area of responsibility.
  
  
q Utilize tools to monitor production line cost and cost trends, striving continuously to improve value.
  
  
Communication:
  
  
q Organize verbal and written ideas clearly and use an appropriate business style.
  
  
q Ask questions; encourage input from team members.
  
  
q Assess communication style of individual team members and adapt own communication style accordingly.
  
  
**Functional Management Responsibilities**
Business Strategy and Direction:
  
  
q Develop an understanding of the Workcell business strategy as it pertains to Manufacturing.
  
  
q Drive team to achieve daily/weekly/monthly goals.
  
  
q Review labor reports for accuracy.
  
  
**Technical Management Responsibilities**
q Minimize excessive material on production floor.
  
  
q Review and analyze production, quality control, maintenance, and operational reports to determine causes of nonconformity with product specifications, and operating or production problems.
  
  
q Implement and validate operating methods and procedures designed to eliminate operating problems and improve product quality.
  
  
q Consult with engineering personnel relative to modification of machines and equipment in order to improve production and quality products.
  
  
q Monitor the quality system to recognize and fix repetitive problems immediately.
  
  
q Supervise production activities and assists in establishing production priorities for products in keeping with effective operations and cost factors. Verifies that only current, accurate and authorized documentation is available to production.
  
  
q Assist in the coordination of production activities with procurement, maintenance, and quality control activities to obtain optimum production and utilization of human resources, machines, and equipment.
  
  
q Coordinate and distribute required information throughout the process flow such as; Test, Specialty Repair, X-Ray, etc.
  
  
q Assist in the minimization of scrap and materials request order (MRO) usage.
  
  
q Sustain the 5S process.
  
  
q Ensure that line employees read, understand and adhere to appropriate policies and procedures.
  
  
q Ensure proper stocking and availability of operation supplies and equipment.
  
  
q Conduct daily shift meeting.
  
  
q Timely disposition of MRB.
  
  
q Kronos/timecard administration.
  
  
q Review and sign off ECN's and deviations.
  
  
q Review daily schedule, coordinate and communicate changes.
  
  
q Respond to CAR's, sorts, purges, etc.
  
  
q Continually monitor status of the line.
  
  
q The first shift Manufacturing Supervisor will be an active participant in the CAC process.
  
  
q Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.
  
  
q Comply and follow all procedures within the company security policy.

Bachelor’s degree is preferred; and two plus years experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

title: IT Service Delivery Leader - Senior (SAP Service Management)
description:
**Job Summary**
Responsible for the management, operations, delivery and support of defined IT applications and/or infrastructure services; directs and coordinates the efforts of people to accomplish goals and objectives using available resources.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Contributes to the delivery and support of specific IT services. Supports the development and maintenance of services and ensures that tools and resources are capable and available (i.e. IT Service Catalog, Asset Management system) Generates and reports service delivery metrics and drives standards across regions and locations (i.e. Scorecards, Service Level Agreement (SLAs) and Customer Satisfaction or Net Promoter Scoring). Acts as a point of contact for customers for service related inquiries and maintains relationships with key customers and suppliers. Is familiar with SLA / Operational Level Agreements between other IT Services Provided. Encourages root cause analysis using the formal problem solving approach for recurring issues. Champions the use of Six Sigma to reduce costs and improve processes. Identifies opportunities for service improvements, discuss with the customer and raise the request for change for assessment if appropriate Maintains the accuracy of service related standards, procedures and work instructions in a knowledge management system. Able to support the Service Owner when needed. Champions the use of ITIL Standards for IT Service Deliverables Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices.
  
  
**Competencies**
Financial acumen - Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.
  
  
Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.
  
  
Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
  
  
IT Supplier Relationships - Leverages a vendor management framework to manage strategic supplier relationships and supplier performance based on business need throughout the contract life using the required processes and tools to control costs, drive service excellence, mitigate risks, and gain increased value from the suppliers.
  
  
Request Fulfillment - Manages a service request through its life cycle with efficiency and professionalism using the required processes and tools to maintain customer satisfaction.
  
  
Service Asset and Configuration Management - Manages service assets and configuration items by maintaining accurate configuration records to support other service management processes with documented and verifiable information.
  
  
Service Catalog Management - Maintains a service catalog that contains all details of active and approved services in service operations using the required processes and tools to provide clear and relevant information to users.
  
  
Service Level Management - Ensures the quality of the services delivered meet agreed levels using the required processes and tools in order to maintain customer satisfaction.
  
  
Troubleshooting - Diagnoses and resolves the customer-identified issue by utilizing appropriate department standards to satisfy customer expectations.
  
  
Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
**Experience**
Intermediate level of relevant work experience required. 5+ years of experience.

title: Manufacturing/Production Head
description:
**CAbout the Role**

**We are looking for an experienced Manufacturing Head / Plant Head**
to lead and manage end-to-end manufacturing and plant operations for our medical technology business.

The role will be responsible for ensuring efficient manufacturing operations while maintaining high standards of quality, compliance, productivity, cost control, and on-time delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end manufacturing and plant operations, including production planning, assembly, testing, dispatch, and operational execution.
* Develop and implement manufacturing strategies aligned with business and production requirements.
* Manage production planning and scheduling to achieve quality, productivity, and delivery targets.
* Establish and monitor KPIs for production, quality, productivity, yield, OEE, cost, and delivery.
* Ensure compliance with applicable quality management systems, regulatory requirements, SOPs, and manufacturing standards.
* Work closely with Quality, R&D, Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain, Service, and Commercial teams.
* Drive process improvement, lean manufacturing, waste reduction, productivity improvement, and cost optimization.
* Identify manufacturing bottlenecks and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure effective utilization of manpower, machines, materials, and plant infrastructure.
* Lead capacity planning and support new product introduction (NPI), product transfer, and manufacturing scale-up.
* Establish robust systems for process validation, production documentation, traceability, and change management.
* Manage vendors and contract manufacturing partners, wherever applicable.
* Ensure adherence to EHS and workplace safety requirements.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing manufacturing and plant operations team.
* Prepare and manage manufacturing budgets, operational costs, and resource requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across the plant.
* Participate in internal and external quality/regulatory audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
* Provide regular operational updates and manufacturing performance reports to senior management.

**Relevant Skills and Knowledge**

**·       Strong leadership in plant operations, production planning, capacity management, and team development.**

**·       In-depth knowledge of medical-device and IVD manufacturing, including assembly, testing, packaging, labeling, traceability, and product release controls.**

**·       Working knowledge of ISO 13485, applicable regulatory requirements, Good Manufacturing Practices, and audit-readiness expectations.**

**·       Strong understanding of process validation, equipment qualification, manufacturing documentation, nonconformance control, CAPA, risk management, and change control.**

**·       Experience with lean manufacturing, operational excellence, root-cause analysis, waste reduction, OEE, yield improvement, and cost optimization.**

**·       Knowledge of supply chain coordination, inventory control, vendor management, and contract manufacturing oversight.**

**·       Ability to support NPI, design transfer, production scale-up, and cross-functional issue resolution.**

* **·       Strong analytical, decision-making, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.**

title: Site Manager| Experience - 5+ | Location - Pune |
description:
**Position:**
**Sr. Site Manager**
**Location:**
**Pune, Maharashtra**
We are looking for a dynamic, target-driven, and experienced Real Estate Site Visit Manager to oversee site visit operations, manage customer relationships, and drive sales performance. The candidate should have strong knowledge of real estate sales and site operations, excellent communication and negotiation skills, and the ability to lead a team effectively.
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing prospective customer visits, monitoring sales leads and conversions, coordinating with site teams, and ensuring an excellent customer experience while achieving monthly sales targets.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**
• Site Visit Management: Plan, coordinate, and manage property site visits for prospective customers, ensuring a smooth and professional experience.
  
• Customer Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong client relationships by understanding customer requirements, providing personalized assistance, and ensuring timely resolution of concerns.
  
• Property Knowledge and Guidance: Conduct site visits to understand property features, amenities, location advantages, and potential risks, providing relevant guidance to customers during their buying or selling decisions.
  
• Project Presentation: Explain project details, pricing, payment plans, amenities, location benefits, and other relevant information based on customer requirements.
  
• Site Team Coordination: Coordinate with site teams to ensure the smooth execution of customer visits and efficient day-to-day operations.
  
• Team Leadership: Supervise and guide the site team, allocate responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure team members work toward achieving business objectives.
  
• Lead and Conversion Tracking: Monitor leads, follow-ups, scheduled site visits, customer feedback, and sales conversion status to maintain an effective sales pipeline.
  
• Customer Issue Resolution: Address customer queries, concerns, and complaints professionally, ensuring timely follow-up and customer satisfaction.
  
• Reporting and Performance Monitoring: Prepare and submit daily,weekly & Monthly reports covering sales performance, lead status, site visits, follow-ups, conversions, and team activities.
  
• Operational Coordination: Ensure effective communication and coordination between the sales team, site team, and management to support business goals.
  
  
  
**Requirements:**
• Minimum 5+ years of experience in sales and site visit management, preferably in the real estate industry.
  
• Strong understanding of real estate sales processes, site operations, and customer management.
  
• Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and client-handling skills.
  
• Proven leadership abilities with experience in managing and motivating teams.
  
• Strong follow-up, planning, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
  
• Target-oriented mindset with a focus on sales performance and conversion.
  
• Good knowledge of the Pune real estate market will be an added advantage.
  
• Willingness to travel regularly to project sites and manage on-site activities.
  
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

title: Manager- Electrical (Reliability)
description:
**About Hygenco:**

Hygenco aims to be a global leader in deploying Green Hydrogen and Green Ammonia-powered

industry solutions. We develop and deploy scaled-up, commercially attractive Green Hydrogen

and Green Ammonia production assets. We combine our in-house expertise in renewable power,

process industry, gases, and project financing with the latest innovation and know-how from our

network of global OEMs and EPC firms. Hygenco is founded by industry professionals bringing in

combined 30+ years of experience in Construction, Renewables, Operations & Maintenance, Investment Banking, and Private Equity.

**Job Overview:**
We are seeking a leading role in Electrical Reliability for our H2 Generation Plant and on-site Solar installations. These plants operate using Solar, Wind, Battery storage or Grid connections, either individually or in combination. This position entails ensuring the reliability of all plants from an electrical standpoint, encompassing both HV & LV systems. The ideal candidate must possess a solid understanding of transformers, rectifiers, breakers, motors, etc. (prior solar experience will be an added advantage). Responsibilities include developing safe operating procedures for electrical operations, creating preventive maintenance schedules for equipment, conducting root cause analyses on failures, devising spare parts plans for the plants, and assisting sites in identifying and troubleshooting issues, either remotely or through on-site visits depending on the severity of the issue.

Supporting the engineering team in identifying suitable equipment, reviewing, and implementing changes by creating MOC (Management of Change) documents are key responsibilities of this role. While the base location for this position will be in Pune, frequent visits to multiple plants across India will be necessary.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinating with site teams to oversee day-to-day operations.
* Establishing a preventive maintenance (PM) schedule for all electrical equipment.
* Ensuring the timely completion of PM tasks.
* Conducting root cause analyses (RCA) on equipment failures and facilitating troubleshooting efforts.
* Developing Safe Operating Procedures (SOPs) for electrical operations.
* Guaranteeing compliance with electrical safety regulations at the site in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
* Providing training to site engineers and technicians on electrical operations and safety protocols.
* Implementing and promoting a safe work culture at the site through the implementation of Permit-to-Work (PtW) systems, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures, and Management of Change (MOC) processes.
* Assisting the project and engineering teams in equipment selection and supporting pre-commissioning/commissioning activities for new plants. Liaising with government offices to ensure compliance with regulations.
* Taking responsibility for maintenance and troubleshooting activities related to solar plants, which are integral to the core plant operations.

**Qualifications:**

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering.

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in continuous process plant/Gas Plant/ASU/SMR/Chemical-Fertilizer plants, etc.

• Strong knowledge of Solar PV-based power generation control and wind power generation control. Control of BESS power systems will be additional value.

**Desired Skills:**

An Electrical Engineer should have a deep-seated passion for sustainable energy and a desire to make a positive impact on the environment.

**Creativity:**
As renewable energy technologies continue to evolve, an electrical engineer should have the ability to think creatively and develop innovative solutions to operational challenges.

**Analytical thinking:**
Electrical Engineers should be able to analyse data, interpret results, and make sound engineering decisions.

**Team player:**
Electrical Engineers should be able to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution.

**Adaptability:**
Electrical Engineers should be able to adapt to changing circumstances and be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

**Problem-solving skills:**
Electrical Engineers should be able to identify problems and develop solutions to overcome them.

**Attention to detail:**
Electrical Engineers should have a strong attention to detail to ensure that projects are completed to required standards.

**Integrity:**
Electrical Engineers should operate with the utmost integrity and be committed to ethical engineering practices.

**Continuous learning:**
Electrical Engineers should have a passion for continuous learning and be committed to staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in renewable energy technologies.

title: Laboratory Manager - Geotechnical and Material Testing (NABL)
description:
**Job title:**
Laboratory Manager – Geotechnical & Materials Testing (NABL)

**Company:**
Soiltech India Private Limited

**Workplace type:**
On-site

**Location:**
Hadapsar, Pune, Maharashtra

**Employment type:**
Full-time

**Seniority:**
Mid-Senior level

**Industry:**
Civil Engineering

**Job function:**
Engineering, Quality Assurance

**Description:**

Soiltech India Private Limited is an ISO/IEC 17025:2017 NABL-accredited geotechnical investigation and materials testing laboratory since 1974. We are hiring a Laboratory Manager to run our Pune lab: test quality, turnaround, people, and continued NABL accreditation.

**What you’ll do**

Technical operations

* Plan and supervise testing of soil, rock, concrete and aggregates as per IS 2720, IS 516, IS 2386, ASTM and project specifications
* Oversee grain size, Atterberg limits, compaction, CBR, consolidation, direct shear, triaxial, permeability, UCS, point load and cube/core testing
* Testing of materials like Aggregates, cement, steel, cubes etc
* Review data and reports before release; act as authorised signatory once NABL approves you
* Manage sample receipt, storage and retention, and meet committed turnaround times
* Support the commercial team on test scope and lab capacity for tenders

NABL and quality system

* Maintain compliance with ISO/IEC 17025:2017 and NABL requirements for the accredited scope
* Lead NABL surveillance, renewal and scope-extension assessments, and close NCs on time
* Conduct internal audits and management reviews; maintain the quality manual, SOPs and formats
* Manage the calibration schedule, intermediate checks and traceability
* Estimate measurement uncertainty and validate methods
* Organise proficiency testing and inter-laboratory comparisons
* Handle complaints, non-conforming work and corrective actions

People and equipment

* Train and authorise lab staff, and maintain competence records
* Build a trained backup for every accredited test
* Plan equipment procurement, maintenance and AMCs
* Enforce lab safety and housekeeping

**What you bring**

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering; M.E./M.Tech in Geotechnical Engineering preferred
* 5-8 years of hands-on geotechnical and materials testing experience
* 3+ years as Technical Manager, Quality Manager or authorised signatory in a NABL-accredited lab, having faced at least two NABL assessments
* Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 17025:2017, internal auditing and measurement uncertainty
* ISO/IEC 17025 internal auditor training preferred
* Rock mechanics and advanced soil testing experience is a plus

**What we offer**

* Leadership of a 50-year-old accredited lab
* Exposure to metro, highway, hydropower, mining and industrial projects across India
* Competitive salary based on experience

title: Digitalization & Automation Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Digitalization & Automation Manager to lead enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives, AI-driven solutions, analytics, and business process automation. The ideal candidate will be responsible for aligning digital strategies with business objectives, driving innovation, improving operational efficiency, and delivering measurable business value through the effective implementation of AI, machine learning, generative AI, and advanced analytics.

The candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams and senior leadership to identify opportunities for digitalization, optimize existing processes, and establish best practices for responsible AI adoption and data governance.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Digital Transformation & AI Strategy**

* Define and execute enterprise-wide AI, analytics, digitalization, and automation strategies in alignment with business objectives and growth priorities.
* Identify opportunities to automate business processes, improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance productivity.
* Develop and implement digital transformation roadmaps with measurable business outcomes.

**2. AI & Automation Implementation**

* Lead the integration of AI, machine learning, generative AI, and intelligent automation into core business processes, products, and services.
* Identify and implement automation solutions to streamline workflows, eliminate repetitive tasks, and improve decision-making.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend suitable AI and automation solutions based on business requirements.
* Monitor the performance and effectiveness of implemented digital solutions.

**3. AI Center of Excellence (CoE)**

* Establish and manage an AI Center of Excellence to promote innovation, standardize best practices, and encourage collaboration across teams.
* Develop frameworks, guidelines, and reusable solutions to accelerate AI and automation adoption.
* Build internal capabilities and promote knowledge sharing across the organization.

**4. Data Analytics & Business Intelligence**

* Lead initiatives to advance analytics from descriptive reporting to predictive and prescriptive analytics.
* Leverage business intelligence tools, machine learning, and data analytics to generate actionable insights.
* Translate complex data and analytical findings into practical business recommendations.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the impact of digitalization and automation initiatives.

**5. Data Governance, Compliance & Responsible AI**

* Establish robust data governance frameworks to ensure data quality, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
* Promote responsible and ethical AI practices, addressing risks related to bias, data privacy, transparency, and compliance.
* Develop policies and controls for secure and effective AI adoption across the organization.

**6. Stakeholder & Project Management**

* Collaborate with business leaders, IT teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to identify business challenges and deliver technology-driven solutions.
* Manage digitalization and automation projects from planning and implementation through deployment and performance evaluation.
* Communicate technical concepts, analytical insights, and project outcomes effectively to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership.
* Ensure that projects deliver measurable business value and align with organizational KPIs.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business Analytics, or a related field.
* 6–10 years of relevant experience in digital transformation, business process automation, AI/ML, data analytics, or technology-driven process improvement.
* Strong understanding of artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, and advanced analytics.
* Experience implementing digitalization and automation initiatives within business functions.
* Knowledge of business intelligence and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of workflow automation, intelligent process automation, and process optimization.
* Familiarity with data governance, responsible AI, data privacy, and regulatory compliance.
* Strong stakeholder management, project management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technology capabilities into business outcomes.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience establishing or managing an AI Center of Excellence.
* Exposure to RPA tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
* Familiarity with cloud-based AI and analytics platforms.
* Experience working with enterprise systems, business intelligence solutions, and digital transformation programs.
* Relevant certifications in AI, data analytics, automation, or project management will be an advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Successful implementation of digitalization and automation initiatives.
* Improvement in process efficiency, productivity, and cost optimization.
* Measurable return on investment (ROI) from AI and automation projects.
* Reduction in manual effort and turnaround time.
* Adoption and effective utilization of AI and digital solutions across teams.
* Compliance with data governance, security, and responsible AI standards.

Employment Type: Full-Time

**ABOUT SPAZIOLIV**

SpazioLiv is an interior design and execution company focused on delivering quality interior solutions through effective project management, timely material procurement and seamless execution. We are looking for an experienced Procurement Manager to manage end-to-end procurement activities for interior projects, ensuring the timely availability of materials at competitive prices while maintaining quality standards.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Procurement Manager will be responsible for managing end-to-end procurement for interior design and execution projects, including sourcing materials, vendor development, price negotiation, purchase order management, delivery tracking and coordination with project execution teams.

The role requires strong knowledge of interior materials, excellent negotiation skills, vendor management capabilities and the ability to ensure timely material availability across multiple project sites.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. **Procurement Planning & Execution**

• Manage end-to-end procurement for multiple interior design and execution projects.

• Understand project requirements, BOQs, material specifications and execution schedules before initiating procurement.

• Ensure timely procurement of materials in line with project timelines and site requirements.

• Prepare procurement plans based on project schedules and material requirements.

• Monitor pending orders and ensure materials reach the respective sites on time.

• Coordinate with project and execution teams to avoid material shortages and project delays.

**2 Vendor Management & Development**

• Identify, evaluate and onboard reliable vendors, suppliers, manufacturers and contractors.

• Develop and maintain a strong vendor network for interior materials and project requirements.

• Regularly assess vendor performance on pricing, quality, delivery timelines and service.

• Maintain updated vendor databases, product catalogues and price lists.

• Build long-term vendor relationships to ensure competitive pricing and reliable supply.

**3. Cost Control & Negotiation**

• Negotiate prices, payment terms, credit periods, discounts and delivery conditions with vendors.

• Obtain and compare multiple quotations before finalising purchases, as per company policy.

• Ensure procurement is aligned with approved project budgets and BOQs.

• Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality or specifications.

• Maintain cost comparison sheets and procurement records.

• Monitor price variations and highlight significant cost differences to management.

**4.Interior Materials & Product Knowledge**

• Develop strong working knowledge of interior materials, including plywood, laminates, veneers, MDF, hardware, modular fittings, electrical materials, lighting, sanitaryware, tiles, flooring, paints, glass, aluminium, false ceiling materials and furnishings.

• Understand material specifications, brands, grades, finishes and technical requirements.

• Ensure materials procured match approved designs, drawings, samples and specifications.

• Coordinate with design and execution teams to clarify material requirements and suitable alternatives.

• Evaluate alternative materials and suppliers wherever cost optimisation is possible without compromising approved quality.

**5 Purchase Orders & Documentation**

• Prepare and release purchase orders after obtaining the required approvals.

• Ensure purchase orders clearly specify material descriptions, quantities, rates, taxes, delivery schedules and payment terms.

• Maintain procurement trackers, purchase registers, quotation comparisons and vendor records.

• Track order confirmations, dispatches, invoices and delivery challans.

• Ensure procurement documentation is complete and properly maintained.

• Follow company policies and approval processes for all purchases.

**6.Site Coordination & Material Delivery**

• Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Supervisors, Storekeepers and the Operations team to understand site requirements.

• Ensure materials are delivered to the correct site as per the required schedule.

• Follow up on delayed orders and resolve supply-related issues promptly.

• Coordinate replacement of damaged, defective or incorrect materials.

• Monitor material shortages, excess procurement and potential wastage.

• Ensure timely communication regarding procurement delays that may affect project execution.

**7. Quality & Inventory Management**

• Ensure procured materials meet approved specifications and quality standards.

• Coordinate with site teams for material inspection and acceptance.

• Address vendor-related quality complaints and arrange replacements where required.

• Monitor material consumption, stock availability and utilisation in coordination with site teams.

• Minimise excess purchases, material wastage and unnecessary inventory holding.

• Maintain appropriate records of material returns, replacements and rejected supplies.

**8. Payments & Internal Coordination**

• Coordinate with the Accounts and Finance team regarding vendor invoices, payment schedules and outstanding dues.

• Verify purchase orders, invoices and delivery documentation before processing payments.

• Coordinate with Design, Projects, Operations, Stores and Accounts teams to ensure smooth procurement operations.

• Escalate critical supply, pricing, quality and payment-related issues to management.

• Provide regular procurement updates and reports to senior management.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

• Timely availability of materials at project sites.

• Procurement cost against approved budgets.

• Cost savings achieved through negotiation and vendor development.

• Vendor delivery performance and adherence to committed timelines.

• Material quality and rejection percentage.

• Number of project delays attributable to procurement.

• Accuracy of purchase orders and procurement documentation.

• Reduction in material wastage and excess procurement.

• Compliance with procurement approval processes.

• Vendor performance and issue-resolution turnaround time.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS**

•1-7 years of experience in procurement, preferably in interior design, turnkey interior projects, construction or real estate.

• Strong understanding of interior materials, specifications, brands and market pricing.

• Proven experience in vendor development, price negotiation and purchase order management.

• Experience managing procurement for multiple projects or sites simultaneously.

• Strong knowledge of BOQs, material schedules, quotations and cost comparison sheets.

• Good coordination and follow-up skills to ensure timely material delivery.

• Proficiency in MS Excel and procurement tracking tools; experience with ERP or procurement software is an advantage.

• Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple procurement requirements.

• High ownership, attention to detail, integrity and accountability.

**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION**

Bachelor's degree or diploma in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Civil Engineering, Interior Design, or a related field preferred.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

A proactive and commercially aware procurement professional with strong knowledge of interior materials, an established vendor network and excellent negotiation skills. The ideal candidate will ensure that the right materials are procured at the right price, in the right quality and delivered to the right site at the right time.

The role requires strong coordination with design and execution teams, cost-conscious decision-making and complete ownership of procurement activities to support timely and efficient project execution.

**ROLE FOCUS**

The role is focused on end-to-end procurement, vendor management, material sourcing, cost optimisation and timely material availability for interior design and execution projects.

description:

The candidate will be responsible for driving the organization's quality strategy, ensuring product excellence, customer satisfaction, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement across all quality functions. The incumbent will lead Supplier Quality, Incoming Quality, Manufacturing Quality, Testing Quality, Customer Quality, and Quality Systems while ensuring adherence to industry standards and customer requirements.
  
  
Power without pause. Heating, cooling and oil-free air without end. We keep our customers’ worlds on. From world-class events that last a few weeks to mining operations and remote communities who rely on us for decades.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Quality Leadership & Strategy: Develops and implements the organization's Quality Vision and Strategy, establishes quality objectives, and drives a culture of Zero-Defect Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives like Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen.
* Manufacturing Quality: Ensures quality compliance across all manufacturing processes, develops and monitors process quality control plans, establishes Critical to Quality (CTQ) characteristics, and drives improvements in First Pass Yield (FPY) and Right First Time (RFT).
* Supplier Quality Management: Develops and implements supplier quality performance programs, conducts audits and assessments, drives supplier development initiatives, monitors performance (PPM, rejection levels), and leads corrective action programs.
* Incoming & In-Process Quality: Ensures effective incoming inspection standards, develops inspection plans for critical components, manages quality approvals for key items (engines, alternators, panels), and works to reduce incoming defects and line stoppages.
* Product Testing & Validation: Leads quality assurance during various testing phases, including Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), Load Bank Testing, Performance Testing, and Reliability Testing, while ensuring compliance with customer specifications and industry standards.
* Customer Quality Management: Leads the resolution of customer complaints, drives Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective actions, works to improve the Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI), establishes preventive action systems, and interfaces directly with key customers on quality matters.

**You Are**

* Educational Background: A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering is required, with a Master's Degree, Six Sigma Black Belt, and Lead Auditor Certification (ISO 9001) being preferred qualifications.
* Extensive Experience: Candidates must possess a minimum of 20 years of experience in relevant sectors such as Genset Manufacturing, Power Generation, Electrical Panel Manufacturing, Switchgear, or Industrial Equipment Manufacturing, with at least 8-10 years in senior quality leadership positions.
* Comprehensive Technical Competencies: Proven expertise in Quality Management Systems (QMS), Supplier Quality Assurance, Manufacturing Quality, and Customer Quality is essential. This includes proficiency in methodologies like FMEA, APQP, PPAP, SPC, MSA, 8D Methodology, CAPA, and conducting internal and external audits, especially concerning Electrical System Quality and Engine & Alternator Assembly Quality.
* In-depth Industry Knowledge: A strong understanding of critical components and systems within the power generation industry, including Diesel Engines, Alternators, Controllers (DSE, ComAp, Woodward), LT Panels, Synchronization Panels, AMF Panels, FDE Packages, and Load Bank Testing.
* Strong Leadership Capabilities: Demonstrated competencies in Strategic Leadership, Customer Focus, Analytical Thinking, Data-Driven Decision Making, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Team Development, Conflict Resolution, Change Management, and a strong Result Orientation.

**What You’ll Get**

* A full-time role based in Pune.
* Competitive Compensation & Benefits
* Dynamic & Supportive Work Environment: Thrive in an innovative and forward-thinking culture that values your expertise and will foster professional growth.
* Accelerate your career with dedicated pathways for advancement, access to specialised training programs and ample opportunities for skill enhancement.

Our people are can-do, positive, resilient and persistent. If that feels like you, apply now and build your career with the people bringing energy to the world.

We welcome people from different backgrounds and cultures, and respect people’s unique skills, attitudes and experiences. We encourage everyone to be themselves at work because we know that’s how we do our best, for each other, for our customers, for the communities where we work, and for our careers.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer. If you apply for a role at Aggreko, we will consider your application based on your qualifications and experience, and not on your race, colour, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Manager, Technology - Network Engineering Operations
description:

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer.Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play.We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond.Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide.
  
  
Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Manager, Network Engineering Operations will lead the India-based network engineering teams responsible for enterprise routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, load balancing, wireless infrastructure, store network operations, and network reliability engineering. This role combines strong technical leadership, operational governance, engineering execution, automation enablement, and people management. The ideal candidate is an experienced network engineering leader who brings deep enterprise networking expertise together with strong operational judgment, incident leadership capability, and a passion for developing high-performing engineering teams. * Establish a strong culture of operational ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Lead operational readiness activities supporting peak retail periods, store operations, and large-scale infrastructure initiatives.
* Partner with global engineering teams to ensure seamless operational coordination and support continuity.
* Leverage AI-assisted operational engineering practices to improve troubleshooting, monitoring analysis, operational reporting, and engineering productivity.

* Enterprise routing and switching
* Firewalls and network security
* VPNs
* Wireless infrastructure
* Load balancing
* Enterprise network monitoring and observability platforms
* Network configuration management and operational tooling
* Automation and scripting practices within network operations environments
* Store network infrastructure

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct technical discussions involving operational risk, incident management, network reliability, observability, security, and operational readiness.
* Drive operational excellence across enterprise network platforms by improving reliability, responsiveness, monitoring effectiveness, scalability, automation, and engineering consistency.
* Lead operational governance processes including incident management, change management, escalation management, and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* Partner closely with cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure engineering, architecture, and platform teams to improve operational reliability and engineering collaboration.
* Mentor engineers through technical coaching, operational leadership, and engineering best practices.
* Establish a strong culture of operational ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Lead operational readiness activities supporting peak retail periods, store operations, and large-scale infrastructure initiatives.
* Partner with global engineering teams to ensure seamless operational coordination and support continuity.
* Leverage AI-assisted operational engineering practices to improve troubleshooting, monitoring analysis, operational reporting, and engineering productivity.

**Qualifications**

* Strong experience leading enterprise network engineering or network operations teams in large-scale production environments.
* Strong technical depth across enterprise networking technologies, operational engineering, automation, and network reliability practices.
* Ability to engage deeply in technical troubleshooting, operational escalation management, network reviews, and engineering decision-making.
* Proven experience leading technically strong engineering teams within enterprise-scale production environments.
* Strong balance of technical credibility, operational discipline, and people leadership.
* Demonstrated success building an engineering culture centered around accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Deep understanding of enterprise networking technologies including routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, wireless, load balancing, and network security concepts.
* Experience managing complex incident response, operational governance, and major incident management processes.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, and network management platforms.
* Familiarity with automation and scripting practices within network operations environments.
* Demonstrated interest in AI-assisted operational engineering practices and automation-driven infrastructure operations.
* Strong communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, highly collaborative enterprise environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 10+ years of enterprise network engineering or network operations experience.
* 4+ years of technical leadership and people management experience leading network engineering or operations teams.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of enterprise routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, load balancing, and wireless technologies.
* Experience with enterprise network monitoring, configuration management, and operational tooling.
* Familiarity with automation and scripting practices within network operations environments.
* Strong understanding of incident management, change management, and operational governance processes.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise production environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and operational decision-making skills.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and business audiences.
* Experience supporting retail, eCommerce, store network infrastructure, or other large-scale customer-facing enterprise environments preferred.
* Experience supporting highly seasonal or peak-event operational environments is a plus.

* Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact.

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teens, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, and Mark and Graham. We are sourcing premium products across all categories of Home Furnishing and recorded double digit year-on-year growth. We have a dynamic team of over 100 members handling versatile vendors across India, Nepal & Bangladesh. We are looking to onboard talented people and create successful professional journey.

title: Manager, Collections Strategy Delivery (L09)
description:
**Job Title: Manager, Collections Strategy Delivery (L09)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The
*Manager , Collections Strategy Delivery Build*
role is responsible for implementation of Collection strategies as they relate to Pre-Delinquent, Delinquent (pre-charge off) & Recovery accounts utilizing SAS, Experian Power Curve (Strategy Manager) and Fiserv Rules. The Analyst leads solution development with build team, direct manager and change requestor for new projects, new clients and Strategy Change Initiatives within Strategy Delivery Team. Analysis of collection strategies and development/ enhancement of Phone and Alternate channel implementation processes are key elements to the success of the Strategy Delivery Team. Participates on multiple initiatives as Build SME for SAS, Strategy Manager application and Fiserv Rules Platform. As a Manager, you are required to be proficient in handing projects and engaging with stakeholders independently.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implements Collections and Operational Strategy initiatives for all delinquent accounts and Strategy designated Pre-Delinquent & Recovery accounts leveraging leading edge technology to enhance customer experience.
* Partner with collections contact strategy team, collection operations and process owners to determine strategy implementation requirements and develop / ensure streamlined approaches to coding, unit testing and queuing process
* Works independently to provide Level of Effort for scoping and scheduling the change requests
* Project Manager / SME for collections projects involving Alternate channel strategies (SAS) and Phone channel strategies (Strategy manager processes)
* Provides recommendations for process enhancements based upon Design Reviews
* Develop and monitor dashboards including analysis, action plans and identification of process improvements support simplification strategies including life-cycle tools and treatments specific to champion/challenger strategies that include digital channels, and other outbound correspondence
* Partners with process owners in establishing procedures and requirements to ensure accurate and timely delivery with regulatory and compliance standards
* Partners with Collections Data Warehouse team and Enterprise Data Lake teams for issue resolution
* Provide account level research for understanding of Collection processing
* Work independently with minimum to moderate supervision
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience
* Minimum 2 + years of hands-on experience with SAS or knowledge of SAS programming
* Minimum 2 + years of experience with design, test and control environments working with large amounts of data
* Minimum 1+ years analytical and decision-making experience.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* 1 year of experience with FISERV/FD Rules/ Strategy Manager Development (batch mode)
* 1 year of Project Management Experience
* Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects concurrently with commitment to deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and present business results to management

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience

**Work Timings: 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST**
(WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: Sr Manager Client Technology
description:
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Manager, Cloud Platform Engineers to lead our India-based platform and automation engineering staff. This is a people-management role with real technical ownership -- you will be evaluated as much on your ability to review and stand behind your team's Kubernetes and Terraform work as on how you manage the people producing it. You will oversee day-to-day execution of AKS operations and Terraform-based automation, working in close coordination with the US-based Principal and Expert Platform Engineers who set the platform's architectural direction.
  
  
This role exists to provide direct, hands-on management and accurate technical oversight of the India-based team -- including work planning, prioritization, quality review, and status reporting to the Senior Manager, Cloud Platform. Reporting must reflect verified, actual system state; this is a core expectation of the role, not a formality.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Directly manage India-based Cloud Platform engineers, including workload assignment, prioritization, and day-to-day people management.
* Review and stand behind your team's Terraform module submissions and AKS configuration changes for correctness, adherence to documented standards, and production-readiness before they are considered complete.
* Enforce engineering process standards across the team: issue-based work tracking, triage and prioritization before work begins, work-in-progress limits, and daily status updates.
* Provide the Senior Manager, Cloud Platform with accurate, verified status reporting on the India-based team's work -- cross-checked against actual system and repository state, not summarized from memory or secondhand updates.
* Coordinate with the Principal and Expert Platform Engineers on platform architecture and standards, ensuring the India-based team's work aligns with the broader platform's GitOps, Terraform, and AKS conventions.
* Escalate technical or delivery risks early and directly, rather than allowing status to be discovered after the fact.
* Support hiring, onboarding, and skill development for the India-based team, including closing gaps in Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD fundamentals where needed.
* Apply policy-as-code and security standards already established on the platform (Kyverno or equivalent) when reviewing team output.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years in platform, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering roles, including some prior people-management or formal technical-lead experience.
* Hands-on production experience with Kubernetes, ideally AKS specifically -- sufficient to personally review a team member's cluster or workload change and identify problems.
* Working Terraform experience, including the ability to review a submitted module for correctness, reusability, and adherence to documented standards.
* GitOps experience (ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent) -- all infrastructure and cluster changes should trace to a git commit as a matter of practice, not preference.
* Demonstrated ability to produce accurate, verifiable status reporting to senior leadership.
* Experience managing engineers directly, including performance management, prioritization, and workload planning.
* Working fluency in policy-as-code tooling (Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, or equivalent).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing a distributed or offshore engineering team reporting to a manager in a different region.
* Practical, current experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily engineering work.
* Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, or equivalent).
* Background modernizing legacy automation (PowerShell or similar) toward Terraform or platform-native replacements.

title: Technical Solutions Engineering Manager, Google Cloud Security
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
  
  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
* 13 years of experience troubleshooting and advocating for customer's needs, and triaging technical issues (e.g., hardware, software, application, operational, process).
* 13 years of experience in managing a technical, customer-facing team through critical escalations.
* 8 years of experience reading code in a general purpose coding language (e.g., Java, C, C++, Python, Shell, Go, JavaScript) or in system design.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH, GCIA, Security+ or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer.
* Experience in troubleshooting and supporting large-scale applications such as web services, data storage, databases, data pipelines, high-performance computing, commerce engines, with Linux/Unix or Windows operating systems.
* Ability to analyze data using a structured query language.
* Ability to operate in a customer focused environment and advocate for customers across a cross-functional organization.
* Excellent communication skills to interact with customers, engineers, and management and problem solving skills to resolve technical issues

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
The modern Security Operations (SecOps), effective Detection and Response relies on a tightly integrated stack like Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) aggregates and correlates vast telemetry, Threat Intelligence enriches that data with high-fidelity adversary context, and Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) automates rapid orchestration and containment.
  
  
As the Detection and Response Technical Solutions Engineer Manager, you will empower engineers to debug issues across this entire pipeline from parser failures and rule latency to Application Programming Interface (API) integration bottlenecks while focusing on driving down escalation resolution times, fostering deep product expertise, and delivering a reliable, high-trust experience for enterprise security customers.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a team across Asia-Pacific and India technical solutions engineering pods providing support across all Google SecOps (e.g., Chronicle SIEM, SOAR, and Google Threat Intelligence), through strategic direction, clear expectations, feedback and opportunities for professional growth.
* Partner with Software Engineering and Site Reliability Engineering to manage production incidents in real time, with emphasis on timely and thorough issue identification and customer communication
* Resolve high-profile escalations and issues, improve the customer experience and drive initiatives that increase their likelihood of success
* Work as people manager of engineers to partner with regional counterparts in Americas and EMEA to ensure seamless 24x7 case transitions, uniform SLA adherence, and standardized troubleshooting workflows
* Translate recurring customer and technical patterns into clear, evidence-based feedback for Product and Engineering including reproducible examples, impact assessment, and recommendations for contact rate reduction scalable solutions.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Lead, Data Validation Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Lead, Data Validation Specialist to oversee a team of Data Validation Specialists responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial data during new client onboarding. You’ll manage daily workflows, ensure consistent data quality across projects, and serve as the primary liaison between the Data Validations team and cross-functional partners.
  
  
This is primarily a non-client-facing role that plays a key part behind the scenes, requiring focus, consistency, and comfort with repetitive work. It’s a great fit for someone who enjoys working with data in a structured way and takes pride in getting the details right.
  
  
You’ll be instrumental in fostering a collaborative team culture, driving consistency in our data conversions, and contributing to the growth of both your team and our global function.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and mentor a team of Data Validation Specialists, supporting career development, delivering regular feedback, and helping individuals thrive in their role
* Manage a team’s work allocation, prioritization, and execution to ensure on-time, high-quality project delivery
* Review and audit data validation projects to ensure adherence to standards and best practices
* Drive process improvements to increase data occurrence, reduce turnaround time, and enhance scalability
* Develop and maintain documentation, templates, and standard operating procedures for data validation
* Collaborate cross-functionally across global teams, including Sales, Client Solutions, Product, and Engineering, to deliver integrated solutions
* Foster a team culture that values collaboration, learning, and a shared commitment to client success
* Maintain a personal set of data validation projects, performing hands-on review and reconciliation of client data alongside team leadership responsibilities

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, ideally in Business, Finance, Math, Economics, or another data-oriented field
* 3+ years of experience in data validation, financial operations, data quality assurance, or a related field
* 1+ year of people leadership or team coordination experience preferred
* Strong organizational and analytical skills, with a proven track record of maintaining accuracy in high-volume data environments
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to guide and influence across teams
* Proficiency with spreadsheets (e.g., Excel), internal tools, and web-based platforms
* Familiarity with financial data is a plus, but not required. Quick to learn new systems and follow structured processes for data navigation and validation
* Process-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset and strong attention to detail

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

description:

**Job Requirement:**

Key Responsibilities

The Production Manager will be responsible for managing and overseeing the day-to-day operations of the manufacturing facility. The role involves ensuring smooth production flow, achieving output and delivery targets, optimizing manpower and machinery utilization, and maintaining strict adherence to quality, safety, and compliance standards. - Prepare and present reports on production output, efficiency, and downtime to management.
