title: Associate Manager - Drone Ecosystem
description:
**About QCI**

The Quality Council of India (QCI) is the Scheme Owner of the Certification Scheme for Unmanned Aircraft Systems (CSUAS), which was notified in official gazette by the Ministry of Civil Aviation on 26 January 2022. The scheme has since been revised and its scope enhanced, evolving into a Type based certification framework that covers Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) and Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) UAS operations, and it also promotes the indigenisation and development of the domestic drone industry, contributing to the vision of India becoming a global drone hub by 2030.

**Role Summary**

As part of the team, you contribute to the development and operation of a national certification framework for UAS. Our work spans into designing and developing certification schemes aligned with international best practice, formulating technical standards, and creating certification ecosystems in partnership with industry, regulators, ministries, academia and other stakeholders, scale them through conformity assessment bodies. Deep understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential.

The next phase of this work is about collaborating with the industry on the segments that still need enabling, namely autonomous drones, Drone-as-a-Service and UAS traffic management, along with the digital transformation that simplifies compliance and the aggregator led facilitation that scales the use-case adaptation to advance the growth of Industry These are areas where the standards, the quality assurance mechanisms and in some cases the market itself are still taking shape, and the people who join us now will help shape the Nation’s Drone Ecosystem.

**Role & Responsibility-**

QCI is seeking professionals to support the implementation of CSUAS. The role will contribute to the development and operation of the CSUAS workstreams below:

* **Scheme Design & Development**
  : Conceptualise UAS related quality interventions that help the industry and the regulator, and develop and revise the scheme criteria, technical standards and guidelines that give them effect with a in-depth understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS.
* **Research, Analysis & Knowledge Products**
  : Conduct rapid primary and secondary research on UAS domain and policy, including comparative study of standards and international best practice to draft standards for UAS and its components.
* **Report Writing & Deck Preparation:**
  Draft and structure reports, concept notes, technical circulars and knowledge products, and create data driven presentations for relevant stakeholders.
* **Scheme Operations**
  : Lead the day to day operations of the scheme and its projects, scheme documentation, deliverables, work plans, trackers and minutes of meetings and report periodically on developments; collect, clean and analyse scheme data and maintain its records, website and dashboard; propose the features and changes required in the dashboard to support operations; monitor scheme-related activities; coordinate with vendors and internal and external stakeholders; and frequently update FAQs.
* **Stakeholder Engagement**
  : Identify key stakeholders, analyse their expectations, and develop and execute appropriate strategies to work with them; manage and regularly engage multiple stakeholders i.e., regulators, Certification Bodies, manufacturers, assessors, technical experts, laboratories and academia to ensure timely information exchange and seamless coordination.
* **Business Development & Marketing of the Scheme**
  : Ensure quantitative improvement in the number of Certification Bodies; identify potential clients and partners for adoption of the scheme; market the scheme to increase its uptake; and develop a comprehensive plan to improve scheme processes and revenue generation.

**Eligibility Criteria & Requirements-**

**Educational Qualification**
:

* A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline is required. A Bachelor’s degree in a related engineering discipline, coupled with strong relevant experience, may also be considered for the Associate Manager role.
* An additional qualification in management, public policy, or conformity assessment ecosystem, or quality and compliance, or training in ISO/IEC 17065, ISO/IEC 17067, or ISO/IEC 17024, or ISO/IEC 17020, or ISO 9001 will be considered a strong added advantage.

**Experience-**

* Minimum 3 years of professional work experience in areas including manufacturing, R&D, operations, consulting (private or government), or testing, auditing or a managerial role specifically in drone industry, or should have experience with stakeholder management, or operating a certification scheme, or national program.
* Knowledge of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential, along with knowledge of the relevant rules and regulations with respect to drones operations in India and type certification.
* Excellent Microsoft Office skills, strong verbal communication, and sound organisational and planning skills, with a proven ability to multitask and meet tight deadlines, are required.
* Experience in marketing of products and creation of knowledge products is desired. Prior experience of working with government agencies, regulators or CABs in any capacity (operations or consulting) will be preferred.
* Working experience in any programming language, or with dashboards and AI tools, would be an added advantage. Exposure to UAS design, manufacturing, testing or flight operations, including VLOS/BVLOS flying experience, will be preferred though not mandatory.
* Fluency in English, both written and oral, is required. Fluency in Hindi, both written and oral, is desired.
* Location for the role is based out of New Delhi, on a full time engagement, with travel anywhere in India or abroad as and when required.

**Technical Capabilities-**

**Strong Research Skills:**
Ability to rapidly identify, read, and understand dense, technical documents (e.g., government reports and research papers) and extract the most relevant information.

**Structured Thinking & Writing:**
Ability to break down large, ambiguous topics into a structured research plan and produce clear, logical, professional, and well-written outputs.

**Data Analysis:**
Comfortable with data cleaning, essential MS Excel functions, and creating charts. Experience analysing survey data using Stata, R, or Python is an added advantage.

**Visualization & Presentation Skills:**
Strong data-visualization skills using MS Office Suite, with Tableau/Power BI proficiency being an added advantage; ability to create well-structured and visually compelling presentations.

**Behavioural Capabilities-**

**High Degree of Curiosity:**
Genuine interest in how India’s public policy and governance systems work; naturally follows current affairs and asks “why.”

**Integrity & Accountability:**
Takes ownership of tasks, delivers on commitments, and upholds the highest ethical standards in all work and workplace interactions.

**Meticulous Attention to Detail:**
Able to identify typos, formatting errors, inconsistencies, and mismatched numbers that others may overlook.

**Proactive & “Get-it-Done” Attitude:**
Self-starter who takes complete ownership of tasks, anticipates what needs to be done, and delivers results without waiting for instructions.

title: Procurement & Costing Manager - Interiors & Turnkey Execution
description:
**Location:**

Delhi NCR

**Company:**

Hub and Oak Interiors

**About Hub and Oak Interiors**

Hub and Oak Interiors is an established commercial interior design and turnkey fit-out company based in Delhi NCR. We specialise in designing and delivering offices and commercial workspaces for startups, corporates and established businesses across Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida and Faridabad. 

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an Procurement & Costing Manager to take end-to-end ownership of BOQs, project estimates and cost planning for office interiors and turnkey projects. The role involves working closely with the Interior Design Head, Business Development Manager and Project Manager to ensure proposals are accurately costed, commercially viable and submitted on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **BOQ Preparation and Quantity Take-Offs:**

   Prepare detailed BOQs by reviewing layouts, working drawings, specifications and site measurements. Identify missing information, scope gaps and discrepancies before finalising estimates.
2. **Project Estimation and Costing:**

   Prepare item-wise estimates covering materials, labour, installation, transport, wastage, site overheads and contingency allowances. Cover all relevant trades, including civil works, partitions, ceilings, flooring, furniture, joinery, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, fire safety and IT infrastructure.
3. **Vendor Quotations and Rate Analysis:**

   Obtain quotations from vendors and contractors, prepare comparison statements, assess scope completeness and negotiate rates to establish reliable project costs.
4. **Commercial Proposals and Tender Support:**

   Prepare priced BOQs, quotation inputs, inclusions, exclusions and assumptions. Coordinate with business development to ensure client proposals reflect the approved scope, costs and margins.
5. **Budget Planning and Value Engineering:**

   Develop execution budgets and recommend alternative materials, specifications or construction methods to meet client budgets while maintaining design intent, functionality and quality.
6. **Design and Execution Coordination:**

   Work with the design and project teams to validate quantities, specifications, site conditions and execution requirements. Hand over approved costing sheets and budgets to the Project Manager before execution.
7. **Variation Costing and Cost Monitoring:**

   Estimate additional work and scope changes, maintain variation records and support approval before execution. Compare actual and committed costs against budgets with the project and accounts teams, highlighting overruns and margin risks.
8. **Cost Database and Documentation:**

   Maintain updated material and labour rates, vendor quotations, standard BOQs and historical project costs. Ensure estimates are version-controlled, traceable and supported by clear calculations and approvals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Preferably 5–8 years of relevant experience in estimation, costing or quantity surveying, with hands-on experience in commercial office interiors and turnkey fit-outs.
* Degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management or a related discipline. Candidates with equivalent practical experience may also be considered.
* Ability to read architectural, interior and services drawings and independently prepare quantity take-offs and detailed BOQs.
* Strong understanding of interior materials, construction methods, labour productivity and vendor pricing.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and AutoCAD for drawing review and measurement; familiarity with estimation software is an advantage.
* Strong commercial judgement, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple estimates within deadlines.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with designers, project managers, vendors and the business development team.

**Success in This Role**

Accurate and timely estimates, complete BOQs with minimal scope omissions, reliable execution budgets, prompt costing of variations and clear visibility of expected project margins.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Minimum
  **5 years of relevant experience**
  in pharmaceutical Regulatory Affairs, preferably in a leadership or managerial role.
* Proven experience in preparing and publishing eCTD dossiers.
* Strong working knowledge of regulatory requirements and product registration processes in CIS countries.
* Hands-on expertise in specialized eCTD publishing and dossier preparation software.
* Sound understanding of CTD/eCTD structure, dossier lifecycle management, and regulatory submission requirements.
* Excellent documentation, analytical, coordination, and team management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple regulatory projects and meet submission deadlines.

Preferred Skills

Compensation

Compensation will be highly competitive and will depend on the candidate’s skills, technical expertise, relevant experience, knowledge of CIS regulatory markets, and hands-on proficiency in eCTD dossier preparation and publishing software.

Interested candidates who meet the above requirements are invited to share their updated CV along with details of their regulatory experience, CIS market exposure, eCTD publishing expertise, and current/expected compensation.

title: Manager, Collections Strategy Delivery (L09)
description:
**Job Title: Manager, Collections Strategy Delivery (L09)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The
*Manager , Collections Strategy Delivery Build*
role is responsible for implementation of Collection strategies as they relate to Pre-Delinquent, Delinquent (pre-charge off) & Recovery accounts utilizing SAS, Experian Power Curve (Strategy Manager) and Fiserv Rules. The Analyst leads solution development with build team, direct manager and change requestor for new projects, new clients and Strategy Change Initiatives within Strategy Delivery Team. Analysis of collection strategies and development/ enhancement of Phone and Alternate channel implementation processes are key elements to the success of the Strategy Delivery Team. Participates on multiple initiatives as Build SME for SAS, Strategy Manager application and Fiserv Rules Platform. As a Manager, you are required to be proficient in handing projects and engaging with stakeholders independently.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implements Collections and Operational Strategy initiatives for all delinquent accounts and Strategy designated Pre-Delinquent & Recovery accounts leveraging leading edge technology to enhance customer experience.
* Partner with collections contact strategy team, collection operations and process owners to determine strategy implementation requirements and develop / ensure streamlined approaches to coding, unit testing and queuing process
* Works independently to provide Level of Effort for scoping and scheduling the change requests
* Project Manager / SME for collections projects involving Alternate channel strategies (SAS) and Phone channel strategies (Strategy manager processes)
* Provides recommendations for process enhancements based upon Design Reviews
* Develop and monitor dashboards including analysis, action plans and identification of process improvements support simplification strategies including life-cycle tools and treatments specific to champion/challenger strategies that include digital channels, and other outbound correspondence
* Partners with process owners in establishing procedures and requirements to ensure accurate and timely delivery with regulatory and compliance standards
* Partners with Collections Data Warehouse team and Enterprise Data Lake teams for issue resolution
* Provide account level research for understanding of Collection processing
* Work independently with minimum to moderate supervision
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience
* Minimum 2 + years of hands-on experience with SAS or knowledge of SAS programming
* Minimum 2 + years of experience with design, test and control environments working with large amounts of data
* Minimum 1+ years analytical and decision-making experience.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* 1 year of experience with FISERV/FD Rules/ Strategy Manager Development (batch mode)
* 1 year of Project Management Experience
* Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects concurrently with commitment to deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and present business results to management

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience

**Work Timings: 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST**
(WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.
  
  
**For Internal Applicants**

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
* Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday

* L8+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in their current role and level are only eligible

****Leadership Profile:****
Hyatt’s Leadership Profile clarifies what is expected of Hyatt’s leaders and the specific behaviors that successful leaders exhibit to achieve business results.
  
  
Be familiar with Hyatt’s Leadership Profile as the expectation and measure of your performance. Additionally, exhibiting these behaviors will help you hire, develop, evaluate and reward talent successfully.
  
  
**Learn & Grow**
Leaders are quick and curious. They are more likely than others to be energized by the challenge of the unfamiliar, to quickly understand new or complex situations and data, and to share that learning with others. They are also likely to be more open to feedback, to reflect and learn from experiences, and to recover quickly from setbacks. They probably also have a higher risk tolerance and greater resilience to recover from mistakes or failures than many of their peers. These behaviors and personal qualities are an adsvantage in becoming more effective as a leader over time.
  
  
**Foster a Culture of Care**
Leaders build trust through listening first, acting ethically and with integrity. They truly care about others and demonstrate that as they display empathy, create an inclusive environment, encourage diverse viewpoints, and recognize and reward excellence. They assume responsibility for the customer experience, prioritize stakeholder needs, and ensure colleagues have the resources and support they need to demonstrate to customers that we really care.
  
  
**Adapt and Thrive with Change**
Leaders look ahead and make needed changes happen. They are comfortable adapting or transforming existing processes or directions to customer needs, and are more proactive in identifying and removing barriers to change and engaging key internal stakeholders. They also tend to be aware of the broader business climate, able to connect trends in the external world to changes needed internally, and more likely to sponsor or coach teams driving change.
  
  
**Achieve Results**
Leaders are action-oriented, understand how to effectively work through others, and are undeterred by challenges. They move quickly to address issues and tend to be comfortable making decisions even when the right answer isn’t totally clear. They are more likely to set clear expectations for colleagues on their team, hold their team to higher performance standards, and give direct feedback. At the same time, they tend to provide support to their team in order to achieve the goals—communicating, coaching and developing, helping them connect their individual work to a greater goal, and entrusting them to act. They are also more likely to see the bigger picture, think longer-term about their team’s talent needs, and to take a longer-term view of results that count.

title: Leather Sourcing / Production Manager (IN)
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

**OUR CULTURE**

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before.

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

**JOB TITLE****:**

**Manager. Material Production - Leather**

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Leather Inventory & Quality Control

* Oversee leather inventory levels to ensure adequate supply for tanning schedules while minimizing waste and overstock.
* Inspect and verify that only quality leather—meeting specified micron, length, and color consistency standards—is released into the tanning process.
* Implement checkpoints to catch non-conforming leather before production begins, preventing downstream defects.
* Coordinate with sourcing and warehouse teams to maintain accurate inventory records and proper storage conditions for raw leather.

  

On-Time Delivery (OTD) Management

* Own leather OTD performance, tracking delivery timelines from suppliers to tanneries and flagging potential delays.
* Proleatherly manage production schedules to ensure leather is available when needed, communicating risks to cross-functional partners.
* Resolve supply interruptions by expediting shipments or reallocating inventory as necessary to meet production deadlines.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for supplier lead times and delivery reliability.

  

Tanning & Production Support

* Partner with tanneries to ensure leather lots are processed according to technical specifications and quality expectations.
* Monitor leather consumption during tanning to identify discrepancies, yield loss, or quality deviations.
* Work upstream with suppliers to align leather bale composition, lot sizing, and traceability for smoother tannery integration.
* Maintain clear documentation of leather lots, test results, and production flow to support traceability and continuous improvement.

  

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Coordinate with planners and production team to align leather availability with production demand and tanning schedules.
* Collaborate with R&D, Product Development, and Sourcing teams to support seamless production handoffs.
* Provide input on leather purchasing decisions based on production capacity, lead times, and quality performance history.
* Escalate production blockers (e.g., leather shortages, quality holds) with recommended solutions to meet OTD goals.

  

QUALIFICATIONS

* Education: Degree in Textile Engineering, Material Science, Supply Chain, or a related field.
* Production Experience: Proven experience managing raw materials in a textile or apparel production environment, preferably with leather or other luxury leathers.
* Quality Focus: Strong ability to assess leather quality and enforce standards before tanning.
* Inventory & OTD Acumen: Demonstrated skill in tracking inventory levels and driving on-time delivery performance.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to use data to monitor leather usage, identify yield issues, and improve production flow.
* Collaboration: Experience working with tanneries, suppliers, planners, and internal production teams to resolve issues quickly.

Preferred:

* Experience with leather leather grading, testing, or lot management.
* Knowledge of tannery operations and leather-to-yarn conversion.
* Familiarity with inventory management systems or ERP tools.
* Understanding of sustainable leather sourcing and production practices.

**WHY QUINCE?**

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

**Role Overview:**

The Operations Manager at SiteRecon will be responsible for leading and scaling our Property Mapping Operations. This is a high-ownership, hands-on leadership role suited for someone comfortable managing large teams in a fast-paced, metrics-driven production environment.

You will own day-to-day execution of mapping operations, with direct responsibility for throughput, quality, delivery SLAs, productivity, capacity planning, and team performance.

You will directly manage
**6–8 Team Leads and QA Supervisors**
and indirectly manage
**120+ cartographers**
, ensuring smooth execution across shifts and consistent delivery for our US and Canada customers.

This role requires someone who can identify bottlenecks, build scalable processes, improve productivity, strengthen quality systems, and use data to continuously improve operational performance.

**About SiteRecon:**

SiteRecon helps property maintenance contractors in the US automate property mapping and site visits through its mapping platform, helping them save time, speed up sales, and improve profitability. We are building a property intelligence platform for businesses in North America.

**About Team:**

Started by IIT Delhi alumni who have worked with multinationals in satellite imaging, e-commerce, and edtech sectors.

To learn more about the team & our origin story -
https://order.siterecon.ai/about-us

To learn more about what we do for our customers -
https://order.siterecon.ai

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Operational Leadership**

* Lead day-to-day Property Mapping Operations with control over output, quality, productivity, and delivery timelines.
* Manage operations across multiple shifts and teams to ensure predictable execution.
* Directly manage Team Leads and QA Supervisors and set clear priorities and performance expectations.
* Indirectly manage 120+ cartographers through the operations leadership structure.
* Establish operating rhythms, accountability, and review mechanisms across teams.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and take corrective action to maintain business continuity.
* Ensure processes are scalable as customer volume and business requirements grow.

**SLA & Productivity Ownership:**

Own operational delivery SLAs and ensure customer commitments are consistently met.

* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly productivity and throughput across teams.
* Track TAT, output per person/team, pending workload, backlog, and key operational metrics.
* Identify productivity gaps and drive improvements with Team Leads.
* Improve throughput without compromising mapping quality.
* Analyse SLA breaches, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
* Establish productivity benchmarks and prioritise work during high-demand periods.

**Quality & Process Improvement**

* Own overall mapping quality and establish effective quality-control mechanisms.
* Implement and continuously improve SOPs for mapping and quality processes.
* Work with QA Supervisors and Team Leads to identify recurring quality issues and rework.
* Reduce rework through root-cause analysis and process improvements.
* Monitor mapping accuracy and quality deviations.
* Establish feedback loops between QA and production teams to improve first-time-right output.
* Standardize and communicate process changes across shifts.

**Planning , Forecasting & Capacity Management:**

* Forecast mapping demand and translate workload into manpower and capacity requirements.
* Maintain adequate capacity to meet current and projected customer demand.
* Prepare manpower plans for seasonal fluctuations and volume spikes.
* Identify capacity constraints before they impact delivery SLAs.
* Optimize allocation of people and workload across teams and shifts.
* Balance utilization, productivity, quality, and turnaround time while planning capacity.

**People Management & Leadership:**

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop Team Leads and QA Supervisors.
* Set measurable goals and review leadership-team performance using operational metrics.
* Build a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Identify high performers and develop them for larger leadership responsibilities.
* Address performance gaps through structured improvement plans.
* Handle operational escalations and support Team Leads in resolving people and performance issues.
* Maintain team morale while ensuring performance and delivery standards.
* Build a strong second line of leadership.

**Cross- Functional Collaboration**

* Work with Product and Engineering teams to identify operational bottlenecks and improve mapping workflows.
* Collaborate with Customer Success on customer requirements, delivery issues, and recurring operational challenges.
* Provide operational inputs for product and process improvements.
* Partner with other functions to implement process or system changes.
* Drive alignment and resolve operational issues at the root level.

**Operational Reporting, MIS & Insight:**

* Own operational dashboards and MIS reporting for the Property Mapping function.
* Establish regular reporting for productivity, quality, SLA adherence, TAT, capacity, backlog, and other KPIs.
* Provide leadership with clear, data-driven visibility into operational performance.
* Conduct regular business reviews with Team Leads and operational leadership.
* Identify trends, deviations, and operational risks through data.
* Recommend corrective actions based on operational insights and track effectiveness.

**Continuous Improvement & Scalability:**

* Build a culture of continuous improvement across Operations.
* Identify repetitive, inefficient, or manual processes and develop better ways of working.
* Standardize successful processes across teams and shifts.
* Use data and structured problem-solving to identify root causes and prevent recurring issues.
* Build processes that support significant growth in mapping volume without proportionately increasing operational complexity.

**Experience & Skills:**

* 8–10 years of experience in operations management, preferably in GIS, mapping, analytics, BPO/KPO, digital operations, or other high-volume production environments.
* Proven experience managing large teams of
  **50–200+ people**
  .
* Experience managing managers/team leads and building a multi-layer operational structure.
* Strong hands-on experience with KPIs, SLAs, productivity, capacity planning, and quality management.
* Experience in a metrics-driven, high-volume operational environment.
* Demonstrated ability to improve operational efficiency, productivity, quality, and turnaround time.
* Experience handling operational escalations and performance management.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for operational analysis and reporting.
* Ability to build and interpret operational dashboards and MIS reports.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends and root causes.
* Comfortable working with large datasets and converting data into actionable insights.
* Experience in a startup, high-growth technology company, or rapidly scaling operations environment is strongly preferred.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Prior experience in a product-led or SaaS company.
* Experience managing GIS, mapping, digital-factory, analytics, BPO/KPO, or other semi-technical operations.
* Experience managing operations for international customers or across different time zones.
* Experience building or scaling operations from an early stage.

**Perks of working at SiteRecon:**

* Opportunity to lead and scale a large, high-impact operations function.
* Work directly with founders and senior leadership.
* High ownership over a core business operation.
* Be part of a rapidly growing AI-driven technology company.
* Freedom to identify operational problems and implement meaningful improvements.
* Growth opportunity to build and scale teams and processes.

title: Manager - Fire and Security
description:

The role will be responsible for protecting customers, tenants, employees, assets and infrastructure while ensuring compliance with statutory requirements, fire safety norms, mall SOPs and client standards.

**Job Descriptions:**

* Manage overall security operations of the mall, including entry/exit gates, parking, loading/unloading, BOH, service and common areas.
* Supervise security agencies, manpower deployment, shift rosters and daily operations.
* Ensure effective access control, frisking, baggage/vehicle checks and material movement.
* Monitor CCTV, access control and security control room operations and ensure system uptime.
* Identify and address security risks, theft, unauthorized access, vandalism and suspicious activities.

* Lead and train Security Officers, Supervisors, Guards, Fire Officers, Firemen and Control Room personnel.
* Conduct regular briefings, toolbox talks, patrols and surprise checks to maintain discipline and operational readiness.
* Investigate security/fire incidents, accidents, thefts and property damage and prepare RCA and corrective action reports.
* Maintain incident records, statutory documents, inspection reports, registers and security/fire MIS.
* Manage VIP visits, mall events, launches and other special security arrangements.
* Implement effective traffic management plans and ensure smooth vehicle and pedestrian movement within the mall.
* Monitor security and fire-related KPIs and drive continuous improvement in safety, security and customer experience.
* Ensure timely reporting and escalation of critical incidents to senior management.

**Requirements:**

* Graduate / Diploma / Degree in Security, Fire & Safety or relevant discipline.
* 8 to 10 Years of relevant experience preferably with Mall / Retail / Hospitality / Commercial / Large Facility Management .
* Strong experience in managing security agencies and large security/fire safety teams.
* Hands-on knowledge of fire & life-safety systems, CCTV, access control and emergency response.
* Good understanding of Fire NOC, statutory compliance, safety audits and regulatory requirements.
* Experience in conducting mock drills, emergency preparedness and incident investigations.
* Strong experience in tenant, contractor and vendor management.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Police, Fire Department, Civil Defence and other authorities.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving and crisis-management skills.
* Experience in traffic management and crowd control in high-footfall environments.
* Should be comfortable working in shifts, weekends and during emergencies/events.
* Strong documentation, reporting and MIS skills.

title: Network Operations Manager
description:
**Why Mobility Global?**
At Mobility Global, our mission is to provide the trusted information that helps billions of people build, sell, and own vehicles with confidence. As we shape the next generation of automotive intelligence through innovation, AI, and industry-leading data, we're creating new opportunities for our customers, our business, and our people.
  
  
Join a team singularly focused on transforming the automotive industry. S&P Global Mobility is Mobility Global — the company behind CARFAX, automotiveMastermind, Market Scan, and Polk Automotive Solutions. Our strength comes from our people, and here, the progress you make helps the entire automotive ecosystem move faster and with greater confidence.
  
  
**The Role**
The Network Operations Manager leads the operational core of the network organization, reporting to the Head of Network. This role spans two primary areas: managing network business functions and driving daily network operations to maintain a high-availability 24/7 environment.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Maintains consolidated lifecycle documentation, asset records, and cost reporting.
* Ensures end-to-end accuracy of network asset and service records, from CMDB to circuit inventory.
* Runs the daily operational cadence—including huddles, alarm triage, outage tracking, and change facilitation—to maintain environment stability.
* Oversees firmware maintenance and ensures high availability across a distributed network infrastructure.

**Network Business Functions**

* Lifecycle Management: Oversee network assets and services from acquisition through refresh and retirement.
* Financial Administration: Consolidate team budget records into a single version-controlled document, track spend, and report rollups to the Head of Network.
* CMDB & Compliance: Keep asset and service records accurate, integrated, and audit-ready.
* Circuit & Carrier Operations: Manage inventory, orders, disconnects, and billing accuracy.
* Vendor & Purchasing Strategy: Partner with peer managers on purchasing, support renewals, and remote-hands vendor relationships.

**Network Operations**

* Operational Leadership: Lead the team in triaging daily alarms, running morning operational huddles, and managing out-of-band management networks.
* Observability & Tooling: Administer network intelligence and monitoring platforms (e.g., Kentik, LogicMonitor, NodePing, Forward Networks).
* Incident & Change Management: Facilitate major changes, log activities, track outages, and supply engineers with operational data to speed recovery.
* Global Coverage: Maintain a follow-the-sun operational model, delivering daily hand-off reports and extending triage coverage across time zones.

**Team Leadership**

* Support and guide a distributed team across Canada, the US, and India, including internal staff, contracted engineers, and remote-hands providers.
* Set clear priorities, support team performance, and coordinate seamless coverage across time zones.

**Required Skills**
**What We're Looking For:**

* Operational Leadership: Experience leading or coordinating 24/7 critical network operations, including monitoring, alarm triage, and incident response. 3+ years of experience.
* Team Leadership: Experience managing or supporting distributed technical teams across multiple time zones. 3+ years of experience.
* Business & Asset Operations: Familiarity with network asset lifecycles, CMDB/ITSM workflows, and circuit/carrier management. 3+ years of experience.
* Financial & Spend Validation: Experience reviewing vendor invoices, tracking spend, or managing functional budget documentation. 3+ years of experience.
* Tooling Familiarity: Working knowledge of network monitoring and observability platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Vendor & Partner Management: Experience working with contracted engineers, managed service providers, or remote-handed vendors.
* Experience with Kentik, LogicMonitor, or Forward Networks.
* Transformation Context: Exposure to standing up processes in a transformation, carve-out, or TSA-exit environment.
* Technical Depth: Network engineering understanding (such as CCNA-level concepts) to effectively partner with engineering teams.
* Automation & Modernization: Interest or experience in network scripting, ITIL frameworks, or integrating automation/AI into operational workflows.

*This is a hybrid role with in-office expectations determined by location and subject to change based on evolving business needs.*

title: Asst Manager – Production (Pharmaceutical Injectables | Sterile/Non-Sterile) | Delhi NCR | Up to ₹14 LPA
description:
**Company Description**
Stavros Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a new-age pharmaceutical organization with a strong vision to become a global leader in healthcare. Built on the foundations of quality and innovation, the company focuses on scientific excellence and continuous advancement in medicine. A dedicated team of professionals works to develop and deliver breakthrough healthcare solutions that address the evolving needs of patients and medical stakeholders. Every product is designed to meet stringent quality standards and align with the latest developments in science and technology. This commitment to research, development, and improving lives positions Stavros as a trailblazer in the pharmaceutical industry.
  
**Role Description**
The Assistant Manager – Production (Pharmaceutical Injectables | Sterile/Non-Sterile) is responsible for overseeing daily production activities for injectable formulations in sterile and non-sterile environments. This full-time, on-site position is based in Bahadurgarh and involves supervising production teams, ensuring adherence to GMP and regulatory standards, and maintaining product quality and safety throughout the manufacturing process. The role includes planning and executing production schedules, coordinating with quality assurance, maintenance, and supply chain teams, and driving continuous improvement initiatives on the shop floor. The Assistant Manager will monitor equipment performance, support validation and documentation activities, troubleshoot process issues, and participate in audits and inspections. The position also involves mentoring team members, supporting training efforts, and fostering a culture of operational excellence and compliance.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Hiring and Recruiting skills to build and support a high-performing production team.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to coordinate effectively with cross-functional departments and frontline staff.
* Candidates should possess Service Quality skills to maintain consistent production standards and compliance with regulatory and customer requirements.
* Candidates should possess Training skills to onboard, guide, and upskill team members on processes, safety, and GMP practices.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, or a related field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.
* Relevant experience in pharmaceutical injectables production, with exposure to sterile and non-sterile operations and GMP environments.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, documentation, regulatory guidelines, and quality systems in pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams, solve operational problems, and implement process improvements safely and efficiently.

title: Plant Head
description:
**Responsibilities**

* **Production Management:**
  Oversee the entire production process to ensure efficient and effective operations. Develop and implement production plans and schedules to meet demand and maximize productivity. Monitor production activities and adjust schedules as needed to maintain workflow.
* **Team Leadership:**
  Lead, manage, and motivate the production team to achieve production goals. Conduct regular performance reviews, provide feedback, and facilitate professional development. Foster a positive work environment, promoting teamwork and collaboration.
* **Quality Control:**
  Ensure that all products meet quality standards and specifications. Implement and maintain quality control procedures to detect and correct defects. Coordinate with the quality assurance team to address any quality issues promptly.
* **Process Improvement:**
  Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce waste. Utilize lean manufacturing principles and best practices to optimize production processes. Monitor and analyze production metrics to drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* **Health and Safety:**
  Ensure compliance with all health and safety regulations and guidelines. Promote a safety culture and conduct regular safety audits and training sessions. Address any safety concerns or incidents promptly and effectively.
* **Inventory and Resource Management:**
  Manage inventory levels to ensure an adequate supply of materials and components. Coordinate with procurement to source materials and negotiate with suppliers. Optimize resource utilization to minimize costs and maximize output.
* **Reporting and Documentation:**
  Prepare and maintain detailed production reports and records. Analyze production data and provide insights and recommendations to senior management. Ensure accurate documentation of production processes and standard operating procedures.
* **Collaboration and Communication:**
  Work closely with other departments, including R&D, engineering, and logistics, to ensure seamless operations. Communicate production status, challenges, and updates to relevant stakeholders. Participate in cross-functional meetings and contribute to strategic planning initiatives.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience minimum in production management, preferably within the Lithium-ion battery industry.
* Expertise in Battery Manufacturing, Production Planning, Quality Assurance, Process Optimization, and Technical & Engineering Skills.
* Strong knowledge of Health, Safety, and Environmental Compliance.
* Project Management, Communication, and Collaboration skills.
* Customer-focused with commitment to Sustainable Practices.
* IT and software proficiency.

title: Support Leader
description:
**Overview**
**170+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.**
At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
  
  
Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our network of industry subject matter experts.
  
  
The Support Leader will oversee the support and governance of Microsoft Dynamics 365 applications including Sales, Field Service, Project Operations, Client Care, Canvas Apps and the wider Power Platform, together with integrations to external enterprise systems.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong technical knowledge with excellent leadership, stakeholder management, service management and operational governance skills, while driving innovation through automation and AI-enabled support capabilities.
  
  
The Support Leader is accountable not just for incident resolution but for the operational health, governance and lifecycle management of the entire Dynamics 365 estate.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
* Lead, coach and develop a team of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Support Engineers.
* Manage team workload, priorities and resource allocation to ensure service commitments are achieved.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring and knowledge sharing across the team.
* Support recruitment, onboarding and performance management activities.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning, accountability and customer service excellence.
* Own the operational support service for Microsoft Dynamics 365 globally.
* Define and monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and operational performance metrics.
* Drive continual service improvement initiatives within D365 and ServiceNow platforms.
* Lead Incident, Problem and Major Incident Management activities.
* Ensure appropriate governance, change control and release management processes are followed.
* Produce regular service reporting and operational updates for senior stakeholders.
* Oversee Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform license management across the global estate, ensuring licenses are appropriately allocated, governed and optimised.
* Identify opportunities to improve license utilisation and manage licensing costs effectively.
* Drive the adoption of AI and automation capabilities within the support function to improve service efficiency, reduce manual effort and enhance the user experience.
* Champion the use of Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform automation, AI-assisted support tools and other emerging technologies to modernise support processes.
* Evaluate and implement innovative support capabilities that improve operational performance, increase first-time resolution and reduce repetitive support activities.
* Oversee day-to-day support activities for Microsoft Dynamics 365 applications, ensuring timely resolution of user issues and minimal business disruption.
* Provide technical escalation support for complex issues where required.
* Monitor platform health, performance and availability, ensuring optimal system reliability.
* Oversee platform configuration and ensure all customisations follow Microsoft best practices and governance standards.
* Review and approve significant configuration changes.
* Ensure integrations with enterprise systems remain stable, secure and supportable.
* Oversee testing activities including regression testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Ensure appropriate testing standards are followed prior to production deployments.
* Coordinate production releases alongside project and delivery teams.
* Review deployment readiness and operational support requirements.
* Own the governance and management of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform environments across Development, Test, UAT, Training and Production.
* Ensure environments are appropriately configured, maintained and secured, supporting both business-as-usual operations and project delivery.
* Manage environment strategies, refreshes, data masking, backups and environment lifecycle activities in accordance with organisational policies and Microsoft best practices.
* Coordinate environment availability and scheduling to support development, testing, releases and business activities while minimising operational disruption.
* Ensure appropriate controls are in place for environment access, security roles, configuration management and solution promotion between environments.
* Work closely with project teams and architects to ensure environments remain fit for purpose and capable of supporting future business and technology initiatives.
* Lead operational readiness for new deployments and platform enhancements.
* Coordinate Hypercare support activities following major releases.
* Ensure effective transition from project delivery into business-as-usual support.
* Build strong relationships with business stakeholders across Sales, Service, Operations and IT.
* Act as the primary operational contact for Dynamics 365 support.
* Communicate service performance, risks and improvement initiatives to senior leadership.
* Collaborate with project teams to ensure supportability is considered throughout solution delivery.
* Ensure technical documentation, knowledge articles and support procedures remain accurate and up to date.
* Promote knowledge sharing across the support team.
* Support user adoption through guidance, communications and best practice.
* Manage relationships with Microsoft partners and third-party support providers.
* Coordinate vendor escalations and ensure contractual service obligations are achieved.
* Monitor third-party delivery quality and performance.
* Partner with Product Owners, Architects, Developers and Infrastructure teams to ensure stable and supportable solutions.
* Provide operational input into future platform enhancements and roadmap planning.
* All other duties, as assigned.

**Qualifications**
E xtensive experience supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement applications, including Sales, Field Service, Project Operations and Power Platform. Demonstrable experience leading or managing technical application support teams. Experience of working with and introducing automation from within ServiceNow. Experience of ServiceNow configuration/setup is highly desirable. Experience managing enterprise application support within global organisations. Experience supporting integrations using APIs, middleware and enterprise integration technologies. Experience managing Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform licensing within an enterprise environment. Strong understanding of environment strategies, solution deployment, release governance and platform administration. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Experience producing operational reporting, KPIs and service metrics.
  
  

* Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform certifications.
* ITIL Foundation (or higher) certification.
* Experience supporting global Dynamics 365 environments.
* Experience using Azure DevOps, ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM tooling.
* Familiarity with XrmToolBox, SQL, Power BI, Microsoft Azure and Azure Integration Services.
* Experience leading geographically distributed support teams.
* Experience implementing AI-enabled support capabilities, including Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform AI, Virtual Agents or intelligent automation.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITIL) principles, including Incident, Problem and Change Management.
* Strong understanding of Dynamics 365 configuration, governance and operational support.
* Experience supporting integrations using APIs, middleware and enterprise integration technologies.
* Awareness of AI, automation and modern IT support practices, with the ability to identify opportunities to improve service delivery through emerging technologies.

**Working Conditions**
With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions;
  
  

* Regular computer usage.
* Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.
* Frequent sitting, standing, and/or walking.
* Travel, as required.

title: Chief Manager - O&M Commissioning
description:
****Position Title****
Chief Manager - O&M Commissioning
  
  
****Position Summary****
The Chief Manager - O&M Commissioning is responsible for ensuring reliable operation, maintenance, testing, commissioning support, protection system performance, and grid compliance for EHV/UHV substations across Resonia assets. The role provides centralized technical leadership for protection, control, automation, SCADA/SAS systems, disturbance analysis, relay coordination, asset reliability improvement, and implementation of best-in-class protection engineering practices across operational and project sites in India.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities**

* Lead operation, maintenance, testing and commissioning support of protection, control and automation systems for 220kV, 400kV and 765kV substations.
* Ensure reliability and performance of numerical relays, protection panels, CTs, PTs, CVTs, DC systems, battery banks and associated protection equipment.
* Conduct disturbance analysis, fault investigations, RCA preparation and timely restoration support following grid events and protection system operations.
* Review and validate relay settings, protection coordination studies, fault level studies and compliance with CEA, CERC, Grid Code and utility standards.
* Drive testing and commissioning best practices including scheme checks, secondary injection testing, primary injection testing and end-to-end protection validation.
* Monitor and ensure optimum performance of IEC 61850 based Substation Automation Systems, SCADA, RTU, Gateway and communication infrastructure.
* Support outage planning, shutdown management, resource mobilization, risk mitigation and asset reliability improvement initiatives.
* Develop technical capability of site teams and ensure adherence to safety, quality and operational excellence standards.

****Critical Success Factors - Essential****

* Expertise in protection relays, automation systems and protection schemes
* Hands-on experience with Omicron, CPC-100, CT Analyzer, FREJA, Megger or equivalent testing platforms
* Strong knowledge of CEA Regulations, Grid Codes, IEC/IEEE standards and electrical safety practices

****Critical Success Factors - Desirable****

* Experience with 132kV, 220kV, 400kV and 765kV AIS/GIS substations
* IEC 61850 engineering and digital substation implementation experience
* Exposure to predictive maintenance, digital asset management and analytics tools

**About Us**
Resonia is one of India's leading developers of power transmission infrastructure, building and operating the grid assets that move electricity from where it is generated to where it is needed most. Operating in one of the world's largest greenfield transmission markets, Resonia has established a proven end-to-end model — developing critical assets across India's most complex geographies, then monetising them through a disciplined capital recycling strategy. To date, the company has monetised assets worth over US$1 billion, and sponsored IndiGrid, India's first power transmission InvIT, which attracted marquee global investors including KKR and GIC.
  
  
Resonia offers a rare combination: world-class execution capability, a demonstrated monetization track record, and a front-row position in India's accelerating energy transition.
  
  

* Integrity & Ethics
* Respect
* Innovation
* Speed

title: Integrated Logistics Excellence Manager Performance
description:
**It's more than a job**
As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  
The IL Excellence Manager is responsible for driving operational excellence across the supply chain by managing LSP performance, ensuring compliance with SOPs and KPIs, and advancing digital integration through automation and real-time shipment visibility.
  
  
The role collaborates closely with internal stakeholders and external LSPs to support efficient operations, continuous improvement, and successful customer implementations.
  
  
**How you create impact**
LSP (3PL) Management
  
  

* Manage and oversee Logistics Service Providers (LSPs) to ensure service excellence
* Monitor supplier performance, drive continuous improvement, and manage escalations
* Support LSP onboarding, integration, SOP implementation, EDI, and digital initiatives
* Coordinate with customers, Control Towers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth operations
* Lead LSP training and change management during new implementations

Problem Solving
  
  

* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) to resolve operational issues affecting KPIs and service quality
* Identify process bottlenecks, analyze performance data, and implement corrective actions
* Monitor process deviations and troubleshoot system or data integration issues

Business Continuity & Hypercare
  
  

* Ensure BCP readiness and resolve critical supply chain disruptions during Hypercare

Freight Procurement
  
  

* Support transportation procurement, supplier management, and cost optimization

**What we would like you to bring**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience
* Strong background in 3PL/logistics operations
* Experience in transportation, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry
* Knowledge of reefer containers, GDP/GxP, and logistics data management
* Experience in LSP supplier management, including performance monitoring and escalation handling
* Candidates with an Operations Excellence Manager background may also be considered
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

**What's in it for you**
At Kuehne+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:
  
  

* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100+ countries
* People-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care
* Learning & Development: Grow with us personally and professionally through world-class training and career pathways
* Innovation & Sustainability: Be part of a future-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet
* Rewards & Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds a trusted global brand with a startup spirit

**Who we are**
Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
  
  
As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

title: Manager - Revenue Operations (Strategy and Transformation)
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Manager - Revenue Operations (Strategy and Transformation)
  
  
Overview of Mastercard Services
  
  
Services Business Unit within Mastercard is focused on driving value beyond payment transactions. We harness the power of our transaction data, deep payments expertise and vast network of merchant and FI partners to offer holistic solutions to our customers. Our solutions comprise consulting; cyber & intelligence; data insights; marketing services; loyalty & analytics platforms; and more. Discover more at www.mastercardservices.com/en.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a dynamic and strategic leader to join our Revenue Operations organization as Manager – Strategy & Transformation. This role will support the evolution of our operating model, lead high-impact transformation initiatives, and enable scalable, efficient, and insight-driven Revenue Operations across our global business.
  
  
The Ideal Candidate Will Combine Strategic Thinking, Operational Expertise, And Execution Rigor To Translate Business Priorities Into Actionable Programs That Enhance Productivity, Customer Experience, And Revenue Realization. Key Responsibilities Include:
  
  

* Strategy & Operating Model Evolution

Define and evolve the Revenue Operations strategy and target operating model aligned with business growth priorities
  
  
Identify opportunities to improve sales lifecycle efficiency, revenue realization, and customer experience
  
  
Act as a trusted advisor to RevOps leadership on strategic planning and transformation roadmaps
  
  

* Transformation & Program Leadership

Lead and execute enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across areas such as deal lifecycle management, order-to-cash, and revenue assurance
  
  
Drive cross-functional programs spanning Sales, Finance, Product, Legal, and Technology
  
  
Ensure disciplined program governance, milestone tracking, risk management, and value realization
  
  

* Process Optimization

Identify, design, and implement process simplification and automation opportunities across Revenue Operations
  
  
Leverage data, tools, and technology (e.g., CRM, workflow automation, analytics) to improve efficiency and scalability
  
  
Champion best practices, standardization, and continuous improvement
  
  

* Insights & Performance Management

Establish robust performance metrics and KPIs to track operational health and transformation impact across RevOps workstreams
  
  
Generate actionable insights to support decision-making and prioritize initiatives
  
  
Drive adoption of a data-driven culture within RevOps
  
  

* Stakeholder Engagement & Change Management

Partner with RevOps leadership and cross functional stakeholders to align on priorities and support execution
  
  
Lead change management efforts, ensuring stakeholder buy-in, effective communication, and sustained adoption
  
  
**Qualifications & Experience**
~6-10 years of experience in Strategy, Transformation, Consulting, or Revenue/Sales Operations
  
  
Proven track record of leading large-scale transformation programs in complex, matrixed organizations
  
  
Strong understanding of end-to-end revenue lifecycle (sales, contracting, order management, billing, revenue assurance)
  
  
Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional alignment
  
  
Experience with Business Process Engineering and Digital Transformation
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset
  
  
Excellent communication and executive presentation skills
  
  
Experience in B2B Services / SaaS environments
  
  
Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, O2C, Business Process Management, Workflow automation
  
  
Global experience working across multiple regions (e.g., LAC, NAM, EMEA, APAC)
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​
