**Role: Senior Analyst- Business Insights (Finance)**
**Location: Bangalore**
**Who are we and What do we do?**
InMobi Group’s mission is to power intelligent, mobile-first experiences for enterprises and consumers. Its businesses across advertising, marketing, data, and content platforms are shaping consumer experience in a world of connected devices. InMobi Group has been recognized on both the 2018 and 2019 CNBC Disruptor 50 list and as one of Fast Company’s 2018 World’s Most Innovative Companies.
  
  
**What’s the InMobi family like?**
Consistently featured among the “Great Places to Work” in India since 2017, our culture is our true north, enabling us to think big, solve complex challenges and grow with new opportunities. InMobians are passionate and driven, creative and fun-loving, take ownership and are results focused. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion.
  
  
**What do we promise?**
We offer an opportunity to have an immediate impact on the company and our products. The work that you shall do will be mission critical for InMobi and will be critical for optimizing tech operations, working with highly capable and ambitious peer groups. At InMobi, you get food for your body, soul, and mind with daily meals, gym, and yoga classes, cutting-edge training, and tools, cocktails at drink cart Thursdays and fun at work on Funky Fridays. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work.
  
  
**Why should you join us?**
You will contribute to creating disruptive and innovative consumer experiences using technology. We value autonomy, collaboration, technical innovation, and results-oriented thinking. InMobi’s culture is all about rewarding excellence so there are fantastic opportunities for the right candidates!
  
  
Finance BI team is part of FP&A and is responsible to upscale the organization towards data driven strategic decision making by adding the intelligence layer on top of this data - to unlock the huge potential that the right analytics could provide. This intelligence layer will be consumed towards unlocking productivity, realizing efficiencies, improving RoI for our various Products.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Own finance data end to end**

* Act as SME for finance data sources, definitions, and business logic across FP&A, Accounting, Revenue, and Business Units.
* Design and build Python and Spark (PySpark) pipelines that ingest, transform, and reconcile data from ERP, billing, ad platform, and operational systems into a governed analytics layer.
* Model data for finance use cases (P&L, unit economics, forecasting inputs, variance analysis, close reporting) with clear lineage and documented logic.
* Connect disconnected datasets across businesses and tools to create a single version of truth.

**Analyze and find the signal**

* Apply statistical methods to explain performance: regression, time-series forecasting, variance decomposition, hypothesis testing, and anomaly detection.
* Explore large, messy datasets to find patterns, explain why numbers move, and turn those findings into recommendations leaders can act on.
* Validate models and metrics rigorously, including back-testing forecasts and quantifying uncertainty.

**Automate reporting and decision support**

* Replace manual reporting with automated, scheduled, and tested data solutions.
* Build interactive dashboards and metrics layers in Rill and Power BI that summarize performance and surface recommended actions, not just charts.
* Define metrics once in a governed semantic layer so every dashboard reports the same numbers.

**Build AI agents and intelligent workflows**

* Design and deploy automations, reporting and insight generation using agents and workflows for tasks such as commentary drafting, anomaly explanation, reconciliation checks, and ad hoc data Q&A.
* Identify where agents create real leverage and where simpler automation is the better answer.

**Work independently and drive outcomes**

* Scope requirements directly with stakeholders, make reasonable trade-offs, and deliver without step-by-step direction.
* Own the full lifecycle: technical design, build, testing, documentation, deployment, monitoring, and issue resolution.
* Write modular, reusable, version-controlled code that others can maintain.

**Tool Stack**

* Python: data processing, automation, statistical analysis, and LLM integration
* Spark / PySpark: large-scale transformation (on Databricks or equivalent)
* SQL: modeling and analysis
* Rill: metrics views and operational dashboards
* Power BI: executive reporting
* Claude / LLM APIs: agent and workflow development
* Git: version control

**What We Are Looking For**
**Must-have**

* 2 to 5 years of experience in analytics, data engineering, or finance systems.
* Python: 2+ years, including writing tested, modular code for data pipelines and automation.
* Spark / PySpark: 2+ years of hands-on experience building production jobs on Databricks or a comparable platform.
* SQL: Strong, with experience modeling data for analytics and finance use cases.
* Rill or a comparable BI-as-code tool (Looker LookML, Cube, or similar): 1+ year of hands-on use, or a demonstrated ability to become productive quickly.
* Power BI: Working knowledge of data modeling and DAX (or equivalent).
* Statistics: Applied experience with regression, time-series forecasting, hypothesis testing, and anomaly detection.
* ETL/ELT and lakehouse experience: Hands-on with tools such as Databricks, dbt, or Airflow, and familiarity with warehouse and lakehouse architecture.
* LLM APIs: Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Claude preferred), including prompt design, tool use, structured outputs, and evaluation.
* Finance fundamentals: Solid understanding of accounting, financial statements, and FP&A concepts. Able to build and check financial models.
* End-to-end delivery: A track record of translating a business problem into a sustainable data product and working independently as the go-to person for a domain.
* Communication: Able to document decisions, write clear specs, and explain results to non-technical leaders.
* Bachelor's or master’s in engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related field.

**Good to have**

* Experience with agent frameworks (MCP, LangGraph, or similar) and multi-step AI workflow orchestration.
* Databricks certification (Data Engineer Associate or Professional) or an equivalent cloud data certification.
* Exposure to ad tech, digital media, or high-volume transactional businesses.

**Key Traits**

* Ownership: You take a problem from vague request to working solution without waiting to be told how.
* Curiosity: You explore data, find patterns in messy datasets, and ask why numbers move.
* Pragmatism: You choose the simplest solution that is reliable, maintainable, and actually used.
* Collaboration: You align Finance, Product, and Tech stakeholders on priorities and trade-offs.
* Bias for results: Strategy only matters once it turns into outcomes.

**The InMobi Culture**
At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.
  
  
We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.
  
  
InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.
  
  
Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more!

title: Business Finance Manager (Solar IPP & EPC)
description:
Business Finance Manager / Controller — Solar IPP & EPC

Sturlite Greentech (ZEOVOLT) | Bengaluru | Full-time

Reports to: Group CFO, Sturlite Group and CEO, Sturlite Greentech

Team: One direct report (Business Finance Analyst)

ABOUT STURLITE GREENTECH

Sturlite Greentech is the clean-energy platform of the Sturlite Group, a ₹700+ Cr FMEG and lighting business with a 16,000+ dealer network across 28 states. Greentech is being built as a standalone C&I solar Independent Power Producer (IPP) with an in-house EPC capability, a group-captive SPV model, and a clear ambition to scale into a listed platform. We develop, build, own and operate solar assets, sign long-term PPAs with commercial and industrial offtakers, and use structured financing (project debt, sale-and-leaseback, land-lease programmes) to recycle capital into the next project.

We are looking for the person who owns the numbers behind every one of those decisions.

THE ROLE

This is the finance brain of the IPP and EPC business. You will sit at the intersection of project evaluation, deal structuring, capital allocation and risk, and you will be the person who tells the CEO and Group CFO whether a project deserves to be built, on what terms, and whether it is delivering once it is.

You will be instrumental in conducting and driving the project Gate Meetings — the forum where every opportunity is approved, re-scoped or killed — and you will be accountable for the quality of the analysis that goes into them. You will be critical to evaluating the risks associated with each project and defining the mitigation strategies, working closely with the project and sales teams throughout.

This is not a bookkeeping or statutory-reporting role. It is a commercial finance role for someone who is comfortable reading a PPA as closely as a cash-flow model.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Project evaluation and capital decisions

* Build and own project financial models for every IPP and EPC opportunity: capex, tariff, generation, degradation, O&M, financing, tax and residual value.
* Compute and defend project and equity IRR, DSCR, payback and NPV; run sensitivity and scenario analysis on tariff, CUF, capex, interest rates, ALMM/duty changes and offtaker credit.
* Drive capital allocation decisions across projects and SPVs — which projects get built, in what sequence, and with what mix of debt, equity and lease finance.
* Drive the Gate Meetings: prepare the case with the project and sales teams, frame the go/no-go criteria, present the analysis, record decisions and follow through on conditions.

Deal structuring and optimisation

* Structure group-captive SPV arrangements (equity splits, offtaker contribution, performance guarantee deposits, buy-back mechanics) and evaluate alternatives.
* Work with lenders, NBFCs and lessors on project debt, sale-and-leaseback and master rental structures; model the economics and negotiate commercial terms alongside the CFO.
* Identify optimisation levers across the project lifecycle — procurement, financing cost, GST/tax treatment, land structures, EPC margin — and quantify them.

Project profitability, tracking and control

* Track budget vs. actual on every project under construction and in operation: capex slippage, schedule slippage, cost overruns, generation vs. P50/P90, collections and receivables.
* Own EPC job costing and margin reporting; flag variances early and drive corrective action with the project, sales and procurement teams.
* Build the management dashboard for the IPP portfolio and EPC pipeline; present monthly to the CEO and Group CFO.

Risk and contracts

* Evaluate the risks associated with each project — commercial, contractual, regulatory, execution and offtaker credit — and define and track the mitigation strategies with the project and sales teams.
* Read and assess PPAs, EPC contracts, lease/rental agreements, land leases, performance bank guarantees and lender term sheets from a risk-and-economics standpoint.
* Identify commercial and legal exposures — termination, change-in-law, curtailment, deemed generation, step-in rights, buy-back and ownership provisions — and ensure they are priced or mitigated before approval.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel, lenders' advisors and technical consultants during diligence and financial close.

Team

* Manage and develop one direct report who supports modelling, data collection and reporting.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

* MBA (Finance) from a Tier 1 institute (IIMs, ISB, XLRI, FMS, SPJIMR or equivalent) or a Chartered Accountant (first-attempt qualifiers preferred), with a minimum of 5 years of post-qualification experience in business finance, project finance, corporate finance or investment roles.
* Prior experience in renewable energy, infrastructure or EPC (IPP, developer, lender or advisory side) is strongly preferred but not mandatory — we value analytical rigour and commercial judgement over sector tenure.
* Hands-on mastery of project financial modelling — you have built models from scratch, not just reviewed them.
* Demonstrated experience with project debt, lease finance or structured transactions; exposure to sale-and-leaseback or group-captive structures is a strong plus.
* A legal bent of mind: you read contracts closely, spot the clause that changes the economics, and are comfortable negotiating commercial terms with counsel and counterparties.
* Working knowledge of the Indian solar regulatory landscape — open access, group captive rules, ALMM, GST on renewable assets, state policy nuances — or the ability to get up to speed on it fast.
* Strong business judgement and the confidence to say no to a project in front of senior leadership, with the analysis to back it.
* Structured communicator who can turn a 40-tab model into a one-page decision.
* Comfortable in an entrepreneurial, fast-moving environment where processes are still being built — and willing to build them.

WHY THIS ROLE

* You will shape the capital-allocation discipline of a platform being built for scale, not maintain one that already exists.
* Direct exposure to the Group CFO and CEO, and to lenders, potential investors, family offices and strategic counterparties.

LOCATION AND COMPENSATION

Bengaluru, with travel to project sites and offtaker locations. Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience.

To apply: Send your CV and a short note on a project you evaluated or structured — and what you would have done differently — to hr2@sturlite.com.

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-V&M-Consultant-BVAL Complex security/EGC
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy & Transactions | Valuation & Modeling | Complex Securities Valuation | Consultant**
Join our team of Strategy & Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, strategy, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
**Level: Senior or equivalent**
As a Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for reviewing the valuation analysis/ models assisting client with their taxation planning and compliance; financial reporting in accordance with ‘US GAAP’ or ‘IFRS’ accounting standards . You will build, review, and validate quantitative models, interpret outputs in the context of applicable accounting standards, and draft client-ready deliverables. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**The team:**
The Complex Securities Valuation team, part of Deloitte Consulting Services, provides services relating to the full life cycle of Valuation, including policy and process assessments, and quantitative solutions to support the valuation of all types of financial instruments under ASC 820, ASC 718, ASC 815, ASC 480, ASC 842 and other financial reporting standards including complex derivatives, convertible securities, contingent consideration, contingent claims analysis, stock compensation, incremental borrowing rates, equity securities and other investment products. Valuation service offering also provides advisory services to financial institutions, governmental agencies and other private and public companies.
  
  
**Work you’ll do / Key Responsibilities:**
The key job responsibilities will be to:
  
  

* Conduct 409A common stock valuations and complex capital structure analyses using OPM (Black-Scholes and Monte Carlo), PWERM, and hybrid methodologies; document DLOM/DLOC assumptions with appropriate support
* Apply and document fair value measurement methodologies under ASC 820, ASC 718, ASC 815, ASC 480, and ASC 842; ensure deliverables are defensible to external auditors
* Support Deloitte US and Deloitte India (Offices of the US) project teams in providing financial consulting services relating to preparing and auditing complex security valuations. Assist in the valuation of financial instruments for regulatory, financial, and 409A purposes.
* Create/assist in creating financial models, analyzing financial statements, conducting industry research, and writing reports
* Draft client-ready valuation reports and memos including methodology rationale, model assumptions, sensitivity analyses, and concluded fair values; respond substantively to auditor and client review comments
* Deliver high-quality valuation work products and assist other team members in India (Offices of the US), when required; and interact with internal clients and communicate with stakeholders in the US
* Supervise and review work of junior analysts; provide structured, technical feedback to build team capability and maintain quality standards across the engagement portfolio
* May need to work on other Deloitte Consulting engagements
* Support business development through proposal preparation, pitch materials, and thought leadership on emerging topics in financial instrument valuation

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Strong background in mathematical finance at the Master's level - degree in Mathematical Finance, Mathematics of Finance, Financial Engineering or Quantitative Finance, or a related technical discipline.
* Understanding financial valuation concepts is required. Applicants are expected to have strong analytical and computer skills. Quantitative analysis technical skills and experience with modeling and valuation theory (Monte-Carlo Simulations, Binomial Lattice, Black Scholes, Options Theory, Geometric Brownian Motion), and tools (Bloomberg, and S&P Capital IQ) are a plus.
* 1-4 years of relevant Complex Securities Valuation experience

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

description:
Employer          - Leading E- Commerce Company

Role.                -  Treasury Finance

Job Location    -  Bangalore

Experience  - 6-8 Years

**Role summary:**

We are seeking a Treasury Lead with 6–8 years of hardcore corporate treasury

experience in loan agreement negotiation with banks, cash flow planning, and

endtoend banking operations in a fastpaced ecommerce/retail or allied environment.

The role will independently own the full treasury stack – from WCDL/SBLC and loan

documentation to cashflow forecasting, BRS, compliances, audit support, and

seniormanagement MIS – while leading process improvements and acting as the

primary interface with bankers and internal stakeholders

**Key responsibilities**

1
**. Banking operations ownership**

o Independently oversee and execute daily banking transactions: vendor

payments, marketplace settlements, statutory dues, employee

reimbursements, and interbank fund movements across multiple bank

relationships.

o Ensure strong control on cutoff timings, dual authorization, and

documentation for all treasury payments.

2
**. Loan agreements & WCDL lifecycle management**

o Lead endtoend working capital and term loan processes – from term

sheet evaluation, covenant analysis, and loan agreement negotiation

with banks to documentation closure.

o Own the complete WCDL cycle: drawdown requests, utilization

tracking, repayment scheduling, interest computation, limit renewals,

and covenant compliance, ensuring zero delays or default.

3.
**SBLC / BG management**

o Manage issuance, renewal, amendment, and closure of Standby

Letters of Credit and other bank guarantees.

o Maintain a robust register of all SBLC/BG instruments with validity,

value, and purpose; proactively coordinate with banks and business

teams on expiry and collateral requirements.

**4. Bank reconciliation (BRS)**

o Own daily and monthly BRS across all bank accounts, including

payment gateways and marketplace accounts.

o Set up systematic workflows for openitem identification and closure;

drive a “zerooutstanding beyond agreed SLA” culture.

**5. Cashflow forecasting & fund planning**

o Build and maintain shortterm (daily/weekly) and mediumterm

(monthly/quarterly) cashflow models at entity and group level.

o Monitor daily liquidity, anticipate funding gaps, and recommend

deployment of surplus funds or drawdown of facilities to optimize

interest cost.

**6. Accounting & Tally ERP**

o Ensure accurate and timely posting of all treasuryrelated entries in Tally

ERP – JVs, payment vouchers, contra entries, interest accruals, and

periodend adjustments – with full supporting documentation.

o Coordinate closely with the GL, AP, and tax teams for smooth

monthend and yearend closing.

**7. MIS & treasury analytics**

o Design, publish, and continuously improve weekly and monthly

treasury MIS dashboards, covering: bank balances, fund positions,

payment summaries, WCDL utilization, interest cost trends, covenant

status, and variancetoplan for Finance leadership.

o Provide actionable insights on cost of funds, idle cash, and utilization

efficiency; suggest optimization levers.

**8. Audit management**

o Lead preparation of treasury schedules and evidence for internal,

statutory, and tax audits.

o Proactively close priorperiod audit observations related to treasury and

strengthen controls to target “nil observations” in subsequent audits.

**9. Compliance & risk controls**

o Ensure compliance with internal treasury policies, banking covenants,

RBI guidelines, and statutory payment timelines (TDS, GST, PF, ESIC,

etc.).

o Flag potential covenant breaches, document lapses, or operational

risks in advance to the Finance Head and help implement mitigating

actions.

**10. Banking & stakeholder management**

o Act as the primary treasury interface with banks and financial

institutions for limits, pricing, documentation, and issue resolution.

o Collaborate closely with Accounts Payable, Tax, Legal, and

Marketplace Finance teams to align cashflow planning with business

decisions.

o Identify bottlenecks in treasury processes (payments, reconciliations,

loan documentation, MIS collation) and propose technology or process

solutions (Tally automation, bank API, Excel models, etc.)

o Lead implementation of approved initiatives to reduce manual effort,

TAT, reconciliation issues, and interest leakage.

description:
**Overview**
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity**
With 5,400 employees and global access to more than 40 derivative exchanges and 75 securities markets operating in over than 80 offices spread across five continents, we’re a Fortune-100, Nasdaq-listed provider, connecting clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.
  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, The StoneX Group is made up of four segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
  
  
**Commercial**
: With boots on the ground authenticity at the heart of everything we do, our comprehensive array of commercial products and services enable you to work directly with our clients, across hedging, risk management, execution and clearing, OTC products, commodity finance and more.
  
  
The Bangalore Treasury team is a newly established regional hub supporting Treasury activities across APAC and EMEA. This role offers the opportunity to be part of an exciting growth journey, helping to build a scalable Treasury function while gaining broad exposure to liquidity management, funding, collateral, risk management, and treasury transformation initiatives across multiple jurisdictions and business lines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Purpose:**
This Treasury role supports business activities across APAC and EMEA, providing broad exposure to liquidity management, funding, cash optimization, collateral and margin management, client asset oversight, and Treasury reporting. The successful candidate will take a lead role in managing day-to-day Treasury activities, monitoring financial risks, and driving process improvements while partnering closely with Finance, Risk, Operations, Technology, and business stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions.
  
  
The role offers opportunities to work with colleagues across APAC and EMEA within a Follow-the-Sun operating model, combining operational oversight with strategic initiatives focused on liquidity optimization, automation, risk management, and scalable Treasury processes to support regional growth.
  
  
**Liquidity, Funding and Cash Optimization**

* Oversee liquidity positions and funding requirements across entities, currencies, and business lines.
* Analyse liquidity trends and support funding, contingency planning, and cash optimization initiatives.
* Execute and review Treasury transactions, including money market placements, deposits, and intercompany funding.
* Support management of bank facilities, funding structures, and liquidity resources.
* Monitor compliance with funding limits, liquidity requirements, and Treasury policies.

**Collateral, Margin and Client Asset Oversight**

* Oversee collateral and margin activities with exchanges, brokers, liquidity providers, and clients.
* Review CCP, broker, and bank balances to optimize liquidity utilization.
* Support safeguarding of client funds and assets in accordance with regulatory and internal requirements.
* Identify funding or collateral pressures and coordinate timely escalation and resolution.

**Investment Portfolio and Financial Risk Support**

* Monitor investment portfolios to ensure alignment with liquidity objectives and risk appetite.
* Evaluate investment and cash optimization opportunities within approved guidelines.
* Monitor interest rate, foreign exchange, and counterparty credit risk exposures.
* Support hedging activities and contribute to Treasury governance, policies, and controls.

**Reporting, Analytics and Process Improvement**

* Prepare and review Treasury reports for management, stakeholders, and regulatory purposes.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, analytics, and financial models to support decision-making.
* Provide insights into liquidity, funding, collateral, and risk exposures.
* Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, and enhancements to reporting and data quality.

**Regional and Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Finance, Risk, Operations, Technology, and business teams across APAC and EMEA.
* Support Treasury systems, payment processes, liquidity management, and reporting capabilities.
* Provide guidance and oversight to junior team members and support knowledge sharing across the Follow-the-Sun model.
* Contribute to Treasury transformation initiatives and scalable processes that support regional growth.

**Qualifications**
**To land this role you will need**
:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related quantitative field. CFA, FRM or MBA would be advantageous.
* 5+ years of experience in Corporate Treasury, Finance, Risk Management, Operations or a related role within financial services.
* Cross Border and Correspondent Banking SWIFT payments experience (MT103,199,202,940)
* Strong understanding of financial markets, treasury operations, FX, fixed income, derivatives, collateral and funding activities.
* Experience in liquidity forecasting, cash management, funding, collateral, margin and reconciliations.

**What makes you stand out:**

* Advanced Excel skills for financial modelling and data analysis.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python or other analytics tools would be advantageous.
* Exposure to brokerage, capital markets, banking, client money or collateral processes would be advantageous.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain Treasury, liquidity and data-driven information clearly to different stakeholders.
* Strong team player

**Work mode:**

* 4 Days in-office

title: Manager - Card Portfolio Optimization Consulting, VCA X
description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Team Summary
  
  
Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.
  
  
VCA-X is VCA's global delivery capability, designed to scale high-value solutions across Regions through multidisciplinary teams, common delivery standards, AI-enabled assets, and continuous learning from delivery. Working in partnership with Regional teams and Practice Areas, VCA-X enables consistent, efficient, and scalable delivery while maintaining client and market relevance.
  
  
Specialist & Consulting Delivery is a core pillar of the VCA-X operating model. It provides the specialist expertise, consulting delivery capacity, consulting leadership, and quality oversight required to ensure VCA-X delivers credible, consistent, and client-ready outputs.
  
  
The role operates as one of three core delivery leadership pillars within VCA-X, alongside Program Management and Data & Analytics Delivery.
  
  
**Purpose**

* Primary focus: Own and drive portfolio strategy — lifting acquisition, activation, engagement, and incremental spend across credit and debit card portfolios.
* Core expertise: Cards portfolio optimization strategy, customer lifecycle management (CLM), and campaign management (design, targeting), with strong familiarity with payments industry rules and card-network/regulatory guidelines.

**Responsibilities**
Portfolio Strategy and Performance
  
  

* Develop and refine end-to-end strategies to improve KPIs: acquisition, activation, usage, spend per active, retention, cross-/up-sell, attrition reduction, credit losses, and ROI.
* Diagnose performance drivers and recommend segment-level interventions by lifecycle stage.

Customer Lifecycle Management
  
  

* Design journeys for onboarding, early engagement, habituation, maturation, retention/win-back; define treatments and test plans (A/B and multivariate).
* Identify friction points and opportunities to accelerate first-use, repeat use, and long-term engagement across digital and partner/merchant channels.

Campaign Strategy, Design, and Execution
  
  

* Translate portfolio objectives into campaign strategies: offer constructs, eligibility, targeting rules, suppression logic, and measurement frameworks.

Insights, Analytics, and Forecasting
  
  

* Drive analytics that size opportunities and forecast impact (propensity, uplift, CLV, attrition, spend elasticities); own a disciplined test-and-learn roadmap.
* Craft clear documentation and executive-ready presentations that turn findings into decisions for senior stakeholders.

Thought Leadership and Team Contribution
  
  

* Track market trends (rewards, interchange, merchant offers, embedded finance, tokenization, BNPL, digital wallets) and turn them into portfolio interventions.
* Build the playbooks, benchmarks, and frameworks that become the reference standard for portfolio optimization across every market — not a one-off deliverable, but the thing other markets build on.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 6-8 years in cards/payments, banking, or consulting with hands-on ownership of cards portfolio optimization, lifecycle programs, and campaign management.
* Experience with offer optimization, rewards strategy, merchant-funded offers, and partnerships.
* Familiarity with credit risk fundamentals (underwriting policy, line management) and their interaction with spend growth strategies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in payments, banking, financial services, consulting, or another data-intensive industry.
* Experience with GenAI, agentic workflows, prompt-based systems, or AI-assisted analytics.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to craft executive-ready presentations and translate complex analytics into clear business decisions.
* Strong project management; ability to run multiple initiatives, set priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment with disciplined documentation.
* Define the methodology, don't just execute one — thrive in a delivery model where the standard for this capability area is still being built, and where your judgment sets it.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Portfolio Management Intern
description:
Job Title: Portfolio Management Intern
  
Location: Remote
  
Organization: PipRaisers
  
Stipend: Up to ₹20,000 per month
  
Duration: 2 Months
  
Opportunities: Letter of Recommendation (LOR) & Pre-Placement Offer (PPO)
  
  
About PipRaisers
  
PipRaisers is a dynamic trading insights and portfolio research firm specializing in global financial markets. We help traders and investors build better strategies through structured portfolio approaches across forex, crypto, and commodities. Our live projects and data-backed frameworks make us a trusted learning hub for aspiring professionals in high-volatility markets.
  
  
Role Overview
  
As a Portfolio Management Intern at PipRaisers, you will contribute to developing and monitoring multi-asset portfolios in live trading environments. Working across FX, commodities, and digital assets, you’ll engage in performance analysis, market scanning, and strategy refinement while gaining a hands-on understanding of managing risks and returns in real-time.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1. Track and evaluate portfolio performance across FX (USD, EUR, JPY), commodities (gold, oil), and crypto (BTC, ETH, SOL)
  
2. Research price trends, economic indicators, and sector sentiment to drive portfolio strategy
  
3. Assist in the development and testing of systematic or discretionary strategies
  
4. Monitor live trades and support in generating actionable trade ideas
  
5. Contribute to daily/weekly rebalancing, stop-loss setups, and position size adjustments
  
6. Maintain detailed records through dashboards, trade logs, and performance summaries
  
7. Collaborate with the core team on reviews, backtests, and strategy improvements
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
1. Students or recent graduates in Finance, Economics, MBA (Finance), Quant, or BBA
  
2. Interest in global markets with a focus on FX, commodities, and crypto portfolios
  
3. Sound understanding of asset allocation, diversification, and market instruments
  
4. Strong analytical mindset with comfort in Excel, TradingView, Binance, or MT4/MT5
  
5. Curious about high-volatility asset classes and real-time decision making
  
6. A self-starter who enjoys exploring strategies, managing data, and drawing insights
  
  
What You’ll Gain
  
1. First-hand exposure to building and managing live trading portfolios
  
2. Understanding of real-time risk management, returns, drawdown metrics, and trade rationale
  
3. Monthly stipend up to ₹20,000 depending on performance
  
4. LOR and internship certificate on successful completion
  
5. PPO opportunity based on performance, innovation, and initiative
  
6. Access to mentorship, exclusive research tools, and trading war rooms
  
  
  
Start Date: Immediate preferred

title: Institutional Equity Division - Associate, Fund Accounting (Bangalore)
description:
Fund Accounting, Associate, Fund Services
  
  
We’re seeking someone to join our team as Associate who will be responsible in ensuring proper NAV calculation of their hedge fund clients. Established in 2004, Morgan Stanley Fund Services (MSFS) is a global business within the Institutional Equities Division (IED) that provides fund administration services for over $700billion in assets across 350+ hedge funds, private equity and large family offices clients. Our best-in-class offering includes accounting and investors services, portfolio analytics, middle-office functions, regulatory and financial reporting, and tax services. Delivering these services to our clients and their investors is a diverse team of 1,400 highly skilled employees across the globe based in New York, London, Glasgow, Dublin, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Hong Kong. Joining MSFS, you will discover a dynamic environment where every day offers new opportunities for personal growth and innovation. Here at MSFS your career isn’t just a job, it’s an incredible journey fueled by collaboration, challenge, and the chance to make a meaningful impact to our business, our clients, their investors and the wider Morgan Stanley franchise.
  
  
The MSFS Accounting group offers a dynamic, client-focused environment providing comprehensive portfolio accounting services—including daily reconciliations, NAV calculations, and daily/weekly return estimates. We bring together sophisticated systems supporting diverse fund structures and incentive arrangements with a highly specialized team with expertise in hedge funds, private equity, audit, and prime brokers. Collaboration, precision, and innovation define the department, ensuring accuracy and timeliness for clients while fostering professional growth across all levels of our diverse global team. MSFS Accounting provides a fast-paced, intellectually stimulating environment ideal for ambitious individuals looking to engage with complex financial products & data, cutting-edge processes, and high-performing colleagues. Join us to be part of a team where expertise and excellence drive success for our clients and your career.
  
  
Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
  
  
**What You’ll Do In The Role**

* Provide Accounting solutions to Hedge Funds for independent valuation, investor transparency and regulatory compliance.
* Calculation of daily NAV.
* Review MSPA to custodian reconciliations. Identify and determine cause. Notify Account Manager of breaks. If break is due to an erroneous or missing transaction in MSPA then make necessary adjustments.

* Review general ledger exceptions. Identify cause and make necessary adjustments.
* Verify performance by reviewing large P&L swings and analyzing income/expense journals for validity.
* Adjust activity as necessary for performance (MSPM) processing and reporting.
* Responsible for accruing daily or monthly non-security related accruals including management fees and financing accruals.
* Process non-automated transactions including OTC derivatives and their related cash movements.
* Perform daily and monthly securities pricing analysis.
* Validate and process corporate action data.
* Providing audit support and assistance to funds in the preparation on financial statements.
* Assistance with compliance functions.

* 0 to 2 years prior work experience – preferably in financial services. Knowledge of hedge fund processing is a strong advantage.
* Good administrative and organisational skills with a particular focus on accuracy and attention to detail.
* An ability to work under pressure and an ability to cope with increased workloads at month-end.
* An ability to work as part of a virtual team that is spread across different time zones and geographies.

An ability to use key financial systems and other IT tools.
  
  
**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

title: Sr. Consultant
description:
Trinity is seeking a
**Senior Consultant**
to join our growing Analytics organization with a focus on delivering data and AI-enabled analytics solutions. This role blends strong analytics execution, business understanding and practical application of AI (including GenAI and LLM-based approaches) across commercial use cases.
  
  
Trinity is a 1400-person, global organization that partners with ~350 life sciences companies annually. At the highest level, we provide Strategy, Insights, and Analytics support. Within Analytics, we have well-established SME verticals (e.g., forecasting, sales analytics, commercial data solutions, data science, AI/ML solutions).
  
  
**Trinity is investing in expanding our Analytics Strategy team**
, a seller-doer group that owns client relationships and overall account delivery. Senior Consultants are responsible for delivery excellence, while helping scale Trinity’s AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to join an established firm and work in an entrepreneurial environment, building and scaling a fast-growing team within a core strategic priority area for Trinity.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Trinity is seeking a talented, committed, and entrepreneurial individual to join our Enterprise Analytics Delivery (EAD) team as a Sr. Consultant.
**The EAD team acts as the pan**
-
**analytics backbone,**
orchestrating end-to-end execution, client partnership, and commercial growth for complex analytics programs
**.**
The Consultant is responsible for:
  
  

* Developing analysis design for client problems, with responsibility for quality, timeliness, and business impact
* Ensuring technical rigor across a range of analytics approaches (from descriptive and diagnostic analysis to advanced analytics and AI/ML)

The ideal candidate for this position will contribute to the firm’s success through a strong work ethic, particularly in team settings, and can communicate with statisticians, data analysts, and business stakeholders alike. The Sr. Consultant should be able to independently run complex analyses, while guiding junior team members and bringing in relevant life sciences context.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**
**This role is an important position within our team, engaging directly with global clients, leading internal teams, building capabilities and standard operating procedures (SOPs), and collaborating with**
**seamlessly with integrated Trinity teams across US, EU, and APAC.**
**Delivery Leadership**

* Lead specific analytical workstreams within a project, from problem framing and workplan development through analysis, synthesis, quality review, and final recommendations.
* Understand and work with secondary RWE datasets such as claims, EMR, sales Data, Patient Level Datasets, and other real-world data sources to support commercial and analytical insights generation (e.g., IQVIA, Komodo, Symphony, Flatiron, Definitive)
* Partner with senior project leaders within Trinity to understand and refine the 'contextual why' for business questions and structure the insights such that inform strategy and decision-making.
* Be responsible for analysis execution using a selection of tools like Excel (along with Copilot), SQL, R, Python, or other analytical tools
* Identify gaps in analysis plan and data limitations as project progresses, and communicate effectively with project leaders to ensure resolution
* Apply advanced data science methodologies and AI/ML models for client problems, support the design and deployment Trinity’s technology solutions in client environments.

**Mentoring and Coaching**

* Mentor and review the work of Associates, Associate Consultants and Consultants, providing feedback to strengthen problem solving, analytics execution, and client readiness.
* Serve as direct people manager and own reporting lines; Coach team members to build stronger analytical, project management, and communication skills through day-to-day guidance and apprenticeship.
* Teach junior team members how to use AI tools and automation responsibly in analytics delivery and operational workflows.
* Support capability building across the EAD team by identifying development opportunities and helping junior staff grow.

**Business Development Support**

* Gain methodological/ analytics approach expertise by aiding in proposal development as needed.
* Contribute to pitch materials and case examples that showcase EAD capabilities across forecasting, brand analytics, RWE, access analytics, sales analytics, advanced modeling, AI/ML, and AI-enabled delivery.

**Required Qualifications**

: With boots on the ground authenticity at the heart of everything we do, our comprehensive array of commercial products and services enable you to work directly with our clients, across hedging, risk management, execution and clearing, OTC products, commodity finance and more.
  
  
The Bangalore Treasury team is a newly established regional hub supporting Treasury activities across APAC and EMEA. This role offers the opportunity to be part of an exciting growth journey, helping to build a scalable Treasury function while gaining broad exposure to liquidity management, funding, collateral, risk management, and treasury transformation initiatives across multiple jurisdictions and business lines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Purpose:**
This Treasury role supports business activities across APAC and EMEA, providing broad exposure to liquidity management, funding, cash optimization, collateral and margin management, client asset oversight, and Treasury reporting. The successful candidate will take a lead role in managing day-to-day Treasury activities, monitoring financial risks, and driving process improvements while partnering closely with Finance, Risk, Operations, Technology, and business stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions.
  
  
The role offers opportunities to work with colleagues across APAC and EMEA within a Follow-the-Sun operating model, combining operational oversight with strategic initiatives focused on liquidity optimization, automation, risk management, and scalable Treasury processes to support regional growth.
  
  
**Primary duties will include:**
Liquidity and Cash Management
  
  

* Monitor daily cash positions and ensure adequate funding across bank accounts and currencies.
* Support cash flow forecasting, liquidity reporting, and funding requirements.
* Execute bank transfers, internal funding movements, and margin-related payments.
* Assist in optimizing CCP, broker, and bank balances.
* Monitor liquidity and currency exposures within internal and regulatory limits
* Support client deposit processing and settlement obligations.

Collateral, Margin and Client Asset Support
  
  

* Support collateral and margin management with exchanges, brokers, liquidity providers, and clients.
* Assist with safeguarding customer funds and assets.
* Support timely settlement of margin and collateral requirements.

Reconciliations and Intercompany Support
  
  

* Perform daily bank and cash reconciliations.
* Monitor payment service provider balances and settlements.
* Support intercompany balance reviews and funding settlements.
* Reconcile Treasury-related interest and transactions.

Reporting and Process Improvement
  
  

* Prepare liquidity, cash, funding, and client money reports.
* Support management reporting and data integrity across Treasury systems.
* Maintain Treasury records and documentation.
* Identify opportunities for process automation and operational improvements.

Systems and Cross-Functional Support
  
  

* Support Treasury Management System processes for payments, liquidity management, and reporting.
* Collaborate with Treasury, Finance, Operations, Technology, and business teams across APAC and EMEA.
* Escalate funding, liquidity, reconciliation, and operational issues promptly.

**Qualifications**
To land this role you will need :
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related discipline.
* 2 to 5 years of experience in Treasury, Finance, FX, Operations or a related financial services role.
* Cross Border and Correspondent Banking SWIFT payments experience (MT103,199,202,940)
* Good understanding of cash management, bank transfers, reconciliations and liquidity reporting.

What makes you stand out:
  
  

* Strong Microsoft Skills (EXCEL, WORD, VISIO, PowerPoint) and attention to detail
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Good numerical ability, accuracy in data handling and ability to work under time-sensitive deadlines

* Strong team player

title: Senior Analyst / Lead / Senior Lead – Planning & Forecasting Analyst
description:

We are looking for a Planning & Forecasting Senior Analyst with strong analytical skills and finance acumen to deliver the full monthly and annual planning and forecasting cycle for markets within the Planning & Forecasting Hub.
  
  
Success in the role requires the ability to think critically, constructively challenge and influence key stakeholders. **Key Responsibilities**

Navigate the cross-functional matrix and form an internal network, working closely with stakeholders being both a reliable partner and an effective customer of the services you depend on
* Simplify how we work and drive globally aligned ways of working. Reduce non-standard work, and continuously improve agility and efficiency in planning, budgeting and forecasting through digital fluency and the adoption of AI in standard ways of working

* Experience of running a full planning and forecasting cycle
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, concise commentary for senior stakeholders

* University degree in Finance or Business (or equivalent).

Business Forecasting, Business Reporting Tools, Critical Thinking, Data Analytics, Data Visualization, Digital Fluency, Financial Controlling, Financial Reporting and Analysis, Influencing Without Authority, Stakeholder Management
  
  
**Why GSK?**

title: Sr Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
**What Do You Need To Know About The Role**
A team in a key role supporting G&A financial planning and decision-making. You will help connect company strategy and goals to financial plans for headcount and operating expenses, deliver insights and recommendations to senior leadership, and establish scalable global standards for OPEX and headcount reporting. You’ll also identify opportunities to strengthen planning infrastructure and streamline financial processes while building and leading a high-performing team of analysts.
  
  
Meet our team
  
  
This role offers ownership of Opex strategy for Corporate/Enabling Functions at a global fintech leader, with high visibility to senior leadership and real influence over how the company invests in Legal, HR, Facilities, and IT. The candidate will work hands-on with modern planning tools (SAP, SAP Analytics Cloud) while driving automation and process improvement — not just reporting numbers, but shaping how Finance operates.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Support planning and forecasting processes
* Review business performance on regular cadences (weekly, monthly, quarterly)Collaborate with stakeholders to gather inputs and summarize insights
* Produce executive-level presentations
* Work closely with the finance and technical teams to drive process and system improvements
* Facilitate discussions with various stakeholders, manage expectations, and collaborate cross-functionally
* Consult with finance leads to review and discuss key issues, risks, and dependencies for assigned initiatives
* Document and escalate potential risks/issues, assist in developing mitigation strategies, and support their implementation

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Own the Opex planning, forecasting, and budgeting cycle for Corporate/Enabling Functions (e.g., Legal, HR, Finance, Corporate Real Estate, IT), ensuring alignment with enterprise-wide financial targets
* Partner directly with senior functional leaders to translate business priorities into financial plans, headcount models, and investment cases, acting as a trusted financial advisor
* Deliver clear, concise, and compelling storytelling on financial performance, key cost drivers, and variances to executive and cross-functional audiences
* Drive standardization, automation, and process improvement across Opex reporting workstreams, leveraging tools such as SAP, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and other planning platforms
* Lead monthly close, variance analysis (budget vs. actual/forecast), and headcount tracking, proactively flagging risks and opportunities before they surface in results
* Build and maintain robust financial models and business cases to support strategic decisions, cost-optimization initiatives, and ad hoc leadership requests
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Controllership, Corporate FP&A, Legal, HR/People, and business stakeholders to ensure data integrity, consistency, and a single source of truth across reporting
* Represent Finance in leadership forums, demonstrating strong executive presence and the ability to influence and articulate recommendations to senior stakeholders

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of progressive FP&A or corporate finance experience, ideally within a fintech, financial services, or technology environment, with direct exposure to Corporate/Enabling Functions
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field; MBA or professional certification (CPA/CFA) a plus
* Hands-on experience with SAP and SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) required; familiarity with additional planning tools (Tableau, Power BI) is a plus
* Demonstrated experience managing Opex budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis for a large, matrixed organization
* Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently present to and influence senior leadership, including comfort operating with ambiguity and competing priorities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex financial data into clear, actionable narratives for non-finance audiences
* Self-starter who can work autonomously in a fast-paced, global environment while collaborating effectively across time zones and functions

**Subsidiary:**
PayPal
  
  
**Travel Percent:**
0
  
  
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.
  
  
For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.
  
  
**Who We Are:**
Click Here to learn more about our culture and community.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.
  
  
**Belonging at PayPal:**
Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.
  
  
Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.
  
  
We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

title: Senior Associate, Business Modelling
description:
**Senior Associate – Financial Modelling | XF1 Advisory | Bengaluru (On-site)**

**About XF1 Advisory**

X-F1 Advisory Services (XF1) is a Bengaluru-based financial advisory firm specializing in Financial Modelling, Valuation Advisory, and Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A).

We work with businesses, investors, private equity funds, and advisory firms across India and international markets, delivering sophisticated financial models that support investment decisions, strategic planning, and business performance.

Our practice is built around technical excellence, with leadership credentials that include a World #2 ranking at the Financial Modeling World Cup.

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a
**Senior Associate – Financial Modelling**
who enjoys building financial models, understanding businesses, and solving complex analytical problems.

Working closely with our Project Leads and Director, you'll take ownership of modelling workstreams, interact directly with clients, and contribute to a diverse range of engagements across sectors and geographies.

This is a hands-on role for someone who values technical depth, attention to detail, and continuous learning.

**What You'll Do**

* Design, build, and maintain integrated financial models, including three-statement forecasts, operating models, valuation models, and investment analysis.
* Develop financial projections, scenario and sensitivity analyses, and other decision-support tools.
* Review, audit, and stress-test financial models for accuracy, consistency, and commercial logic.
* Work directly with clients to understand business drivers, gather financial and operational data, and translate assumptions into structured forecasts.
* Prepare financial analysis and communicate key findings through presentations, reports, and model walkthroughs.
* Collaborate with senior team members on engagements across sectors, including private equity, real estate, infrastructure, SaaS, and other businesses.
* Leverage AI, automation, and analytical tools to improve modelling efficiency, accuracy, and delivery quality.

**What We're Looking For**

* **CA or CFA qualification (mandatory).**
* **1–3 years of relevant experience**
  in financial modelling, preferably with a Big 4 firm, investment bank, consulting firm, or specialized financial advisory practice.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, corporate finance, and valuation concepts.
* Advanced Excel skills, including the ability to build structured, dynamic, and fully integrated financial models.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to understand business models, identify key financial drivers, and translate complex information into meaningful insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence in working directly with clients.
* Interest in AI, automation, and modern analytical tools. Experience with Power Query, VBA, or similar technologies is an advantage.
* A collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity, and genuine enthusiasm for financial modelling.

**Why Join XF1?**

* Work on diverse and technically challenging engagements across international markets.
* Gain direct exposure to clients, senior professionals, and investment decision-making.
* Develop expertise across multiple industries and financial modelling disciplines.
* Be part of a growing advisory practice where modelling quality, analytical thinking, and continuous improvement are central to how we work.
* Explore the practical application of AI and automation alongside traditional financial modelling.

**Location:**
Bengaluru | On-site

**Compensation:**
₹12–18 LPA, depending on relevant experience and capabilities.

**To Apply**

Send your CV to people@xf1advisory.com or apply directly through LinkedIn Easy Apply.

**We encourage applicants to highlight 1–2 financial modelling assignments undertaken in the past 12 months, briefly outlining the industry, type of model, and their specific contribution. Please exclude any confidential client information.**

**VME Real Estate**
–
**Transactions & Corporate Finance (TCF) – Associate Manager**
Within TAS, Real Estate (RE) group is part of Valuations, Modelling and Economics sub-service line. Our RE practice provides real estate valuation, analytical services and other business advisory services to developers, builders, investors, lenders and Fortune 500 companies.
  
  
With over 500 RE professionals worldwide (~45 in GDS RE), no similarly positioned global professional organization can match breadth of our capabilities or depth of our resources. GDS RE works as a strategic partner to global RE practices, working with them to provide highly efficient and value-added services to meet our clients’ real estate valuation and diligence requirements.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Associate Manager with expertise in
**real estate valuation**
to join the valuation group of our
**Real Estate Valuation Team**
.
  
  
As a member of the Ernst & Young Real Estate team, the Associate Manager will serve as a project lead and/or member of multiple client engagement teams around the world (US, UK, Germany, Australia etc) which primarily assist in real estate and hospitality advisory engagements in a fast-paced, service-oriented business environment. Associate Manager will work on a wide variety of real estate and hospitality-specific clients including owners, developers, builders, financial institutions, lenders, pension funds, as well as numerous Fortune 500 companies.
  
  
Typical engagements include CRE underwriting, appraisals and valuations, review of valuation analysis, market studies/research, cash flow analyses, due diligence, portfolio analysis and cash flow modelling.
  
  
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a valuation service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a member of multiple client engagement teams, taking a lead role in understanding clients’ needs, conducting analyses and reporting results
* Lead and manage commercial real estate underwriting and due diligence engagements across a broad range of property types including multi-family residential, office, retail, hotel, industrial, mixed-use, infrastructure, and special-use properties
* Perform comprehensive loan underwriting and asset-level analyses, including review of historical operating performance, cash flow sustainability, analysing general ledgers and financial records to identify unusual transactions and key credit considerations.
* Conduct detailed revenue and expense review procedures by analysing rent rolls, bank statements, check deposits, operating expense invoices, property tax records, lease agreements, and supporting property documentation.
* Review, abstract, and analyse complex lease agreements, amendments, estoppels, and other tenancy documents to identify critical lease terms, reimbursement structures, rent escalations, renewal options, concessions, and termination provisions.
* Prepare and review Asset Summary Reports (ASRs), underwriting memorandums, due diligence reports, and other client deliverables summarizing property performance, risks, mitigants, and investment considerations.
* Specific engagement will include financial and cash flow modelling, market research, real estate documents analysis (including site/building plans, leases, appraisals, and mortgage underwriting/lending documents), asset valuation (PPA/fair value), and report writing
* Challenge yourself to continually learn and teach, mentoring others while developing your own career
* Take ownership of your projects, while working collaboratively with other team members
* Maintain and develop positive, productive, and professional relationships with clients
* Supervise, develop and mentor professionals at the Staff and Senior level
* Ability to manage a team of 3-5 professionals; Conducting timely performance reviews for employees and developing other professionals by providing effective performance feedback and training to them. Leading by example.
* Use current technology and tools to enhance the effectiveness of services provided.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of commercial real estate underwriting, due diligence processes, and credit analysis across multiple property types and loan products.
* Extensive experience analysing rent rolls, operating statements, general ledgers, bank statements, lease documents, property tax records, and borrower financial information.
* Experience preparing Asset Summary Reports (ASRs), underwriting memorandums, due diligence reports, and lender review packages.
* Strong knowledge in performing valuation of Real & Intangible assets using Income Approach (Discounted Cash Flow Method & Direct Capitalization Method), Net Asset Value Method (or Cost Method) and Precedent Transaction Analysis (or Relative Valuation/ Sales Comparison/ Market Approach)
* Knowledge of developing valuation models, performing highest and best use valuation analysis for purposes of financial reporting, tax planning etc.
* Proficient at using research databases like LoopNet, REIS, RCA (real capital analytics), CoStar, CBRE, JLL, C&W, Capital IQ, One Source, Factiva, Reuters, etc.
* Analyzing financial statements, conducting market research studies and preparing reports, Application of Free Cash Flows, Terminal value, Discount rate, WACC, Advanced MS Excel models etc.
* Strong knowledge of key clauses in lease (options, economic terms, terminations)
* Excellent analytical, project management, communication, interpersonal and teaming skills
* Willingness and ability to travel, when necessary
* Actively promote the sharing of knowledge within the group; Contribute pro-actively to building team spirit
* Manage and responsible for 1-2 people for their career progression, learning and development etc
* Exposure to tools like Argus, Power BI, Gen AI tools etc. will be added advantage

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Master’s in business administration (MBA) specialize in Finance
* 7+ years of direct work experience in real estate underwriting and valuation projects
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Experience with BIG4 accounting firm would be provided weightage

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* People management skills
* Project management skills

title: Associate Director, Finance Controlling / Entity
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
You will lead management accounting and entity control activities that ensure accurate financial reporting and useful business insight. You will work closely with finance leaders, business partners, shared services, and external auditors. We value integrity, clear thinking, and a coachable mindset. This role offers visible impact, strong learning and progression, and alignment with our mission of uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  

* Lead month-end close for assigned entities and deliver accurate profit and loss, balance sheet, and cash flow reporting.
* Provide clear variance and commercial analysis to explain performance and guide business decisions.
* Partner with business leaders and shared services to prepare budgets, forecasts, and monthly reforecasts.
* Improve accounting processes, controls, and automation to increase efficiency and reduce risk.
* Support internal and external audits and ensure compliance with IFRS and local regulations.
* Coach and develop team members and contribute to a positive, inclusive team culture.

Why You?
  
  
This role is hybrid, combining time at an office in India with remote work as agreed with your manager. You will join a team where your work supports better decisions across the business. You will gain exposure to cross-functional projects and opportunities to grow into broader finance leadership roles.
  
  
Basic Qualification
  
  
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
* Professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CIMA, CA, or equivalent).
* Minimum 5 years of experience in management accounting, finance controlling, or similar roles.
* Strong knowledge of IFRS and applicable local accounting rules.
* Practical experience with ERP systems such as SAP and strong Excel skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication in English and ability to work with multicultural teams.

**Preferred Qualification**
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus
  
  

* Experience leading or coaching a small to medium finance team.
* Hands-on experience with financial planning and analysis, including driver-based forecasting.
* Familiarity with reporting and automation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
* Prior exposure to audits, tax reporting, and regulatory filings in an international environment.
* Strong commercial mindset with ability to translate data into clear business actions.
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and supporting change and transformation.

#AGFinance
  
  
**Skills**
Business Acumen, Cyber Risks, Digital Fluency, Driving Continuous Improvement, Enterprise Thinking, Financial Controlling, Operational Governance, Services Management, Stakeholder Management
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. title: M&A Analyst, Motion Services (Europe or India)
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
  
  
This Position reports to:
  
  
Head of Strategy, Business Development and Sustainability
  
  
  
  
  
ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion
