title: Cyber Risk & Compliance Analyst
description:
At DuPont, our purpose is to empower the world with essential innovations to thrive. We work on things that matter. Whether it’s providing clean water to more than a billion people on the planet, producing materials that are essential in everyday technology devices from smartphones to electric vehicles, or protecting workers around the world. Discover the many reasons the world’s most talented people are choosing to work at DuPont. Why Join Us | DuPont Careers
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Senior IT Compliance Specialist is a hands-on, globally oriented role responsible for translating regulatory, customer, and internal security requirements into sustainable controls, defensible evidence, and audit-ready operations. The position partners across security, legal, business, support, engineering, infrastructure, and cloud teams to advance compliance outcomes without creating unnecessary operational friction.
  
  
This role is designed for an experienced practitioner who can independently lead workstreams, influence control owners, communicate with auditors and customers, and improve the way compliance work is scoped, documented, monitored, and automated.
  
  
**Role mandate**
Make compliance executable: clarify scope and ownership, design practical controls, maintain evidence, anticipate change, and keep priority programs ready for assessment throughout the year.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Compliance leadership and program delivery**

* Lead and manage IT compliance initiatives to ensure adherence to internal policies, standards, contractual obligations, and applicable international or government security frameworks.
* Own assigned workstreams from requirement intake and scoping through control mapping, gap assessment, remediation, evidence readiness, and ongoing governance.
* Maintain compliance strategies, roadmaps, and operating plans that align security requirements with business priorities, technology architecture, and delivery commitments.
* Establish clear accountability with business owners, IT asset owners, and control owners; track decisions, risks, dependencies, and remediation commitments to closure.

**Assessments, certifications, and audit readiness**

* Drive certification and assurance efforts by coordinating internal audits, external assessments, customer reviews, risk assessments, and security documentation submissions.
* Plan and facilitate readiness activities for ISO 27001, NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, TISAX, NIS2, and other requirements assigned to the team.
* Coordinate requests with assessors and third-party auditors, validate the completeness and quality of evidence, and ensure responses are accurate, consistent, and traceable.
* Manage findings and corrective actions using a risk-based approach, including root-cause analysis, remediation planning, validation, exception handling, and status reporting.
* Promote continuous readiness by defining evidence expectations, review cadences, health indicators, and escalation paths rather than relying on point-in-time audit preparation.

**Control design, implementation, and monitoring**

* Interpret framework and regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, testable control objectives, control activities, evidence requirements, and ownership models.
* Partner with engineering, infrastructure, application, cloud, security operations, identity, data, and support teams to embed controls into technology processes and system lifecycles.
* Assess control design and operating effectiveness, identify gaps or duplicated effort, and recommend practical remediation that balances risk, compliance, and operational needs.
* Support continuous monitoring through defined metrics, automated evidence collection, exception reporting, and periodic control reviews.
* Contribute to reusable control mappings and a unified control approach to reduce duplication across overlapping frameworks and customer obligations.

**Documentation and stakeholder support**

* Maintain and enhance System Security Plans (SSPs), Information Security Management System, policies, standards, procedures, control narratives, risk assessments, plans of action, evidence repositories, and governance records.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on IT compliance, advising internal teams on scope, control expectations, audit evidence, risk treatment, and compliance-by-design.
* Support customers, contracting stakeholders, and Authorizing Officials (AOs) by providing approved compliance documentation and clear guidance for security evaluations.
* Prepare concise status reports, risk statements, decision materials, and executive updates that distinguish confirmed facts, open issues, ownership, and required action.
* Develop practical guidance and targeted training for control owners and technical teams to improve execution quality and audit readiness.

**Regulatory intelligence and process improvement**

* Coordinate with Legal, Privacy, Procurement, Internal Audit, Security, and business stakeholders to validate interpretations and convert changes into actionable implementation plans.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring compliance activities, streamline evidence collection, improve workflow quality, and reduce manual or duplicative work.
* Use lessons learned, audit results, metrics, and stakeholder feedback to improve control design, documentation quality, governance, and team operating practices.
* Perform other responsibilities or special assignments as requested by leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–10 years of relevant experience in IT compliance, IT audit, cybersecurity governance, technology risk, or a closely related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience leading compliance assessments, audits, certifications, or regulatory readiness efforts in a complex, multinational technology environment.
* Working knowledge of several of the following: ISO 27001/27002, NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, TISAX, NIS2, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, SOC reporting, IT general controls, or comparable security frameworks.
* Experience translating requirements into control designs, test procedures, evidence expectations, risk statements, and remediation plans.
* Experience creating or maintaining compliance documentation such as SSPs, policies, standards, procedures, control narratives, risk assessments, and audit evidence packages.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams, organize complex information, meet deadlines, and escalate material risks or dependencies with sound judgment.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to work effectively across cultures, functions, technical disciplines, and time zones.
* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, cybersecurity, computer science, accounting, risk management, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant certification such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CISM, or a comparable credential.
* Experience supporting cloud or hybrid environments, regulated data, government contracting obligations, automotive assurance, or European cybersecurity requirements.
* Experience with governance, risk, and compliance platforms; workflow automation; data visualization; scripting; or automated evidence collection.
* Familiarity with third-party risk, privacy, Responsible AI governance, mergers and acquisitions, or customer security assurance.
* Experience supporting distributed teams through clear documentation, structured handoffs, measurable service expectations, and overlapping working hours when required.

**Indicators of Success**

* Assigned compliance obligations are clearly scoped, mapped to accountable owners, and supported by current documentation.
* Assessments and audits are executed with timely, accurate, and traceable evidence and minimal avoidable rework.
* Control gaps, risks, exceptions, and remediation actions are transparent, risk-prioritized, and progressed to closure.
* Compliance requirements are embedded earlier in technology, sourcing, and change decisions.
* Recurring work becomes more standardized, measurable, automated, and sustainable across the global delivery model.

**Work Style and Collaboration Expectations**
The successful candidate is proactive, structured, pragmatic, and comfortable operating with a high degree of independence. title: Legal Compliance Manager - APMEA
description:
**Position Title:**
Legal & Compliance Manager

**Scope:**
Primary responsibility for data protection and privacy in APMEA deployment of RBC compliance policies and programs in the region and the local implementation in India, and for provision of legal support to India GBS. The role may also support English-speaking countries in the APMEA region, as designated by the Regional General Counsel.

**Reports to:**
Regional General Counsel, APMEA

**Team Leadership:**
A small India GBS-based team covering data protection, RBC compliance, and junior legal support for contract and RFP reviews.

**Key interfaces:**
Regional and country Legal & Compliance teams; Group Data Protection Office; Group Compliance and Ethics; local management; HR; Finance; Procurement; IS&T and Information Security; operational leadership; external counsel and regulators.

**Employment type:**
Full time

**Purpose of the Role:**

The Legal & Compliance Manager is a qualified lawyer who supports Sodexo's data protection and Responsible Business Conduct (RBC) compliance agenda. The role has primary responsibility for data protection and privacy matters within APMEA, driving the rollout and deployment of RBC compliance policies in the region and local implementation in India, and provision of legal support to India GBS. The role may also support countries in the APMEA region, depending on business priorities and as designated by the Regional General Counsel.

The role has three complementary dimensions: (i) data protection and privacy; (ii) RBC compliance; (iii) legal matters of India GBS; (iv) leadership of a small India GBS-based legal, compliance and data protection team. The role holder will provide practical, risk-growth balanced advice; drive and deploy designated Group programs; implement relevant policies and controls; deliver training; monitor compliance; and report material risks to appropriate stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

2.1 Data Protection and Privacy

* Advise the business in APMEA (English-speaking markets), on applicable data protection and privacy laws, including Australia’s Privacy Act 1988, India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and, where relevant, the GDPR and other local privacy laws.
* Interpret and implement Sodexo's global data protection policies, standards and Binding Corporate Rules (BCR), identifying where local laws impose additional or different requirements.
* Advise on privacy notices, lawful bases, consent, data subject rights, employee privacy, monitoring, biometrics, CCTV, direct marketing and privacy implications of emerging technologies, including AI.
* Draft, review and negotiate data processing agreements, data sharing arrangements, international data transfer provisions and privacy clauses in client, supplier and technology contracts.
* Support vendor privacy due diligence and third-party privacy risk assessments in collaboration with Procurement, IS&T and Information Security.
* Lead or review Data Protection Impact Assessments and privacy-by-design reviews for new projects, systems and service offerings.
* Manage data subject requests, privacy complaints and personal data breaches, including assessment of regulatory and individual notification obligations.
* Lead data retention implementation for in-scope markets, including defining local retention periods with business owners, recording requirements in OneTrust, facilitating working groups, and monitoring deletion, archiving and remediation actions.
* Support BCR monitoring, quarterly and annual reporting, risk registers, audits, transfer assessments and corrective actions requested by the Group Data Protection Office.
* Cooperate with relevant data protection authorities and coordinate external counsel support where required.

2.2 Responsible Business Conduct (RBC) Compliance

* Drive and deploy Sodexo's Group RBC and compliance programs within the scope designated by the Regional General Counsel, working in coordination with Group Compliance and relevant regional and country stakeholders.
* Serve as the legal and compliance business partner for designated Group compliance programs, including the Third-Party Risk Evaluation Policy, Gifts and Hospitality Policy, Sanctions Policy, and other RBC or ethics-related initiatives assigned by the Regional General Counsel.
* Lead the local implementation, rollout and operationalization of these RBC policies and compliance programs in India, including local procedures, stakeholder guidance, training and awareness, monitoring, remediation and reporting. Ensure that local implementation in India is aligned with Group standards and applicable Indian legal and regulatory requirements.
* Advise management and business teams on compliance risks and controls, including anti-bribery and anti-corruption, conflicts of interest, gifts and hospitality, third-party integrity, competition law, sanctions and other RBC topics within the role’s remit.
* Conduct compliance risk assessments and support integrity due diligence and risk evaluation of relevant third parties, business partners and proposed transactions for the region as directed by regional GC, including HRTP risk assessment/sanction screening, in accordance with group compliance requirements.
* Identify root causes and lessons learned from compliance incidents and support proportionate remediation, control enhancement and disciplinary or contractual follow-up as appropriate.
* Monitor relevant legal and regulatory developments and enforcement trends and assess their potential impact on Sodexo’s operations in India.
* Provide compliance training for the RBC policies for the designated stakeholders.

2.3 Team Leadership and India GBS Legal Support

* Lead, coach and develop a small India GBS-based team whose responsibilities may include data protection, RBC compliance and other legal support activities.
* Provide oversight, guidance and quality assurance to junior legal counsel supporting commercial contract reviews, RFP and bid reviews, and related legal matters handled through India GBS.
* Draft, review and negotiate commercial contracts, supplier contracts and related legal documents for India GBS, and provide practical legal advice on associated contractual risks and issues.
* Plan resources, allocate and prioritize work, manage workloads and establish appropriate service standards to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.
* Build team capability through regular coaching, knowledge sharing, templates, playbooks, training and professional development.
* Foster a collaborative, solution-oriented and business-partnering culture while maintaining strong legal, risk management and compliance standards.
* Coordinate effectively with regional and country Legal & Compliance teams to clarify ownership, escalation routes and service delivery expectations.
* Undertake any other legal, compliance, data protection or related work as may be directed by the APAC Regional General Counsel.

2.4 Training, Awareness and Stakeholder Engagement

* Design and deliver practical training and awareness activities covering data protection, RBC compliance and relevant legal topics.
* Build effective working relationships with local management and key functions, and support a network of privacy, compliance and legal contacts across the in-scope markets.
* Provide timely, commercially aware advice that enables business objectives while protecting Sodexo’s legal, regulatory and reputational interests.
* Escalate material privacy, compliance or legal risks promptly to the Regional General Counsel and relevant Group functions.

3. Qualifications and Experience

3.1 Essential

* Law degree and admission to practise as a lawyer, preferably in India or another common law jurisdiction.
* Approximately 6-8 years’ post-qualification experience gained in-house in a multinational company and/or with a leading law firm.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in data protection and privacy, including GDPR or comparable privacy frameworks, DPIAs, international data transfers, retention, processor arrangements and breach management.
* Meaningful experience advising on corporate compliance or ethics matters, including deployment and local implementation of compliance policies and controls, risk assessment, training, third-party risk management, sanctions compliance and/or investigations.
* Experience supervising or developing junior legal, compliance or data protection professionals, preferably within a shared services or GBS environment.
* Experience in commercial contract review and RFP or bid support, with the ability to oversee junior legal counsel performing such work.
* Working knowledge of Australian and Indian legal and regulatory requirements relevant to data protection, together with Indian legal and regulatory requirements relevant to corporate compliance, and the ability to support additional APMEA English-speaking markets where assigned.
* Strong drafting, analytical and communication skills, with excellent written and spoken English.
* Ability to work independently across countries, cultures, functions and time zones, and to manage sensitive matters with discretion and sound judgment.

3.2 Desirable

* Professional privacy certification such as CIPP/E, CIPP/A, CIPM or CIPT.
* Recognized compliance, ethics, anti-bribery, sanctions or investigations training/certification.
* Experience in a multi-site services, facilities management, food services or HR-intensive business.
* Familiarity with OneTrust, compliance case-management or third-party due-diligence tools.
* Experience engaging with regulators, supporting compliance audits.

4. Key Competencies

* Pragmatic, business-focused and risk-based judgment.
* High integrity, independence, discretion and professional courage.
* People leadership, coaching and team development.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing and cross-cultural collaboration skills.
* Ability to translate legal and policy requirements into practical controls and business guidance.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage competing priorities across data protection, compliance and legal service delivery.
* Clear, concise communication suitable for operational teams, senior management and Group stakeholders.

5. Key Performance Indicators

* Timely, high-quality and practical advice on data protection, RBC compliance and related legal matters.
* Effective deployment of designated Group compliance programs and implementation of relevant RBC policies in India.
* Effective leadership, workload management and capability development of the India GBS-based team.
* Consistent quality and timely delivery of direct and supervised commercial contract, supplier contract and RFP review support for India GBS.
* DPIAs, data subject requests, incidents and breach notifications handled within applicable timelines.
* Data retention and BCR reporting obligations completed on schedule, with remediation actions tracked to closure.
* Compliance risk assessments, third-party evaluations, sanctions and gifts and hospitality controls, monitoring reviews and investigation support delivered in accordance with agreed priorities and procedures.
* Training and awareness activities completed, with identified gaps and follow-up actions addressed.
* Material risks and incidents escalated promptly and accurately.
* Positive stakeholder feedback and demonstrable improvement in privacy, compliance and legal service delivery maturity.

6. Working Conditions

The role is based in Mumbai. Flexibility is required to support data protection stakeholders in Australia and India, RBC compliance implementation in India, and stakeholders in other assigned APMEA English-speaking markets, including calls across Asia-Pacific and European time zones. Occasional regional travel may be required.

title: Cruelty Response Officer
description:
**Position Objective:**

The Cruelty Response Officer is responsible for investigating complaints of cruelty to animals and violations of animal protection laws, collaborating with authorities, volunteers, animal welfare organisations, and other stakeholders to secure relief for animals and to pursue legal action against offenders. This role primarily involves cruelty case management, complaint drafting, investigations, coordination with local NGOs/activists, and active engagement with authorities to ensure cases of cruelty to animals are taken to their logical end. It also includes working with different law enforcement agencies to coordinate raids and enforcement action against illegal activities.

**Term of Employment:**

Full-time

**Work Schedule:**

Primarily daytime work, with work during evenings, weekends, and public holidays as required.

**Reports To:**

Legal Advisor and Director of Cruelty Response

**Location:**

Mumbai or Delhi (The position involves a combination of office-based, field-based and remote work)

**Primary Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Receive, assess, investigate, and respond to complaints of cruelty to animals involving domestic and wild animals, ranging from neglect and welfare concerns to serious offences, received via phone, e-mail, social media, and other channels.
* Advise members of the public on appropriate legal and practical steps to address cruelty to animals, neglect, and other welfare concerns.
* Analyse photographs, videos, social media content, and other evidence to assess complaints, identify potential violations of animal protection laws, gather information about the accused, and support investigations and case resolution.
* Draft complaints, representations, follow-up communications, and other correspondence to police, forest departments, government authorities, housing societies, educational institutions, and other stakeholders/law enforcement agencies.
* Work with law enforcement authorities, including police, forest department officials, and SPCA representatives, to secure appropriate action in cruelty cases, including the registration of non-cognisable offence reports, first information reports, and preliminary offence reports.
* Coordinate with local animal protection organisations or volunteers to facilitate intervention in cases of cruelty.
* Manage multiple ongoing cases simultaneously, prioritising urgent matters while ensuring timely follow-up.
* Follow up persistently with authorities and other stakeholders to ensure that cruelty cases continue to progress and appropriate action is taken.
* Travel independently across the country, when required, to meet authorities, attend court hearings of cruelty cases, conduct investigations, support rescue efforts, or assist with other case-related activities.
* Travel and coordinate logistics pertaining to sensitisation cum training workshops organised in different parts of the country for law enforcement personnel across different government departments such as police, forest department, animal husbandry, and more.
* Maintain and regularly update the department’s national database of volunteers, animal protection organisations and law enforcement contacts.
* Ensure accurate and comprehensive records of all complaints, correspondence, evidence, actions taken, and case outcomes are maintained.
* Professionally represent PETA India in interactions with members of the public, volunteers, animal welfare organisations, veterinarians, law enforcement agencies, government authorities and other stakeholders.
* Monitor emerging animal welfare issues and identify opportunities for strategic intervention and advocacy.

title: AML Compliance Manager
description:
**Company Overview**

At Opus, we grow together. Our team of bold thinkers and passionate doers is united by a shared mission to tackle meaningful challenges. Our culture of trust and belonging has earned us the Great Place to Work certification in four countries, based entirely on team feedback. It reflects our commitment to fairness, pride credibility and camaraderie, and reinforces what we believe: when people feel valued, they do their best work.

**About the Role**

The Deputy MLRO / AML Compliance Manager supports the MLRO in maintaining an effective, risk-based AML/ATF and sanctions compliance framework for Opus. The role provides day-to-day 2nd line oversight of client and investor due diligence, enhanced due diligence, ongoing monitoring, sanctions screening, suspicious activity escalation, training, record-keeping, and management information, while preserving independence from 1st line operational decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the MLRO in implementing and maintaining AML/ATF policies, procedures, systems and controls consistent with Bermuda regulatory expectations and the administrator’s financial crime risk profile.
* Provide independent 2nd line review and challenge over client, fund and investor onboarding, including CDD, EDD, beneficial ownership, source of funds, source of wealth, PEP, jurisdictional and intermediary risk considerations.
* Manage and triage AML/ATF and sanctions escalations from the 1st line, ensuring matters are assessed, documented, escalated and resolved in a timely manner.
* Assist the MLRO with suspicious activity assessment and internal reporting processes, including preparation of case analysis and documentation to support any decision to report to the appropriate authority.
* Oversee ongoing monitoring and periodic review activity, including risk-rating changes, trigger events, overdue reviews, exceptions, remediation actions and higher-risk relationships.
* Support sanctions screening governance, including escalation standards, potential match review, disposition quality, list management oversight and reporting or freezing escalation where applicable.
* Prepare AML/ATF management information for the MLRO, senior management and board or committee reporting, including key risks, issues, breaches, SAR-related metrics, sanctions matters, training completion, testing results and remediation status.
* Coordinate AML/ATF training and awareness activity, ensuring role-based training is delivered, completion is monitored and effectiveness is reviewed.
* Maintain appropriate records of AML/ATF approvals, escalations, risk assessments, monitoring outcomes, training, testing, breaches and remediation in line with record-keeping requirements.
* Deputise for the MLRO when required, including acting as an escalation point and supporting regulatory engagement, while ensuring significant matters remain subject to appropriate MLRO and governance oversight.

**Key Qualifications and Reporting Line**

The role should be held by an appropriately senior and experienced AML/ATF professional with sufficient authority, access to information, independence and resources to provide effective challenge. The Deputy MLRO / AML Compliance Manager should report to the MLRO for functional AML/ATF matters, have access to senior management and relevant governance forums, and avoid conflicts created by direct ownership of 1st line client acceptance or processing activity.

Strategic Sourcing & Commercial Negotiations

**About the Team:**
Real Estate services (RES) provides services and premises that are cost effective, safe, and productive to Citi Businesses, through a network of regional offices and a team of international realty advisors. RES manages approximately 2,500 properties (36 MM Sf) and supports businesses through the development and maintenance of office buildings, data centers and branches. The products and services include premises acquisition and disposal, construction (including fit outs, moves and changes), maintenance, facilities management, and utilities supply.
  
  
In this role, you’re expected to:
  
  
The Assistant Vice President (AVP), F&C Operations Team Lead is responsible for leading a team that supports Real Estate Services (RES) project compliance activities across the project lifecycle. The role ensures adherence to Citi policies, procedures, standards, and governance requirements while maintaining high-quality project documentation, financial controls, and operational excellence.
  
  
The AVP serves as a key partner to Project Managers, Facilities Managers, Finance, Procurement, and Vendor Management teams by overseeing project initiation, compliance reviews, quality assurance, purchase-to-pay processes, and project closure activities within REALM and P2P systems.
  
  
The AVP needs to demonstrate strong leadership, operational discipline, and deep understanding of compliance and governance requirements. Needs to effectively balance people leadership, risk management, process efficiency, and stakeholder support to ensure projects are executed in a compliant, controlled, and efficient manner while delivering exceptional service to the business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership & People Management**
Lead, coach, and develop the team to achieve operational excellence and service delivery goals. Manage team capacity, workload distribution, and resource planning to optimize productivity and performance. Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and support employee development initiatives. Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and operational excellence. Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick, effective decisions. Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset to track and measure performance
  
  
**Compliance & Governance**
Ensure compliance with Citi policies, procedures, standards, and regulatory requirements across all project activities. Monitor project documentation and records to ensure completeness, accuracy, and audit readiness. Review contracts, permits, certificates of insurance, scope documentation, and supporting approvals to ensure adherence to governance requirements. Identify compliance risks and implement corrective actions to mitigate potential issues.
  
  
**REALM Project Lifecycle Management**
Oversee project initiation activities, including project setup and validation within REALM. Review and approve Scope Agreements and pre-funding documentation to ensure accuracy and completeness. Partner with project teams to ensure compliance requirements are met throughout the project lifecycle. Support project closure activities and ensure all required documentation is completed and archived appropriately.
  
  
**P2P and Financial Operations**
Oversee creation and validation of Purchase Requisitions and Purchase Orders within P2P systems. Ensure accurate invoice receipting and supporting documentation review prior to approval. Monitor financial controls associated with project expenditure and procurement processes. Resolve procurement and payment-related issues in collaboration with Finance and Procurement teams.
  
  
**Quality Assurance & Operational Excellence**
Conduct quality reviews and sample-based audits of team outputs. Develop and maintain operational controls to improve accuracy and reduce processing errors. Analyze operational metrics and identify opportunities for process enhancement. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline workflows, eliminate inefficiencies, and enhance user experience.
  
  
**Stakeholder Management**
Serve as a trusted advisor to Project Managers and operational stakeholders on compliance and process requirements. Provide interpretation and guidance on Citi operational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance procedures. Collaborate with regional and global teams to support consistent execution of compliance standards. Escalate risks, control gaps, and operational issues to senior management as required.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Operations Management, Real Estate, or related discipline.
  
  
Minimum 5 years of experience in operations, compliance, project administration, procurement, or related functions.

title: Legal and Compliance Officer
description:
**Role Summary**

Priquant Ventures Private Limited is hiring a Legal & Compliance Officer who will be designated as the Compliance Officer of the Investment Manager under Regulation 20(17) of the SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations, 2012.

The role owns the fund's regulatory compliance end to end and acts as in-house counsel on fund documents, investor onboarding and portfolio transactions. It is a hands-on position in a lean team, with reporting to the Managing Partner.

Key responsibilities

The officer is accountable for the fund staying compliant with the SEBI Act, the AIF Regulations, the AIF Master Circular and every scheme's PPM, and for the legal soundness of what the fund signs.

SEBI and regulatory compliance

* Act as the designated Compliance Officer of the Investment Manager and monitor compliance with the SEBI Act, AIF Regulations, circulars and directions
* Own the compliance calendar for all schemes: quarterly activity reports to SEBI, unit value reporting to depositories, benchmarking agency data, and other periodic filings
* Prepare the annual Compliance Test Report for the Trustee and Sponsor under the AIF Master Circular
* Coordinate the annual PPM compliance audit, track findings to closure, and file PPM changes with SEBI and investors
* Report material breaches to SEBI, the Trustee and the Board within the prescribed timelines
* Track new SEBI circulars, assess their impact on each scheme, and update internal policies and procedures accordingly
* Monitor investment conditions and restrictions: concentration limits, Category II leverage restrictions, related-party and associate investments, and investor consents where required
* Handle SEBI inspections, queries and correspondence

Fund documentation and launches

* Draft, review and maintain PPMs, contribution agreements, the indenture of trust and investment management agreement
* Run the regulatory process for new scheme launches through merchant bankers and SEBI, including responding to observations
* Maintain unit class terms, side letters and investor-specific arrangements consistently with the PPM

Drafting of agreements and legal documents

* Draft and negotiate agreements across the fund and the Investment Manager: contribution agreements, side letters, investment management and trusteeship agreements, distribution and placement agreements, and venture partner and advisor agreements
* Prepare first drafts of transaction documents, including term sheets, share subscription, shareholders' and share purchase agreements, debenture trust deeds and security documents
* Draft vendor, service provider and outsourcing contracts (RTA, fund accountant, custodian, valuer, technology vendors), NDAs and engagement letters for counsel and auditors
* Draft board and Investment Committee resolutions, minutes, investor notices, consent requests and regulatory correspondence
* Maintain a library of standard templates and clause positions, and keep them current with regulatory changes

Investor onboarding, KYC and AML

* Run investor onboarding: KYC, CKYC uploads, FATCA/CRS declarations, accredited investor checks and minimum commitment validation
* Act as the point person for PMLA obligations, including risk-based due diligence, record-keeping and suspicious transaction reporting through the Principal Officer framework
* Oversee capital call, distribution and transfer documentation; review distributor empanelment and distribution agreements
* Handle investor grievances and SCORES / SEBI ODR complaints

Transaction and portfolio legal support

* Review term sheets, share subscription and shareholders' agreements, share purchase agreements and debt documentation for equity and structured credit deals
* Run legal due diligence with external counsel and track conditions precedent and post-closing obligations
* Review structured credit documentation: PTC and SDI transaction documents, trust deeds, servicing arrangements and security documents
* Monitor portfolio company covenants, information rights and reporting obligations owed to the fund

Governance, conflicts and controls

* Maintain the conflict of interest policy, the code of conduct and personal trading rules for the investment team
* Keep minutes and records for Investment Committee and Board meetings and maintain the statutory registers of the Investment Manager
* Track NISM certification requirements for the key investment team and other associated persons
* Oversee cyber security, data protection and outsourcing compliance, including vendor contracts
* Manage external counsel, auditors, the Trustee, the custodian, the RTA and the fund accountant on legal and compliance matters

Qualifications and experience

The NISM Series-III-C certification is non-negotiable: from 1 January 2027, only certified persons may be appointed as, or continue to act as, Compliance Officer of an AIF manager (SEBI circular, 30 Dec 2025).

**Required**

* Qualified Company Secretary (ACS/FCS) — mandatory; an LLB is an added advantage
* NISM Series-III-C: Securities Intermediaries Compliance (Fund) certification, or willingness to obtain it before joining
* Working knowledge of the SEBI AIF Regulations and Master Circular, PMLA and KYC rules, the Companies Act 2013, FEMA, and the Indian Trusts Act
* Hands-on drafting & review of investment documents, agreements etc.

**Preferred**

* Experience with growth equity or venture transactions: SHAs, SSAs and secondary share purchases

title: Associate Manager - Drone Ecosystem
description:
**About QCI**

The Quality Council of India (QCI) is the Scheme Owner of the Certification Scheme for Unmanned Aircraft Systems (CSUAS), which was notified in official gazette by the Ministry of Civil Aviation on 26 January 2022. The scheme has since been revised and its scope enhanced, evolving into a Type based certification framework that covers Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) and Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) UAS operations, and it also promotes the indigenisation and development of the domestic drone industry, contributing to the vision of India becoming a global drone hub by 2030.

**Role Summary**

As part of the team, you contribute to the development and operation of a national certification framework for UAS. Our work spans into designing and developing certification schemes aligned with international best practice, formulating technical standards, and creating certification ecosystems in partnership with industry, regulators, ministries, academia and other stakeholders, scale them through conformity assessment bodies. Deep understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential.

The next phase of this work is about collaborating with the industry on the segments that still need enabling, namely autonomous drones, Drone-as-a-Service and UAS traffic management, along with the digital transformation that simplifies compliance and the aggregator led facilitation that scales the use-case adaptation to advance the growth of Industry These are areas where the standards, the quality assurance mechanisms and in some cases the market itself are still taking shape, and the people who join us now will help shape the Nation’s Drone Ecosystem.

**Role & Responsibility-**

QCI is seeking professionals to support the implementation of CSUAS. The role will contribute to the development and operation of the CSUAS workstreams below:

* **Scheme Design & Development**
  : Conceptualise UAS related quality interventions that help the industry and the regulator, and develop and revise the scheme criteria, technical standards and guidelines that give them effect with a in-depth understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS.
* **Research, Analysis & Knowledge Products**
  : Conduct rapid primary and secondary research on UAS domain and policy, including comparative study of standards and international best practice to draft standards for UAS and its components.
* **Report Writing & Deck Preparation:**
  Draft and structure reports, concept notes, technical circulars and knowledge products, and create data driven presentations for relevant stakeholders.
* **Scheme Operations**
  : Lead the day to day operations of the scheme and its projects, scheme documentation, deliverables, work plans, trackers and minutes of meetings and report periodically on developments; collect, clean and analyse scheme data and maintain its records, website and dashboard; propose the features and changes required in the dashboard to support operations; monitor scheme-related activities; coordinate with vendors and internal and external stakeholders; and frequently update FAQs.
* **Stakeholder Engagement**
  : Identify key stakeholders, analyse their expectations, and develop and execute appropriate strategies to work with them; manage and regularly engage multiple stakeholders i.e., regulators, Certification Bodies, manufacturers, assessors, technical experts, laboratories and academia to ensure timely information exchange and seamless coordination.
* **Business Development & Marketing of the Scheme**
  : Ensure quantitative improvement in the number of Certification Bodies; identify potential clients and partners for adoption of the scheme; market the scheme to increase its uptake; and develop a comprehensive plan to improve scheme processes and revenue generation.

**Eligibility Criteria & Requirements-**

**Educational Qualification**
:

* A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline is required. A Bachelor’s degree in a related engineering discipline, coupled with strong relevant experience, may also be considered for the Associate Manager role.
* An additional qualification in management, public policy, or conformity assessment ecosystem, or quality and compliance, or training in ISO/IEC 17065, ISO/IEC 17067, or ISO/IEC 17024, or ISO/IEC 17020, or ISO 9001 will be considered a strong added advantage.

**Experience-**

* Minimum 3 years of professional work experience in areas including manufacturing, R&D, operations, consulting (private or government), or testing, auditing or a managerial role specifically in drone industry, or should have experience with stakeholder management, or operating a certification scheme, or national program.
* Knowledge of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential, along with knowledge of the relevant rules and regulations with respect to drones operations in India and type certification.
* Excellent Microsoft Office skills, strong verbal communication, and sound organisational and planning skills, with a proven ability to multitask and meet tight deadlines, are required.
* Experience in marketing of products and creation of knowledge products is desired. Prior experience of working with government agencies, regulators or CABs in any capacity (operations or consulting) will be preferred.
* Working experience in any programming language, or with dashboards and AI tools, would be an added advantage. Exposure to UAS design, manufacturing, testing or flight operations, including VLOS/BVLOS flying experience, will be preferred though not mandatory.
* Fluency in English, both written and oral, is required. Fluency in Hindi, both written and oral, is desired.
* Location for the role is based out of New Delhi, on a full time engagement, with travel anywhere in India or abroad as and when required.

**Technical Capabilities-**

**Strong Research Skills:**
Ability to rapidly identify, read, and understand dense, technical documents (e.g., government reports and research papers) and extract the most relevant information.

**Structured Thinking & Writing:**
Ability to break down large, ambiguous topics into a structured research plan and produce clear, logical, professional, and well-written outputs.

**Data Analysis:**
Comfortable with data cleaning, essential MS Excel functions, and creating charts. Experience analysing survey data using Stata, R, or Python is an added advantage.

**Visualization & Presentation Skills:**
Strong data-visualization skills using MS Office Suite, with Tableau/Power BI proficiency being an added advantage; ability to create well-structured and visually compelling presentations.

**Behavioural Capabilities-**

**High Degree of Curiosity:**
Genuine interest in how India’s public policy and governance systems work; naturally follows current affairs and asks “why.”

**Integrity & Accountability:**
Takes ownership of tasks, delivers on commitments, and upholds the highest ethical standards in all work and workplace interactions.

**Meticulous Attention to Detail:**
Able to identify typos, formatting errors, inconsistencies, and mismatched numbers that others may overlook.

**Proactive & “Get-it-Done” Attitude:**
Self-starter who takes complete ownership of tasks, anticipates what needs to be done, and delivers results without waiting for instructions.

Contract Management Team

title: Company Secretary
description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking a Company Secretary (CS) who responsible for ensuring the organization complies with all applicable statutory, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements. This role acts as a primary advisor to the Board of Directors on corporate governance, statutory compliance under the Companies Act, and best practices in administrative and corporate affairs, they will report to Director.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Organize, convene, and manage Board of Directors meetings, Committee meetings (Audit, Nomination & Remuneration, CSR, etc.), and Annual General Meetings (AGM) / Extra-Ordinary General Meetings (EGM).
* Oversee statutory filings with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) / Registrar of Companies (ROC), including annual returns, financial statements, director appointments, charges, and event-based e-forms.
* Ensure strict adherence to the Companies Act, 2013, Secretarial Standards issued by ICSI, and other corporate legislations.
* Coordinate and facilitate Annual Secretarial Audits, statutory audits, and internal compliance reviews.
* Manage compliances related to FEMA/RBI regulations (such as FDI filings, FLA returns) if foreign investment or cross-border transactions apply.
* Maintain and update mandatory statutory registers (Members, Directors& KMPs, Charges, Loans & Investments, and Related Party Transactions).
* Supervise corporate actions, including share allotments, share transfers, dematerialization, rights issues, private placements, buybacks, and dividend payments.
* Manage documentation related to changes in corporate structure, alter Memorandum and Articles of Association (MOA/AOA), and handle registered office changes.

* Liaise with external legal counsels, regulatory bodies, and authorities during inspections, litigation, or regulatory queries.

* Qualified Company Secretary and an active Associate/Fellow member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ACS / FCS).
* 2–5 years of post-qualification secretarial experience in a private limited or listed public company.

title: Team Member - Secretarial
description:
**Responsibilities**
**Compliance Monitoring for Unlisted Companies**

* Monitor unlisted entities within the company’s portfolio to ensure they comply with regulatory thresholds, such as the appointment of independent directors, if the company’s capital exceeds specific limits.
* Regularly review the Articles of Association (AOA) and Memorandum of Association (MOA) of unlisted subsidiaries to ensure they are up-to-date and in line with regulatory changes.
* Support in the development of governance frameworks for unlisted entities, ensuring that appropriate corporate governance measures are in place, including the establishment of key committees.

**Subsidiary Governance and Committees**

* Ensure subsidiaries have the required governance committees in place, such as the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Committee, and monitor their compliance with governance standards.
* Oversee the appointment of members to key committees such as the Audit Committee and ensure adherence to corporate governance standards across unlisted entities.

**Internal Audit and Compliance**

* Oversee the appointment of internal auditors, ensuring proper approvals are obtained and the correct internal audit processes are in place.
* Respond to queries related to the requirement for an internal auditor, ensuring compliance with corporate governance practices.
* Conduct regular compliance checks and audits to ensure that all legal and regulatory filings for unlisted companies are accurate and timely.

**Appointment and CSR Compliance**

* Monitor the company’s capital and profits to assess whether it meets the criteria requiring the appointment of a Managing Director (MD) or full-time executive director, and handle any exceptions as per legal provisions.
* Work with senior leadership to ensure any necessary appointments are made in compliance with the Companies Act and other regulatory requirements.
* Track compliance with regulations concerning the appointment of women directors, ensuring companies that meet the capital or profit thresholds appoint a woman director to their board.
* Coordinate with the Adani Foundation and other CSR partners to confirm contributions, ensuring they are in line with statutory obligations.
* Ensure CSR contributions are accurately reflected in the Directors' Report.
* Prepare and file the necessary CSR forms with the Registrar of Companies (ROC), ensuring timely and accurate submissions.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure all company filings are publicly available and accessible to shareholders, ensuring transparency and proper communication in line with regulatory requirements.
* Manage statutory reporting requirements for unlisted entities, including the preparation and submission of annual returns and financial statements.
* Coordinate with legal teams to ensure all subsidiary entities comply with relevant laws, including the Companies Act, SEBI regulations, and other statutory bodies.
* Provide guidance to the Board of Directors and senior management on matters related to corporate governance, legal compliance, and corporate strategy.
* Advise on changes in governance and compliance regulations, ensuring the company's processes are updated in line with legal and regulatory developments.
* Ensure that the unlisted companies have the balances in place, supporting their long-term sustainability and compliance with all relevant laws.

**Routine Documentation and Administrative Tasks**

* Accurately record and maintain minutes of board meetings, shareholders' meetings, and business meetings, ensuring that all decisions are properly documented and communicated.
* Ensure the timely update of statutory registers, including the Register of Directors and Register of Members, ensuring proper maintenance and accuracy.
* Provide Know Your Customer (KYC) documents when required, such as for the opening of bank accounts, and maintain records as needed for statutory purposes.
* File necessary forms with the Registrar of Companies (ROC), ensuring compliance with both event-based and periodic filing requirements.
* Manage shareholding changes, ensuring all necessary documentation, such as share transfer forms, is in place and all changes are communicated to the relevant stakeholders.
* Provide periodic information to statutory auditors to support their reviews and ensure proper compliance with corporate governance standards.
* Manage time and attendance signatures for directors and key personnel during board meetings or when required for statutory purposes.
* Respond to emails and inquiries promptly, ensuring effective and timely communication with internal and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate with practicing company secretaries for tasks that require collaboration and ensure efficient handling of all secretarial duties.
* Handle director payments, ensuring timely and accurate processing, particularly for the second phase of the payment cycle.
* Process payments for consultants, ensuring timely submission of invoices and proper approvals.

**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
Qualified Company Secretary (Associate or Fellow Member)
  
  
**Experience**
Minimum 2 years in handling secretarial and governance responsibilities for unlisted entities.

Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management ICs, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCUs), and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand across automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications, and artificial intelligence markets.
  
  
Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata Group, which operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission to improve the quality of life of the communities it serves globally through long-term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with trust.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own capex architecture and investment planning activities across customer bid opportunities, ensuring solutions are technically and commercially optimized.
* Lead the assigned bid workstream, integrate subject matter expert inputs, and present recommendations during management review and approval gates.
* Develop bottom-up should-cost models for equipment, tooling, automation, manufacturing infrastructure, and supporting capital investments.
* Perform scenario modeling, sensitivity analysis, and investment trade-off studies to support strategic bid decisions.
* Conduct make-versus-buy evaluations, including technical, operational, and financial assessments supported by NPV, IRR, and payback analysis.
* Review and approve the technical basis of estimate prior to submission into proposal costing and bid management processes.
* Review RFQs, customer specifications, drawings, BOMs, standards, and technical data packages to identify gaps, risks, assumptions, and clarification requirements.
* Develop structured customer clarification lists and convert incomplete RFQ inputs into explicit assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, and closure actions.
* Define workstream solutions, basis of estimates, implementation approaches, assumptions, risks, mitigation plans, and technical dependencies.
* Develop estimates for quantities, cycle times, resource loading, equipment and tooling requirements, NRE, capex, lead times, and implementation milestones.
* Assess equipment sourcing strategies and evaluate lead-time exposure for both standard and custom-built manufacturing equipment.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Capital expenditure planning, equipment investment strategy, and manufacturing infrastructure cost modeling.
* Development of bottom-up should-cost models for manufacturing equipment, automation systems, tooling, fixtures, and production assets.
* Financial evaluation techniques including NPV analysis, IRR calculations, payback analysis, return-on-investment assessment, and business case development.
* Scenario modeling, sensitivity analysis, investment trade studies, and make-versus-buy decision frameworks.
* RFQ decomposition, requirements analysis, compliance matrix development, and requirements traceability management.
* Bid strategy development, proposal governance, solution storytelling, executive presentations, and customer clarification management.
* Integrated planning, RAID management, risk assessment, change management, and configuration control.
* Commercial evaluation of cost structures, schedules, contractual obligations, lead-time risks, and investment decisions.
* Equipment sizing, manufacturing capacity planning, resource loading analysis, cycle-time calculations, and implementation scheduling.
* Supplier evaluation, quotation analysis, sourcing strategy development, and technical-commercial recommendation preparation.
* Experience with ERP systems, PLM platforms, BOM management, document repositories, and controlled bid content environments.
* Strong analytical, financial modeling, structured problem-solving, and evidence-based decision-making capabilities.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and customer presentation skills.
* Proven capability to lead multidisciplinary teams across engineering, operations, quality, sourcing, finance, supply chain, and supplier organizations.
* Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, and ability to consistently deliver high-quality outputs against fixed bid deadlines.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* MBA or Postgraduate qualification in Operations Management, Finance, or a related discipline preferred.
* 10-15 years of relevant experience in costing, capital expenditure planning, bid management, manufacturing industrialization, NPI, engineering, or related functions within EMS or complex manufacturing environments.

title: Associate Business Support Specialist
description:
Job Description At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We-re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that's welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us. Overview As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing's team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company's core values of safety, quality and integrity. Technology for today and tomorrow The Boeing India Engineering Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge RD, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace. People-driven culture At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts - enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected.-No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people's careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing. With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace. About Position / Position Summary The responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to, the following: Implement innovative principles of Space planning in tune with Business requirement Orienting the new joiners with Boeing India and BGES- Global workplace strategy and operations function Responsible for all Employee services including but not limited to Food, transport, vending, events, telecommunications etc. Maintaining excellent relationships with various Business Units (BU) taking care of any related business requirements. Engage with BU's and proactively anticipate business requirements Coordinating with Landlord to ensure smooth building operations Should be able to manage all technical services including equipment maintenance required to operate facility and always ensure 100% uptime of services. Manages and support integration of activities like facilities occupation including facilities planning, analysis, project administration, property administration, facilities provisioning as required from time to time Should have managed small and large projects. Ability to lead and manage small minor project works on-site. Will be responsible for facility takeover from Project team which includes snagging / de-snagging / track and maintain all facility related documentation etc. Responsible for Asset management i.e. end to end life cycle of an asset until disposal taking care of quarterly/annual physical verification of assets. Responsible for complete Procure to Pay cycle (P2P) coordinating with relevant business partners(s) Responsible for ensuring safety security at workplace and implementation of Employee Health and Safety policies Ability to collaborate with other functions like Global Real Estate/Finance/HR/Security etc as when required to deliver the assigned scope of work. Responsible for representing BGES- Global workplace strategy and operations for various audits like Quality/ISO/BCP including recertification(s) Sharing input on annual budget allocation tracking planned vs actual spent along with proper reasoning of deviations (if any). Monitor emergency response procedures such as dialogic/call tree/ERT members. Manage end-to-end site operations with special focus on driving value through service delivery improvements, cost saving initiatives etc. Should have knowledge of required permits to maintain compliant facility operations. Ability to ideate, develop, lead and execute operational excellence projects. Plan and manage operational budgets. This role will be based out of Bengaluru, India. Position Responsibilities: This is a position for an Associate Business Support Specialist located in Bangalore and in support of the Boeing Global Enterprise Services - Global Workplace and strategy organization.-The position will report to the Business Support Manager and will receive day-to-day directions from this manager.-The candidate will work closely with local agencies and vendors to proactively support the business needs related to Boeing personnel because of emerging business needs. This includes but is not limited to Boeing infrastructure (office facilities), employee services, and safety and security (disaster planning and business continuity) within the assigned location, payment process for vendors. Candidate should have good command over English language. Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience): Entrepreneurial mindset. Ability to foster two-way collaboration. Ability to facilitate decision making. Proactive risk management. Effective Communicator with good verbal and written communication skills. Knowledge of advanced Microsoft office tool. Intermediate analytical skills. People Management with good inter interpersonal skills. Quick learner has eye for detail. Customer focused. Capability to manage and lead teams. Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience): 5-10years of relevant experience in site operations, business operations, Integrated Facilities Management (IFM), Shared Services, or an administrative environment. Graduate / equivalent qualification in hospitality, administration, engineering, operations
will be preferred. Previous work experience with multinationals in similar environments. Typical Education Experience: Education/experience typically acquired through advanced education (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 5 Plus years' related work experience or master's degree with 5+ years of experience with-n equivalent combination of education and experience. Relocation: This position does offer relocation within INDIA. 
 Applications for this position will be accepted until Oct. 22, 2026 
 Export Control Requirements: This is not an Export Control position. Relocation This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility. Visa Sponsorship Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status. Shift Not a Shift Worker (India) 
 Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not accept unlawful discrimination in our recruitment or employment practices on any grounds including but not limited to; race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military and veteran status, or other characteristics covered by applicable law. We have teams in more than 65 countries, and each person plays a role in helping us become one of the world's most innovative, diverse and inclusive companies. We are proud members of the Valuable 500 and welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. Applicants are encouraged to share with our recruitment team any accommodations required during the recruitment process. Accommodations may include but are not limited to: conducting interviews in accessible locations that accommodate mobility needs, encouraging candidates to bring and use any existing assistive technology such as screen readers and offering flexible interview formats such as virtual or phone interviews.

Internships, projects or competitions involving data analysis. 
 What You ll Gain

title: Canada- Model validation RFP
description:
The Model Risk Management (MRM) provides oversight for the MRM Framework, which consists of the policy, processes, and procedures. The Quant Analyst - Model Risk Management (MRM) will be responsible for conducting independent model validations for the assigned models to ensure models align with business objectives and design objectives. Verify that models are performing as expected, identify potential limitations, which includes assessing potential impact. Perform annual reviews and review the on-going monitoring reports to ensure that the models are performing as intended. Key Responsibilities Comprehensive Model Validation: Conduct thorough and comprehensive validations of various model components, ensuring that they are accurate, reliable, and aligned with the intended business objectives and regulatory requirements. This includes but is not limited to: Model Inputs Analysis: Apply data analysis techniques to assess the quality, integrity, and appropriateness of data used in the models. Examine data extraction, cleaning, transformation processes, and evaluate data-related assumptions and limitations. Model Conceptual Evaluation: Scrutinize the model design and construction, verifying the suitability of the modeling framework and theory for the intended use. Review model segmentation, variable selection, model testing procedures, and evaluation model assumptions, limitations, and risks. Model Code Review and Replication: Review model code to ensure correctness, accuracy, and absence of material errors. Collaborate with model developers to address any identified issues. Outcomes Analysis: Assess both in-sample and out-of-sample back test results; evaluate sensitivity and scenario testing, stress testing, benchmark model development, and quantitative and business performance metrics. Challenger Model Development (if required) Risk Identification and Mitigation: Provide effective challenges and identify potential model risks. Recommend appropriate mitigation measures and enhancements to improve model quality and compliance with regulatory standards. Ongoing Monitoring and Outcome Analysis: Assess the mechanisms for ongoing model performance monitoring, issue identification, and risk management to ensure effective oversight, policy compliance. Ensure that the model remains reliable, relevant, and compliant throughout its lifecycle, this includes review risk mitigation measures, compensating controls, and risk acceptances. Documentation and Reporting: Produce high-quality, comprehensive validation reports that clearly communicate findings, recommendations, and potential risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ensure that validation documentation adheres to internal standards and regulatory requirements (SR11-7). Review and upgradation of MRM policies and Procedures annually, with new trends Audit and Regulatory Review Support: Assist in gathering and providing materials requested by internal audit and regulators, drafting responses to questions, and defending validations in exams. Continuous Learning and Improvement: Stay up to date with emerging trends and best practices in model validation and regulatory requirements. Contribute to the enhancement of the model validation framework by suggesting process improvements and implementing industry-leading methodologies. Develop and maintain model governance documentation and performance monitoring, including periodically presenting results to MRM stakeholders. Interact with all key stakeholders including model users, model owners, vendors, Model Risk Governance, and other Validators throughout the model lifecycle including validation, ongoing performance evaluation. Build relationships across model owners, data scientists, Model Risk Management, Audit, and third-party vendors. Use subject matter expertise and analytics to proactively identify and address gaps and identify emerging risks. Contribute towards remediation efforts for model-related issues identified through exams, audits, and model validations.

title: Senior Platform Hardware Design Engineer
description:
Job Details: Position Overview As a Platform Hardware Design Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the architecture, design, integration, bring-up, and validation of complex platform hardware. You will drive hardware development end-to-end, translating high level system requirements into detailed circuit and component specifications and leading designs from architecture and schematic development through PCB implementation, board power-on, debugging, validation, and delivery. You will be expected to make platform level technical decisions, resolve complex and ambiguous multidisciplinary problems, lead critical design reviews, drive cross-functional alignment, mentor engineers, and influence hardware development practices across projects. Our Business Group You will be joining the Silicon and Platform Engineering Group (SPE), an organization at Intel committed to advancing Intels mission of delivering world-class silicon and platform solutions. The group focuses on developing integrated systems that align with customer needs and support Intels broader goals of leadership in technology innovation. SPE collaborates across diverse domains to ensure Intel platforms meet performance, reliability, and scalability requirements. Our work sits at the intersection of silicon, board hardware, firmware, validation, signal and power integrity, mechanical and thermal engineering, PCB technology, manufacturing, and system integration. Our senior hardware engineers have a broader responsibility than executing an individual design. They help establish platform architecture, guide implementation, identify and qualify appropriate hardware solutions, provide technical leadership during board power-on and debug, and lead resolution of schematic, layout, SI/PI, and hardware issues. Key Responsibilities Platform Architecture and End-to-End Technical Ownership - Own complex platform-board designs from requirements and architecture through deployment. - Translate high level platform and silicon requirements into system architecture, circuit level requirements, component specifications, and PCB implementation requirements. - Define and drive critical platform architecture decisions encompassing high speed interfaces, memory, power delivery, clocking, resets, sequencing, control, management, and validation functionality. - Lead design trade-offs across electrical performance, SI/PI, thermal and mechanical constraints, board complexity, reliability, manufacturability, component availability, cost, schedule, and system compatibility. - Establish clear technical direction where platform requirements or implementation approaches are initially ambiguous. Advanced Board Design and Technical Leadership - Lead development of complex high density, multilayer PCBs incorporating advanced digital, analog, mixed signal, and power circuitry. - Own or provide technical leadership for schematic design, component selection, interface definition, PCB implementation, and design verification. - Establish PCB stack-up, placement, routing, impedance, power distribution, and critical interface requirements in collaboration with layout and analysis teams. - Lead schematic, layout, and technical design reviews and ensure critical findings are driven to closure. - Guide engineers and layout teams in resolving challenging schematic, PCB, layout, and design-for-X issues. - Identify and qualify new hardware solutions and reusable design approaches where appropriate. High-Speed Design and SI/PI - Apply deep understanding of signal integrity, power integrity, transmission-line behavior, high-speed interfaces, and platform power delivery to architecture and implementation decisions. - Partner with SI/PI engineers to establish design constraints and evaluate critical interfaces and power delivery networks. - Review PCB implementations for stack-up, placement, routing, return path continuity, high speed performance, and advanced SI/PI considerations. - Use modeling, simulation, measurement, and hardware correlation to guide technical decisions as appropriate. Power Architecture and Power Delivery - Define and review platform power delivery architecture, voltage regulation, sequencing, power budgeting, and power distribution networks. - Evaluate board and system power delivery tradeoffs, considering electrical performance, transient behavior, PCB implementation, and platform requirements. - Work with power integrity specialists to assess PDN behavior and drive required design improvements. - Apply simulation and hardware measurement to correlate power delivery behavior and resolve platform issues. Board Bring-up, System Integration and Debug - Define and lead power-on, bring up, validation, characterization, and debug strategy for complex platform hardware. - Lead resolution of difficult issues spanning board hardware, silicon, firmware, high-speed interfaces, power delivery, and system integration. - Use disciplined root cause analysis to diagnose failures and define corrective actions. - Provide hands-on technical leadership in the lab during critical power-on, bring up, and debug activities. - Apply appropriate measurement techniques and laboratory equipment for high speed, low speed, clock, power, and digital/analog circuitry. - Drive problems across engineering boundaries until technical closure. Program and Cross-functional Leadership - Serve as a senior technical interface across silicon, firmware, validation, SI/PI, mechanical, thermal, PCB layout, manufacturing, suppliers, and program teams. - Lead technical discussions and design reviews and communicate risks, tradeoffs, recommendations, and design decisions clearly to stakeholders. - Identify technical and execution risks early and drive mitigation plans. - Own technical readiness for critical hardware milestones, including design release, fabrication, assembly, power-on, and validation. - Develop and improve reusable architectures, review methodologies, design checklists, development flows, and engineering practices. - Mentor engineers through architecture development, schematic and PCB reviews, bring-up, debug, and technical problem solving. - Influence technical decisions and engineering practices beyond an individual board or project. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications
 - Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
 - 6+ years significant hands-on industry experience in complex platform hardware, PCB development, or system hardware engineering.
 - Demonstrated experience leading complex board designs from architecture and requirements through schematic design, PCB implementation, bring-up, debug, and validation.
 - Deep understanding of digital and analog board design, electrical interfaces, mixed-signal fundamentals, and system architecture.
 - Strong knowledge of high speed interfaces, transmission line behavior, signal integrity, power integrity, memory, clocking, reset, sequencing, and power delivery.
 - Proven experience with PCB technologies and layout techniques, including stack-up, placement, routing, and advanced SI/PI considerations. 
 - Advanced experience with schematic capture and PCB design/review environments.
 - Strong hands-on laboratory experience and demonstrated ability to diagnose complex board level problems, determine root cause, and drive corrective actions. 
 - Demonstrated ability to analyze board/system level design tradeoffs and make sound technical decisions.
 - Ability to independently lead complex technical development activities and drive issues across multiple engineering functions.
 - Strong technical documentation, presentation, written communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
 - Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring capability.
Preferred Qualifications
 - Extensive experience designing complex compute, server, client, FPGA-based, semiconductor validation or other high performance platform hardware.
 - Experience with high speed I/O and memory technologies such as PCIe, DDR/LPDDR, Ethernet, USB, or comparable interfaces.
 - Deep understanding of PCB stack-up, placement, routing, high speed design, transmission lines, signal integrity, crosstalk, power integrity, and PDN design.
 - Experience applying SI/PI, power, circuit, or electromagnetic simulation to board architecture and design decisions.
 - Experience defining and validating sophisticated power delivery solutions, power management architectures and basic Verilog coding,
 - Strong understanding of PCB fabrication, assembly manufacturing flows, DFM/DFT, component selection, and design release processes.
 - Proven experience taking complex boards through the complete lifecycle from architecture through PCB implementation, fabrication, assembly, power-on, validation, and deployment.

 - Experience with scripting or automation using Python or comparable tools for hardware development, analysis, validation, or debug.
