title: Principal Architect - Network & Data Infrastructure
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Position Overview We are seeking a Principal Architect - Network & Data Infrastructure to serve as the enterprise design authority for network platforms and lead the definition, governance, and evolution of scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available architectures across LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, and network security domains. The role combines deep hands-on expertise with enterprise-level architectural judgment. The Principal Architect will translate business, application, security, and operational requirements into technology strategies, reference architectures, standards, and roadmaps while acting as the senior technical escalation point for complex network and security challenges. This position will drive modernization, performance optimization, automation, proactive vulnerability management, and operational resilience while influencing engineering, operations, security, application, and business stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Enterprise Architecture & Technology Strategy Define and own enterprise network architecture principles, standards, reference designs, patterns, and multi-year technology roadmaps across LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, and network security platforms. Assess business and technology requirements and translate them into scalable, secure, resilient, and supportable target-state architectures. Lead architecture review boards and design assurance activities, ensuring solutions align with enterprise standards, security requirements, lifecycle strategy, and operational readiness. Provide strategic technical direction for Cisco and Aruba-based solutions and evaluate emerging capabilities for enterprise adoption. Guide technology lifecycle decisions, platform rationalization, technical debt reduction, and modernization priorities. Network Engineering, Design & Optimization Architect high-availability enterprise network solutions using Cisco and Aruba technologies across campus, branch, data center, WAN, SD-WAN, and wireless environments. Own routing architecture and governance for OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP, including resiliency, convergence, scalability, route control, and failure-domain considerations. Architect and optimize Aruba wireless platforms to deliver secure enterprise mobility, reliable coverage, capacity, roaming, and user experience. Define design requirements for availability, redundancy, performance, capacity, quality of service, segmentation, and disaster recovery. Validate complex designs through architecture reviews, risk assessments, design walkthroughs, and implementation readiness checkpoints. Operational Excellence & Incident Leadership Act as the highest-level technical escalation and decision authority for critical, complex, or recurring network incidents. Lead technical root cause analysis for major incidents and ensure corrective and preventive actions address architectural and systemic causes. Partner with operations, security, application, and vendor teams to reduce downtime, improve MTTR, and strengthen service resilience. Identify recurring operational patterns and convert them into engineering standards, automation opportunities, and architectural improvements. Security, Risk & Vulnerability Governance Architect network security controls aligned with enterprise security frameworks, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. Govern vulnerability identification, risk assessment, remediation strategy, exception handling, and lifecycle management using tools such as Rapid7, Nessus, or Qualys. Define and review network hardening, patching, segmentation, access control, compliance, and quality-of-service standards. Provide architecture-level risk assessments and remediation recommendations for legacy platforms, unsupported technologies, and high-risk designs. Monitoring, Automation & Continuous Improvement Define enterprise monitoring, telemetry, observability, alerting, and performance baselines using SolarWinds, and related monitoring platforms. Drive network performance analytics, trend analysis, capacity planning, service health reporting, and proactive optimization. Set direction for network automation, configuration standardization, compliance validation, and repeatable engineering practices. Promote scripting and automation frameworks that improve reliability, consistency, delivery speed, and operational efficiency. Documentation, Governance & Stakeholder Engagement Maintain architecture documentation, technology standards, reference designs, decision records, high-level designs, and governance artifacts. Provide executive-level reporting on network health, architecture risks, vulnerability posture, lifecycle exposure, and strategic improvement initiatives. Present complex technical concepts, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Mentor architects and senior engineers, build technical capability, and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority. Partner with technology vendors and service providers on solution strategy, design quality, roadmap alignment, and issue resolution.

 Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Relevant professional certifications and equivalent experience may be considered. Experience 15+ years of progressive experience designing, engineering, and architecting enterprise-scale network environments. Demonstrated experience operating as a Principal Architect, Lead Architect, enterprise design authority, or equivalent senior technical leader. Proven ownership of enterprise architecture standards, complex solution designs, technology roadmaps, and architecture governance. Hands-on experience leading critical incident resolution, root cause analysis, modernization programs, and cross-functional technical decisions. Technical Expertise Advanced expertise in Cisco switching, routing, wireless, and SD-WAN platforms. Strong command of OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP in large-scale, highly available enterprise environments. Deep knowledge of Aruba wireless architectures, design, security, capacity, and optimization techniques. Enterprise network architecture across LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, segmentation, resiliency, and quality of service. Experience with vulnerability management and security assessment platforms such as Rapid7, Nessus, or Qualys. title: Software Engineering Manager - Enterprise Data platform
description:
a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; } Short Description We are seeking a highly technical Engineering Manager - Enterprise Data Platform to lead a team of engineers responsible for building and scaling a modern enterprise data platform. This role combines people leadership, platform architecture, and hands-on software engineering. The successful candidate will lead the development of a scalable data ingestion platform that collects data from manufacturing plants, enterprise applications, operational systems, IoT devices, databases, APIs, and streaming sources, transforming it into trusted, governed, and consumable data products within our enterprise data lake. This is a hands-on leadership role where the Engineering Manager is expected to actively contribute to technical design, software development, troubleshooting, and platform innovation while mentoring and growing a high-performing engineering team. Description We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager - Enterprise Data Platform to lead the design, development, and operation of our next-generation data platform. As a technology leader, you will be responsible for managing a team of engineers while remaining deeply involved in architecture, solution design, and software development. You should be equally comfortable defining technical strategy, reviewing architecture, mentoring engineers, and stepping in as a Senior Developer when complex technical challenges arise. You will lead the development of a platform-first ecosystem that enables the efficient onboarding, processing, governance, and consumption of data from diverse enterprise and manufacturing environments. The platform will support analytics, reporting, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and operational decision-making across the organisation. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Engineers, Product Managers, business stakeholders, and data consumers to ensure data is reliable, secure, governed, and accessible at scale. The ideal candidate combines strong engineering management capabilities with deep expertise in data platforms, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and modern AI-enabled engineering practices. Responsibilities Engineering Leadership & People Management Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software, platform, and data engineers. Drive engineering excellence through coaching, code reviews, technical guidance, and best practices. Manage hiring, onboarding, performance development, and career growth of team members. Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Define team goals and ensure alignment with business and platform objectives. Drive delivery excellence through effective prioritisation, planning, and execution. Architecture & Platform Strategy Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for the Enterprise Data Platform. Design scalable, resilient, secure, and cost-effective platform capabilities. Establish architecture patterns for data ingestion, data access, metadata management, governance, and observability. Evaluate architectural trade-offs across batch, streaming, event-driven, and API-based solutions. Act as the technical decision-maker for critical platform initiatives. Hands-On Engineering Actively contribute to software design, development, and code reviews. Step in as a senior developer or technical lead when required to solve complex engineering challenges. Develop and maintain production-grade software and platform services. Lead root cause analysis and implement long-term technical solutions. Ensure engineering teams follow modern software engineering principles, design patterns, and quality standards. Drive automation, standardisation, and platform reusability. Data Ingestion Platform Development Build and scale a cloud-native data ingestion platform capable of collecting data from manufacturing plants, enterprise systems, applications, APIs, databases, IoT devices, external data providers, and streaming platforms. Design and implement ingestion patterns supporting batch, real-time streaming, and Change Data Capture (CDC). Develop reusable ingestion frameworks, connectors, SDKs, and self-service onboarding capabilities. Enable trusted movement of structured and unstructured data into enterprise data lake environments. Improve the reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency of ingestion services. Data Governance, Quality & Observability Design and implement metadata management, lineage tracking, and governance frameworks. Establish enterprise-grade data quality validation and monitoring processes. Enable end-to-end visibility into data movement across the platform. Implement secure and policy-driven data access controls. Develop observability capabilities covering data freshness, reliability, usage, performance, and cost optimisation. AI-Enabled Engineering & Platform Operations Leverage Generative AI and AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate software development, troubleshooting, and operational excellence. Drive adoption of AI-powered solutions for identifying data ingestion failures, schema drift, data quality issues, pipeline bottlenecks, and platform anomalies. Partner with Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists to develop intelligent monitoring, anomaly detection, and automated remediation capabilities. Evaluate and implement AI/LLM-powered approaches for root cause analysis, incident investigation, operational insights, and developer productivity. Promote the effective use of AI-assisted coding, testing, observability, and platform support tools across engineering teams. Collaboration & Stakeholder Management Collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Engineers, Product Managers, and data consumers. Translate business and analytical requirements into scalable platform capabilities. Support AI, Machine Learning, analytics, and reporting initiatives through reliable and accessible data products. Influence platform strategy, engineering standards, and long-term technology decisions. Serve as a trusted technical partner across multiple cross-functional teams. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 10+ years of software engineering experience. 3+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams. Strong experience building large-scale data platforms, distributed systems, or cloud-native applications. Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise data ingestion solutions. Deep expertise in batch, streaming, and Change Data Capture (CDC) architectures. Strong software development experience using Python, Java, or similar programming languages. Experience designing APIs, platform services, and scalable system architectures. Strong understanding of data governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, and access control. Experience working closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and analytics teams. Demonstrated ability to balance people leadership with hands-on technical contribution. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, and Datastream. Experience with Airflow, Astronomer, or similar orchestration platforms. Experience with DataHub, OpenMetadata, Collibra, Alation, Apache Atlas, or similar governance solutions. Experience with Terraform, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and GitHub Actions. Experience building enterprise data lakes and modern data platform ecosystems. Exposure to Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and intelligent automation frameworks. Experience implementing AI-powered observability, anomaly detection, and operational monitoring solutions. Experience building internal developer platforms, engineering productivity tools, or platform SDKs. Who You Are You are a builder and a leader. You enjoy creating scalable platforms while helping engineers grow and succeed. You are comfortable operating at multiple levels, from defining platform strategy and architecture to reviewing code and solving production challenges. You understand that successful data platforms are not just technology solutions but business enablers. You bring a product mindset to platform engineering and are passionate about delivering reliable, secure, and governed data capabilities that empower Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, analysts, and business users to make better decisions and innovate faster. You embrace modern AI and Generative AI technologies and actively leverage them to improve engineering productivity, platform reliability, observability, and operational excellence.

title: Java Developer
description:
About the role 
 eG Innovations is a product company looking for a Java Developer who enjoys solving hard, open-ended problems. This role is 100% research-driven: you will investigate unknowns, prototype ideas and turn findings into production-grade product features. No two weeks look the same. You will dig into JVM internals, performance bottlenecks and complex runtime behaviour, and help shape how our product observes and diagnoses Java applications. 
 Location: [Hybrid] • Experience: 57 years • Employment type: Full-time 
 Key responsibilities 
 Research, prototype and evaluate new approaches for the product, then take the winning ideas into production-quality Java code. Perform in-depth troubleshooting of Java applications: memory leaks, thread contention, deadlocks, GC pauses, class-loading issues and CPU hotspots. Analyse heap dumps, thread dumps, GC logs and JFR recordings to find root causes, and document findings clearly. Explore JVM internals, bytecode instrumentation and agent-based techniques where the product needs them. Run proof-of-concepts and benchmarks, and present results with data to product and engineering leads. Design and build features that are performant, observable and reliable at scale. Stay current with the Java ecosystem and observability space, and bring new ideas to the team. Collaborate with product, QA and fellow engineers in a fast-moving, changing environment. 
 Required skills and qualifications 
 Minimum 5 to maximum 7 years of hands-on experience in Core Java (Java 11+; Java 17/21 preferred). Strong grasp of JVM internals: memory model, garbage collectors (G1, ZGC, Shenandoah), JIT compilation and class loading. Proven in-depth Java troubleshooting in production: memory leaks, OutOfMemoryErrors, high CPU, thread deadlocks and latency spikes. Hands-on with diagnostic tools such as jstack, jmap, jcmd, Java Flight Recorder, JDK Mission Control, VisualVM, Eclipse MAT or async-profiler. Solid knowledge of multithreading, concurrency and performance tuning. Experience with Spring / Spring Boot, REST APIs and microservices. Comfortable with Linux, Git, Maven or Gradle, and debugging in containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes). A research mindset: curious, self-driven, comfortable with ambiguity and able to explain findings clearly. Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 Added advantage 
 OpenTelemetry (OTEL): hands-on with the OTEL Java agent, SDK, manual and auto-instrumentation, context propagation and the OTEL Collector. Monitoring and observability: experience with metrics, logs and distributed tracing using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, Zipkin, Elastic/ELK, Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace or AppDynamics. Familiarity with Java agents, bytecode manipulation (ByteBuddy, ASM, Javassist) or the JVMTI. Understanding of APM concepts: SLIs/SLOs, alerting, and dashboards that lead to faster root-cause analysis. Contributions to open-source projects, technical blogs or conference talks on Java performance or observability. 
 Who will thrive here 
 You will enjoy this role if you would rather chase down why a JVM behaves strangely than repeat the same CRUD feature. You like freedom to experiment, and you take ownership from idea to shipped product. 
 What we offer 
 Fully research-oriented work on a core product, with real influence on its direction. Time and room to explore new technologies and build proof-of-concepts. A collaborative team of engineers who value deep technical work.

title: AMP Regional Manager
description:
Regional Manager (Earthmoving & Mining Equipment spare parts and attachments) Position Summary We are looking for a dynamic and passionate Spare Parts Sales Professional to drive sales growth across the assigned territory through direct customer engagement and dealer network development. The role involves promoting and selling high-quality spare parts for earthmoving, construction, and mining equipment, identifying business opportunities, building strong customer relationships, driving the sales team and achieving sales targets. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical knowledge of heavy equipment spare parts, excellent communication skills, and a growth-oriented mindset with a passion for aftermarket sales. Qualification & Experience Educational Qualification Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in: Mechanical Engineering Automobile Engineering Related Engineering Discipline Experience Minimum 15 years of experience in spare parts sales within the: Construction Equipment (CE) Industry Earthmoving Equipment Industry Mining Equipment Industry CE/Mining aftermarket Industry. Proven experience in team handling , direct customer sales and territory management. Experience in aftermarket parts sales and dealer management preferred. Technical Skills Good working knowledge of: Microsoft Excel Microsoft Word Microsoft PowerPoint Hands-on experience with: SAP ERP Other ERP platforms (added advantage) Key Roles & Responsibilities Sales & Business Development Lead and support the team across the assigned territory while effectively engaging with prospective and existing customers to achieve business objectives. Conduct regular customer visits, sales calls, and business reviews to generate sales opportunities. Promote and sell high-quality spare parts for earthmoving, construction, and mining equipment. Prepare and present sales proposals highlighting product benefits, reliability, and value proposition. Identify market opportunities and develop strategies to increase market penetration and revenue growth. Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets. Customer Relationship Management Build, maintain, and strengthen relationships with key customer accounts, fleet owners, contractors, mining companies, and dealers. Understand customer requirements and provide suitable spare parts solutions. Develop long-term partnerships through exceptional customer service and technical support. Handle customer inquiries, quotations, and follow-ups effectively. Market Development Increase market share by identifying competitor activities and developing growth strategies. Expand customer base and generate new business opportunities. Gather market intelligence, customer feedback, and industry trends to support business decisions. Product Promotion & Customer Education Educate customers on the advantages, quality, performance, and value of our spare parts offerings. Conduct product demonstrations and technical discussions with customers and dealers. Promote preventive maintenance and parts replacement programs that add value to the customer's operations. Reporting & System Management Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, sales pipelines, quotations, and business opportunities. Use SAP and Tuffex Stores Management System for: Quotations Order processing Inventory checks Lead tracking Customer data management Sales reporting Prepare periodic sales reports and territory performance updates. Desired Candidate Profile Passionate about Spare Parts Sales and Aftermarket Business . Strong customer focus with excellent relationship-building skills. Proven team handling skills. Self-driven, result-oriented, and proactive approach to business development. Strong negotiation and communication skills. Ability to work independently and thrive in a target-driven environment. Growth mindset with a commitment to expanding market share and business profitability. Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory. Key Competencies Spare Parts Sales

 Mining & Construction Equipment Knowledge

 Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The performance of the Regional Manager will be measured against the following Key Performance Indicators: Sales & Revenue Performance Achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets. Revenue growth from assigned territory. Gross margin achievement against budget. Year-on-year business growth percentage. Customer Acquisition & Retention Number of new customers acquired per quarter. Customer retention rate and repeat business. Growth in business from existing customer accounts. Number of active customer accounts in the territory. Market Development Recruit experienced team to ensure adequate coverage. Increase in market share within assigned territory. Penetration of new geographic areas and customer segments. Conversion rate of identified sales opportunities into orders. Competitive account conversions and business wins. Customer Engagement Number of customer/dealer visits and meetings conducted per month. Number of sales calls completed versus planned. Customer satisfaction and relationship management scores. Timely resolution of customer inquiries and complaints. Lead Management & Pipeline Development Number of qualified leads generated each month. Value of sales pipeline maintained. Lead-to-order conversion ratio. Follow-up closure effectiveness on quotations submitted. Quotation & Order Management Number and value of quotations submitted. Quotation-to-order conversion percentage. Order booking value versus target. Accuracy and timeliness of quotations and order processing. Reporting Compliance Timely and accurate updating of customer activities. Submission of weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales reports on time. Accuracy of sales forecasts and demand planning inputs. Inventory & Product Focus Promotion of strategic and fast-moving spare parts. Sales growth of focus product categories. Support in reducing non-moving inventory through sales initiatives. Identification of stocking opportunities with key customers. Dealer & Channel Development Recruit capable dealers to cover and scale up the business. Dealer sales growth in assigned territory. Dealer engagement and training programs conducted. Dealer coverage and account performance improvement. Achievement of channel partner sales objectives. Success Metrics for the Role Achieve 100%+ Sales Target attainment. Deliver 25-30% annual business growth in assigned territory. Increase market share and customer penetration year-on-year. Maintain high customer retention and satisfaction levels . Generate sustainable growth through new customer acquisition expansion of existing accounts and new business ventures. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a strong passion for Spare Parts Sales, team handling, customer relationship management, territory expansion, and aftermarket business growth in the Earthmoving, Construction Equipment, and Mining industries.

title: Immediate Hiring For VAPT (Face To face interview)
description:
Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) 
 Conduct manual and automated security assessments of web applications, REST APIs, mobile applications, and network infrastructure. Perform penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and potential attack vectors. Validate findings, assess business impact, and recommend appropriate remediation measures. Perform retesting to verify that identified vulnerabilities have been successfully resolved. Prepare detailed VAPT reports with proof of concept, risk ratings, technical evidence, and remediation guidance. Conduct security assessments aligned with OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, and relevant industry standards. 

 Application Security (AppSec) 
 Integrate security practices into the Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC). Perform secure code reviews to identify common coding vulnerabilities and security weaknesses. Conduct SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and secrets scanning. Identify and assess vulnerabilities such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting (XSS), broken access control, authentication flaws, SSRF, insecure deserialization, and business logic vulnerabilities. Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for new features and applications. Provide secure coding recommendations to developers and help validate remediation. 

 API and Mobile Application Security 
 Assess API authentication, authorization, input validation, rate limiting, and data exposure risks. Perform security testing of Android and iOS applications, including static and dynamic analysis. Evaluate session management, cryptographic implementations, sensitive data storage, and communication security. Identify insecure integrations and third-party component risks. 

 Vulnerability Management and Reporting 
 Maintain a vulnerability register and track findings through remediation and closure. Prioritize vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, business impact, and exposure. Work with development and infrastructure teams to establish remediation timelines. Track remediation SLAs and report vulnerability trends and security metrics. Support compliance and audit requirements related to application security and penetration testing. 

 Security Automation and Collaboration 
 Integrate security testing tools into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps workflows. Help reduce false positives and improve the effectiveness of security testing. Collaborate with developers, QA, DevOps, and architecture teams to resolve security issues. Conduct security awareness sessions and provide guidance on secure development practices. Stay updated on emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques, CVEs, and security testing methodologies. 

 Required Technical Skills 
 Strong understanding of web application, API, and network security. Hands-on experience with penetration testing and vulnerability assessment methodologies. Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, and common application security vulnerabilities. Experience with tools such as Burp Suite Professional, OWASP ZAP, Nmap, Nessus, and Postman. Familiarity with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools such as SonarQube, Checkmarx, Fortify, Veracode, or Snyk. Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, authentication, authorization, OAuth 2.0, and JWT. Experience with Linux, Windows, web technologies, databases, and cloud application security fundamentals. Ability to document security findings and communicate technical risks clearly. Basic scripting or programming skills in Python, JavaScript, Bash, or similar languages. 

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with mobile application security testing using tools such as MobSF, Frida, or JADX. Knowledge of cloud security across AWS, Azure, or GCP. Familiarity with container security, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipeline security. Experience with threat modeling methodologies such as STRIDE. Knowledge of secure coding practices and common vulnerabilities in Java, Python, JavaScript, or .NET applications. Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, eWPTX, CEH, Security+, or equivalent practical experience. 

 Educational Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline. Relevant hands-on cybersecurity experience may be considered in place of specific certifications. 

 Key Competencies 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Attention to detail and a methodical approach to security testing. Ability to distinguish exploitable vulnerabilities from false positives. Clear technical report writing and stakeholder communication. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Commitment to ethical testing and responsible vulnerability disclosure

title: Sr. Analyst, Global Client Payments - Avalara
description:
Role Summary: 
 Global Client Payments reconciles and validates the payments Avalara makes on behalf of clients to tax authorities. Payment volume is growing across every line of business, and the team is investing in stronger reconciliation processes and AI-enabled workflows to support that growth. This role owns an established reconciliation process and the month-end close that runs alongside it. Daily reconciliations, exception resolution, and month-end close all run to fixed deadlines that partner teams and clients rely on. The role exists to raise the accuracy and timeliness of reconciliation and to convert manual reconciliation effort into repeatable, AI-supported process that makes the work faster and more reliable. 
 How This Role Elevates Avalara: 
 Reduces compliance risk by clearing exceptions and unpaid items within published turnaround targets Enhances client experience through accurate, timely reconciliation that reduces notices and penalties Improves month-end close reliability through complete, on-time delivery Prevents errors from reaching clients by catching breaks in peer reconciliations Improves decision quality by applying critical thinking across all reconciliation work Strengthens the control environment through current procedures and audit-ready evidence Increases operational scale by using AI to surface opportunities to improve reconciliation processes Raises team capability through documentation, process improvement, and AI best-practice sharing 
 Responsibilities: 
 Own daily reconciliations of bank activity against liability records, and clear exceptions within published turnaround targets Own month-end reconciliation close and deliver complete, accurate results on deadline Own creation and resolution of unpaid items, and keep aging within target Review reconciliations completed by other analysts, and catch errors before they impact clients Own presented-item and stop-payment decisions, exercising judgment within defined control requirements Own standard operating procedure (SOP) documentation, keeping it current and audit-ready Identify and implement process and AI-enabled improvements that reduce manual effort or improve accuracy Partner cross-functionally on unresolved items, and escalate with a recommendation, not just a problem Lead within the team by driving shared work to delivery and keeping peers unblocked Raise peer capability through onboarding support, knowledge sharing, and coaching. 
 AI Expectations: 
 This role is built for someone who uses AI to create real leverage in speed, accuracy, insight, and scale. 
 How you will show up in the role today 
 Spot opportunities to use AI to surface mismatches, aging patterns, and unpaid item trends faster, and work with the team to test and validate those approaches before they touch live work Build reusable prompts for recurring tasks like drafting exception narratives, summarizing unpaid item aging, and formatting variance explanations, and strengthen them through peer input before they become part of the teams toolkit Use AI to assist with SOP drafting, updates, and version comparisons, reducing the time it takes to keep documentation current after process changes Validate every AI-generated output against source data before it informs any reconciliation decision, presented-item judgment, or stop-payment action; AI assists; it does not decide 
 How this role will evolve as AI matures 
 As AI takes on more of the routine matching work, this role will shift toward owning the exception logic itself, defining the rules, thresholds, and escalation criteria that AI workflows operate within The analyst will increasingly serve as a quality control layer over AI outputs, spotting drift, validating edge cases, and flagging where AI confidence should not be trusted Process improvement will evolve from one-off efficiency gains to identifying where AI can be consistently embedded in recurring reconciliation tasks Documentation and knowledge transfer will carry more weight, as well-structured process knowledge enables more consistent execution across the team and makes AI assistance more accurate Candidates who can demonstrate this mindset, using AI confidently today while thinking clearly about where the role is heading, will stand out. 
 Bar Raiser 
 This role exists to raise the bar for the team, not just maintain current state or restore capacity. The right candidate doesn’t just do the job well; they introduce new practices, make the people around them better, and leave the process more capable than they found it. 
 What bar-raising looks like in this role 
 Structured thinking that makes complex problems legible. This person doesn’t just resolve exceptions; they diagnose why the exception occurred, whether it signals a broader pattern, and what process change would prevent recurrence. When they escalate, they bring a clear problem statement, the relevant data, and a recommended path forward. When they document a process, someone else can follow it without asking a follow-up question. Introduces new practices, not just better execution of old ones. They don’t wait to be asked to improve something. They see a manual step in month-end close, assess the control risk, and come with a proposal. They identify an AI workflow that eliminates a recurring data-prep task and pilot it with sign-off. They set a new standard for what “good” looks like in reconciliation. Raises the floor of the team, not just their own ceiling. Their onboarding support, knowledge sharing, and documentation make junior analysts measurably more independent. Peers escalate less to the manager because this person is a reliable first resource. The team’s collective output improves because of how they show up. Drives better decisions through better information. They surface insights from reconciliation data that inform business decisions upstream — patterns in unpaid items, jurisdictions with recurring exceptions, or trends that signal a process control failure before it becomes a customer issue. 
 Qualifications: Required Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field 4+ years of experience in treasury, finance, or accounting Demonstrated experience in data analysis, independent problem-solving, and reconciliation Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency, including the ability to translate technical detail into business terms Experience working within an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system Strong written and verbal communication skills with internal and external partners Proven ability to deliver results under pressure and against tight deadlines High quality-control standards and strong attention to detail Understanding of both accounting guidance and the mechanics of execution Collaborative working style with the ability to adapt as business priorities shift 
 Preferred MBA with a concentration in Finance Demonstrated hands-on AI use that produced measurable, documented improvement Experience with payment processing, bank reconciliation, or tax remittance workflows Experience with NetSuite Familiarity with building or refining process documentation and SOPs Experience coaching or mentoring junior analysts in a finance or accounting context

description:
We are looking forward to hire Master Data Management (MDM) Professionals in the following areas : Experience Level 8+ Years Job Title: Lead Quality Engineer / MDM Test Engineer Role Overview 
 Were looking for a detail-oriented Quality Engineer with experience in Master Data Management testing to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our Reltio MDM platform. Youll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes - ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for Reltio MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing. Validate Reltio data models, entity configurations, relationships, attributes, and reference data for accuracy and completeness. Test match merge rules, survivorship logic, and deduplication processes to ensure golden record quality meets business expectations. Validate integration pipelines (batch and real-time) between Reltio and source/target systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness. Perform data quality testing - profiling, validation, and reconciliation - across source systems and the Reltio MDM hub. Test Reltio workflows, business rules, stewardship processes, and exception handling scenarios. Develop and maintain automated test scripts for regression and data validation testing using tools such as Python, SQL, or Selenium. Perform API testing of Reltio REST APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or similar. Conduct performance and load testing on Reltio integrations and platform configurations. Log, track, and manage defects through the full lifecycle using JIRA or similar tools, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution. Collaborate with business analysts, data stewards, and developers to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria. Validate data migration activities - pre-migration, mid-migration, and post-migration - ensuring data integrity and completeness. Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles. Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports. Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects. Required Skills Experience 3+ years of experience in software or data quality engineering, with at least 1-2 years of exposure to MDM platforms (Reltio preferred, or Informatica MDM, Semarchy, SAP MDG, Stibo STEP, or similar). Hands-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts - entities, relationships, match merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows - sufficient to design meaningful test cases. Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases. Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools. Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar). Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy). Experience with data quality testing concepts - completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness. Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements. Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint-based delivery teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy. Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines. Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus. Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc. ) for automated testing workflows. Experience with data migration testing in large-scale MDM implementation projects. Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements. Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services. Key Competencies Meticulous attention to detail and strong data analytical mindset. Ability to understand complex data relationships and identify edge cases in match/merge scenarios. Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across data engineering, business, and architecture teams. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple test deliverables across concurrent project tracks. Proactive in identifying risks, raising issues early, and proposing pragmatic testing solutions. Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration All Support needed for the realization of business goals, Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

title: Manager - Policy & Process Excellence
description:
About the Role: You will own Orenda's policies, SOPs, and process manuals across Operations, Sales, Credit, and Product, and make sure every department actually follows them. Today, much of how our best people work lives only in their heads. You will turn that into clear, versioned documents, train teams on them, and keep them current as lenders and regulations change. You will also act as the business voice for our tech team: bringing the rules, lender context, and priorities they need, and taking each feature rollout through testing, training, and go-live. This is not a documentation-only role. We are looking for an owner who can push back on department heads when a process is broken, and who is not satisfied with a document nobody reads. You will start as an individual contributor, with the opportunity to build a small team as the scope grows. 
 What You Will Do: 
 1. Operations Policies and Lender SOPs Document end-to-end login processes for each bank and NBFC partner, covering document checklists, portal steps, eligibility gates, turnaround times, and escalation paths. Maintain a lender-wise SOP library and update it within days of any lender policy or portal change. Define handoffs between Sales, Ops, and Credit so every file has a clear owner at every stage. 
 2. Sales Incentive Policy and Training Processes Draft and maintain sales incentive and channel-partner payout policies, with worked examples and edge cases. Convert policies into training material and assessments with the Training/HR team, and keep the induction program current. Run policy walk throughs whenever something changes, and track acknowledgement from every team member. 
 3. Credit Policy and Software Parameters Translate each lender's credit norms (FOIR, ABB, vintage, bureau score, ticket size, negative profiles) into structured rules. Define how these parameters are entered and maintained in Orenda's software, and own the rule master. Audit samples of live files to check that system output matches the written policy. 
 4. Business Owner for Tech and Feature Rollouts Coordinate with the tech manager on feature rollouts, bringing the business inputs, rules, and lender and process context they need to draft specifications. Gather and consolidate requests from Ops, Sales, and Credit, and help set and manage priorities with the tech manager and the MD. Answer business-side questions during development so tech is never blocked waiting on departments Run user-acceptance testing with the end teams, and own go-live readiness: training, updated SOPs, and communication Collect post-launch feedback and issues from users and route them back to tech with clear priority. 
 5. Governance Across Departments Own the company-wide SOP registry (the Orenda Playbook), including templates, version control, approvals, and review dates. Draft new department policies on request, such as HR, admin, and finance processes, using the same standard. Run periodic compliance checks and report gaps to department heads and the MD. Flag where processes need updating for regulatory changes, such as RBI digital lending rules, in coordination with advisors. 
 Must-Have Skills 
 1. Lending Knowledge 58years in retail or MSME lending at a bank, NBFC, fintech, or large DSA, in operations, credit, process excellence, or business analysis. Hands-on knowledge of loan login, documentation, and credit norms across multiple lenders. Ability to explain core lending concepts such as FOIR and ABB in plain words to a new sales hire. 
 2. SOPs, Policy, and Process Proven record of writing SOPs, policy documents, or process manuals that teams actually used. Advanced Excel and experience with process-mapping tools such as Visio, draw.io, Lucid, or similar. 
 3. Working with Tech Experience working with tech teams on system or feature rollouts, including explaining business rules, prioritising requests, and testing releases. 
 4. Communication Strong written English, with the ability to write simply and clearly. Comfortable explaining processes in Gujarati or Hindi to field teams. 
 Good to Have Graduate in commerce or finance; MBA, CA Inter, or a process certification such as Lean or Six Sigma Green Belt is a plus. Experience with a loan origination system or CRM rollout. Familiarity with RBI digital lending and DSA guidelines. 
 Who You Are Obsessive about detail and consistency, but writes simply. Willing to push back onsenior people, with facts, when a process is broken. Follows through on adoption rather than stopping at the document. 
 Why Join Us? Own the company's rulebook at an early stage, shaping how a growing lender-channel business runs rather than inheriting an established system. Direct access to the Founder & MD, with short decision cycles and real authority to change broken processes. Work at the intersection of lending, operations, and product, with a front-row seat to how our lending-tech platform is built. The opportunity to grow from an individual contributor into a team lead as the function scales.

Key Skills: Software implementation,SOP,Lending,Sop preparation,Process audit,Policies,Process analysis,Management

title: Data Operations Executive
description:
Job Summary: 
 We are seeking a Data Operations Executive to support business and operational teams through effective data management, data quality control, reporting, and automation support. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of data handling, data scrubbing, address standardization, reporting processes, and operational workflows, along with working knowledge of SQL, Python, and Excel VBA-based automation. The role involves managing day-to-day data operations, ensuring data accuracy and quality, executing automated processes, preparing reports, troubleshooting data-related issues, and coordinating with internal stakeholders to support smooth business operations. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Data & Operational Support 
 Support daily data, MIS, and reporting requirements for business and operations teams. Extract, validate, reconcile, and analyze data from multiple sources. Perform data scrubbing, cleansing, standardization, and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency. Execute address scrubbing and address standardization activities to improve data quality, accuracy, and serviceability. Identify duplicate, incomplete, inaccurate, or inconsistent records and perform corrective actions as per defined processes. Ensure data integrity, quality, and completeness across operational databases and reporting systems. Identify data discrepancies and coordinate with relevant teams for timely resolution. Support bulk data correction, enrichment, and maintenance activities as required. Monitor operational activities and ensure adherence to defined SLAs and processes. 
 Automation & Process Efficiency: 
 Execute, monitor, and maintain existing automation solutions developed using: SQL Python Excel VBA Perform basic troubleshooting and minor enhancements to automation scripts, queries, and macros. Support automation initiatives aimed at reducing manual effort and improving operational efficiency. Ensure automated reports and workflows are executed successfully and delivered on schedule. Identify opportunities for process improvements through automation and standardization. 
 Reporting & Documentation 
 Prepare and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly operational and MIS reports. Validate report accuracy and completeness before publication. Ensure reports are delivered within agreed timelines and formats. Maintain and update documentation related to reports, automation processes, SOPs, and support activities. Assist in creating dashboards and management reports as required. 
 Communication & Stakeholder Coordination 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for data, reporting, and operational support requests. Coordinate with internal teams to resolve operational and data-related issues. Provide timely updates on open issues, incidents, and support requests. Escalate critical issues appropriately and ensure effective follow-through until closure. Maintain professional communication with stakeholders across functions. 
 Required Skills & Competencies: 
 Strong understanding of data handling, data validation, and reporting processes. Good understanding of data quality management, including: Data scrubbing and cleansing Deduplication Address standardization and validation Data reconciliation Working knowledge of: SQL (queries, data extraction, data validation, and basic automation) Python (executing and understanding automation scripts) Excel VBA (running and maintaining macros) Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including: Advanced formulas Pivot Tables Lookup functions (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP) Data validation Reporting and analysis Experience working with large datasets and operational databases. 
 Communication & Soft Skills: 
 Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong coordination and stakeholder management abilities. Excellent attention to detail and analytical thinking. Ability to manage multiple tasks in a process-driven environment. Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills. Proactive approach toward issue identification and resolution. Educational Qualification: 
 Minimum Qualification: Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC / 12th Pass). Graduation in any discipline will be considered an added advantage but is not mandatory. Candidates with relevant experience, technical skills, and strong operational aptitude will be considered regardless of educational background. Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience in MIS, data operations, reporting, data quality, or operations support roles. Exposure to BI and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Experience working in SLA-driven support environments. Familiarity with process documentation, SOP management, and operational governance. Experience with automation-driven process improvements. Exposure to address validation, customer master data management, or data quality projects will be an advantage.

Key Skills: Powerpoint,Data Operations,SQL,Reporting,Data Reporting,Bi,Dashboards,Microsoft

description:
About the Role We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Talent Operations Associate to manage and streamline our hiring operations at GoML. You will play a key role in ensuring a smooth candidate experience, managing interview coordination, offer processing, preboarding, candidate engagement, and onboarding readiness. You will also act as a bridge between the Talent Acquisition and HRBP teams, ensuring seamless coordination and a positive transition from candidate to employee. What Youll Do First 30 Days - Learn Support Understand GoMLs hiring process, talent operations workflows, and internal stakeholders. Get familiar with Keka ATS, HRMS, interview tools, and recruitment trackers. Coordinate interviews, panel availability, candidate communication, and scheduling. Ensure interview feedback is collected on time and updated in the ATS. Support offer letter processing, approvals, and candidate documentation. Initiate preboarding activities and track document submissions. Connect regularly with offered candidates to keep them engaged until joining. Understand the onboarding handover process between Talent Acquisition and HRBP. First 60 Days - Own Execute Independently manage end-to-end interview scheduling and recruitment coordination. Own offer processing, approval follow-ups, offer acceptance tracking, and joining confirmations. Manage the complete preboarding process, including documentation, background verification coordination, and joining formalities. Drive preboarding candidate engagement through regular check-ins, welcome communications, joining updates, and query resolution. Track candidates serving notice periods, identify potential dropouts, and proactively flag joining risks. Coordinate with HRBP, IT, and hiring managers to ensure everything is ready before Day 1. Maintain accurate candidate data, recruitment trackers, offer records, and upcoming-joiner dashboards. Support campus hiring drives, internship onboarding, and recruitment events. Coordinate recruitment vendor invoices, employee referrals, and related operational activities. First 90 Days - Improve Optimize Take complete ownership of day-to-day talent operations with minimal supervision. Establish structured preboarding engagement touchpoints to improve candidate experience and joining conversion. Ensure seamless handovers between Talent Acquisition and HRBP, with clear documentation and ownership. Standardize interview coordination, offer processing, preboarding, and onboarding checklists. Track key operational metrics, including interview turnaround time, offer processing time, offer acceptance, and joining conversion. Identify operational bottlenecks and improve workflows through process enhancements and automation. Maintain ATS/HRMS data accuracy and ensure timely operational reporting. Gather candidate and new-joiner feedback to improve the overall hiring and onboarding experience. Build scalable talent operations processes to support GoMLs growing hiring needs. What Were Looking For 1-2 years of experience in Talent Operations, Recruitment Coordination, or HR Operations. Good understanding of recruitment processes, offer management, preboarding, and onboarding. Hands-on experience with ATS/HRMS platforms; experience with Keka is a plus. Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and follow up proactively. Good working knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets, and recruitment reporting. Strong attention to detail, documentation, and data accuracy. Ability to handle confidential candidate and employee information responsibly. A process-oriented mindset with strong ownership and problem-solving skills. Experience in a startup or fast-paced technology environment is an advantage. What Success Looks Like Interviews, offers, and preboarding activities are completed on time. Offered candidates remain engaged and informed throughout their notice period. Candidate dropouts and last-minute joining challenges are proactively managed. Every new joiner experiences a smooth, organized, and welcoming transition. Talent Acquisition and HRBP have clear visibility into upcoming joiners and handover activities. Recruitment records, trackers, and operational dashboards are accurate and up to date. Talent operations run efficiently through clear processes, ownership, and continuous improvement. Why Join GoML At GoML, youll be part of a growing team building impactful AI solutions. Youll have the opportunity to take ownership, improve how we hire and onboard talent, and help create a seamless experience for every new team member. If you enjoy working with people, bringing structure to processes, and making things happen, wed love to hear from you!

title: Content Creator
description:
We are looking for a creative, enthusiastic, and hands-on Content Creator to develop engaging, visually appealing, and informative digital content for social media and other marketing platforms. The role involves conceptualising content ideas, developing recipes, preparing and styling food, and presenting content in front of the camera. The selected candidate will collaborate closely with the Content and Marketing teams to create engaging videos, product demonstrations, recipe content, and digital campaigns that align with the organisation's brand and marketing objectives. The ideal candidate should have a creative mindset, practical cooking skills, good communication abilities, and the confidence to perform in front of a camera. Knowledge of photography, video production, and editing will be an added advantage. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Content Ideation and Development Generate creative content ideas for social media platforms, digital campaigns, and other marketing initiatives. Develop concepts for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, long-form videos, product demonstrations, and promotional content. Research emerging trends, audience preferences, and popular content formats to create relevant and engaging content. Develop scripts, storyboards, captions, and content outlines in coordination with the Marketing team. Translate product features and marketing objectives into engaging, audience-focused content. B. Recipe Development and Content Preparation Develop creative recipes, food concepts, serving suggestions, and product applications for digital content. Prepare and cook dishes for video shoots, photography, and product demonstrations. Experiment with ingredients, flavours, cooking techniques, and presentation styles to create innovative content. Ensure consistency in recipe execution, food quality, portioning, and presentation during shoots. Maintain proper food hygiene, ingredient handling, kitchen safety, and workspace organisation. C. On-Camera Presentation and Production Present content, demonstrate recipes, and explain product applications in a clear, engaging, and approachable manner. Prepare and style food to ensure it is visually appealing and suitable for photography and video production. Coordinate with the production team on shot planning, props, plating, lighting, and shoot schedules. Participate in video shoots and repeat cooking demonstrations or scenes as required. Ensure consistency in presentation and content quality across multiple takes. Assist in developing engaging product stories, demonstrations, and other camera-led content. D. Photography, Video Editing and Post-Production Support photography and video production activities for digital marketing campaigns. Assist with basic video editing, photo editing, transitions, captions, and other post-production requirements where needed. Coordinate with the creative team to ensure content meets quality standards and brand guidelines. Suggest improvements to video presentation, visual appeal, storytelling, and overall content quality. Explore relevant creative software and emerging content creation tools to improve production efficiency. E. Social Media and Content Performance Collaborate with the Content and Marketing teams to plan and execute content calendars. Create content suited to different digital platforms and target audiences. Monitor relevant content trends and identify opportunities for new formats and creative approaches. Review content performance and contribute ideas to improve reach, engagement, and audience interaction. Support the execution of seasonal campaigns, product launches, and other marketing initiatives. 3. Educational Qualifications Candidates pursuing or having completed qualifications in the following disciplines are encouraged to apply: Media and Mass Communication Visual Communication Digital Media and Content Creation Culinary Arts Hotel Management and Food Production Food Technology or Food Science Other relevant creative or technical disciplines Candidates from other educational backgrounds with strong creative abilities and a relevant portfolio will also be considered. 4. Required Skills and Experience 0 to 2 years of experience in content creation, digital media, social media, culinary content, or a related field. Freshers with relevant skills, creativity, and a strong portfolio are encouraged to apply. Strong creative thinking and the ability to develop engaging content ideas. Practical cooking and food preparation skills to support recipe development and food-related content. Confidence in presenting and demonstrating concepts in front of a camera. Understanding of visual storytelling, food styling, plating, and product presentation. Good verbal and written communication skills. Ability to plan and execute content within agreed timelines. Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple creative tasks. Willingness to learn new tools, experiment with formats, and incorporate feedback. 5. Good-to-Have Skills Basic video-editing knowledge using Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar tools. Familiarity with photo-editing software such as Photoshop. Experience creating Reels, Shorts, YouTube videos, product demonstrations, or social media posts. Basic understanding of cameras, lighting, audio, and video production. Knowledge of social media trends, digital marketing, and content performance metrics. Familiarity with motion graphics and AI-assisted image or video creation tools. Experience with food, FMCG, hospitality, lifestyle, or consumer brands. A portfolio showcasing videos, photography, recipes, or other creative work. 6. Desired Competencies Creativity: Ability to develop original ideas and engaging digital content. Communication: Confidence in presenting ideas and demonstrating concepts on camera. Practical Approach: Willingness to participate actively in content preparation, cooking, and production. Visual Awareness: Understanding of presentation, composition, styling, and audience appeal. Adaptability: Ability to respond to changing trends, campaign requirements, and creative feedback. Teamwork: Effective collaboration with Content, Marketing, and production teams. Organisation: Ability to manage shoot preparation, schedules, and deliverables. Learning Agility: Interest in exploring new formats, creative tools, and content strategies. 7. Key Performance Expectations Develop creative and relevant content ideas aligned with marketing objectives. Execute engaging content across social media and other digital platforms. Ensure quality and consistency in content preparation, presentation, and production. Contribute to improved audience engagement through relevant and innovative content. Complete assigned content deliverables within agreed timelines. Collaborate effectively with internal teams to support brand communication and marketing campaigns. 8. Application Requirement Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their updated resume along with a portfolio of relevant creative work, such as videos, social media content, photography, recipe demonstrations, or other digital content. Candidates should be creative, comfortable working in front of a camera, and willing to participate hands-on in content development and production. Practical cooking skills are required for food-related content assignments, while video-editing skills will be an added advantage.

 • Define and monitor KPIs for deployed agents; establish feedback loops for continuous improvement

 • Partner with business process owners to translate operational problems into agent design briefs 
 • Collaborate with IT, data engineering, and enterprise architecture teams for system integration and cloud deployment

All About You

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard s guidelines.

title: Tech Lead QA - Master Data Management (MDM)
description:
We are looking forward to hire Master Data Management (MDM) Professionals in the following areas : Experience Level 8+ Years Job Title: Lead Quality Engineer / MDM Test Engineer Role Overview 
 Were looking for a detail-oriented Quality Engineer with experience in Master Data Management testing to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our Reltio MDM platform. Youll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes - ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for Reltio MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing. Validate Reltio data models, entity configurations, relationships, attributes, and reference data for accuracy and completeness. Test match merge rules, survivorship logic, and deduplication processes to ensure golden record quality meets business expectations. Validate integration pipelines (batch and real-time) between Reltio and source/target systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness. Perform data quality testing - profiling, validation, and reconciliation - across source systems and the Reltio MDM hub. Test Reltio workflows, business rules, stewardship processes, and exception handling scenarios. Develop and maintain automated test scripts for regression and data validation testing using tools such as Python, SQL, or Selenium. Perform API testing of Reltio REST APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or similar. Conduct performance and load testing on Reltio integrations and platform configurations. Log, track, and manage defects through the full lifecycle using JIRA or similar tools, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution. Collaborate with business analysts, data stewards, and developers to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria. Validate data migration activities - pre-migration, mid-migration, and post-migration - ensuring data integrity and completeness. Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles. Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports. Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects. Required Skills Experience 3+ years of experience in software or data quality engineering, with at least 1-2 years of exposure to MDM platforms (Reltio preferred, or Informatica MDM, Semarchy, SAP MDG, Stibo STEP, or similar). Hands-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts - entities, relationships, match merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows - sufficient to design meaningful test cases. Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases. Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools. Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar). Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy). Experience with data quality testing concepts - completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness. Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements. Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint-based delivery teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy. Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines. Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus. Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc. ) for automated testing workflows. Experience with data migration testing in large-scale MDM implementation projects. Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements. Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services. Key Competencies Meticulous attention to detail and strong data analytical mindset. Ability to understand complex data relationships and identify edge cases in match/merge scenarios. Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across data engineering, business, and architecture teams. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple test deliverables across concurrent project tracks. Proactive in identifying risks, raising issues early, and proposing pragmatic testing solutions. title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our team full-time in India. 
 We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live. 
 About the role: As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. This role is ideal for someone who can work across frontend experiences, backend services, integrations, and agent workflow orchestration, helping turn business workflows into production-ready AI-enabled features. The engineer will work closely with product, architecture, AI engineering, and platform teams to build usable, secure, and scalable agent interfaces that connect into enterprise systems, data sources, LLM services, and internal client platform capabilities. You will help develop the end-to-end application layer for AI agents - from the user-facing screens where business users interact with agents, to the backend APIs and integration services that allow agents to retrieve data, trigger workflows, call enterprise systems, and return structured outputs. You will be expected to build clean frontend components, robust backend services, secure API integrations, and reusable patterns that accelerate the delivery of multiple agents across a wide range of use cases. 
 Responsibilities: Build full stack features for AI agent use cases, including chat interfaces, task review screens, approval flows, exception queues and operational dashboards Develop React/TypeScript frontend components for agent interaction, configuration, monitoring and human-in-the-loop review Design and implement backend APIs and services that support agent execution, data retrieval, workflow actions, audit trails and enterprise integrations Connect agents with enterprise systems, databases, document stores, APIs and event-based workflows used within client environment Integrate with LLM gateways, model platforms, vector stores, prompt/configuration services and AI observability tooling Implement secure, production-ready patterns for authentication, RBAC, tenant-aware data access, logging, testing, CI/CD and deployment support 
 Requirements: Strong hands-on experience with React, TypeScript, modern frontend patterns and business application UI development Backend engineering experience with Python/FastAPI, Java/Spring Boot or Node.js Experience building REST APIs, integration services and data access layers for enterprise applications Working knowledge of PostgreSQL or similar relational databases; exposure to vector databases is beneficial Understanding of AI agent patterns such as tool/function calling, RAG, prompt configuration, workflow orchestration and human-in-the-loop design Experience with OAuth 2.0, SSO, RBAC, secure API design and multi-tenant application patterns Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, logging and production troubleshooting 
 Desirable: Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or similar agent frameworks Exposure to Langfuse, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, or similar observability tools Experience with Temporal or workflow orchestration platforms for long-running business processes Experience building review queues, approval workflows, case management screens, or operational dashboards Familiarity with AWS services, especially AWS Bedrock, API Gateway, Lambda, S3, and related cloud-native services Experience working from Figma designs and building reusable UI component libraries 
 Whats in it for you? Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies Care: Weve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations 
 About us: At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, youll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress. India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level. 
 Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum! Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We cant wait to see you at Ciklum

Our engineering is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. Our team builds products that are built on a mature, cloud-native event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS. SailPoint is seeking a Backend Software Engineer to help build a new cloud-based SaaS identity analytics product. We are looking for well-rounded backend or full stack engineers who are passionate about building and delivering reliable, scalable microservices and infrastructure for SaaS products. As one of the first members on the team, you will be integral in building this product and will be part of an agile team that is in startup mode. This is a unique opportunity to build something from scratch but have the backing of an organization that has the muscle to take it to market quickly, with a very satisfied customer base. Responsibilities Deliver efficient, maintainable, robust Java based microservices. Produce designs and rough estimates, and implement features based on product requirements. Collaborate with peers on designs, code reviews, and testing. Produce unit and end-to-end tests to improve code quality and maximize code coverage for new and existing features. Requirements 9-14 yearss of experience in Java / GO-based backend development. Strong knowledge in developing server-side, Object-Oriented Programming and Spring Boot framework Experience in designing, implementing RESTful/GraphQL APIs for an API-first application architecture. Experience using cloud-native technologies from AWS/other cloud providers. Experience developing microservices in multi-tenant SaaS application. Experience using SQL/NoSQL, EKS, Kafka, Redis Experience using monitoring, alerting, visualization tools like Prometheus, Grafana Experience with AI development tools such as Cursor or Claude. Experience working with remote teams Great communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills Desired Professional experience in design/implementation of event-driven architecture. Experience writing software applications in Go What success looks like in the role Within the first 30 days you will Onboard into your new role, get familiar with our product offering and technology, proactively meet peers and stakeholders, set up your development environment. Seek to deeply understand business problems or common engineering challenges and develop feature and unit test it. By 90 days Proactively implement different enhancements, defect fixes by interacting independently with different (sometimes many) stakeholders, architects and members of your team. Take a committed approach to contributing to different projects development alongside less experienced engineers on your team-there s no room for ivory towers here. Is able to provide 12x7 on-call support during their day. By 6 months Collaborates with Product Management and Engineering Manager to estimate and develop small to medium complexity features more independently. Lead projects with small group of 3-4 members. Participate in resource planning, backlog refinement activity.
