title: AVP / Director Computer Vision
description:
Overview about Ripik.AI 
 Ripik.ai  is an Accel-backed Applied AI company building computer vision and process-optimization agents for the world's largest industrial enterprises across steel, cement, aluminum, chemicals, pharma, and power. Our Vision AI platform acts as an automated pair of eyes on the shop floor  monitoring materials, equipment, and processes 24/7 with 95%+ accuracy, eliminating human error, and delivering measurable gains in throughput, yield, energy efficiency, and safety. We work with marquee customers including Tata Steel, JSW, ArcelorMittal, Vedanta, Godrej & Boyce, Grasim, Holcim, and Jindal Steel, and are scaling globally across India, the Middle East,Europe, and North America. As we move into our next phase of growth, we are building the operating backbone that will take Ripik from a high-velocity scale-up to a category-defining global industrial AI company. 
 The Role 
 We are looking for a hands on Computer Vision Lead to lead a team of 6–8 AI — Computer Vision engineers. This is a player-coach role: you will set technical direction, personally solve the hardest modelling problems, and grow a high-performing engineering team — all within the fast-moving environment of a venture-backed industrial AI start-up. Prior formal management experience is not required; what matters is deep technical expertise, the ability to influence through craft, and the drive to build and ship in ambiguous, high-stakes settings. 
 Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Hands-on Delivery 
 Own the end-to end computer vision roadmap — from problem framing and data strategy through model development, edge deployment, and production monitoring — across Ripik’s industrial portfolio (steel, cement, pharma, paints, and beyond). Personally architect and build solutions for the most complex vision challenges: novel defect types, extreme class imbalance, multi-camera fusion, low-light / high-noise factory environments, and real-time inference on constrained edge hardware. Stay at the cutting edge of CV research and rapidly evaluate and adopt new models and techniques — YOLO26, SAM 3, Vision Transformers (DINOv2, Swin), Grounding DINO, RF-DETR, zero-shot / open-vocabulary detection (YOLO-World, CLIP) — translating papers into production value. Define and enforce engineering standards for the vision stack: model training pipelines, data versioning (DVC), annotation workflows (CVAT, Roboflow, Label Studio), experiment tracking (W&B, MLflow), edge export formats (TensorRT, ONNX, OpenVINO), and CI/CD for model updates. Drive inference optimisation — quantisation (INT8 / FP16, GPTQ), pruning, knowledge distillation, and batching strategies — to meet latency and cost targets across NVIDIA Jetson, industrial PCs, and cloud GPU instances. 
 Team Building & People Growth 
 Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 6–8 Computer Vision engineers — set clear goals, run structured code reviews and design reviews, and create an environment of rapid learning and ownership. Hire and onboard strong engineers; raise the technical bar through hands-on pairing, knowledge-sharing sessions, and a culture of experimentation over perfection. Manage sprint planning, task prioritisation, and delivery timelines; balance exploratory R&D with committed product deliverables in a fast-paced start-up cadence. Act as the primary technical interface between the CV team and cross-functional stakeholders — product, field engineering, operations, and leadership — translating business problems into well-scoped modelling projects and communicating results clearly. 
 Innovation & Problem Solving 
 Identify and frame novel, first-of-its-kind vision problems in industrial settings where off-the-shelf approaches fall short; design creative solutions combining classical image processing, deep learning, and domain heuristics. Champion a data-centric AI approach — invest in annotation quality, active learning, synthetic data generation, and feedback loops from production rather than only chasing bigger models. Establish robust evaluation frameworks: domain-specific metrics, A/B testing against production baselines, and systematic failure-mode analysis to ensure models deliver real business impact. 
 Required Skills & Experience 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree  in Computer Science, AI/ML, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 6–10 years of hands-on experience in computer vision — with a strong track record of taking models from research / prototyping through to production deployment. Deep proficiency in Python and PyTorch; strong working knowledge of OpenCV, Albumentations, and image / video processing fundamentals. Demonstrated expertise across multiple CV tasks: object detection, instance / semantic / panoptic segmentation, anomaly detection, pose estimation, or tracking. Hands-on experience with modern model families — YOLO (v8 / v11 / v26), transformer-based detectors (RT-DETR, DETR, RF-DETR), segmentation models (SAM / SAM 2), and CNN backbones (ResNet, EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, Vision Transformers). Production experience deploying models to edge or on-prem hardware using TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, or OpenVINO; comfort with Docker, Kubernetes, and at least one cloud platform (AWS / Azure / GCP). Experience in a high-growth start-up or similarly fast-paced environment where scope is ambiguous, timelines are tight, and wearing multiple hats is the norm. Strong first-principles problem-solving ability — comfortable navigating novel, unstructured problems where no playbook exists. Excellent communication skills — able to distil complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders, write clear documentation, and present results to leadership and customers. 
 Good to Have Prior experience leading or mentoring a small engineering team (formal management title not required; tech-lead, senior IC, or project-lead experience counts). Experience with industrial or manufacturing domains — understanding of factory-floor constraints, camera setups, lighting variability, and integration with PLCs / SCADA systems. Familiarity with zero-shot and open-vocabulary detection (Grounding DINO, YOLO-World, CLIP) and foundation models (DINOv2, SAM 3, Florence) for data-efficient learning. Exposure to vision–language models (GPT-4o vision, Gemini, LLaVA) for combining visual inspection with natural-language reporting or operator copilots. Knowledge of 3D vision, depth estimation, point-cloud processing, or multi-camera calibration for volumetric industrial inspection. Experience with multi-object tracking (ByteTrack, BoT-SORT) and video analytics pipelines for continuous production-line monitoring. Contributions to open-source CV projects, publications in top-tier venues (CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, NeurIPS), or strong Kaggle competition results. 
 What Can You Expect? A leadership seat at a high-growth, venture-backed AI start-up — directly shape the technical direction and team culture of the computer vision function. Ability to shape the future of manufacturing by leveraging best-in-class AI and software; develop a niche skill set at the intersection of deep learning and heavy industry. World-class work culture, coaching, and development. Mentoring from highly experienced leadership from world-class companies (refer to Ripik.AI website for details). International exposure.

title: Enterprise Integration and Data Architecture Professional
description:
Job Overview The Senior Manager - Enterprise Integration Data Architecture is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining NetSuite integrations, APIs, EDI connections, and data pipelines. The role ensures reliable data exchange, data integrity, and secure connectivity across enterprise systems while supporting distribution, inventory, order processing, and accounting workflows. It also focuses on data governance, legacy system migration, integration monitoring, troubleshooting, and long-term technical ownership to build scalable and efficient business solutions. Duties Responsibilities Design and maintain enterprise integration architecture for APIs, EDI, webhooks, SFTP, files, native connectors, events and batch processing. Define source and target systems, authoritative data boundaries, field mappings, sequencing, validation, error handling, retries, reconciliation, security and support ownership. Maintain architecture diagrams, interface inventories, mapping specifications, decision records and runbooks. Design, build, test, deploy and support integrations between NetSuite and internal or external systems. Work with NetSuite REST web services, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, SuiteScript, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect and token-based authentication, as applicable. Support EDI and API connectivity with customers, distributors, vendors, logistics providers, marketplaces, payment services and websites. Develop mappings and workflows for purchase orders, acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory updates, item data, pricing and order status. Establish enterprise data architecture, data ownership, stewardship, quality rules and lifecycle requirements. Design governed data pipelines, transformation logic, shared definitions and reconciliation processes. Inspect legacy applications, databases, scripts, interfaces, files and automated jobs to identify business rules and technical dependencies. Support data extraction, transformation, mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation and reconciliation. Support NetSuite Analytics Warehouse and related analytics capabilities where adopted. Design trusted data models and pipelines for reporting and ensure they reconcile to source transactions. Develop and execute unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, failure-mode, cutover and reconciliation tests. Implement logging, automated alerts, transaction tracing, exception queues, retry mechanisms and escalation procedures. Troubleshoot production issues and perform root-cause analysis across systems, data, networks, authentication and business rules. Apply security and data protection standards, including source control, code review, automated testing, environment separation, deployment and change control. Own integration standards, data pipelines, technical documentation and long-term architecture improvements. Work with implementation partners, build internal support capability and prioritize technical debt and enhancements. Develop scalable integration patterns that support growth, acquisitions, customer and vendor onboarding, analytics and automation. Education Training The JD does not specify a mandatory degree or formal educational qualification. It requires more than 7 years of enterprise application integration, software engineering, data engineering or related technical experience, along with meaningful hands-on NetSuite integration experience. Candidates should have experience designing, building, testing, deploying and supporting production integrations and data pipelines. Experience with a full range of integration technologies and data migration processes is important. Preferred experience includes Oracle Integration Cloud, NetSuite integration technologies, EDI, cloud data platforms and legacy application modernization. Knowledge, Skills Experience More than 7 years of enterprise application integration, software engineering, data engineering or related technical experience. Hands-on experience integrating with NetSuite records, transactions, permissions, APIs or scripting capabilities. Strong knowledge of REST and SOAP services, JSON, XML, SQL, SFTP, webhooks, authentication and modern integration patterns. Experience designing, building, testing, deploying, monitoring and supporting production integrations and data pipelines. Experience with data mapping, transformation, migration, reconciliation, master data and data-quality controls. Strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills across applications, interfaces, data, security and business processes. Knowledge of API security, token-based authentication, source control, code review, testing, deployment, environment management and operational documentation. Understanding of order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, fulfillment and accounting impacts. Ability to assess and challenge consultant or vendor recommendations and take ownership of technical designs. Strong written communication skills and willingness to remain hands-on throughout implementation and long-term operations. Preferred: Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), SuiteTalk, SuiteScript, RESTlets, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, NetSuite Analytics Warehouse, EDI standards, food or wholesale distribution, retail, logistics, Microsoft Dynamics GP modernization, Oracle APEX, Power BI, cloud data platforms, workflow automation, document processing, multi-entity environments and acquisition integrations.  About Eden Health Eden Health is a US healthcare company delivering exceptional healthcare experiences through technology. Eden has set up a dedicated Engineering and Product Hub in India in partnership with Softobiz Technologies, to expand engineering capacity, speed up innovation and strengthen its AI and data capabilities. We are now building the next version of Edens platform: a connected healthcare ecosystem that brings patients, doctors, care teams and partners such as clinics and pharmacies together on one modern, cloud-native foundation. The India hub is at the centre of that build.AI is central to how Eden will grow, from clinical decision support to operational automation. The India hub works hand in hand with Edens US leadership, with real ownership across product, engineering and operations.Read the announcement: Expanding Our Digital Footprint in India 
 About the role We’re looking for developers who treat AI as the default way to build software. You will help build the next version of Eden’s platform end to end, use AI tools to move fast without cutting corners, and bring AI into the product where it genuinely makes things better for patients, doctors and care teams.This is a hands-on engineering role on a modern platform being built the right way from the ground up. You’ll be part of a small, high-ownership team where your work reaches real patients quickly. 
 What AI-first means here Think AI: For any problem, you ask whether AI can solve it better, faster or cheaper. You can also tell when it shouldn’t be used. Use AI: AI coding tools are part of how you plan, write, test, debug, refactor and document code every day. Build AI: You can turn a good idea into a working AI feature when the opportunity is there. Build apps: Solid engineering comes first. You ship clean, tested, secure, production-ready applications. 
 What you’ll do Build the platform Build end-to-end features across web apps, APIs and backend services. Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and own it from design to production. Build with security and privacy in mind, from access control to protecting patient data. Improve performance, reliability and observability across the platform. Work with product and design to turn requirements into working software quickly. Bring AI into the product Help design and build AI-powered features such as smart search, summarisation and assistants for patients and care teams. Spot manual work across Support, Operations and Marketing that AI can automate, and help build the solutions. Keep up with fast-moving AI tools and bring practical ideas to the team. Ways of working Use Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar tools daily, and stay accountable for the quality of everything you merge. Share what works: prompts, workflows and shortcuts that help the whole team move faster. Take part in code reviews, sprint ceremonies, release planning and the production support rotation. Handle patient data responsibly under HIPAA-aligned security and privacy practices. Communicate clearly and asynchronously with US-based stakeholders. Must have 3 to 5 years of professional full stack development experience. Strong skills in TypeScript, with React or Next.js on the front end and Node.js on the back end. Solid experience with APIs, SQL databases and cloud platforms, ideally AWS. AI-assisted coding as part of your daily workflow, with examples to show. Some hands-on experience integrating AI APIs (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini), at work or in side projects. Good engineering habits: Git, CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews. Clear written and spoken English. Nice to have GraphQL, microservices or event-driven architectures. Agent or automation tools such as LangChain, n8n or MCP servers. Healthcare or another regulated domain. A public portfolio, GitHub or side projects that show how you build. What success looks like in your first 6 months You’re shipping features independently across the full stack. You’ve contributed to at least one AI-powered feature or automation that’s in use. Your AI-assisted workflow is visibly raising the team’s pace and quality. Teammates come to you for AI tooling ideas. Why join Help build the next version of a healthcare platform from the ground up. Be part of the founding team of Eden’s India Engineering and Product Hub, with a real mandate to shape what comes next. Join an AI-first culture where the best tools are part of how everyone works. High ownership, fast feedback and visible impact. How we’ll assess you Show us something you built with AI, or something AI helped you build faster. Share a GitHub link, a demo or a short walkthrough with your application. Expect a live build exercise where you use your own AI tools. We care about how you think, break down the problem and steer the AI, as much as the final result. Expect a technical conversation with our engineering lead about your past work and decisions.

title: AI Engineer Lead
description:
Job Summary 
 Job Description - Senior AI Engineer About the Role: We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to act as the technical lead for our Agentic AI product engineering pod. This is a hybrid IC/lead role. Beyond remain deeply hands-on, this role is responsible for owning the day-to-day technical guidance, task allocation, growth of junior engineers into the domain and upholding engineering standards. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Lead the delivery of production AI agent systems, from prototyping agent workflows to deploying and scaling them in production. Lead design and code reviews for the pod, ensuring consistent engineering quality and technical standards. Directly manage 1-2 junior engineers: assign and prioritize work, run regular 1:1s, give ongoing feedback, and support their career growth. Write clean, maintainable, well-tested Python code (FastAPI, Pydantic, async) and set the standard for code quality across the team. Unblock the team on technical issues and act as the first escalation point before involving the engineering manager. Establish and document engineering best practices for system design, prompt/context strategies, and evaluation methodology. Drive evaluation standards for non-deterministic LLM outputs across the team (eval design, regression testing, red teaming). Partner directly with product and business stakeholders to translate ambiguous requirements into scalable agent system design. Evaluate frontier and open-source LLMs, agent frameworks, and tooling; make and defend adoption recommendations to leadership. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 AI/ML Agent Engineering 
 Strong machine learning foundation, including deep understanding of tokenization, context windows, embeddings, and transformer architectures. Hands-on production experience with agent design patterns (ReAct, planning, reflection, tool use, memory, multi-agent handoff). Deep hands-on experience with RAG frameworks, LangChain/LangGraph or AutoGen for product development, including A2A and MCP integration at scale. Hands-on experience with Azure AI services for agent orchestration (e.g. Azure AI Foundry, Prompt Flow, Azure OpenAI Service). Advanced experience in prompt and context engineering, with a track record of driving eval methodology and testing strategy for non-deterministic outputs across a team. 
 
 Software Engineering 
 5 years of experience in Python product development, with deep proficiency in frameworks/libraries. Experience owning cost/latency tradeoffs and optimization for LLM systems at production scale. Experience using AI coding assistants (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code) in daily development workflows. 
 
 Technical Leadership 
 Experience leading design/code reviews and setting technical standards for a team. Comfortable making and defending technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders and leadership. Experience mentoring engineers, with genuine interest in growing junior talent. Ability to break down and delegate work appropriately based on team members skill level. Comfortable giving direct, constructive feedback and running regular 1:1s. Strong collaboration skills with product, engineering, and domain experts to translate business requirements into agent capabilities. 
 
 Good to Have 
 Knowledge graph (KG) experience, including hands-on work with Neo4j, with the ability to apply KG patterns in agent grounding contexts. Hands-on experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs, particularly with parameter-efficient methods (LoRA/QLoRA) and/or supervised fine-tuning (SFT); exposure to RLHF or DPO is a plus. 
 
 What Success Looks Like in This Role 
 Production AI agent systems are delivered reliably, with sound architecture that scales as usage grows. The junior engineers on the pod grow in capability, autonomy, and confidence under this persons mentorship. The team maintains high, consistent engineering standards across code, design, and evaluation practices. Leadership trusts this persons technical judgment on architecture, tooling, and framework decisions.

United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer s and partner s needs and solve their challenges. Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve. You ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about-locally and globally. Come make an impact every day at Zebra. What Were Looking For: Responsible for monitoring cloud environments, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring timely escalation of events to maintain system health and performance. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to incident management in a 24x7x365 operational environment. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 
- Diligently observe and interpret cloud monitoring dashboards and alerts
- Resolve basic issues; escalate urgent and complex issues. Know the difference
- Coordinate with internal departments and sometimes with customers
- Be aware of customer SLA s and escalate issues if cases are taking too long to resolve
- Document all troubleshooting and issue management actions via the electronic case management system
- Schedule resources and arrange work effort to cover weekends and/or on-call shifts to be available to be engaged in response to system-initiated alerts
- Monitoring case backlog to ensure we meet agreed SLAs with customers and internal KPI targets; share regular status reports with stakeholders
- Be able to work in a variety of different shifts, including days, nights, weekends, and holidays to support a 24x7x365 environment. Shifts may fluctuate to meet business and staffing needs Key Skills and Competencies: 
- Experience with Windows, Linux, web services, networking, Data bases, and cloud platforms.
- Understanding of the following monitoring concepts: Infrastructure, systems, and Application health, system availability, latency, performance, and end-to-end monitoring.
- Entry level cloud, network or security certificate from Cisco, Microsoft, AWS, CompTIA, or other well-known vendors.
- Knowledge and experience of SIEM, ELK, PLG, and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes are preferred.
- Cyber Security related Certifications like Security+, SSCP, CCSP, and CEH.
- Knowledge of Markup, query, and scripting languages, including Python, HTML, PromQL, SQL and familiarity with REST API calls, and PowerShell.
- Experience (1+ years) with ITIL processes including Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge and Event Management. Minimum Education or Equivalent: Bachelors degree or technical diploma in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field Minimum Work Experience: 2+ years experience working on an operations style team (NOC, SOC, MOC, etc.) and troubleshooting networking, service desk, operations center and/or supporting cloud based Infrastructure Work Environment: Hybrid Safety Sensitive Role: No Travel: Up to 10% Personal Protective Equipment (PPE): No Must be able to see color: No Physical Demands: - Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting/standing Benefits: We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. Job Posting Statement: To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department. AI Technology Statement: Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy .

title: Software Engineer 2 (Frontend)
description:
Position : Software Engineer II, Frontend 
 Base Location : New Delhi, India (Remote / Hybrid) 
 Experience : 4+ years 
 About the Engineering Team 
 Cheggs engineering team is a community of passionate builders who partner closely with 
 product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to shape the future of online learning. 
 Grounded in Cheggs core valuesputting students first, acting with integrity, and holding 
 a high bar for excellencewe build with care and accountability. As the world and our 
 industry continue to evolve, we stay true to those principles: we invest in quality, design for 
 scale and longevity, and avoid shortcuts (hello unit tests and documentation) so we can deliver 
 reliable, high-impact experiences on time. 
 About the Role 
 We're hiring a Software Engineer II, Frontend to own the design, quality, and delivery of features 
 across our student-facing web applications. This role is focused on building React/Next.js 
 product experiences, the GraphQL-powered data layers behind them, and increasingly, 
 AI-powered study features (step-by-step solutions, Q&A, and personalized study assistance). 
 You will also contribute across the stack as needed this is a frontend-first role with full-stack 
 reach, and you should be comfortable enough with backend concepts and AWS infrastructure to 
 ramp into our Java or Python backend services when a task calls for it. 
 What You'll Do 
 Own frontend features end-to-end architecture, implementation, testing, staged 
 rollout, and production monitoring across student-facing web application. 
 Translate product requirements into component architecture, GraphQL query/schema 
 boundaries, and client-state contracts (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar) that other 
 engineers build on. 
 Debug cross-system issues that surface in the UI GraphQL supergraph errors, 
 auth/session edge cases, server/client rendering mismatches by tracing root cause 
 across the stack. 
 Build AI-powered study features responsibly: validate model output (e.g., step-by-step 
 solutions, Q&A answers) before it reaches the UI, design graceful fallbacks for unusable 
 or low-confidence responses, and instrument these flows with telemetry. 
 
 
 
 Apply security and data-protection practices input validation, secure auth/session 
 handling, careful treatment of student data as a default part of the code you ship, not 
 a step someone else checks for. 
 Optimize application performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals) as 
 an ongoing part of feature work, particularly for high-traffic student study flows. 
 Own the quality of your changes through automated tests (unit, component, and 
 end-to-end), CI stability, and production validation. 
 Partner closely with Product, Design, and Backend to deliver and harden high-impact 
 student workflows (search, Q&A, subscription/paywall flows, study tools). 
 Contribute to engineering quality through strong code reviews including review of 
 AI-generated code reusable patterns, shared components, and clear documentation 
 that keeps technical debt low. 
 Ship end-to-end changes across the web application and its supporting APIs/schema, as 
 needed. 
 Required Qualifications 
 Most qualified candidates will likely bring 4+ years of professional frontend engineering 
 experience building production web applications, with demonstrated ownership of 
 features from design through launch. 
 Strong hands-on experience with React and Next.js, and comfort working in TypeScript. 
 Working knowledge of web fundamentals common security pitfalls (XSS, CSRF, 
 auth/session handling), performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals), 
 and accessibility (WCAG/ARIA basics) and the judgment to apply them without being 
 told to. 
 Experience designing and consuming APIs across common paradigms GraphQL 
 (schema design, codegen, querying), REST, and real-time protocols such as 
 WebSockets and working with at least one modern client-state approach (React 
 Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar). 
 Strong testing and release-validation discipline unit/component testing (Vitest or Jest, 
 React Testing Library) and end-to-end testing (Playwright or Cypress). 
 Comfort using AI-assisted development tools responsibly, with the ability to explain, 
 validate, and safely ship the code you produce. 
 Sound understanding of data structures, algorithms, and general software design 
 principles, applied pragmatically rather than academically. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 
 
 Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure concepts (compute, storage, networking, 
 basic service architecture) and some Node.js backend exposure enough of a 
 foundation to ramp into our Java or Python backend services when needed. 
 Experience with Auth0 or similar authentication providers in a Next.js application. 
 Experience shipping AI-powered UI streaming responses, structured output 
 rendering, graceful handling of model failures. Experience contributing to shared 
 component libraries or tooling used across multiple teams/repos. 
 Familiarity with frontend observability tooling (New Relic or similar). 
 Experience in EdTech, e-commerce, or another high-traffic, subscription-based 
 consumer product company. 
 Tech Stack 
 Frontend: React (18/19), Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL (Apollo tooling, codegen against 
 a shared supergraph), React Query / Redux Toolkit / Zustand, styled-components, MUI 
 Backend (foundational): Node.js, AWS (compute/storage/networking basics) 
 enough to ramp into Kotlin/Java (Spring) or Python (FastAPI/Django) services owned by 
 backend engineering 
 Testing: Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright 
 Auth / Delivery: Auth0, GitLab CI 
 Observability: New Relic 
 AI / ML: OpenAI, RAG, MCP, AWS Bedrock (via shared backend integrations)

Ciklum is looking for a Solution Architect to join our team full-time in India. 
 We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live. 
 About the role: As a Solution Architect, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. You will be joining a greenfield B2B Marketplace development for Client Procurement Company (VPC) a centralised procurement entity within the Group based in Luxembourg. The platform is a self service ordering portal for VF WEST deployment partners rolling out fiber-to-home infrastructure across Germany. It replaces fully manual, Excel-based procurement with a governed digital ordering channel integrated into VPC's existing enterprise systems. The solution is built as an API-led web application with a React frontend, .NET backend services, Azure infrastructure, and Entra ID (Azure AD B2C) for authentication. Core integrations include SAP S/4HANA (NSS), WMS (CFL), Transporeon TMS, MDM/MMOLA, and SAP Finance all via an integration middleware layer. The platform covers end-to-end procurement operations: catalogue and stock visibility, partner-specific pricing, checkout, bulk order upload, allocation-based order governance, shipment tracking, invoicing, returns initiation, operational reporting and automated notifications. The architecture is modular and designed to scale across additional customers and deployment partner networks without redesign. 
 Responsibilities: Define and own the end-to-end solution architecture for a B2B Marketplace platform integrating with SAP S/4HANA, WMS, TMS, MDM and Azure AD B2C Design the integration middleware layer, API contracts and data flow between the Webshop and client backend systems Ensure architectural decisions align with enterprise security, scalability and data segregation requirements Lead technical discovery sessions with client system owners Produce and maintain architecture documentation, integration specs and decision records Support engineering teams during implementation to validate alignment with the target architecture Participate in pre-sales and client-facing sessions to present and defend technical approach

title: AWS - Solutions Architect
description:
AWS Solutions Architect - Data AI 
 Experience: 8-12 Years 
 About the Role: We are looking for an experienced AWS Solutions Architect with strong hands-on engineering capabilities across Data, AI/ML, and cloud platforms. This is a dual-mode role requiring the ability to design scalable enterprise solutions, write code, build and deliver production-ready data/AI products, and operate at an architecture level. You will work closely with client-side Enterprise Architects, technology leaders, cybersecurity, legal, and business stakeholders, contributing to architectural documentation, governance processes, solution reviews, and technical decision-making. The role requires strong technical depth, architectural thinking, and exceptional communication skills to engage confidently with US-based enterprise stakeholders. 
 
 Key Responsibilites: Solution Architecture: Design scalable, secure, and cost-effective AWS architectures for enterprise Data and AI/ML solutions. Hands-on Engineering: Develop, validate, and deliver production-ready data pipelines, cloud components, and AI/ML solutions. AWS Data AI: Work with services such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Glue, Redshift, and Lake Formation. Architecture Governance: Prepare architecture documents, solution designs, technical assessments, and decision records; support architecture reviews and governance approvals. Enterprise Collaboration: Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Legal, and engineering teams to navigate enterprise standards, risk, compliance, and technology approval processes. Stakeholder Management: Present technical solutions, recommendations, risks, and trade-offs to directors, managing directors, and C-suite stakeholders. Technical Leadership: Guide developers and tech leads, evaluate solution approaches, review designs and code, and drive engineering best practices. Documentation Communication: Translate complex technical concepts into clear, structured documentation and executive-ready presentations. 
 
 Required Skills Experience: 8-12 years of experience in cloud engineering, solution architecture, or technical leadership, with substantial hands-on experience in AWS. Strong experience delivering enterprise-grade Data Engineering and AI/ML solutions. Practical experience with AWS services, including: Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker AWS Glue and Amazon Redshift AWS Lake Formation Relevant AWS security, networking, IAM, and data governance capabilities. Strong programming and engineering skills, with the ability to develop, troubleshoot, and deliver production-grade solutions. Experience creating architecture diagrams, solution design documents, technical assessments, and governance artefacts. Experience working directly with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Legal, Risk, or Compliance teams. Proven ability to communicate complex technical topics to senior business and technology stakeholders. Excellent spoken and written English, executive presence, and confidence engaging with US-based stakeholders. 
 
 Ideal Candidate Profile: A hands-on architect or senior technical lead who can move seamlessly between coding, solution design, architecture discussions, and stakeholder presentations. Someone comfortable representing the technical perspective in discussions with senior, non-technical stakeholders. A strong problem-solver who can balance enterprise architecture standards with practical delivery requirements. 
 
 Who Should Not Apply Purely hands-off architects without recent hands-on engineering experience. Developers who lack solution design, architecture documentation, and enterprise stakeholder exposure. Candidates who struggle to communicate technical concepts confidently to senior US-based audiences. 
 
 Success in this role: The ability to combine hands-on Data AI delivery, architectural judgement, enterprise governance, and executive-level communication to move complex technology initiatives forward.

title: DevOps Engineer (Jenkins Expert)
description:
Job Summary About the Role We are looking for a Senior Automation Engineer - Jenkins Administration CI/CD Integrations to join a dedicated Agivant engineering pod. This role is ideal for a hands-on Jenkins expert with strong experience in Jenkins administration, pipeline automation, GitLab integration, and CI/CD troubleshooting. You will play a key role in optimizing CI/CD workflows by integrating GitLab with Jenkins, automating repository configurations, and developing reliable webhook-based integrations. The primary objective is to reduce manual effort, improve pipeline reliability, and streamline configurations across 40+ repositories. Responsibilities Administer, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Jenkins environments, including jobs, pipelines, plugins, credentials, agents/nodes, and build execution. Develop, optimize, and maintain Jenkins pipelines using Jenkinsfiles and Groovy scripting. Ensure reliable pipeline execution and efficient build and deployment workflows. Configure and maintain GitLab integrations with Jenkins, enabling automated pipeline triggers through webhooks and repository events. Configure and troubleshoot webhook delivery from GitLab to multiple downstream Jenkins pipelines. Develop or maintain intermediary services such as RelayProxy, or configure suitable tunneling and routing tools where required. Develop and maintain Terraform configurations to automate repository-related setup and configuration migration from Gerrit to GitLab. Use GitLab REST APIs and scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or Go to automate configurations, validate migrations, and reduce repetitive manual work. Execute and validate automated configuration changes across 40+ repositories, improving operational efficiency and reducing manual intervention. Diagnose Jenkins build failures, webhook delivery issues, plugin conflicts, agent connectivity problems, authentication errors, and CI/CD integration bottlenecks. Maintain technical documentation, automation scripts, and troubleshooting procedures while ensuring reliable day-to-day CI/CD operations. Requirements 6-9 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, CI/CD engineering, build and release automation, or Jenkins administration. Strong hands-on expertise in Jenkins administration, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting in production environments. Experience creating and maintaining Jenkins pipelines using Jenkinsfiles and Groovy. Strong understanding of Jenkins architecture, controller-agent configuration, plugins, credentials management, build execution, and pipeline security. Practical experience integrating Jenkins with GitLab using webhooks, repository events, APIs, and authentication mechanisms. Experience troubleshooting pipeline triggers, failed builds, webhook delivery, and connectivity issues. Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, preferably Python, Bash, or Go. Working knowledge of GitLab REST APIs and Git-based repository management. Exposure to Terraform and Infrastructure as Code for configuration automation. Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, network routing, reverse proxies, webhook payloads, and request/response handling. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced engineering environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience migrating CI/CD integrations or repository configurations from Gerrit to GitLab. Experience developing custom webhook relay or proxy services to route events to multiple Jenkins pipelines. Familiarity with Docker, Linux administration, Git, and CI/CD security best practices. Experience managing Jenkins at scale across multiple repositories, teams, or build agents. Experience automating repetitive administrative tasks through APIs and Infrastructure as Code. Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for a Jenkins-first engineer who can administer, optimize, integrate, and troubleshoot CI/CD systems hands-on. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with Jenkins pipelines and GitLab integrations, writing automation scripts, and using Terraform where required. Candidates with strong Jenkins administration and pipeline expertise, supported by practical GitLab integration and automation experience, will be preferred over candidates whose experience is limited to general DevOps operations.

The role owns end-to-end MIS, dashboarding, deep-dive analysis, and predictive/strategic insights partnering with Sales, Credit, Risk, Operations, Collections, Finance, and HR to drive performance, process efficiency, and portfolio quality for the LAP business. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Business & Performance Analytics Deliver and track daily performance and share insights to Sales, business teams, and senior leadership. Provide deep-dive analysis on key metrics yield, NPAs, bounce rates, TATs, and approval/rejection ratios. Build and maintain dashboards covering productivity, business metrics, stage-wise funnel tracking & TAT, and branch-level portfolio analysis. 
 2. P&L & Financial Analysis Track P&L performance against budgets; analyze variances with Finance and provide regular, actionable feedback. 
 3. Risk & Credit Insights Partner closely with Credit and Risk teams to help refine underwriting rules using data. Analyze borrower profiles to optimize approval rates and minimize delinquencies. Conduct regular, extensive quality-of-leads and approval/rejection analysis. Conduct foreclosure analysis and share insights with business and leadership. Leverage bureau data (CIBIL/CRIF) for opportunity assessment and benchmarking at alocation/branch level. Leverage alternate data sources (GST, bank statements, property valuation) for deeper credit and risk insights. 
 4. Customer & Channel Analytics Segment customers using demographic, financial, and behavioral data to drive targeting and engagement. Analyze channel partner, productivity, and quality of sourcing to support channel optimization. Own payout and incentive data support/reconciliation; generate insights and design data- backed contests to improve productivity and activation. Oversee EMI-calling allocation and track feedback for insights 
 5. Manpower, Hiring Workforce Analytics Own manpower mapping at case-level and branch-level, with regular reconciliation. Own hiring analysis and insights on a regular basis to support workforce planning. 
 6. Product & Pricing Strategy Evaluate pricing effectiveness using portfolio performance data and competitor benchmarking. Analyze the impact of product changes on conversion, risk, and profitability. 
 7. Process & Funnel Optimization Use funnel data to identify drop-offs and TAT issues across the digital LOS/LMS journey. Recommend workflow enhancements using data, to improve user experience and reduce operational friction. Validate data flow for any new system feature and reconcile backend data Drive field additions in systems to reduce manual data-gathering effort. Drive MIS automation for recurring reports and dashboards to reduce manual effort. 
 8. Leaderboards, Scorecards & Predictive Models Create leaderboards and scorecards at various levels productivity, login, hiring, and approval rates/quality of sourcing. Build models to define targets and run prediction analysis 
 9. Alternate Data Analysis Leverage alternate data sources (GST, bank statements, bureau data, property valuation) for deeper business and credit insights. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor /Master's degree from reputed institution 2-4 years of analytics experience in lending ideally with a Fintech, NBFC, or Digital Lending platform. Strong command of SQL and Python for data analysis and modeling. Experience with BI tools like Power BI or Tableau. Understanding of LAP-specific metrics (LTV, FOIR, delinquency buckets, etc.). Exposure to LOS/LMS/lending systems. Strong business acumen, with the ability to convert data into strategy. Experience working in agile, cross-functional product and tech environments.

title: Canada- Model validation RFP
description:
The Model Risk Management (MRM) provides oversight for the MRM Framework, which consists of the policy, processes, and procedures. The Quant Analyst - Model Risk Management (MRM) will be responsible for conducting independent model validations for the assigned models to ensure models align with business objectives and design objectives. Verify that models are performing as expected, identify potential limitations, which includes assessing potential impact. Perform annual reviews and review the on-going monitoring reports to ensure that the models are performing as intended. Key Responsibilities Comprehensive Model Validation: Conduct thorough and comprehensive validations of various model components, ensuring that they are accurate, reliable, and aligned with the intended business objectives and regulatory requirements. This includes but is not limited to: Model Inputs Analysis: Apply data analysis techniques to assess the quality, integrity, and appropriateness of data used in the models. Examine data extraction, cleaning, transformation processes, and evaluate data-related assumptions and limitations. Model Conceptual Evaluation: Scrutinize the model design and construction, verifying the suitability of the modeling framework and theory for the intended use. Review model segmentation, variable selection, model testing procedures, and evaluation model assumptions, limitations, and risks. Model Code Review and Replication: Review model code to ensure correctness, accuracy, and absence of material errors. Collaborate with model developers to address any identified issues. Outcomes Analysis: Assess both in-sample and out-of-sample back test results; evaluate sensitivity and scenario testing, stress testing, benchmark model development, and quantitative and business performance metrics. Challenger Model Development (if required) Risk Identification and Mitigation: Provide effective challenges and identify potential model risks. Recommend appropriate mitigation measures and enhancements to improve model quality and compliance with regulatory standards. Ongoing Monitoring and Outcome Analysis: Assess the mechanisms for ongoing model performance monitoring, issue identification, and risk management to ensure effective oversight, policy compliance. Ensure that the model remains reliable, relevant, and compliant throughout its lifecycle, this includes review risk mitigation measures, compensating controls, and risk acceptances. Documentation and Reporting: Produce high-quality, comprehensive validation reports that clearly communicate findings, recommendations, and potential risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ensure that validation documentation adheres to internal standards and regulatory requirements (SR11-7). Review and upgradation of MRM policies and Procedures annually, with new trends Audit and Regulatory Review Support: Assist in gathering and providing materials requested by internal audit and regulators, drafting responses to questions, and defending validations in exams. Continuous Learning and Improvement: Stay up to date with emerging trends and best practices in model validation and regulatory requirements. Contribute to the enhancement of the model validation framework by suggesting process improvements and implementing industry-leading methodologies. Develop and maintain model governance documentation and performance monitoring, including periodically presenting results to MRM stakeholders. Interact with all key stakeholders including model users, model owners, vendors, Model Risk Governance, and other Validators throughout the model lifecycle including validation, ongoing performance evaluation. Build relationships across model owners, data scientists, Model Risk Management, Audit, and third-party vendors. Use subject matter expertise and analytics to proactively identify and address gaps and identify emerging risks. Contribute towards remediation efforts for model-related issues identified through exams, audits, and model validations.

DataZymes is a data analytics company delivering actionable intelligence and digital solutions. We are setting up a brand-new Digital Product Centre of Excellence (COE) in Bengaluru to design, build and scale AI-native enterprise products.

The Role
We are hiring a hands-on Digital Product Architect to build our Digital Product COE from zero to one. You will define the technical vision, build the engineering team from the ground up, and stay hands-on in the code. You will architect enterprise-scale applications that combine full-stack engineering (Java / .NET, React / Angular) with Generative AI (LLMs, RAG, AI agents, Vector and Graph databases).

Key Responsibilities
• COE Setup & Leadership: Set up the Digital Product COE. Hire, mentor and lead a team of full-stack engineers and AI engineers. Define coding standards, CI/CD pipelines and Agile delivery practices.
• Solution Architecture: Design scalable, secure microservices architecture for high-volume data workloads and real-time AI inference.
• Hands-on Full Stack Development: Write production code across the stack. Build backends in Java (Spring Boot) and/or .NET Core (C#), and frontends in React and/or Angular.
• Generative AI & LLM Integration: Build AI-driven applications using LLMs such as Claude, Gemini and GPT-4. Design and build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines on enterprise data.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Work with Product Managers, Data Scientists and leadership to turn business needs into technical blueprints and ship products.

Must-Have Skills
• 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 3–5 years as a Solution Architect / Technical Architect / Technical Lead
• Hands-on expertise in Java (Spring Boot, Hibernate) OR .NET (C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET)
• Hands-on expertise in React OR Angular, with TypeScript
• Hands-on Generative AI experience: built and deployed RAG pipelines and LLM-based applications in production
• Experience with LangChain (or LangGraph / LlamaIndex / Semantic Kernel)
• Experience with at least one Vector Database: Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector or FAISS
• Strong knowledge of Microservices, RESTful APIs and Event-Driven Architecture
• Cloud experience on AWS, Azure or GCP, plus Docker and Kubernetes
• Track record of building enterprise SaaS platforms or data-heavy applications from scratch

Good-to-Have Skills
• Hands-on in both Java and .NET, and both React and Angular
• Graph Databases: Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Knowledge Graphs

• LLM APIs: OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini
• gRPC, Kafka, Redux / NgRx, Tailwind / Material UI
• Experience in life sciences, pharma or healthcare analytics
• Experience setting up an engineering team or COE

Who You Are

title: Canada- Model validation RFP
description:
The Model Risk Management (MRM) provides oversight for the MRM Framework, which consists of the policy, processes, and procedures. The Quant Analyst - Model Risk Management (MRM) will be responsible for conducting independent model validations for the assigned models to ensure models align with business objectives and design objectives. Verify that models are performing as expected, identify potential limitations, which includes assessing potential impact. Perform annual reviews and review the on-going monitoring reports to ensure that the models are performing as intended. Key Responsibilities Comprehensive Model Validation: Conduct thorough and comprehensive validations of various model components, ensuring that they are accurate, reliable, and aligned with the intended business objectives and regulatory requirements. This includes but is not limited to: Model Inputs Analysis: Apply data analysis techniques to assess the quality, integrity, and appropriateness of data used in the models. Examine data extraction, cleaning, transformation processes, and evaluate data-related assumptions and limitations. Model Conceptual Evaluation: Scrutinize the model design and construction, verifying the suitability of the modeling framework and theory for the intended use. Review model segmentation, variable selection, model testing procedures, and evaluation model assumptions, limitations, and risks. Model Code Review and Replication: Review model code to ensure correctness, accuracy, and absence of material errors. Collaborate with model developers to address any identified issues. Outcomes Analysis: Assess both in-sample and out-of-sample back test results; evaluate sensitivity and scenario testing, stress testing, benchmark model development, and quantitative and business performance metrics. Challenger Model Development (if required) Risk Identification and Mitigation: Provide effective challenges and identify potential model risks. Recommend appropriate mitigation measures and enhancements to improve model quality and compliance with regulatory standards. Ongoing Monitoring and Outcome Analysis: Assess the mechanisms for ongoing model performance monitoring, issue identification, and risk management to ensure effective oversight, policy compliance. Ensure that the model remains reliable, relevant, and compliant throughout its lifecycle, this includes review risk mitigation measures, compensating controls, and risk acceptances. Documentation and Reporting: Produce high-quality, comprehensive validation reports that clearly communicate findings, recommendations, and potential risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ensure that validation documentation adheres to internal standards and regulatory requirements (SR11-7). Review and upgradation of MRM policies and Procedures annually, with new trends Audit and Regulatory Review Support: Assist in gathering and providing materials requested by internal audit and regulators, drafting responses to questions, and defending validations in exams. Continuous Learning and Improvement: Stay up to date with emerging trends and best practices in model validation and regulatory requirements. Contribute to the enhancement of the model validation framework by suggesting process improvements and implementing industry-leading methodologies. Develop and maintain model governance documentation and performance monitoring, including periodically presenting results to MRM stakeholders. Interact with all key stakeholders including model users, model owners, vendors, Model Risk Governance, and other Validators throughout the model lifecycle including validation, ongoing performance evaluation. Build relationships across model owners, data scientists, Model Risk Management, Audit, and third-party vendors. Use subject matter expertise and analytics to proactively identify and address gaps and identify emerging risks. Contribute towards remediation efforts for model-related issues identified through exams, audits, and model validations.

title: Manager, Quality Assurance (Supplier & Product Quality)
description: Role Overview AerX Labs is seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Manager to oversee end-to-end quality across supplier-manufactured components, incoming materials, in-house assembly, testing and final product acceptance. The role will initially focus on industrial equipment and integrated cart/trailer systems involving fabricated chassis, sheet-metal enclosures, mechanical assemblies, electrical systems, piping, hoses and other bought-out components. The candidate will be responsible for establishing and implementing robust quality processes, ensuring supplier compliance with engineering specifications and maintaining consistent product quality through final inspection and dispatch. Key Responsibilities 1. Supplier Quality Assurance (SQA) Evaluate, qualify and periodically audit suppliers and subcontractors. Ensure supplier compliance with approved drawings, specifications, materials and manufacturing processes. Conduct First Article Inspections (FAI) for newly developed components and assemblies. Monitor supplier quality performance and coordinate corrective actions. Review material certificates, welding records, dimensional inspection reports and coating specifications. Conduct supplier-site inspections at critical manufacturing stages. 2. Incoming Quality Control (IQC) Establish incoming inspection procedures and acceptance criteria. Inspect fabricated structures, sheet-metal parts, machined components and bought-out items. Verify dimensions, tolerances, material specifications, surface finishes and workmanship. Maintain inspection records and ensure traceability. Identify, segregate and document nonconforming materials. 3. In-Process and Final Product Quality Define and implement Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) for assembly and integration. Monitor quality during mechanical assembly, electrical integration and functional testing. Verify critical interfaces, mounting arrangements, piping, wiring and installation workmanship. Coordinate final inspections and Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT). Ensure product compliance with customer specifications before dispatch. 4. Quality Management System (QMS) Develop and maintain quality procedures, inspection checklists and acceptance documentation. Implement ISO 9001-aligned quality management practices. Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCR), Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). Maintain calibration records for inspection and measuring equipment. Support customer inspections, quality audits and product acceptance activities. Drive continuous improvement and reduction of supplier and manufacturing defects. Required Technical Competencies Strong understanding of engineering drawings, GD&T and dimensional tolerances. Experience with sheet-metal fabrication, welding, machining, structural assemblies and surface treatments. Familiarity with welding inspection, coating inspection and material certification. Hands-on knowledge of inspection instruments and measurement techniques. Working knowledge of ISO 9001:2015, FAI, NCR, CAPA, 8D and 5 Why analysis. Experience preparing inspection reports, quality plans, checklists and FAT documentation. Ability to coordinate effectively with Engineering, Procurement, Production and external suppliers. Preferred Experience Industrial machinery, fabricated equipment, automotive, commercial vehicles, trailers, aerospace ground-support equipment or similar manufacturing industries. Supplier development and quality management of outsourced fabrication vendors. Experience managing quality across low-volume, high-value engineered products. ISO 9001 Internal Auditor certification. Familiarity with APQP, PPAP, welding standards and NDT processes. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Supplier defect and rejection rates. First-pass acceptance of incoming components. Reduction in assembly rework and nonconformances. Timely closure of NCRs and corrective actions. First-pass success rate during FAT. Completeness of inspection and product quality records. Reduction in customer complaints and post-delivery quality issues. Reporting and Authority The position will report to the Head of Operations / CEO, with independent authority over quality acceptance. The Quality Assurance Manager will have the authority to reject nonconforming materials, hold production activities and prevent dispatch of products that do not meet approved quality requirements. Candidate Profile We are looking for a hands-on manufacturing quality professional , comfortable working on the shop floor, visiting suppliers, interpreting engineering drawings and resolving practical manufacturing quality issues. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently establishing and managing the quality function in a growing engineering and manufacturing organization, rather than focusing solely on documentation or audits.

title: Growth Analytics Manager
description:
Role Purpose Haleon Indias e-commerce business is a priority growth lever, and the Growth Analytics Manager is the person who turns our platform and market data into decisions. The role owns the business intelligence layer for DCommerce: platform-level dashboards, city-level reporting and daily market share tracking across marketplaces, quick commerce and e-pharma for all brands. This is not a reporting/ data analytics role. The Growth Analytics Manager defines what we measure, makes sure the numbers can be trusted, and tells the business what to do next. What Will The Person Own Platform dashboards: one consistent, decision-ready dashboard view per platform (offtake units, MRP value, NSV, share, availability, pricing), with brand, subcategory, SKU and NPI cuts built in. City-level reporting: city and cluster views of QCom and marketplace performance, so we can see where we are winning or losing, not just how we are doing nationally; and actionability on pincodes/ RPI with strongly correlated inputs of promos and visibility Daily market share view: brand and subcategory share, built from platform external analytics, tracked daily with clear trend and exception flags. Metric definitions and data trust: the single set of KPI definitions for DCom (including multipack and virtual combo treatment, and platform-specific quirks such as Amazon Core, Fresh and Now), and sign-off on every dashboard before it reaches leadership. Key Responsibilities Business Intelligence: Design, platform dashboards in Power BI (or equivalent) on top of the clean data layer provided by the Data Analyst; own the business logic, visuals and usability. Build the analytics reporting module within the existing DCom dashboard: platform views, NPI tracking shown separately from base business, multipack and combo views. Maintain a dashboard release and QC checklist so that numbers reconcile across offtake, MRP, NSV and platform-reported views. City-Level Market Share Intelligence: Build city-level views of share, offtake, availability and pricing, using the city and pincode mapping on external data. Identify under-indexed cities and clusters by brand and platform, and convert them into specific actions (assortment, availability, visibility, activation). Track daily share movements at brand and subcategory level; flag material shifts, competitor moves and root causes within the same week. Insight to Action: Run weekly, monthly and quarterly performance reviews: what happened, why, and what we should do about it, with owners and follow-up on actions. Deliver brand and platform deep dives that lead to a decision (for example share erosion in a subcategory, OOS impact on a hero SKU, or a pricing gap versus competition). Partner with Digital Shelf to bring shopper research into the business narrative, so reviews combine the numbers with the shopper reasons behind them. Promo, Pricing Growth Analytics: Own promo effectiveness analytics for e-commerce: uplift, ROI and cannibalisation by platform and brand. Manage the promo planning file and its platform-wise splits, so one master plan is adapted and shared correctly with each platform. Planning Strategy Support: Support the annual and quarterly planning cycle with baselines, scenario models and growth lever sizing by brand, platform and city tier. Contribute to channel mix and competitor benchmarking so strategy is anchored on external facts as well as our own data. Skillsets Must have 3-6 years in business analysis, e-commerce analytics, category management or BI, ideally in FMCG or consumer health. Strong Power BI (or Tableau) skills: you have built dashboards end to end, including data modelling and DAX or equivalent, not just consumed them. Advanced Excel (Power Query, complex modelling) and working SQL; Python is a plus. Sound understanding of Indian e-commerce and quick commerce: how offtake, share, availability and pricing behave across platforms. A structured storytelling habit: you move from what happened, to why, to what we should do, and you can defend the number in the room. Comfortable questioning data: you spot anomalies and push back on numbers that do not reconcile. Good to have Experience with digital shelf or market share tools such as Gobblecube, NIQ, Profitero or similar. Exposure to promo analytics, pricing or RGM-style analysis. City or geo-level analysis experience (pincode, dark store or cluster mapping). Prior experience supporting annual planning or QBR cycles.

title: Data Operations Executive
description:
Job Summary: 
 We are seeking a Data Operations Executive to support business and operational teams through effective data management, data quality control, reporting, and automation support. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of data handling, data scrubbing, address standardization, reporting processes, and operational workflows, along with working knowledge of SQL, Python, and Excel VBA-based automation. The role involves managing day-to-day data operations, ensuring data accuracy and quality, executing automated processes, preparing reports, troubleshooting data-related issues, and coordinating with internal stakeholders to support smooth business operations. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Data & Operational Support 
 Support daily data, MIS, and reporting requirements for business and operations teams. Extract, validate, reconcile, and analyze data from multiple sources. Perform data scrubbing, cleansing, standardization, and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency. Execute address scrubbing and address standardization activities to improve data quality, accuracy, and serviceability. Identify duplicate, incomplete, inaccurate, or inconsistent records and perform corrective actions as per defined processes. Ensure data integrity, quality, and completeness across operational databases and reporting systems. Identify data discrepancies and coordinate with relevant teams for timely resolution. Support bulk data correction, enrichment, and maintenance activities as required. Monitor operational activities and ensure adherence to defined SLAs and processes. 
 Automation & Process Efficiency: 
 Execute, monitor, and maintain existing automation solutions developed using: SQL Python Excel VBA Perform basic troubleshooting and minor enhancements to automation scripts, queries, and macros. Support automation initiatives aimed at reducing manual effort and improving operational efficiency. Ensure automated reports and workflows are executed successfully and delivered on schedule. Identify opportunities for process improvements through automation and standardization. 
 Reporting & Documentation 
 Prepare and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly operational and MIS reports. Validate report accuracy and completeness before publication. Ensure reports are delivered within agreed timelines and formats. Maintain and update documentation related to reports, automation processes, SOPs, and support activities. Assist in creating dashboards and management reports as required. 
 Communication & Stakeholder Coordination 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for data, reporting, and operational support requests. Coordinate with internal teams to resolve operational and data-related issues. Provide timely updates on open issues, incidents, and support requests. Escalate critical issues appropriately and ensure effective follow-through until closure. Maintain professional communication with stakeholders across functions. 
 Required Skills & Competencies: 
 Strong understanding of data handling, data validation, and reporting processes. Good understanding of data quality management, including: Data scrubbing and cleansing Deduplication Address standardization and validation Data reconciliation Working knowledge of: SQL (queries, data extraction, data validation, and basic automation) Python (executing and understanding automation scripts) Excel VBA (running and maintaining macros) Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including: Advanced formulas Pivot Tables Lookup functions (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP) Data validation Reporting and analysis Experience working with large datasets and operational databases. 
 Communication & Soft Skills: 
 Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong coordination and stakeholder management abilities. Excellent attention to detail and analytical thinking. Ability to manage multiple tasks in a process-driven environment. Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills. Proactive approach toward issue identification and resolution. Educational Qualification: 
 Minimum Qualification: Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC / 12th Pass). Graduation in any discipline will be considered an added advantage but is not mandatory. Candidates with relevant experience, technical skills, and strong operational aptitude will be considered regardless of educational background. Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience in MIS, data operations, reporting, data quality, or operations support roles. Exposure to BI and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Experience working in SLA-driven support environments. Familiarity with process documentation, SOP management, and operational governance. Experience with automation-driven process improvements. Exposure to address validation, customer master data management, or data quality projects will be an advantage.
