description:
Job Title: Senior Mobility Telecom, Network Operations & Major Incident Lead 
 Experience Required : 10+ years of relevant experience in enterprise network operations, telecom infrastructure support, major incident management, service operations or a comparable global production-support environment . 
 Role Purpose: - The Senior Mobility Telecom, Network Operations & Major Incident Lead will provide end-to-end technical and operational leadership for a global retail telecom and network environment supporting Mobility and E-Mobility services . 
 The role will act as a senior technical authority and operational integrator across internal support teams, network and telecom suppliers, application teams, service providers, business stakeholders and incident-management functions. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining network stability, leading the resolution of complex incidents, coordinating major incidents, overseeing infrastructure changes, driving root-cause analysis and improving the overall reliability, security and performance of the service. The role requires strong ownership across a highly integrated support landscape where telecom, network, payment, loyalty, site systems and central applications cannot be managed as isolated service components. 
 Key Accountabilities:- 1. Global Telecom and Network Operations. 2. Incident and Major Incident Management. 3. Advanced Troubleshooting and Technical Investigation. 4. Root-Cause and Problem Management. 5. Change, Migration and Implementation Support. 6. Network Architecture and Design Assurance. 7. Firewall, Security and Access Governance. 8. Supplier and Stakeholder Management. 9. Monitoring and Service Improvement. 10. Documentation and Operational Readiness. 11. Team Leadership and Capability Development. 12. Reporting and Executive Communication. 
 Mandatory Experience The successful candidate should demonstrate: A minimum of 10 year's experience in enterprise telecom, network engineering, network operations, infrastructure operations or a closely related discipline. Significant experience supporting large, business-critical, geographically distributed production environments. Strong operational experience with enterprise routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs and network-security technologies. Advanced troubleshooting experience across multiple infrastructure and application layers. Practical experience using packet-capture or network-sniffer tools for protocol-level troubleshooting. Experience with multiple routing protocols and complex interconnected networks. Experience leading high-priority incidents and coordinating technical recovery across multiple resolver groups. Experience working with external telecom providers, managed-service suppliers and third-party technology vendors. Experience conducting Root Cause Analysis and managing corrective and preventive actions. Experience assessing, planning and supporting infrastructure changes, migrations and implementations. Experience reviewing network architecture and technical designs. Experience producing detailed technical, operational and process documentation. Experience supporting 24x7 production services and participating in on-call arrangements. Experience leading technical meetings and communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Working knowledge of Unix/Linux and Windows operating environments. Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and network-diagramming tools such as Visio. 
 The contracts network-engineering description calls for senior Cisco router, switch and firewall expertise, Unix/Linux and Windows knowledge, packet-level troubleshooting, routing-protocol experience, network design, documentation, project management and international-team experience. Preferred Experience The following experience would be advantageous: Retail, forecourt, payment, loyalty, mobility or E-Mobility technology environments. Payment-related or PCI-controlled network environments. Global multi-site connectivity supporting large numbers of distributed locations. Major Incident Management within an ITIL-aligned service organization. ServiceNow or a comparable enterprise service-management platform. Network and application monitoring platforms such as SolarWinds and Dynatrace. Zscaler or comparable secure-access and network-security services. Data-centre network infrastructure and controlled third-party access. User Access Management processes for external or business-critical applications. Operational support for services spanning network, site systems, payment platforms, loyalty platforms and central applications. Supplier-performance management within a multi-vendor operating model. Project management or technical workstream leadership. Network automation, operational analytics or monitoring automation. 
 These preferences reflect technologies and operational activities directly named in the scope, including SolarWinds, Dynatrace, Zscaler, ServiceNow-related ticketing, data-center access, UAM and multi-supplier service integration. Technical Competencies Enterprise routing and switching Firewall and network-security management VPN and secure connectivity Packet capture and traffic analysis Network architecture and design review Telecom and carrier-service operations Network and application monitoring Incident and Major Incident Management Problem Management and Root Cause Analysis Change and release risk assessment ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms Unix/Linux and Windows operating systems Technical documentation and network diagrams Data-centre network operations Third-party access and infrastructure governance PCI and information-risk support Supplier and vendor technical management Operational reporting and service improvement Behavioural Competencies:- End-to-end ownership: Takes accountability from issue identification through service restoration, documentation and preventive action. Calm under pressure: Leads complex technical situations effectively during high-impact incidents. Analytical thinking: Uses technical evidence and operational data to isolate faults and validate conclusions. Attention to detail: Maintains accuracy across configurations, tickets,communications and technical documentation. Stakeholder awareness: Adapts communication to technical teams, suppliers, service managers and business leadership. Supplier assertiveness: Challenges suppliers constructively and drives delivery against agreed obligations. Collaboration: Works effectively across geographical, organisational and supplier boundaries. Decision-making: Makes risk-based technical and operational decisions with incomplete but evolving information. Continuous improvement: Identifies recurring weaknesses and converts operational learning into sustainable improvements. Communication: Produces clear, concise and professional written and verbal communications in English. Leadership: Coaches team members, establishes standards and creates clarity during complex situations. Customer and business focus: Understands how telecom and infrastructure disruptions affect retail sites, customers and business services. Education and Certifications:- Essential: - Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Electronics, Engineering or an equivalent technical discipline . Equivalent significant professional experience may be considered where permitted by the organizations recruitment policy. 
 Preferred: - Cisco professional-level certification or comparable enterprise networking certification. ITIL Foundation or higher mandatory . Network-security or firewall certification . Cloud Networking certification . Project management or Agile delivery certification.

title: Principal Architect - Network & Data Infrastructure
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Position Overview We are seeking a Principal Architect - Network & Data Infrastructure to serve as the enterprise design authority for network platforms and lead the definition, governance, and evolution of scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available architectures across LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, and network security domains. The role combines deep hands-on expertise with enterprise-level architectural judgment. The Principal Architect will translate business, application, security, and operational requirements into technology strategies, reference architectures, standards, and roadmaps while acting as the senior technical escalation point for complex network and security challenges. This position will drive modernization, performance optimization, automation, proactive vulnerability management, and operational resilience while influencing engineering, operations, security, application, and business stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Enterprise Architecture & Technology Strategy Define and own enterprise network architecture principles, standards, reference designs, patterns, and multi-year technology roadmaps across LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, and network security platforms. Assess business and technology requirements and translate them into scalable, secure, resilient, and supportable target-state architectures. Lead architecture review boards and design assurance activities, ensuring solutions align with enterprise standards, security requirements, lifecycle strategy, and operational readiness. Provide strategic technical direction for Cisco and Aruba-based solutions and evaluate emerging capabilities for enterprise adoption. Guide technology lifecycle decisions, platform rationalization, technical debt reduction, and modernization priorities. Network Engineering, Design & Optimization Architect high-availability enterprise network solutions using Cisco and Aruba technologies across campus, branch, data center, WAN, SD-WAN, and wireless environments. Own routing architecture and governance for OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP, including resiliency, convergence, scalability, route control, and failure-domain considerations. Architect and optimize Aruba wireless platforms to deliver secure enterprise mobility, reliable coverage, capacity, roaming, and user experience. Define design requirements for availability, redundancy, performance, capacity, quality of service, segmentation, and disaster recovery. Validate complex designs through architecture reviews, risk assessments, design walkthroughs, and implementation readiness checkpoints. Operational Excellence & Incident Leadership Act as the highest-level technical escalation and decision authority for critical, complex, or recurring network incidents. Lead technical root cause analysis for major incidents and ensure corrective and preventive actions address architectural and systemic causes. Partner with operations, security, application, and vendor teams to reduce downtime, improve MTTR, and strengthen service resilience. Identify recurring operational patterns and convert them into engineering standards, automation opportunities, and architectural improvements. Security, Risk & Vulnerability Governance Architect network security controls aligned with enterprise security frameworks, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. Govern vulnerability identification, risk assessment, remediation strategy, exception handling, and lifecycle management using tools such as Rapid7, Nessus, or Qualys. Define and review network hardening, patching, segmentation, access control, compliance, and quality-of-service standards. Provide architecture-level risk assessments and remediation recommendations for legacy platforms, unsupported technologies, and high-risk designs. Monitoring, Automation & Continuous Improvement Define enterprise monitoring, telemetry, observability, alerting, and performance baselines using SolarWinds, and related monitoring platforms. Drive network performance analytics, trend analysis, capacity planning, service health reporting, and proactive optimization. Set direction for network automation, configuration standardization, compliance validation, and repeatable engineering practices. Promote scripting and automation frameworks that improve reliability, consistency, delivery speed, and operational efficiency. Documentation, Governance & Stakeholder Engagement Maintain architecture documentation, technology standards, reference designs, decision records, high-level designs, and governance artifacts. Provide executive-level reporting on network health, architecture risks, vulnerability posture, lifecycle exposure, and strategic improvement initiatives. Present complex technical concepts, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Mentor architects and senior engineers, build technical capability, and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority. Partner with technology vendors and service providers on solution strategy, design quality, roadmap alignment, and issue resolution. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Relevant professional certifications and equivalent experience may be considered. Experience 15+ years of progressive experience designing, engineering, and architecting enterprise-scale network environments. Demonstrated experience operating as a Principal Architect, Lead Architect, enterprise design authority, or equivalent senior technical leader. Proven ownership of enterprise architecture standards, complex solution designs, technology roadmaps, and architecture governance. Hands-on experience leading critical incident resolution, root cause analysis, modernization programs, and cross-functional technical decisions. Technical Expertise Advanced expertise in Cisco switching, routing, wireless, and SD-WAN platforms. Strong command of OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP in large-scale, highly available enterprise environments. Deep knowledge of Aruba wireless architectures, design, security, capacity, and optimization techniques. Enterprise network architecture across LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, segmentation, resiliency, and quality of service. Experience with vulnerability management and security assessment platforms such as Rapid7, Nessus, or Qualys. Proficiency with enterprise monitoring and performance tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, and Fluke. Working knowledge of network automation frameworks, APIs, configuration management, and scripting. Ability to develop and review architecture standards, high-level designs, low-level designs, and technical decision records. Preferred Certifications Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) Aruba Certified Mobility Associate (ACMA) Aruba Certified SD-WAN Deployment Professional (ACSDP) Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) or equivalent expert-level certification is an advantage Leadership & Professional Skills Enterprise-level architectural thinking with strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making capability. Ability to communicate complex designs, risks, and trade-offs to engineering teams, leadership, and business stakeholders. Proven technical leadership during high-severity incidents, transformation initiatives, and architecture governance discussions. Ability to influence stakeholders, establish technical direction, and drive alignment without direct authority. Strong collaboration, mentoring, documentation, presentation, and vendor-management skills. Ability to balance strategic architecture ownership with hands-on technical engagement when required. Architecture Leadership : Enterprise network strategy, reference architectures, standards, and design governance Technology Depth: Cisco and Aruba networking, routing, SD-WAN, wireless, monitoring, and security Operational Resilience : Major incident leadership, RCA, performance, capacity, and service continuity Risk Governance : Security architecture, vulnerability remediation, lifecycle risk, hardening, and compliance Transformation : Modernization, automation, standardization, optimization, and technical debt reduction Influence : Executive communication, stakeholder alignment, mentoring, and cross-functional leadership

 Experience

 Must have

title: Canada- Model validation RFP
description:
The Model Risk Management (MRM) provides oversight for the MRM Framework, which consists of the policy, processes, and procedures. The Quant Analyst - Model Risk Management (MRM) will be responsible for conducting independent model validations for the assigned models to ensure models align with business objectives and design objectives. Verify that models are performing as expected, identify potential limitations, which includes assessing potential impact. Perform annual reviews and review the on-going monitoring reports to ensure that the models are performing as intended. Key Responsibilities Comprehensive Model Validation: Conduct thorough and comprehensive validations of various model components, ensuring that they are accurate, reliable, and aligned with the intended business objectives and regulatory requirements. This includes but is not limited to: Model Inputs Analysis: Apply data analysis techniques to assess the quality, integrity, and appropriateness of data used in the models. Examine data extraction, cleaning, transformation processes, and evaluate data-related assumptions and limitations. Model Conceptual Evaluation: Scrutinize the model design and construction, verifying the suitability of the modeling framework and theory for the intended use. Review model segmentation, variable selection, model testing procedures, and evaluation model assumptions, limitations, and risks. Model Code Review and Replication: Review model code to ensure correctness, accuracy, and absence of material errors. Collaborate with model developers to address any identified issues. Outcomes Analysis: Assess both in-sample and out-of-sample back test results; evaluate sensitivity and scenario testing, stress testing, benchmark model development, and quantitative and business performance metrics. Challenger Model Development (if required) Risk Identification and Mitigation: Provide effective challenges and identify potential model risks. Recommend appropriate mitigation measures and enhancements to improve model quality and compliance with regulatory standards. Ongoing Monitoring and Outcome Analysis: Assess the mechanisms for ongoing model performance monitoring, issue identification, and risk management to ensure effective oversight, policy compliance. Ensure that the model remains reliable, relevant, and compliant throughout its lifecycle, this includes review risk mitigation measures, compensating controls, and risk acceptances. Documentation and Reporting: Produce high-quality, comprehensive validation reports that clearly communicate findings, recommendations, and potential risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ensure that validation documentation adheres to internal standards and regulatory requirements (SR11-7). Review and upgradation of MRM policies and Procedures annually, with new trends Audit and Regulatory Review Support: Assist in gathering and providing materials requested by internal audit and regulators, drafting responses to questions, and defending validations in exams. Continuous Learning and Improvement: Stay up to date with emerging trends and best practices in model validation and regulatory requirements. Contribute to the enhancement of the model validation framework by suggesting process improvements and implementing industry-leading methodologies. Develop and maintain model governance documentation and performance monitoring, including periodically presenting results to MRM stakeholders. Interact with all key stakeholders including model users, model owners, vendors, Model Risk Governance, and other Validators throughout the model lifecycle including validation, ongoing performance evaluation. Build relationships across model owners, data scientists, Model Risk Management, Audit, and third-party vendors. Use subject matter expertise and analytics to proactively identify and address gaps and identify emerging risks. Contribute towards remediation efforts for model-related issues identified through exams, audits, and model validations.

 As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AI & ML Data Collection, you will play a critical role in building and scaling the companys Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform, enabling standardized, reliable, and scalable machine learning capabilities across the organization. This role will focus on transforming existing AI/ML and LLM-driven data systems into a cohesive platform that supports data pipelines, model lifecycle management, evaluation frameworks, and production deployment. This position requires deep hands-on expertise in machine learning engineering, LLM-based systems, ML platform development, and MLOps. You will work closely with ML engineers, product managers, researchers, and business stakeholders to deliver production-ready AI/ML systems aligned with broader business objectives and AI/ML strategy. You will be deeply involved in the design, development, and operationalization of platform components, including data ingestion, feature management, model training and evaluation, scalable inference systems, and model observability capabilities. You will help ensure that AI/ML systems are production-ready, observable, maintainable, and cost-efficient, with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, governance, and developer productivity. You will leverage your expertise in areas such as large language models (LLM), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and ML Operations (MLOps). You will contribute to the end-to-end lifecycle of ML systems, from experimentation and prototyping to deployment, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement while mentoring engineers and promoting strong engineering practices across the team. Team Overview You will be part of a multidisciplinary team of ML engineers responsible for building and maintaining the Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform. title: Senior Cybersecurity Research Engineer / Security Researcher
description:
About the Company Turtleneck Systems & Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a 100% Indian cybersecurity startup delivering next-generation security solutions for private industries, government organizations, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), and defense establishments. The organization is ISO 9001:2015 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and incubated with DSC. Turtleneck focuses on developing advanced cybersecurity capabilities to address evolving security challenges across enterprise and government environments. 
 What Were Looking For We are looking for a curious, technically rigorous professional who can work with complex systems and explore challenging security problems. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical thinking with practical engineering skills to translate research into actionable findings, reusable tools, proof-of-concepts, and meaningful cybersecurity capabilities. Join Turtleneck Systems & Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and contribute to the research and development of next-generation cybersecurity solutions. 
 Job Overview Job Title: Senior Cybersecurity Research Engineer / Security Researcher Company: Turtleneck Systems & Solutions Pvt. Ltd. Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh Experience: 25 Years Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent Industry: Computer and Network Security Department: Cybersecurity / Security Research Vacancies: 1 Salary: Best in Industry 
 Role Summary We are looking for a technically proficient and research-oriented cybersecurity professional with expertise in security research, vulnerability analysis, AI security, reverse engineering, cloud security, and operating-system internals. The ideal candidate will be responsible for investigating emerging security threats, analyzing complex systems, researching vulnerabilities, developing proof-of-concept implementations, and building tools that strengthen next-generation cybersecurity capabilities. This role is suited for individuals who enjoy solving complex technical problems, exploring emerging technologies, and translating research findings into practical security solutions. 
 Key Roles and Responsibilities 
 1. Advanced Cybersecurity Research Research emerging cybersecurity threats, attack techniques, vulnerabilities, and security mechanisms. Analyze enterprise technologies and identify potential security weaknesses. Map research findings to established frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and MITRE ATLAS. Prepare technical research reports, security advisories, and proof-of-concept implementations. 
 2. AI and Emerging Technology Security Investigate security risks associated with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and AI-enabled applications. Research prompt injection, jailbreak techniques, RAG poisoning, agentic tool abuse, and multimodal AI security. Contribute to AI-driven security research, automation, and security tooling. 3. Security Framework and Infrastructure Research Evaluate modern security frameworks and infrastructure used in authorized research and adversary simulation. Analyze framework architecture, communication mechanisms, agents, extensions, profiles, and security controls. Identify security weaknesses and opportunities for improving existing research capabilities. 4. Vulnerability and Systems Security Research Investigate memory-safety issues, including stack and heap vulnerabilities, use-after-free conditions, and related weaknesses. Research operating-system security mechanisms, kernel security, and modern mitigation technologies. Develop controlled proof-of-concept implementations to validate findings. Analyze vulnerability chains across applications, operating systems, and enterprise technologies. 5. Reverse Engineering and Malware Analysis Perform static and dynamic analysis of binaries, malware samples, and suspicious software components. Use tools such as Ghidra, IDA Pro, WinDbg, and x64dbg for reverse engineering and debugging. Analyze software behavior and security mechanisms. Develop YARA rules and reusable research artifacts based on analysis findings. 6. Cloud and Infrastructure Security Conduct security research across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Investigate cloud IAM configurations, privilege boundaries, container security, and Kubernetes environments. Analyze CI/CD pipelines, software supply-chain risks, and cloud-native architectures. Identify potential infrastructure weaknesses and recommend security improvements. 7. Application and Document Security Research Investigate vulnerabilities in enterprise applications and commonly used document formats. Research DOCX, RTF, OLE, and related technologies from a security perspective. Analyze publicly disclosed vulnerabilities and emerging enterprise software security issues. Develop controlled proof-of-concept implementations for validated findings. 8. Security Tooling and Proof-of-Concept Development Develop research tools, scripts, utilities, and proof-of-concept implementations using C, C++, Python, Rust, or Go. Apply AI-assisted development techniques to accelerate research and experimentation. Build custom tools when existing solutions do not meet research requirements. Contribute to reusable internal security frameworks and research capabilities. 9. Vulnerability Disclosure and Technical Documentation Research vulnerabilities in security frameworks, enterprise software, and cybersecurity products. Investigate authorization weaknesses, vulnerability chains, remote-code-execution conditions, denial-of-service conditions, and other security-impacting issues. Prepare technical documentation for responsible vulnerability disclosure. Contribute to CVE research, technical advisories, research papers, blogs, and security publications, where applicable. 10. Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Learning Prepare detailed technical reports and executive-level summaries of research findings. Document methodologies, technical observations, proof-of-concept results, impact, and recommendations. Support mentoring and internal knowledge-sharing initiatives. Stay updated on emerging vulnerabilities, cybersecurity research, technologies, and industry developments. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications 
 Experience and Certifications 25 years of experience in cybersecurity, security research, advanced security engineering, or related technical security domains. OSCP or a related certification such as OSEP, OSWE, CRTO, or CRTP. AI Security Research Knowledge of LLM security, prompt injection, the OWASP LLM Top 10, AI agent security, and RAG security. Familiarity with MITRE ATLAS and emerging AI security threats. Cloud and Infrastructure Security Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP. Understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, cloud IAM, CI/CD security, and cloud infrastructure security. Security Research and Adversary Simulation Familiarity with security frameworks and tools such as Mythic, Sliver, Havoc, Cobalt Strike, and BloodHound. Understanding of Active Directory security and related research areas. Memory and Operating-System Security Knowledge of memory corruption, exploit development, shellcode, ROP/JOP, kernel security, and security mitigation analysis. Understanding of Windows and Linux internals, process architecture, PE format, system calls, and kernel debugging. Familiarity with Windows security mechanisms, including Defender, AMSI, ETW, and firewall security. Reverse Engineering and Malware Analysis Experience with Ghidra, IDA Pro, WinDbg, or x64dbg. Understanding of static and dynamic binary analysis, reverse engineering, and malware analysis. Programming and Tool Development Proficiency in one or more of C, C++, Python, Rust, or Go. Ability to develop scripts, utilities, research tools, and proof-of-concept implementations. Security Frameworks Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP, and PTES.

title: Enterprise Integration and Data Architecture Professional
description:
Job Overview The Senior Manager - Enterprise Integration Data Architecture is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining NetSuite integrations, APIs, EDI connections, and data pipelines. The role ensures reliable data exchange, data integrity, and secure connectivity across enterprise systems while supporting distribution, inventory, order processing, and accounting workflows. It also focuses on data governance, legacy system migration, integration monitoring, troubleshooting, and long-term technical ownership to build scalable and efficient business solutions. Duties Responsibilities Design and maintain enterprise integration architecture for APIs, EDI, webhooks, SFTP, files, native connectors, events and batch processing. Define source and target systems, authoritative data boundaries, field mappings, sequencing, validation, error handling, retries, reconciliation, security and support ownership. Maintain architecture diagrams, interface inventories, mapping specifications, decision records and runbooks. Design, build, test, deploy and support integrations between NetSuite and internal or external systems. Work with NetSuite REST web services, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, SuiteScript, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect and token-based authentication, as applicable. Support EDI and API connectivity with customers, distributors, vendors, logistics providers, marketplaces, payment services and websites. Develop mappings and workflows for purchase orders, acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory updates, item data, pricing and order status. Establish enterprise data architecture, data ownership, stewardship, quality rules and lifecycle requirements. Design governed data pipelines, transformation logic, shared definitions and reconciliation processes. Inspect legacy applications, databases, scripts, interfaces, files and automated jobs to identify business rules and technical dependencies. Support data extraction, transformation, mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation and reconciliation. Support NetSuite Analytics Warehouse and related analytics capabilities where adopted. Design trusted data models and pipelines for reporting and ensure they reconcile to source transactions. Develop and execute unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, failure-mode, cutover and reconciliation tests. Implement logging, automated alerts, transaction tracing, exception queues, retry mechanisms and escalation procedures. Troubleshoot production issues and perform root-cause analysis across systems, data, networks, authentication and business rules. Apply security and data protection standards, including source control, code review, automated testing, environment separation, deployment and change control. Own integration standards, data pipelines, technical documentation and long-term architecture improvements. Work with implementation partners, build internal support capability and prioritize technical debt and enhancements. Develop scalable integration patterns that support growth, acquisitions, customer and vendor onboarding, analytics and automation. Education Training The JD does not specify a mandatory degree or formal educational qualification. It requires more than 7 years of enterprise application integration, software engineering, data engineering or related technical experience, along with meaningful hands-on NetSuite integration experience. Candidates should have experience designing, building, testing, deploying and supporting production integrations and data pipelines. Experience with a full range of integration technologies and data migration processes is important. Preferred experience includes Oracle Integration Cloud, NetSuite integration technologies, EDI, cloud data platforms and legacy application modernization. description:
Job Overview The Senior Manager - Enterprise Integration Data Architecture is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining NetSuite integrations, APIs, EDI connections, and data pipelines. The role ensures reliable data exchange, data integrity, and secure connectivity across enterprise systems while supporting distribution, inventory, order processing, and accounting workflows. It also focuses on data governance, legacy system migration, integration monitoring, troubleshooting, and long-term technical ownership to build scalable and efficient business solutions. Duties Responsibilities Design and maintain enterprise integration architecture for APIs, EDI, webhooks, SFTP, files, native connectors, events and batch processing. Define source and target systems, authoritative data boundaries, field mappings, sequencing, validation, error handling, retries, reconciliation, security and support ownership. Maintain architecture diagrams, interface inventories, mapping specifications, decision records and runbooks. Work with NetSuite REST web services, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, SuiteScript, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect and token-based authentication, as applicable. Support EDI and API connectivity with customers, distributors, vendors, logistics providers, marketplaces, payment services and websites. Design governed data pipelines, transformation logic, shared definitions and reconciliation processes. Inspect legacy applications, databases, scripts, interfaces, files and automated jobs to identify business rules and technical dependencies. Support data extraction, transformation, mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation and reconciliation. Support NetSuite Analytics Warehouse and related analytics capabilities where adopted. Design trusted data models and pipelines for reporting and ensure they reconcile to source transactions. Develop and execute unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, failure-mode, cutover and reconciliation tests. Implement logging, automated alerts, transaction tracing, exception queues, retry mechanisms and escalation procedures. Troubleshoot production issues and perform root-cause analysis across systems, data, networks, authentication and business rules. Apply security and data protection standards, including source control, code review, automated testing, environment separation, deployment and change control. Own integration standards, data pipelines, technical documentation and long-term architecture improvements. Work with implementation partners, build internal support capability and prioritize technical debt and enhancements. Develop scalable integration patterns that support growth, acquisitions, customer and vendor onboarding, analytics and automation. We operate in a fast-paced environment where product quality, customer experience, and release speed are critical. We are looking for an Engineering Manager, QA, to lead our Quality Assurance function, strengthen testing practices, and ensure consistent product quality across teams. This role requires strong QA fundamentals, people leadership, excellent execution, and the ability to collaborate closely with Engineering and Product teams. The ideal candidate can build a high-performing QA team, establish effective testing processes, identify risks early, and ensure quality remains a shared responsibility across the organisation. Responsibilities Quality strategy and test planning Own the QA strategy and testing approach across product features and releases. Define test plans, test scenarios, coverage expectations, and release-readiness criteria based on product risks. Ensure functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and end-to-end testing are performed effectively. Identify quality risks early during requirement discussions and ensure appropriate test coverage before development is completed. Establish consistent QA processes and standards across product teams. Ensure testing focuses on customer experience, business-critical workflows, and potential production risks. Release quality and defect management Own QA sign-off and communicate release risks clearly to stakeholders. Drive defect triage, prioritisation, root cause discussions, and follow-up on critical issues. Ensure production defects are analysed and preventive actions are implemented. Monitor defect leakage, regression failures, escaped bugs, and recurring quality issues. Partner with Engineering and Product leaders to make informed release decisions. Balance release timelines with product quality and customer impact. People management and team development Lead, mentor, and develop QA engineers, helping them improve testing skills, product understanding, and ownership. Set clear expectations, goals, and performance standards for the team. Conduct regular feedback and career development discussions. Hire and onboard QA talent as the organisation grows. Allocate team resources based on product priorities and release commitments. Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, proactive communication, and continuous improvement. Encourage team members to take ownership of quality rather than limiting their responsibilities to executing test cases. Cross-functional collaboration Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design teams to ensure requirements are testable and quality risks are identified early. Participate in feature planning, requirement reviews, and release discussions. Ensure QA is involved throughout the development lifecycle rather than only during final validation. Communicate testing progress, blockers, release risks, and quality status to stakeholders. Drive alignment across teams on defect severity, release readiness, and quality expectations. Improve team execution by identifying process bottlenecks and removing unnecessary testing delays. Continuous improvement Improve test planning, test case quality, regression coverage, and testing efficiency. Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual effort and improve QA productivity. Encourage the team to use AI tools where appropriate to support test scenario creation, test documentation, and test analysis. a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; } Short Description We are seeking a highly technical Engineering Manager - Enterprise Data Platform to lead a team of engineers responsible for building and scaling a modern enterprise data platform. This role combines people leadership, platform architecture, and hands-on software engineering. The successful candidate will lead the development of a scalable data ingestion platform that collects data from manufacturing plants, enterprise applications, operational systems, IoT devices, databases, APIs, and streaming sources, transforming it into trusted, governed, and consumable data products within our enterprise data lake. This is a hands-on leadership role where the Engineering Manager is expected to actively contribute to technical design, software development, troubleshooting, and platform innovation while mentoring and growing a high-performing engineering team. Description We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager - Enterprise Data Platform to lead the design, development, and operation of our next-generation data platform. As a technology leader, you will be responsible for managing a team of engineers while remaining deeply involved in architecture, solution design, and software development. You should be equally comfortable defining technical strategy, reviewing architecture, mentoring engineers, and stepping in as a Senior Developer when complex technical challenges arise. You will lead the development of a platform-first ecosystem that enables the efficient onboarding, processing, governance, and consumption of data from diverse enterprise and manufacturing environments. The platform will support analytics, reporting, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and operational decision-making across the organisation. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Engineers, Product Managers, business stakeholders, and data consumers to ensure data is reliable, secure, governed, and accessible at scale. The ideal candidate combines strong engineering management capabilities with deep expertise in data platforms, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and modern AI-enabled engineering practices. Responsibilities Engineering Leadership & People Management Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software, platform, and data engineers. Drive engineering excellence through coaching, code reviews, technical guidance, and best practices. Manage hiring, onboarding, performance development, and career growth of team members. Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Define team goals and ensure alignment with business and platform objectives. Drive delivery excellence through effective prioritisation, planning, and execution. Architecture & Platform Strategy Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for the Enterprise Data Platform. Design scalable, resilient, secure, and cost-effective platform capabilities. Establish architecture patterns for data ingestion, data access, metadata management, governance, and observability. Evaluate architectural trade-offs across batch, streaming, event-driven, and API-based solutions. Act as the technical decision-maker for critical platform initiatives. Hands-On Engineering Actively contribute to software design, development, and code reviews. Step in as a senior developer or technical lead when required to solve complex engineering challenges. Develop and maintain production-grade software and platform services. Lead root cause analysis and implement long-term technical solutions. Ensure engineering teams follow modern software engineering principles, design patterns, and quality standards. Drive automation, standardisation, and platform reusability. Data Ingestion Platform Development Build and scale a cloud-native data ingestion platform capable of collecting data from manufacturing plants, enterprise systems, applications, APIs, databases, IoT devices, external data providers, and streaming platforms. Design and implement ingestion patterns supporting batch, real-time streaming, and Change Data Capture (CDC). Develop reusable ingestion frameworks, connectors, SDKs, and self-service onboarding capabilities. Enable trusted movement of structured and unstructured data into enterprise data lake environments. Improve the reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency of ingestion services. Data Governance, Quality & Observability Design and implement metadata management, lineage tracking, and governance frameworks. Establish enterprise-grade data quality validation and monitoring processes. Enable end-to-end visibility into data movement across the platform. Implement secure and policy-driven data access controls. Develop observability capabilities covering data freshness, reliability, usage, performance, and cost optimisation. AI-Enabled Engineering & Platform Operations Leverage Generative AI and AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate software development, troubleshooting, and operational excellence. Drive adoption of AI-powered solutions for identifying data ingestion failures, schema drift, data quality issues, pipeline bottlenecks, and platform anomalies. Partner with Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists to develop intelligent monitoring, anomaly detection, and automated remediation capabilities. Evaluate and implement AI/LLM-powered approaches for root cause analysis, incident investigation, operational insights, and developer productivity. Promote the effective use of AI-assisted coding, testing, observability, and platform support tools across engineering teams. Collaboration & Stakeholder Management Collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Engineers, Product Managers, and data consumers. Translate business and analytical requirements into scalable platform capabilities. Support AI, Machine Learning, analytics, and reporting initiatives through reliable and accessible data products. Influence platform strategy, engineering standards, and long-term technology decisions. Serve as a trusted technical partner across multiple cross-functional teams. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 10+ years of software engineering experience. 3+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams. Strong experience building large-scale data platforms, distributed systems, or cloud-native applications. Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise data ingestion solutions. Deep expertise in batch, streaming, and Change Data Capture (CDC) architectures. Strong software development experience using Python, Java, or similar programming languages. Experience designing APIs, platform services, and scalable system architectures. Strong understanding of data governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, and access control. title: Network Manager
description:
Network Manager L2/L3 SME & Network Architecture Lead Location: Noida or Gurugram, India
 Shift: Evening/Night Shift (5:30 PM – 2:30AM) Both side Cab facility will be provided 
 Experience Required: 10+ years in networking
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 About the Role We are looking for a Network Manager who is both a hands-on L2/L3 Subject Matter Expert (SME) and a proven people leader. You will own network architecture, stability and roadmap for our voice-led KPO/BPO operations, lead the network engineers and IT SWAT team, and remain the final technical escalation point for the toughest issues. You are accountable for outcomes, not only fixes: uptime, voice quality, team capability and client confidence in our network. You will balance deep technical credibility with strong communication and people management. 
 Environment You Will Own Firewall: SonicWall (primary + secondary/HA), dual ISP, IPSec site-to-site VPN to client peer IP Switching: approx. 15 L3/core devices and 100 L2 access switches Wi-Fi: approx. 30 access points Servers: approx. 10 servers Voice: Vonage DID over internet, VDI-based agent desktops Locations: 3 sites (Noida 2, Gurugram) Monitoring: Zabbix, OPManager (distributed, proxy per site) with SNMP, syslog and scripted path monitoring 
 Key Responsibilities Network architecture and strategy Own the end-to-end network architecture across three sites: WAN/ISP design, dual-ISP and SonicWall HA failover, IPSec VPN to client peers, L3 core and L2 access design, Wi-Fi, and the VDI and voice traffic paths. Define and maintain the network roadmap, capacity plan and lifecycle/refresh plan, with business cases and budgets for IT leadership. Lead design reviews for new sites, new client onboarding, client-mandated connectivity and security requirements, and changes to voice infrastructure. Align the network design with global client security, compliance and audit expectations (for example ISO 27001 and client-specific requirements). L2/L3 SME and escalation ownership Be the final technical authority for firewall, switching, VPN, WAN, VDI connectivity and voice-path issues, and decide whether an issue is fixed on the spot or escalated to a vendor or ISP. Lead triage and the incident bridge on major disruptions, isolating LAN, WAN, VPN, firewall, VDI or carrier-side causes while giving clear updates to leadership and client stakeholders. Diagnose complex IPSec VPN problems (Phase 1/Phase 2 failures, IKE negotiation errors, SA lifetime mismatches, DPD misconfiguration) and interpret traceroute/MTR output and firewall and switch logs. Own root cause analysis and problem management for recurring issues, and track permanent fixes to closure instead of repeating quick fixes. Voice quality and resilience Own voice-quality escalations (jitter, packet loss, MOS, one-way audio, call drops) and decide whether the fix is internal (QoS, shaping, configuration) or needs Vonage engagement. Design, tune and validate QoS so voice (RTP/SIP) is prioritised on shared internet links. Validate dual-ISP failover behaviour and confirm the VPN and voice services re-establish cleanly after a failover. Monitoring, reporting and governance Own the Zabbix monitoring strategy: templates, triggers, severity mapping (P1–P4), dependencies and escalation actions, plus VPN tunnel and MTR/path monitoring to the client peer IP and US voice/application endpoints. Own the weekly issue-trend report and client-facing service reviews: recurring root causes, closure status and permanent-fix proposals. Define and enforce incident, change and problem management processes (ITIL), change windows, runbooks, and network DR/BCP documentation. Team leadership Lead, coach and develop the network engineers and the IT SWAT team across shifts: set goals, review performance, plan skills growth, manage rosters and coverage, and build succession. Build runbooks, escalation matrices and training so that one-engineer-per-shift coverage works without depending on a single person. Hire and onboard network talent, and set the standard for technical interviews and capability assessment. Build a blameless culture of root cause analysis and continuous improvement. Vendor and stakeholder management Own the relationships and SLAs with SonicWall, ISPs and Vonage; manage escalations and provide input on renewals and contracts. Communicate with global clients, operations heads and IT leadership, explaining technical issues and trade-offs in business terms. Partner with Operations, Information Security and Infrastructure teams on changes, audits and client requirements. Required Skills and Experience 12+ years in enterprise networking, with deep experience in the KPO/BPO/ITES industry or a similar voice-dependent, client-facing operation. title: Academic Coordinator
description:
Job Opening: Academic Coordinator 
 Company: Radiant Minds Education Ltd
 Job Title: Academic Coordinator
 Location: Work From Home (Remote India)
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Salary: 50,000 - 60,000 per month (67.2 LPA)
 Working Days: Monday to Saturday (6 days per week)
 Working Hours: 9-hour shift aligned with UK business hours
 Reporting To: Company Directors / Senior Management 
 About Radiant Minds Education Ltd Radiant Minds Education Ltd is a UK-based education and vocational training provider delivering regulated qualifications in areas including Early Years Education, Functional Skills and professional development. We work with recognised UK awarding organisations and are committed to maintaining high standards of teaching, assessment, internal quality assurance, learner support and regulatory compliance. 
 About the Role 
 We are seeking a highly educated, academically accomplished, exceptionally organised and self-motivated Academic Coordinator to oversee academic operations, coordinate learner assessments, provide academic support, undertake academic research and writing, and ensure the smooth delivery of our educational programmes. 
 This is a multifaceted position requiring an individual who can confidently manage academic responsibilities, coordinate with tutors and assessors, maintain accurate educational records and support senior management in achieving academic and organisational objectives. 
 The successful candidate must possess an outstanding academic background, exceptional English writing and communication skills, strong research capabilities and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision . 
 We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate intellectual ability, academic excellence, meticulous attention to detail and a proactive approach to managing responsibilities. 
 Key Roles and Responsibilities 
 1. Academic Coordination Oversee and coordinate the day-to-day academic operations of the organisation. Manage learner enrolment records, academic schedules, assessment deadlines and qualification completion timelines. Monitor learners' academic progress, assignment submissions, outstanding assessments and portfolio completion. Coordinate with tutors, assessors, Internal Quality Assurers (IQAs), learners and management. Maintain accurate learner progress trackers, academic records and assessment documentation. Conduct regular follow-ups with learners to ensure timely completion of academic requirements. Organise online academic support sessions, learner reviews and meetings. Ensure academic activities align with the requirements of UK awarding organisations. 
 2. Academic Writing, Research and Assignment Support 
 Exceptional academic writing and research skills are essential for this position. 
 Prepare high-quality, research-based academic content, model assignments, learning materials, reports and educational resources. Demonstrate strong capabilities in academic analysis, critical evaluation, reflective writing and evidence-based discussion. Conduct independent research using credible academic journals, government publications, educational frameworks and professional guidance. Apply accurate Harvard referencing, in-text citations and reference lists with relevant source URLs . Review, proofread, edit and format academic assignments to ensure clarity, accuracy, relevance and appropriate academic standards. Interpret assignment briefs, learning outcomes and assessment criteria to develop structured guidance and supporting resources. Prepare academic presentations, assessment guidance, teaching materials and professional educational documents. Ensure all academic content is original, appropriately referenced and written in professional British English. Maintain academic integrity and ensure that learner submissions represent the learners' own work. Complete academic writing, research and documentation tasks within strict deadlines. 
 3. Assessment and Quality Assurance Coordination 
 Coordinate assignment submissions, assessment reviews, resubmissions and portfolio completion. Liaise with assessors and IQAs to ensure assessment activities are completed within agreed timelines. Maintain assessment trackers and monitor outstanding evidence, assessment decisions and learner progress. Support the preparation of assessment plans, learner feedback documentation and progress reports. Assist in organising documentation for Internal Quality Assurance (IQA) and External Quality Assurance (EQA) reviews. Maintain accurate records in accordance with UK qualification and awarding organisation requirements. Identify assessment delays, documentation discrepancies and outstanding academic requirements. Support the implementation of quality improvement actions and academic procedures. 
 4. Academic Documentation and Record Management 
 Prepare, format and maintain academic documents, assessment plans, learner progress reports, spreadsheets and presentations. Maintain organised electronic filing systems, learner databases and academic records. Prepare and update academic trackers, assessment schedules and qualification completion reports. Ensure learner records, assessment documentation and academic evidence are accurately maintained. Monitor academic deadlines, outstanding submissions and pending learner requirements. Maintain confidentiality and comply with organisational data protection policies. Ensure all academic documents are professionally formatted, appropriately stored and accessible to authorised personnel. 
 5. Academic Communication 
 Communicate assignment deadlines, assessment requirements and academic updates to learners. Provide clear explanations of assessment criteria, qualification structures and academic expectations. Liaise with UK-based tutors, assessors, awarding organisations and other educational stakeholders. Monitor outstanding academic queries and ensure timely responses. Escalate significant academic concerns or learner progress issues to senior management. 
 6. Academic Planning and Management Support 
 Assist senior management in planning and coordinating academic activities. Prepare academic schedules, progress reports and assessment completion summaries. Monitor departmental academic targets and qualification completion timelines. Coordinate assigned academic tasks and follow up with relevant staff. Prepare meeting agendas, minutes and action plans for academic review meetings. Provide regular updates on learner progress, outstanding assessments and academic performance. Support the development and implementation of academic policies and procedures. 
 7. Compliance, Quality Standards and Reporting 
 Support compliance with UK awarding organisation requirements and relevant educational standards. Maintain accurate academic documentation for internal reviews and external quality assurance visits. Assist with preparation for audits, inspections and awarding organisation reviews. Monitor academic quality, assessment deadlines and documentation requirements. Prepare daily and weekly academic progress reports for management. Identify gaps in academic records, learner evidence and assessment documentation. Support continuous improvement in academic delivery, assessment practices and learner outcomes. 
 Essential Academic Qualifications 
 A consistently strong academic background is a mandatory requirement for this position. 
 A Bachelor's degree from a recognised university is essential. A Master's degree is strongly preferred , particularly in English, Education, Early Childhood Education, Psychology, Sociology or a related academic discipline. Candidates with an M.Phil., PhD or other advanced academic qualifications will be given additional preference. Applicants should demonstrate consistently strong academic performance throughout their education. Candidates educated at reputed universities or recognised academic institutions with excellent academic records will be preferred. Exceptional English language proficiency, analytical thinking and academic comprehension skills are essential. Strong research, critical evaluation, report writing and professional documentation skills are mandatory. 
 Important: Academic qualifications alone will not be sufficient. Candidates must demonstrate the practical ability to produce high-quality academic work, coordinate educational activities and communicate professionally. 
 Essential Skills and Competencies Academic and Writing Skills Exceptional written and spoken English, with strong command of British English. Advanced academic writing, proofreading, editing and research capabilities. Ability to interpret complex academic instructions, learning outcomes and assessment criteria. Excellent critical thinking, analytical reasoning and problem-solving skills. Ability to independently prepare professional academic documents and educational resources. 
 Organisational and Technical Skills Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint. Good working knowledge of Google Workspace and cloud-based document management. Confidence in using Microsoft Teams, Zoom and online collaboration platforms. Experience maintaining academic trackers, spreadsheets, reports and electronic databases. Excellent organisational, multitasking and time-management skills. High attention to detail, accuracy and consistency in documentation. 
 Professional and Personal Attributes Highly self-motivated, dependable and accountable. Capable of working independently with minimal supervision. Proactive in identifying problems and implementing solutions. Excellent professional communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to manage multiple academic responsibilities and meet strict deadlines. Strong sense of confidentiality, integrity and professionalism. Willingness to take ownership of academic tasks and accept responsibility for outcomes. Adaptability and flexibility when working with UK-based teams and academic requirements. 
 Experience Requirements Candidates should ideally have relevant professional experience in one or more of the following areas: 
 Academic coordination or educational administration. Academic content development, research, assignment support or educational writing. Curriculum development, teaching or educational resource preparation. Academic quality assurance, assessment documentation or compliance support. Remote academic coordination for UK-based or international educational organisations. 
 Previous experience in the UK education or vocational training sector will be a significant advantage. Familiarity with the Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS), UK-regulated qualifications, awarding organisations and assessment processes will be highly desirable. 
 Working Arrangements Work Mode: 100% Remote / Work From Home. Working Days: Monday to Saturday. Shift Duration: 9 hours per day, aligned with UK business hours. Candidates must be comfortable adjusting their working schedule according to UK daylight saving time. Regular communication will take place through email, Microsoft Teams, Zoom and other online platforms. Daily academic task updates and periodic progress reports must be provided to management. Candidates must have a personal laptop/computer, reliable high-speed internet connection and a suitable private working environment. Professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality and availability during working hours are essential. 
 Ideal Candidate Profile 
 We are looking for an intellectually capable, academically strong, highly articulate and exceptionally organised professional who can combine academic expertise with effective educational coordination. 
 The ideal candidate will have an excellent educational record, advanced English writing skills, strong research abilities and the confidence to manage complex academic responsibilities independently. 
 They should be equally comfortable preparing research-based academic materials, coordinating learner assessments, communicating with tutors and assessors, maintaining academic records and supporting senior management with academic planning. 
 We are seeking a high-calibre academic professional who demonstrates academic excellence, independent judgement, strong accountability and a genuine commitment to educational quality. 
 Please note: This is a full-time, six-day working position requiring a nine-hour shift aligned with UK business hours. Applicants must be comfortable managing academic responsibilities independently from home.

title: Senior Technical - Project Manager
description:
About the Role We are building a modular, end-to-end air cargo platform that covers the airline cargo offer, order and operations. As Senior Technical Project Manager, you will lead the delivery of this platform across a complex landscape of new and legacy products, multiple technology and product teams. You will be the connective tissue between technology, product, sales and business development, and the Delivery GPMs who own customer implementations and migrations from the legacy product to the new platform as well as green field. Your job is to keep a multi-team, multi-product program aligned, predictable, and moving. 
 Role & responsibilities: 
 Platform program delivery Own end-to-end delivery planning for the modular platform, including roadmap, milestones, dependencies, release plans, and budget tracking Manage cross-module and cross-product dependencies, integration points, and shared services Drive release readiness, go-live planning, cutover and rollback strategy, and hypercare 
 Technology and product alignment Work with engineering leads, architects, and QA across both new-platform and legacy-product teams Partner with product managers for new and existing products to align roadmap priorities, scope, and release sequencing Balance investment between building new capabilities, and delivering migration tooling Surface technical risks early (data quality, performance, integration complexity, regulatory and security constraints) and drive mitigation plans 
 Migration, transition, and customer implementation Work closely with Delivery PMs to plan and de-risk legacy-to-new-platform migrations and brand-new customer implementations Define repeatable implementation and migration playbooks, templates, and readiness criteria Coordinate platform capacity, environments, and engineering support against the implementation pipeline Manage the feedback loop from implementations back into product and engineering backlogs Support data migration, parallel-run, and cutover planning with customers and internal teams 
 Commercial and stakeholder collaboration Work with sales and business development on solution feasibility, delivery timelines, and commitments before and during deal cycles Translate customer commitments into delivery plans and flag capacity or scope conflicts early Provide clear, regular reporting to executives on progress, risks, dependencies, and forecasts Facilitate prioritization and trade-off decisions between competing demands from product, customers, and engineering 
 Agile governance and process Partner with Scrum Masters across teams to align sprint cadences, program increments, and cross-team planning Maintain RAID logs, program dashboards, and delivery metrics (predictability, cycle time, defect trends, migration progress) Establish and improve program governance, escalation paths, and ways of working across distributed teams Ensure documentation and change management practices meet customer, security, and regulatory expectations 
 Customer enablement and readiness Lead the planning and readiness of customer enablement programs that prepare airline customers to adopt the platform successfully. Work with Delivery GPMs, product, and customer success teams to define training curricula, user documentation, sandbox and test environments, and onboarding materials for each module. Establish clear enablement readiness criteria (such as trained user groups, completed user acceptance testing, operational procedures, and support handover) that must be met before go-live, and track them as formal gates in the implementation and migration plans. Ensure enablement content stays aligned with product releases, and feed customer adoption feedback and training gaps back into the product and engineering backlogs. 
 Required Qualifications 8+ years in technical project or program management, with at least 3 years leading multi-team platform or enterprise software delivery Proven experience delivering complex programs that involve both legacy and new products, including migration or modernization Strong technical grounding in software architecture, APIs, integrations, microservices, cloud platforms, and data migration Experience of working with customer implementation or professional services teams Hands-on experience with Agile at scale SAFe and hybrid delivery models Excellent stakeholder management, with the ability to influence senior leaders across technology, product, and commercial functions Strong skills in risk management, dependency management, and executive communication Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and portfolio or roadmap tools Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience 
 Key Competencies Systems thinking across technology, product, and operations Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities in a transformation program Strong negotiation skills when balancing customer commitments against engineering capacity Credibility with engineers and senior executives alike Structured, data-driven approach to planning and reporting Success Measures Modules and releases delivered on schedule and to agreed quality Migrations and new implementations executed predictably, with fewer surprises at cutover Reusable implementation and migration playbooks adopted by Delivery GPMs Clear alignment between sales commitments, product roadmap, and engineering capacity High stakeholder confidence and transparent, timely reporting 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Experience in air cargo, airline, logistics, or aviation technology (e.g., cargo reservations, revenue management, ground handling, load control, cargo accounting, IATA standards such as Cargo-XML and e-AWB) Experience with SaaS platform implementations for airlines or large enterprise customers Familiarity with multi-tenant and modular platform architectures Experience managing delivery across global, distributed teams and time zones PMP, PgMP, SAFe Program Consultant, or similar certification Exposure to presales or solution-scoping activities

title: Lead Engineer Integrated Smart Pole Solutions
description:
JOB PURPOSE : Smart pole development Own the end-to-end architecture, integration, development and validation of an integrated Smart Pole solution combining smart lighting, video surveillance, environmental sensing, EV charging and digital LED display capabilities. Deliver a secure, interoperable, remotely managed solution by integrating field devices, embedded firmware, communication protocols and software platforms into a scalable, reliable product for smart cities, infrastructure and commercial applications. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Define end-to-end system architecture for an integrated Smart Pole, covering smart LED lighting, CCTV/IP cameras, environmental sensors (air quality, temperature, humidity, noise and other applicable parameters), EV chargers, digital LED display/signage and the central connected management platform. Translate business, customer and project requirements into system specifications, interface-control documents, block diagrams, integration plans, acceptance criteria and product requirements. Lead hardware, embedded firmware, device, network and application integration across heterogeneous vendors and technologies; manage interface dependencies and resolve system-level issues. Integrate communication and application protocols such as MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, REST APIs, Modbus, TCP/IP, ONVIF, RTSP, BLE, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, LoRaWAN, cellular and other relevant protocols as applicable to selected devices. Define and integrate device onboarding, provisioning, configuration, remote monitoring, diagnostics, alarms, OTA firmware/software updates, data logging, dashboards and fleet/device lifecycle management. Lead firmware and software integration with cloud/edge platforms, mobile/web applications, analytics, video management systems, lighting controls, EV charging management systems and third-party enterprise/city platforms. Establish cybersecurity-by-design for devices and platforms, including secure boot, signed firmware, identity and certificate management, authentication/authorization, encryption, key management, network segmentation, vulnerability management and secure update mechanisms. Ensure interoperability, scalability, availability and performance across multi-vendor devices; define fallback modes, offline behaviour, time synchronisation, data integrity and fault recovery. Plan and execute integration testing, system verification, field trials, reliability testing, cybersecurity testing and user acceptance; manage defects through root-cause analysis and closure. Coordinate with electronics, mechanical, lighting, firmware, software, cloud, cybersecurity, EV charging, camera, sensor, display, manufacturing, quality, sourcing and service teams, as well as external technology partners. Evaluate vendors and technical solutions; review datasheets, SDKs, APIs, protocol specifications, firmware release notes and compliance evidence. Drive proof-of-concepts and technical due diligence. Prepare and maintain architecture documents, interface specifications, BOM inputs, test plans, deployment guides, service procedures and technical documentation. Support design-for-manufacturing, installation and commissioning, remote serviceability, lifecycle management, cost optimisation and product roadmap planning. Drive project execution, risks, milestones and technical reviews; mentor engineers and ensure delivery against agreed quality, cost, performance and schedule targets. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS 
 Bachelors degree in Electronics / Electronics & Telecommunication / Electrical / Instrumentation / Computer Engineering or a related discipline. Master’s degree or relevant specialisation in embedded systems, IoT, networking, cybersecurity or systems engineering is an advantage. WORK EXPERIENCE 
 10–12 years of relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, system integration, connected devices or industrial/urban technology solutions. Demonstrated ownership of at least one complex, multi-device solution from architecture and proof-of-concept through integration, validation and deployment. Hands-on experience integrating hardware, firmware, communication protocols, APIs and cloud/edge software across multiple vendors. CERTIFICATIONS 
 Relevant certifications in IoT, embedded systems, networking, cloud architecture or cyber-security are desirable (e.g., cloud/IoT platform, networking or security certifications). PREFERRED/ ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENT 
 Strong understanding of embedded Linux/RTOS, device drivers, firmware lifecycle, OTA updates, APIs, SDKs, databases and cloud/edge architectures. Practical exposure to smart lighting controls, IP video surveillance, environmental sensors, EV charging systems and digital signage is highly desirable. Experience with MQTT brokers, REST APIs, device management platforms, Linux tools, packet/protocol analysis and integration/debugging tools. Knowledge of device and platform security, secure coding practices, threat modelling, vulnerability handling and relevant standards such as IEC 62443 is an advantage. Ability to read schematics, interface diagrams, protocol documents and firmware/software logs; strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills. Experience in smart city, street lighting, infrastructure, industrial IoT or public-space deployments is preferred. Willingness to support field integration, commissioning and troubleshooting at customer/vendor locations as required. REPORTEES 
 May guide and coordinate integration engineers / cross-functional project resources; formal direct reportees to be defined based on project structure. INTERNAL / EXTERNAL INTERFACE 
 Internal: R&D – Electronics, Firmware, Software, IoT/Cloud, Lighting, Mechanical, Cybersecurity, Quality, Testing & Validation, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Product Management, Sales/Projects and Service. External: Camera, sensor, EV charger, LED display and lighting suppliers; system integrators; cloud/platform partners; telecom/network providers; cybersecurity/testing agencies; customers, EPCs and smart-city/municipal stakeholders. FUNCTIONAL COMPETENCIES 
 System architecture and systems engineering IoT and multi-protocol integration / API integration Embedded firmware and device lifecycle management Cloud/edge platform and application integration Device, network and platform cybersecurity Integration planning, verification, validation and field commissioning Technical documentation, vendor evaluation and root-cause analysis Project execution, risk management and cross-functional coordination BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES
